Conclusion: HGPTrans能兼顾局部与全局几何信息，实现高精度、高效率的车辆阻力系数预测，适用于大规模早期设计探索并具良好泛化能力。

Abstract: Accurate and rapid prediction of the aerodynamic drag coefficient ($C_D$) is essential for vehicle design, particularly during early-stage styling iterations where a large number of candidate geometries must be evaluated. Although computational fluid dynamics (CFD) provides reliable aerodynamic estimates, its high computational cost, typically requiring hours to days for a single configuration, limits its use in large-scale design exploration. This paper proposes HGPTrans, a hierarchical graph-pooling network with Transolver-based attention, to directly predict $C_D$ from vehicle surface meshes. Motivated by the fact that vehicle aerodynamics depends on both local geometric features and long-range interactions among spatially distant surface regions, HGPTrans integrates three complementary components. Graph isomorphism convolutions encode discriminative local geometry, physics-aware slice attention captures global interactions with linear computational complexity, and information-redundancy-aware hierarchical pooling progressively removes redundant nodes while preserving informative geometric structures. The model is trained and evaluated on the large-scale DrivAerNet and DrivAerNet++ datasets, where it achieves the lowest mean absolute error and mean squared error among the evaluated baselines. Its generalization capability is further assessed through transfer learning on a real-vehicle dataset containing both sedans and SUVs, achieving relative $L_1$ errors of 1.56% (sedans) and 2.12% (SUVs) with an inference time of approximately $0.293$ s per vehicle. This corresponds to an acceleration of several orders of magnitude relative to high-fidelity CFD while keeping the predicted drag coefficients within a few percent of the CFD reference. Ablation studies confirm each component's contribution and reveal the effects of depth and pooling ratio.

</details>

*Xinjin Li,Lian Lian,Yuanzhe Yang,Yudi Xia,Calvin Chang Liu,Yeyun Xu,Yu Ma,Jinghan Cao,Yuruo Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"方向性多尺度覆盖"表示，用于图文事实核查中的图像-主张对应关系建模，并在Fauxtography基准上取得优于MCOT的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像-主张配对检测器通常将两种模态压缩为单一全局相容性分数或采用高度灵活但难以解释的交互模块，容易掩盖关键的局部不匹配。

Method: 提出方向性多尺度覆盖（directional multiscale coverage）：在三个空间尺度上、双向汇总局部图像-主张亲和性。每个尺度每个方向用均值、下四分位数和两个阈值化支持比率进行概括，方向均值之差构成九维尺度描述子；拼接三个尺度得到紧凑的局部表示，再输入轻量级全局-局部分类器（UNMATCH）。

Result: 在Fauxtography基准的Snopes子集上进行泄漏感知的三折三种子评估，UNMATCH达到69.82 Macro-F1和71.05平衡准确率，分别超过MCOT适配版2.60和2.16个点。匹配-重分配干预实验显示，破坏原有配对会降低覆盖度并提高差异度与假配对概率。

Conclusion: 紧凑的方向性多尺度局部表示能有效捕捉决定性的局部不匹配，提升图文事实核查中图像-主张对应判定的性能。

Abstract: Contextual image misuse pairs an image with a misleading claim. We study image-claim correspondence in fact-checked pairs containing out-of-context reuse, visual manipulation, or both. Existing pair-based detectors often compress the two modalities into a global compatibility score or learn a highly flexible interaction module, which can obscure a decisive local mismatch. We introduce directional multiscale coverage, a compact representation that summarizes local image-claim affinity in both directions and at three spatial scales. At each scale, each direction is summarized by its mean, lower quartile, and two thresholded support ratios; the signed difference between directional means completes a nine-dimensional scale descriptor. Concatenating the three scales yields a compact local representation for a lightweight global-local classifier. Under leakage-aware three-fold, three-seed evaluation on the Snopes subset of the Fauxtography benchmark, UNMATCH achieves 69.82 Macro-F1 and 71.05 balanced accuracy, exceeding the MCOT adaptation by 2.60 and 2.16 points. A matched-reassigned intervention shows that breaking the observed pairing lowers coverage and increases both discrepancy and false-pair probability.

</details>


### [56] [Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31780)
*Chika Maduabuchi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PSP-DiT，将全景场景程序作为一类潜变量与图像潜变量联合去噪，显著提升组合式文本到图像生成的计数、属性绑定与角色敏感关系等能力，且几乎不损失图像质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代文本到图像模型虽能生成高保真图像，但在需要实例身份、属性归属、计数、空间排序和角色敏感关系的组合式提示上仍表现不佳，作者希望从建模范式上解决这一问题。

Method: PSP-DiT 是一种扩散 Transformer 架构，把全景场景程序（panoptic scene program）作为一等潜变量，而非外部控制信号或事后解析结果；它通过耦合的 Transformer 流对图像潜变量与场景程序潜变量进行联合去噪，并引入全景 grounding 与循环一致性目标，将对象实例、属性、关系和计数与生成图像中的视觉支撑绑定。

Conclusion: 将全景场景程序作为潜变量并与图像联合去噪，是提升组合式文本到图像生成能力的有效途径，且在质量、开销与鲁棒性之间取得良好平衡。

Abstract: Modern text-to-image models produce high-fidelity images but still struggle with compositional prompts that require instance identity, attribute ownership, counting, spatial ordering, and role-sensitive relations. We introduce Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer (PSP-DiT), a diffusion-transformer architecture that treats a panoptic scene program as a first-class latent variable rather than an external control signal or post-hoc parse. PSP-DiT jointly denoises image latents and scene-program latents through coupled transformer streams, while panoptic grounding and cycle-consistency objectives tie object instances, attributes, relations, and counts to visual support in the generated image. Under matched training and inference settings, PSP-DiT improves over a strong flat-text baseline across GenEval 2, SANEval-Simple, PSG-Score, and DetailMaster, with the largest gains on counting, attribute binding, role-sensitive relations, and long structured prompts. The method preserves image quality, adds modest inference overhead, and remains robust to imperfect scene programs.

</details>


### [57] [SelfCue: Making a 3D CT Report Generator Say What It Already Knows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31788)
*Renjie Liang,Yang Yang,Jinqian Pan,Zhengkang Fan,Chengkun Sun,Jie Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文发现3D CT报告生成模型的隐状态中已包含报告遗漏的信息，提出基于对比解码的SelfCue方法激发其潜力，并通过知识蒸馏得到无需额外推理开销的SelfCue-KD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D CT报告生成研究多聚焦于更复杂的架构和更大训练数据，但作者发现模型隐状态其实已包含报告中遗漏的信息，只是解码成token时丢失了，即存在"隐状态到报告"的涌现鸿沟。

Conclusion: SelfCue-KD作为学生模型无需额外推理开销，可直接嵌入已部署基线模型的任何流程，为3D CT报告生成提供了高效实用的改进方案。

Abstract: Progress in 3D CT report generation is usually sought in increasingly sophisticated architectures and larger pools of training data. We find instead that a 3D CT report generator already holds what its report leaves out, and loses it when the hidden state becomes tokens. Over the 18 CT-RATE abnormalities, this hidden-to-report surfacing gap is reflected by a drop in macro AUROC from 0.848 in the hidden states to 0.739 in the generated report. We propose SelfCue based on contrastive decoding. It promotes what the hidden state already supports and suppresses what it does not. It raises clinical efficacy F1 to 0.481 and the LLM-judged GREEN score to 0.510. Distilling that behaviour into the weights gives SelfCue-KD, a student that keeps most of the gain, needs nothing extra at inference, and drops into any pipeline already serving the baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/renjie-liang/SelfCue-CT.

</details>


### [58] [Rate-Adaptive One-Step Diffusion Compression for AIGC Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31795)
*Nitiz Khanal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文报告了LoViF 2026 AIGC图像压缩挑战赛的参赛方案：基于AEIC一步扩散编解码器的四档码率专用微调、逐图候选生成、生成精炼与rANS熵编码，并通过多重选择背包问题在真实码流大小下择优，最终以0.02495 BPP取得PSNR 27.02 dB、MS-SSIM 0.9176、LPIPS 0.0778、DISTS 0.0390，总得分31.527739，位列最终测试阶段排行榜第5名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AIGC生成图像在0.025 BPP的超低码率预算下难以压缩：传统面向失真优化的编解码器会抹除渲染文字、合成边缘、重复母题与微纹理，而无约束的生成式解码器又会生成看似合理却与源几何或符号不符的细节。作者将问题重新定义为"码率-感知分配"问题，旨在受限预算下保住感知质量与结构一致性。

Method: 微调AEIC一步扩散编解码器的四个码率专用检查点；对每张图由四个检查点生成候选，其中一个隐变量经编码端测试时优化（TTO）并周期性刷新熵条件；用实用的rANS对每个候选做熵编码；以真实编码文件大小构建精确多重选择背包问题，每图只选一条码流；解码时施加零额外比特的固定残差恢复网络。所有提交码流由随附解码器独立解码，不使用源图或外部辅助信息。

Result: 最终得分31.527739；在0.02495 BPP下PSNR 27.02 dB、MS-SSIM 0.9176、LPIPS 0.0778、DISTS 0.0390。DISTS为排行榜第二佳，最终测试阶段排行榜排名第5（2026年8月4日公布）。

Conclusion: 本文属挑战赛报告，公开了完整流程、覆盖77次日志实验的消融历程以及若干负面结果，其中包括该架构下PSNR为何无法与面向率失真的参赛方案持平的分析，对后续参赛者有参考价值。在极低码率下，以感知质量为导向的码率分配与候选择优策略有效，但保真度指标仍为该类生成式编解码架构的短板。

Abstract: We describe our entry to the LoViF 2026 AIGC Image Compression Challenge, a benchmark for ultra-low-bitrate coding of AI-generated images under a strict global rate budget of 0.025 bits per pixel (BPP). Generated imagery poses a distinct challenge for compression: it frequently contains rendered typography, synthetic edges, repeated motifs, UI-like layout, and stylized micro-texture that conventional distortion-oriented codecs erase at this rate, while unconstrained generative decoders can restore plausible-looking detail that no longer matches the source geometry or symbols. We treat this as a rate-perception allocation problem. Our system fine-tunes four rate-specialized checkpoints of the AEIC one-step diffusion codec, generates per-image candidates from all four, including one latent refined through encoder-side test-time optimization (TTO) with periodic entropy-conditioning refresh, entropy-codes every candidate with practical rANS coding, and selects exactly one bitstream per image with an exact multiple-choice knapsack solved over true coded file sizes. A fixed, zero-additional-bit residual restoration network is applied at decode time. Every submitted bitstream is independently decodable by the shipped decoder, which uses no source image or external side information. We report the full pipeline, an ablation history spanning 77 logged experiments, and a set of negative results, including why PSNR could not be pushed to parity with rate-distortion-oriented competitors under this architecture, useful to future participants. This is a challenge report: our entry scored 31.527739 (PSNR 27.02 dB, MS-SSIM 0.9176, LPIPS 0.0778, DISTS 0.0390 at 0.02495 BPP), the second-best DISTS on the leaderboard, ranking 5th on the final test-phase leaderboard announced August 4, 2026.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 标签效率具有任务依赖性，为在复杂领域中分配专家标注投入提供了指导蓝图，并公开代码与检查点推动后续研究。

Abstract: Developing label-efficient models is a central challenge in surgical AI due to the high cost and scarcity of expert annotation. While self-supervised foundation models adapt well to new tasks with minimal data, how label efficiency varies across different surgical tasks remains largely unexplored.
  Here, we introduce SURGE, a surgical foundation model trained on SurgSpectrum-30M+, the largest pretraining dataset comprising over 30 million frames, with checkpoints released to enable further research. We systematically evaluate label efficiency across 5 task categories and 15 benchmarks. These range from temporal and spatial scene understanding to fine-grained reasoning tied to instrument-anatomy interactions and safety-critical maneuvers.
  SURGE outperforms prior state-of-the-art on all benchmarks, even surpassing task-specific models on complex reasoning tasks. Crucially, we reveal a task-dependent scaling behavior: while scene understanding tasks saturate with minimal supervision, fine-grained reasoning tasks continue improving with substantially larger annotation budgets, providing a blueprint for allocating expert effort in complex domains.
  Code: https://github.com/CAMMA-public/SURGE

</details>


### [60] [SynDORBench: Evaluating LVLM Perceptual Robustness Under Physically Constrained Visibility Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31823)
*Jeremy Stephen Gabriel Yee,Zhengkui Wang,Zhiyuan Zhang,Avinash Anand,Timothy Liu,Benedict Chan,Aik Beng Ng,Simon See*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出SynDORBench，首个基于DORI物理成像条件的基准，用于评测LVLM在真实感知约束下的鲁棒性，并揭示像素密度比模型规模更决定感知失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LVLM评测多假设理想视觉输入，无法刻画相机距离、光照、视角和像素密度对语义可恢复性的根本影响，导致物理成像约束下的感知可靠性认识不足。

Method: 构建SynDORBench，含5.4万+问答对，通过可控合成流程系统变化观看距离、光照、相机几何与动作姿态，对齐DORI像素密度区间；并提出可判别性标注框架，用掩码条件统计特征与集成学习传播人类感知标签。

Result: 在16个开源LVLM、1个商用LVLM基线和YOLO11x上评测人类存在分类与动作识别，发现LVLM感知失败主要由像素密度和物理成像约束决定，而非模型规模；部分小型开源LVLM在远距离和低光下优于更大商用基线并显著超过YOLO11x。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on multimodal reasoning benchmarks, yet their perceptual reliability under physically constrained imaging conditions remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations predominantly assume ideal visual inputs and therefore fail to characterize how camera distance, illumination, viewpoint, and pixel density fundamentally affect semantic recoverability. We introduce SynDORBench, the first physically grounded benchmark for evaluating LVLM perceptual robustness under DORI-calibrated conditions aligned with human visual capability standards. SynDORBench comprises over 54k question--answer pairs generated through a controllable synthetic pipeline that systematically varies viewing distance, lighting, camera geometry, and action pose according to physically interpretable pixel-density regimes. To support scalable low-visibility supervision, we further propose a discernibility annotation framework that propagates human perceptual labels using mask-conditioned statistical features and ensemble learning. We evaluate 16 open-source LVLMs, a commercial LVLM baseline, and YOLO11x across human-presence classification and action recognition tasks under progressively degraded visibility conditions. Our results reveal that perceptual failure in LVLMs is strongly governed by pixel density and physical imaging constraints rather than model scale alone. Surprisingly, several compact open-source LVLMs outperform larger commercial baselines and substantially exceed YOLO11x robustness under long-range and low-light conditions. SynDORBench establishes a new benchmark paradigm for physically grounded multimodal evaluation, enabling systematic analysis of LVLM reliability under real-world perceptual constraints and direct comparison against human visibility thresholds.

</details>


### [61] [CueKFS: Agentic Cue-Driven Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31873)
*Weitai Kang,Hanieh Deilamsalehy,Yumo Xu,Dewang Sultania,Serdar Cellat,Yan Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CueKFS是一种免训练的关键帧选择方法，将问题-帧匹配重构为与动态生成的视觉线索（cues）比对，通过智能体式线索修正实现长视频问答帧选择，在三个基准27个设置上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频问答中，均匀采样效率低，而现有基于问题的关键帧选择方法多按问题与帧的相似度排序。但当问题组合了单帧无法同时呈现的主体或时刻，或需要字面未提及的隐式信息时，相关帧相似度评分偏低；基于子查询分解的方法又因静态初始上下文导致分解不准确。

Method: 提出CueKFS免训练方法：从一组初始显著帧出发，将问题分解为多个视觉线索；每个线索并行探测视频以导航到各自的证据；推理VLM根据证据智能体式地修正线索集合，重新探索视频；最后在存活的线索间分配帧预算。

Result: 在三个基准的全部27个可比设置上均取得SOTA，预算平均提升最高达+4.54%，VLM调用中位数仅2次。行为分析显示，智能体式线索修正驱动视频主动再探索，相较初始上下文相似度相对提升最高达92%。

Conclusion: CueKFS通过动态视觉线索与智能体式修正，克服了静态分解与单帧相似度的局限，以极低VLM调用成本实现高效且优越的关键帧选择。

Abstract: Keyframe selection (KFS) has long produced compact video summaries for browsing and retrieval, and representative frames for thumbnails. More recently, when conditioned on a question, KFS provides an alternative to uniform sampling for long-video question answering by selecting frames that are more relevant to the question. Most methods rank frames by similarity to the question. Yet a relevant frame may score poorly when the question combines subjects or moments that no single frame shows, or requires implicit information absent from its wording. Other methods try to break down the question into subqueries, but suffer from inaccurate decomposition due to their static initial context. Therefore, we propose CueKFS, a training-free method that reformulates question--frame matching as comparing frames against a set of dynamically generated visual cues. From an initial set of salient frames, we decompose the question into cues. Each cue concurrently probes the video to navigate to its own evidence. A reasoning VLM then agentically revises the cue set against its evidence to re-explore the video. CueKFS then allocates the budget across the surviving cues. Across three benchmarks, CueKFS establishes state-of-the-art results in all 27 evaluated settings with available prior results, achieving budget-averaged gains of up to +4.54% over the previous baseline and a median of only two VLM calls. We further provide a detailed behavioral analysis of CueKFS, showing that agentic cue refinement drives active re-exploration of the video, yielding relative similarity gains of up to 92% over the initial context.

</details>


### [62] [Auditing Quality Filters for Long-Tail Human Data Curation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31896)
*Rishav Agarwal,Nirshal Chandra Sekar,Anirudh Vemula*

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑工地机器人需检测跪姿、弯腰等"低姿态"工人，但这类样本在自动标注的训练数据集里容易丢失。作者希望探究低姿态稀缺的成因，尤其是流程中质量过滤器的作用，以指导长尾人体数据的筛选方法。

Result: 低姿态仅占保留样本约2%。四种线索一致显示低姿态更常被过滤器拒斥（如低检测置信度或关节估计不确定）。仿真表明即便校正边界框高度，微调检测器仍会漏检更多这类姿态的工人。

Conclusion: 低姿态样本既稀缺又难以发现，不能单纯依赖边界框或姿态估计来为长尾人体数据进行筛选与整理。

Abstract: Robots on construction sites must detect workers who are kneeling or bending, which we call low poses. These workers can be lost from training datasets during automatic labeling. This low share may partly reflect the pipeline's quality filter, which rejects examples with low detection confidence or uncertain joint estimates. We examine this filtering using four alternative pose clues: bounding-box shape, vertical body span, pose grouping aligned to the scene's vertical direction, and image appearance. All four suggest that low poses are rejected by the filter more often. Separately, controlled simulated scenes show that a person detector fine-tuned on a public construction dataset misses more workers in these poses even when we correct their bounding box height is matched to that of standing workers. These findings suggest that low poses are scarce and hard to find, and we cannot rely on bounding boxes or poses for long-tail human data curation.

</details>

*Denis Musinguzi,Andrew Katumba,Prasenjit Mitra*

Main category: cs.CV

  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 强化学习带来了仅靠SFT无法达到的性能增益；联合验证推理步骤与最终输出比单独验证任一者带来更大提升。研究还识别出RL阶段多种奖励黑客（reward hacking）模式。

Abstract: Medical report generation has made significant progress with the rise of modern vision-language models and the growing availability of large-scale medical datasets. However, hallucinations remain a major challenge, largely due to the limitations of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which prioritizes lexical similarity to reference reports rather than clinical correctness. While reinforcement learning has shown strong performance in domains with verifiable rewards such as mathematics and code generation, its application to open-ended medical tasks remains limited. Existing work focuses on evaluating final answers, overlooking the model's reasoning, despite evidence that flawed reasoning can degrade overall performance. In this study, we propose a framework that verifies the model's reasoning process by integrating anatomical regions, bounding boxes, and region-level textual descriptions. We design spatial and factual reward mechanisms to ensure that the model's reasoning is both visually grounded and factually accurate. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as our base model, we adapt it to the medical domain using supervised fine-tuning, introduce reasoning capability through a cold-start SFT stage, and refine it with reinforcement learning. We find that RL provides performance gains beyond those achievable through SFT alone, and that jointly verifying both reasoning steps and final outputs yields larger improvements than verifying either in isolation. We further identify multiple modes of reward hacking in the RL stage. Finally, the model's structured think traces enhance interpretability, making its outputs easier to audit for clinical use.

</details>


### [64] [PredRA: Fast Medical Image Translation by Deterministic Component Extraction and Controlled Stochastic Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31912)
*Jianhai Zhang,Pattarawut Charatpangoon,Donghao Zhang,Bijoy K. Menon,Wu Qiu,M. Ethan MacDonald,Aravind Ganesh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PredRA将确定性预测作为稳定参考，从残差中提取额外确定性成分并全局控制残差细化幅度，实现快速、保真且感知强的医学图像翻译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强配对医学图像翻译中存在大量可直接从源图像预测的成分。纯确定性预测会平滑掉细节，而生成模型虽能恢复细节却可能引入不必要甚至有害的变化。现有方法难以在保真度与感知质量之间取得良好平衡。

Method: PredRA以确定性预测为稳定参考，将整个基于残差的生成过程视为优化问题并推导实用解，在生成细化过程中从残差中提取额外的确定性成分，同时全局控制残差细化的添加量，以减少不必要不确定性的累积。

Result: 机制研究表明有用的残差信息遵循结构化模式，但在体素级别难以可靠估计其有用性，因此采用全局控制策略。在多个真实数据集上验证，受控细化相比完整残差细化提升了对配对目标的保真度，同时保留生成建模的感知优势。PredRA总参数少1.4-11.9倍、可训练参数少3.1-26.2倍，性能仍具竞争力或更优；其32步流采样器比匹配的1000步DDPM少31.25倍采样步数。

Conclusion: PredRA结合确定性成分提取与受控随机细化，实现了快速、保真且感知强的医学图像翻译，在显著更小模型规模和更少采样步数下达到甚至超越大型最先进模型的性能。

Abstract: Strongly paired medical image translation contains a substantial component that can be predicted directly from the source. The current reality is that pure deterministic prediction can smooth away fine detail, while generative models can recover detail but may also introduce unnecessary or potentially harmful variation. We propose PredRA, a fast framework that uses the deterministic prediction as a stable reference and further extracts additional deterministic components from the residual during generative refinement, thereby improving fidelity while maintaining perceptual quality. The goal is simple: we view the entire residual-based generative process as an optimization problem and derive a practical solution that recovers useful residual detail through controlled refinement while keeping the prediction close to the paired target. Mechanism studies further show that useful residual information follows structured patterns, but its usefulness is difficult to estimate reliably at the voxel level. We therefore globally control how much of the residual refinement is added to the deterministic prediction, thereby reducing the accumulation of unnecessary uncertainty. PredRA therefore combines deterministic component extraction with controlled stochastic refinement for fast, fidelity-preserving, and perceptually strong medical image translation. We validate the approach across multiple real-world datasets, showing that controlled refinement improves fidelity to the paired target compared with full residual refinement while retaining much of the perceptual benefit of generative modeling. PredRA achieves competitive or superior performance to substantially larger state-of-the-art models with 1.4-11.9x fewer total parameters and 3.1-26.2x fewer trainable parameters, while its 32-step flow sampler requires 31.25x fewer sampling steps than the matched 1000-step DDPM.

</details>

*Roshan Babu Bandlapalli,Srinivas V Katakam,Jitendra Chougala,Ravi Kumar Kappagantu,Jayasri Dontabhaktuni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可在标准CPU硬件上运行的混合量子-经典人脸识别流程，在5万张图像数据集上优于CPU训练的FaceNet基线，并已在实际考勤场景中部署验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合量子方法在资源受限的人脸生物识别领域研究不足，作者希望探索在普通计算硬件（CPU）上部署混合量子人脸识别的可行性。

Method: 图像先进行伽马校正、对比度增强和主成分分析（PCA），提取的特征编码进一个八量子比特的变分量子分类器，再由经典图像匹配完成识别。方法在CPU、GPU及量子硬件上均进行了评估。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持在现有CPU硬件上部署混合量子人脸识别方法的可行性，并已通过实际考勤监控场景验证。

Abstract: Hybrid quantum methods have received limited study for resource-constrained facial biometrics. We present a hybrid quantum-classical facial recognition pipeline designed to run on standard computing hardware. Images undergo gamma correction, contrast enhancement, and principal component analysis before their features are encoded into an eight-qubit variational quantum classifier. Classical image matching then performs recognition. In experiments with 50,000 images, comprising 25,000 faces from CelebA and 25,000 non-face images from CIFAR-10, the method outperformed the reported CPU-trained FaceNet baseline in accuracy and training efficiency. The pipeline was also evaluated on GPU and quantum hardware. In an attendance monitoring deployment at Mahindra University in collaboration with Lloyds Technology Centre, CPU inference took 0.2 to 0.5 seconds per person, and the system remained robust to the use of spectacles. These findings support the feasibility of deploying hybrid quantum methods for facial recognition on existing CPU hardware.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式验证码对计算机使用智能体仍是难题，现有数据集在类型覆盖、交互保真度与轨迹监督之间存在权衡，亟需一个大规模、细粒度且经过执行验证的数据集。

Abstract: Interactive CAPTCHAs remain challenging for computer-use agents, while existing datasets face trade-offs among type coverage, interaction fidelity, and trajectory supervision. To address these gaps, we present CaptchaArena, the first large-scale, fine-grained training dataset for interactive CAPTCHA solving. It contains 50K puzzles across 20 CAPTCHA types and 5 interaction modes, with every solution verified through execution. CaptchaArena provides 50K screenshot-action trajectories, including 46K with step-by-step reasoning annotations. It also includes fine-grained pixel-mask annotations for irregular targets. Using CaptchaArena, we train CaptchaAgent, a single 9B policy for all 20 CAPTCHA types, with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. The environment verifier directly provides the RL reward. Supervised fine-tuning reaches 70.5 Pass@1, and reinforcement learning further improves it to 71.7, while also improving performance on two external benchmarks. These results demonstrate the value of large-scale, fine-grained computer-use supervision for training interactive CAPTCHA agents. We release CaptchaArena and CaptchaAgent at https://github.com/X0X0X00/CaptchaArena.

</details>


### [67] [Double-Edged Sword of Mediated Visibility: How Visual Framing Undermines Congresswomen's Perceived Competence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31970)
*Bryce J. Dietrich,Hyein Ko,Myriam Shiran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 议会女性占比长期停滞在30%以下，电视新闻中她们的视觉呈现更为受限。对CNN与Fox News十年间69万余个图文片段的分析及两项预注册实验表明：女性议员更多以分屏而非单人镜头出现；分屏降低其被感知的政治能力，而愤怒语言对其亲和力的损害约为男性议员的三倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 女性在国会中的代表性长期低于30%，而这种制度性不足也反映在电视新闻的低可见度上。视觉呈现会影响受众对能力与权威的感知，但既有研究多关注女性议员"是否出现"，较少探讨她们"如何被视觉框定"，因此本文聚焦视觉框架的作用。

Result: 人脸识别分析显示，女性议员在分屏镜头中被不成比例地过度呈现，而非单人镜头。静态帧实验中，分屏框架降低了女性议员被感知的政治能力，对男性议员则无此效应；在动态视频中，这一能力惩罚消失，但愤怒语言对女性议员亲和力的削弱约为男性议员的三倍。另有提示性证据（p = .057）表明，女性观众在观看女性议员独自出镜后外部政治效能感更高。

Conclusion: 视觉框架既塑造女性议员在媒介中的可见性，也影响对其能力的评价。分屏等呈现方式对女性政治人物存在不对称的负面效应，而动态情境与愤怒语言的作用机制有所不同，提示媒介呈现形式是性别化政治评价的重要变量。

Abstract: Women's presence in Congress has stalled below 30%. That institutional underrepresentation is mirrored by their limited visibility on televised news, where visual presentation can shape perceived competence and authority. Yet research tells us more about whether congresswomen appear than how they are visually framed. Facial recognition analysis of 695,464 image-text segments from CNN and Fox News (2011-2021) reveals that congresswomen appear disproportionately in split-screen rather than solo shots. Two pre-registered experiments with 6,220 participants show that, in static frames, split-screen framing reduces congresswomen's perceived political competence, but not congressmen's. In dynamic videos, the competence penalty disappears; instead, outraged language reduces a congresswoman's perceived warmth roughly three times as much as a congressman's. Suggestive evidence (p = .057) indicates that women viewers report greater external political efficacy after watching a congresswoman appear alone. We conclude that visual framing shapes both congresswomen's mediated visibility and their perceived capabilities.

</details>


### [68] [Does Vision-Language Pretraining Granularity Matter? A Controlled Evaluation of Vision-Language Objectives Across Chest X-Ray Interpretation Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31985)
*Denis Musinguzi,Andrew Katumba,Prasenjit Mitra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究通过控制编码器与预训练数据，系统比较九种视觉-语言预训练目标在五个空间粒度递增的胸片任务上的表现，揭示预训练粒度与任务粒度、目标类型的交互决定下游性能，无单一最优目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言预训练目标在监督的空间粒度上存在差异，但这种差异对胸片（CXR）解读的影响尚未被充分探索，缺乏对预训练目标本身的受控研究。

Method: 固定编码器与预训练数据，仅隔离改变预训练目标，训练涵盖全局与局部对比学习、图文描述（captioning）及其组合的九种目标；在五个空间粒度递增的胸片任务上进行评估。

Result: (i) 两端粒度上预训练粒度与任务粒度一致：局部目标在异常检测上领先，全局目标在分类上领先；(ii) 局部目标在全球层级的生成与问答任务上出人意料地有竞争力；(iii) captioning与对比学习的优势随粒度反转；(iv) 组合目标中，混合captioning与对比监督在分类及分布内生成最强，两个captioning目标配对在零样本报告生成上泛化最佳。

Conclusion: 没有任何单一预训练目标是普遍最优的，目标类型、粒度与任务之间的交互共同决定下游性能。

Abstract: Vision-language pretraining objectives differ in the spatial granularity of their supervision, yet the implications of this distribution for chest X-ray interpretation remain underexplored. We present a controlled study that isolates the pretraining objective: holding the encoder and pretraining data fixed, we train nine objectives spanning global and local contrastive learning, captioning, and their combinations, and evaluate across five chest X-ray tasks of increasing spatial granularity. We find that (i) pretraining granularity aligns with task granularity at the extremes, with local objectives leading on abnormality detection and global objectives on classification; (ii) local objectives are surprisingly competitive on global-level generation and question answering tasks; (iii) the merits of captioning and contrastive learning reverse across granularity levels; and (iv) among combinations, mixing captioning and contrastive supervision is strongest on classification and in distribution generation, while pairing two captioning objectives generalizes best on zero-shot report generation. These results show that no single objective is universally optimal, and that the interaction of objective type, granularity, and task governs downstream performance.

</details>


### [69] [Type-Balanced Federated Learning for Visual Analog Meter Reading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31998)
*Weida Zhao,Logan Bellamy,Yazhou Tu,Jiaqi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个联邦学习框架用于视觉模拟仪表读数，允许各站点在不共享原始图像的情况下协同训练，并发布了MeterFL数据集用于系统评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟指针仪表广泛部署于工业和公用事业场景，但环境与表型多样、检查数据可能敏感。现有自动抄表需针对每种环境和表型单独开发部署，深度学习方案虽能应对多样性却依赖大量昂贵的标注数据；而实际中图像分散在独立站点、标注有限，且因所有权、治理或隐私限制无法汇聚原始图像。

Method: 提出面向视觉模拟仪表读数的联邦框架，使多站点协作训练读数模型而无需共享原始图像。框架为四阶段流水线：(1) 表盘定位；(2) 跨客户端联邦训练的细结构分割；(3) 极坐标展开；(4) 用于最终读数的刻度计数解码。同时发布MeterFL数据集，含1,382张带掩码标注图像，按视觉属性通过确定性规则组织为部署动机驱动的伪客户端，并用dHash在分割训练/测试划分间做近重复控制。

Abstract: Analog dial meters are widely deployed in industrial applications and utility sites, where environments and meter types vary and inspection data may be sensitive. Currently, automatic meter readers must be individually developed and deployed for each environment and meter type in practice. Deep learning could handle this variability but requires diverse labeled data that are costly to collect and update. In practice, meter images are distributed across independent sites, each with limited labels, while raw images often cannot be pooled because of ownership, governance, or privacy constraints. To address these challenges, we present a federated framework for visual analog meter reading that enables multiple sites to collaboratively train a reading model without sharing their raw images. Our framework consists of a four-stage pipeline: (1) dial localization, (2) thin-structure segmentation trained federatively across clients, (3) polar unwrapping, and (4) tick-counting decoding for final reading. To enable systematic evaluation of this setting, we release MeterFL, a 1,382-image mask-annotated dataset organized into deployment-motivated pseudo-clients derived from visual attributes via deterministic rules, with dHash near-duplicate control between the segmentation train and test splits. We evaluate both segmentation quality and end-to-end reading accuracy. MeterFL is publicly available at https://github.com/weidazhaoooo/Meter-FL.

</details>

*Quinlan Sykora,Sourav Biswas,Christopher Diehl,Andrew Cunningham,Thomas Gilles,Raquel Urtasun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TriO是一种多模态无监督世界模型，可预测4D占据、障碍物分割、光流和LiDAR，利用相机、LiDAR、RADAR三种模态同时作为输入与自监督来源，无需人工标注，在多项3D/4D任务上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在处理长尾物体（开放集场景）时存在局限，且依赖人工标注。作者希望利用多模态传感器之间的互补性作为自监督信号，消除对额外人工标注的需求。

Method: TriO以相机、LiDAR和RADAR三种传感器模态作为输入，同时将其作为自监督来源；通过这种新颖的多模态监督方式，模型能够从可行驶路面中分割出任意占据区域。

Result: 在多项3D和4D任务上取得SOTA，包括占据预测、光流预测、LiDAR预测，以及在Argoverse 2和Spotting the Unexpected等多个数据集上的零样本道路障碍物分割。

Conclusion: TriO通过多模态自监督实现了无标注的多任务世界模型学习，克服了现有开放集方法在长尾物体上的不足，并展现了良好的跨数据集泛化能力。

Abstract: We present TriO, a multi-modal unsupervised world model that predicts 4D occupancy, obstacle segmentation, flow and LiDAR. In contrast to prior work, TriO utilizes three distinct sensor modalities (camera, LiDAR, and RADAR) as both inputs and sources of self-supervision, eliminating the need for additional human annotations. Thanks to its novel supervision, the model is able to segment any occupancy from the drivable surface, overcoming the limitations of existing open-set methods in handling long-tail objects. TriO achieves state-of-the-art results in multiple 3D and 4D tasks, including occupancy, flow, and LiDAR prediction, as well as zero-shot road obstacle segmentation across multiple datasets such as Argoverse 2, and Spotting the Unexpected.

</details>


### [71] [Depth Any Seen: Which Surfaces and How Far?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32027)
*Xiaohao Xu,Xiaonan Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究单幅图像中多表面（多层可见表面）的可见3D结构恢复，提出将表面表示为图像条件下的多伯努利深度集合，并揭示现有目标函数在组件-表面分配上的缺陷，通过对比实验验证改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当一条光线穿过多个可见表面时，从单幅图像恢复可见3D结构需要同时估计这些表面的存在性与度量深度。现有多伯努利深度集合方法（如ExactMB）通过边缘化一对一指派来学习深度与存在性，但作者分析发现，仅匹配期望计数可能无法解决组件与表面之间的指派问题，因此需要更细致的评估与改进。

Method: 作者将表面建模为图像条件下的多伯努利深度集合，每个组件对应一个深度或缺失。分析ExactMB目标中"匹配期望计数"导致的指派不确定问题。扩展真实与合成分层深度基准（LD-Real、MD-3K、LD-Syn），评估深度精度、恢复支撑集（recovered support）与过度预测。并开展消融研究，比较有序指派与边缘化、以及计数正则化配置的效果。

Result: 相比depth stacking，ExactMB在LD-Real上相对减少88.2%的过度预测，在MD-3K上减少80.5%，同时保留大部分序数精度；在LD-Syn上条件度量深度误差相当。消融显示，有序指派在深度准确的召回率与精确率上优于边缘化；而计数正则化配置在较低召回下实现更高的更深秩精确率（deeper-rank precision）。

Conclusion: 仅匹配期望计数不足以确定组件-表面指派，需结合有序指派或计数正则化等策略。ExactMB在显著降低过度预测的同时保持深度精度，不同指派策略在召回率与精确率之间存在权衡。代码将公开。

Abstract: When several surfaces are visible along a ray, recovering visible 3D structure from one image requires jointly estimating their presence and metric depth. Depth Any Seen represents these surfaces as image-conditioned multi-Bernoulli depth sets, whose components each contribute one depth or remain absent. Its auxiliary-free Exact Multi-Bernoulli objective (ExactMB) learns depth and presence by marginalizing one-to-one assignments to complete, distinct targets. Our analysis shows that matching expected count can leave component-surface assignment unresolved. We extend real and synthetic layered-depth benchmarks to evaluate depth accuracy, recovered support, and overprediction. Compared to depth stacking, ExactMB reduces overprediction by a relative 88.2% on LD-Real and 80.5% on MD-3K while retaining most ordinal accuracy, with comparable conditional metric-depth error on LD-Syn. Further ablation studies show that ordered assignment improves depth-accurate recall and precision over marginalization, whereas the count-regularized configuration achieves higher deeper-rank precision than ordered assignment at lower recall. Our code will be publicly released.

</details>


### [72] [ScreenHaystack: Finding Blind Zones in GUI Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32036)
*Chenyue Li,Xiaoxiao Sun,Yubo Deng,Qinlin Zhao,Serena Yeung-Levy,Yuhui Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 ScreenHaystack 基准，通过系统性地在高分辨率 GUI 背景中移动目标图标，发现主流 GUI grounding 模型存在"盲区"，这些盲区可迁移到未见数据，并可通过针对盲区的数据增强策略改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GUI grounding 评估通常在固定位置测试目标，无法衡量模型在空间上的可靠性。作者希望揭示模型是否存在依赖于目标位置的系统性失效区域，并探究其成因与解决方案。核心动机是发现并解释 GUI grounding 模型的空间"盲区"现象。

Method: 提出屏幕针里找针基准 ScreenHaystack：在高分辨率 GUI 背景上系统性地重定位受控目标图标，测量模型能否一致地定位它们。通过该基准评估 Qwen3-VL、UI-TARS、GTA、UI-Venus 等主流模型；并通过受控合成实验验证训练数据空间覆盖不均会导致盲区；进而提出 blind-zone-oriented augmentation（盲区导向增强）策略，在盲区增加监督信号。

Result: 主流 GUI grounding 模型（如 Qwen3-VL、UI-TARS、GTA、UI-Venus）存在盲区，即在目标外观和指令固定的情况下，某些空间区域定位准确率急剧下降。这些盲区可迁移到未见过的 ScreenSpot-Pro 样本：盲区内目标更难定位，Qwen3-VL-8B 下降 16.1 个百分点；受控重定位显示，将目标移入盲区准确率下降，移出则提升。合成实验表明训练数据空间覆盖不均会诱发盲区。盲区导向增强在 Click-100k 微调下优于原始和随机增强，提升了 ScreenSpot-Pro 准确率。

Conclusion: GUI grounding 模型存在可迁移的空间盲区，其成因可归结为训练数据空间覆盖不均；通过盲区导向的数据增强可有效缓解该问题并提升 grounding 性能。ScreenHaystack 为评估空间可靠性提供了新的基准视角。

Abstract: We introduce ScreenHaystack, a dynamic needle-in-a-haystack benchmark for evaluating spatial reliability in GUI grounding. Instead of testing each target at a fixed position, ScreenHaystack systematically relocates controlled target icons across high-resolution GUI backgrounds and measures whether models can localize them consistently. Using this benchmark, we find that leading GUI grounding models, including Qwen3-VL, UI-TARS, GTA, and UI-Venus, exhibit blind zones: spatial regions where grounding accuracy drops sharply despite fixed target appearance and instruction. These blind zones transfer to unseen ScreenSpot-Pro examples: targets inside blind zones are consistently harder to ground, with Qwen3-VL-8B dropping by 16.1 percentage points, and controlled relocation shows that moving targets into blind zones decreases accuracy while moving them out improves accuracy. We further show through controlled synthetic experiments that uneven spatial coverage in training data can induce such blind zones. Therefore, we propose a simple strategy, blind-zone-oriented augmentation, which adds supervision in blind zones and improves ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy over both original and randomly augmented Click-100k fine-tuning.

</details>


### [73] [ControlGS: Conditioning Neural Gaussians for Downstream-Processing-Aware XR Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32038)
*Weikai Lin,Junjie Zhao,Carl Marshall,Sushant Kondguli,Yuhao Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ControlGS 提出一种面向扩展现实（XR）的端到端高斯渲染管线，将渲染输出到人眼之间的全部下游处理纳入优化目标，并依据下游处理参数动态生成高斯基元，在多种神经高斯骨干与数据集上以极小开销持续提升端到端光学后画质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: XR 用户看到的并非渲染引擎的直接输出，渲染图像还需经过后处理管线与显示-光学路径才能到达眼睛。而这一下游处理在运行时可能因相机位姿、显示功耗预算等因素发生显著变化。传统 3DGS 方法要么默认下游管线能保持画质，要么无法适应下游处理变化，导致端到端视觉质量受限。

Method: ControlGS 将渲染输出与人眼之间的整个下游处理过程建模并整合进优化目标，实现端到端优化；为适应运行时下游处理的变化，它以条件方式依据下游处理参数动态生成高斯基元。

Result: 实验表明，ControlGS 在不同神经高斯骨干网络和数据集上都能持续提升端到端的光学后 XR 画质，且额外开销极小。代码已开源于 https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/。

Conclusion: 通过把下游显示-光学处理纳入优化并使其自适应运行时参数，ControlGS 有效弥合了传统 3DGS 与真实 XR 显示链路之间的差距，为 XR 端到端视觉质量优化提供了通用且低开销的方案。

Abstract: Extended Reality (XR) users do not directly perceive the output of a rendering engine. Instead, rendered images pass through a post-processing pipeline and the physical display-optics path before reaching the eye. Critically, the exact downstream processing can vary significantly at run time, influenced by, for instance, camera pose and display power budget. Traditional 3DGS methods either implicitly assume that this downstream pipeline preserves image quality or cannot adapt to downstream processing changes. To bridge this gap, we present ControlGS, an XR Gaussian rendering pipeline that optimizes end-to-end visual quality. ControlGS models and integrates the entire downstream processing, between the rendering output and the human eye, into the optimization objective. To adapt to downstream processing at run time, ControlGS dynamically generates Gaussian primitives conditioned upon the downstream processing parameters. Experiments show that ControlGS consistently improves end-to-end post-optics XR quality across different neural Gaussian backbones and datasets, with minimal overhead. Code is available at https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/.

</details>


### [74] [Amnesia by Design, Memory By Necessity: Persistent State for Document Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32041)
*Souhail Bakkali,Ayoub Merimi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"无状态瓶颈"概念，指出当前Document AI系统是无状态函数，无法跨会话保留与演化文档状态；作者形式化了"持久化、证据落地的文档状态"框架，通过状态性审计揭示现有基准未测试跨会话状态演化，并提出包含五项反事实指标的纵向基准工具，以刻画持久文档状态的收益、成本、风险与可治理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代Document AI能阅读合同、抽取字段、推理表格并将答案定位到页面区域，但处理完即遗忘。例如次日处理一份修订时需从头开始，不保留模式、不检测矛盾、不累积经验。作者强调这是结构性选择而非规模不足所致：当前系统本质上是无状态函数。该瓶颈无法仅靠参数扩展、上下文延长或检索增强解决——存储提供持久性、检索提供访问，但二者都未能将观察结果整合为可改善未来处理的知识。

Method: 作者将"持久化、证据落地的文档状态"形式化为一个统一框架，明确规定了将多模态证据转化为持久、与来源（provenance）关联的状态所需具备的操作与不变量。同时开展"状态性审计"：以八项状态性标准编码并评估十个代表性基准。基于审计结果，作者设计了一套纵向基准测试工具（longitudinal benchmark harness），包含五项反事实度量指标。

Result: 状态性审计表明，十个代表性基准均未测试跨会话的状态演化。作者提出五项反事实度量指标用于刻画持久文档状态：Experience Gain（经验增益）、Cost Efficiency（成本效率）、Memory Harm（记忆损害）、Forgetting Fidelity（遗忘保真度）、Coverage Retention（覆盖保持），分别对应收益、成本、风险与可治理性四个维度。

Conclusion: 当前Document AI缺乏将持久状态与文档原生结构、来源追溯和时间有效性相耦合的机制。作者主张，Document AI的下一时代将由其系统在跨文档、跨会话和跨时间维度上"保留了什么"来定义。

Abstract: Modern Document AI reads contracts, extracts fields, reasons over tables, and grounds answers to page regions, then forgets everything. Processing an amendment the next day begins from scratch: no schema retained, no contradiction detected, no experience carried forward. This is a structural choice, not a scale failure: current systems are stateless functions. We call this the statelessness bottleneck. This bottleneck lies beyond parameter scaling, context extension, and retrieval augmentation: storage provides persistence and retrieval provides access, but neither consolidates observations into knowledge that improves future processing. This survey formalizes persistent evidence-grounded document state as a unifying framework, specifying the operations and invariants required to convert multimodal evidence into durable, provenance-linked state. We introduce a statefulness audit showing that ten representative benchmarks, coded against eight statefulness criteria, leave cross-session state evolution untested, and derive a longitudinal benchmark harness with five counterfactual metrics: Experience Gain, Cost Efficiency, Memory Harm, Forgetting Fidelity, Coverage Retention, to characterize the benefit, cost, risk, and governability of persistent document state. Document AI lacks mechanisms coupling persistent state to document-native structure, provenance, and temporal validity. The next era of Document AI will be defined by what systems retain across documents, sessions, and time.

</details>


### [75] [ReFM: Semantic-Aware Refinement Flow Model for Motion Retargeting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32068)
*Jingxiang Qu,Lucie Taglienti,Evan Atherton*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出ReFM，一种源网格无关、能量引导的运动重定向框架，将重定向重新表述为渐进式细化过程，通过对比学习获得角色不变语义表示，并引导流模型逐步优化目标运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有运动重定向方法面临两个根本问题：一是在缺乏高质量配对重定向数据时难以学习可靠的源运动语义；二是当没有可靠配对运动作为明确回归目标时，重定向任务该如何表述。现有方法通过将预测约束向复制运动靠拢来保留语义，但这会将有用的关节线索与骨骼比例和身体几何不匹配产生的伪影纠缠在一起。此外，单次前向回归最终运动具有局限性，因为重定向本质上是欠定的，理想解需在语义保真度与目标特定的物理和时间约束之间取得平衡，而非匹配唯一的配对目标。

Method: ReFM包含几个关键组件：首先使用SO(3)规范化器去除冗余的全局方向变化；其次，通过对比学习预训练的跨角色语义编码器提供角色不变的表示，用于优化引导和语义评估；然后，ReFM通过学习的流逐步细化初始化的目标运动，该流由语义一致性、物理合理性、时间连贯性和最小运动修改共同引导。该框架兼容不同的初始化策略，包括直接运动复制和Autodesk HumanIK这一工业级全身逆运动学重定向系统。

Result: ReFM实现了源网格无关的运动重定向，能够在缺乏配对重定向数据的情况下学习可靠的语义表示，并通过渐进式细化平衡语义保真度与目标特定的物理和时间约束。框架与多种初始化策略兼容，包括直接运动复制和Autodesk HumanIK系统。

Conclusion: ReFM通过将运动重定向重新表述为能量引导的渐进式细化过程，有效解决了配对数据缺乏和欠定回归目标两个根本挑战，为跨骨骼结构的运动迁移提供了新的解决思路。

Abstract: Motion retargeting transfers motion across characters with different skeletal structures while preserving semantic intent and physical plausibility. Despite recent progress, two fundamental questions remain: (i) how can reliable source-motion semantics be learned without high-quality paired retargeting data, and (ii) how should retargeting be formulated when no reliable paired motion can serve as a definitive regression objective? Existing methods commonly preserve semantics by constraining predictions toward copied motions. However, such initializations entangle useful articulation cues with artifacts caused by mismatched skeletal proportions and body geometry. Moreover, directly regressing a final motion in one forward pass is restrictive because retargeting is inherently underdetermined, and the desired solution must balance semantic fidelity with target-specific physical and temporal constraints rather than match a unique paired target. Motivated by these limitations, we propose ReFM, a source-mesh-agnostic, energy-guided model that reformulates motion retargeting as progressive refinement. First, an SO(3) canonicalizer removes redundant global-orientation variations. Second, a cross-character semantic encoder, pretrained through contrastive learning, provides a character-invariant representation for both optimization guidance and semantic evaluation. ReFM then progressively refines an initialized target motion through a learned flow guided by semantic consistency, physical plausibility, temporal coherence, and minimal motion modification. The framework is compatible with different initialization strategies, including both direct motion copying and Autodesk HumanIK, an industry-standard full-body inverse-kinematics retargeting system.

</details>


### [76] [Gaussian Image Steganography via Parameter-Domain Keyed Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32131)
*Tong Wu,Runze Cheng,Xiaoyue Fan,Kaan Akşit*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于2D高斯表示的隐写方法，将信息嵌入高斯参数而非图像像素中，在保持高视觉保真度的同时实现近零错误率的信息恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2D高斯图像表示日益流行，现有隐写多基于像素层面。作者希望探索在高斯参数层面嵌入信息的新途径，以在重建图像中保持高视觉保真度并提升安全性。

Method: 先将高斯表示参数拟合到目标图像，再用密钥选择参数子集进行微调以嵌入8位消息。选取扰动最小的编辑而非随机选择。嵌入通过三类高斯参数实现：对数各向异性、不透明度和颜色亮度。并设计了去除颜色亮度的九次拟合简化设置进行对比。

Result: 在三张合成图像上的30次拟合实验中，正确密钥可无误恢复消息，错误密钥BER为0.543（接近随机猜测）。选取最小扰动编辑比随机选择更可靠（单侧p=0.031），平均PSNR代价仅0.091 dB。方法迁移到112张256×256自然图像（4096个高斯）：正确密钥BER为0.000，错误密钥BER为0.520。在简化设置中，参数类型从三类降至两类（减少33.3%），正确密钥仍无误恢复，但错误密钥BER从0.514升至0.571。

Conclusion: 在高斯参数空间嵌入信息的隐写方法可行，能在保持高视觉保真度的同时实现正确密钥下的无误恢复；减少嵌入参数类型可维持正确密钥性能，但会改变错误密钥的BER特性。

Abstract: 2D Gaussian-based image representation is becoming increasingly popular, and our work proposes a new approach to steganography by embedding information within Gaussian parameters rather than image pixels. We first fit the parameters of this representation to the target image and employ a secret key to select a subset of these parameters for fine-tuning, allowing us to embed an 8-bit message while maintaining high visual fidelity in the reconstructed image. Thirty fitting experiments on three synthetic images show that the correct key can recover the message without error, while decoding with incorrect keys yields a Bit Error Rate (BER) of $0.543$, close to random guessing. Compared with random selection using the key, selecting the least-disturbing edits recovers the message more reliably (one-sided $p=0.031$), and the average PSNR cost is only $0.091$ dB in visual quality. The embedding method transfers to 112 natural images at $256\times256$ using 4,096 Gaussians. The correct-key BER is $0.000$, and decoding under a wrong key stays close to random guessing at $0.520$. Our method embeds the payload through three Gaussian parameter types: log-anisotropy, opacity, and color luminance. In a separate nine-fit reduced setting, color luminance is removed, so the payload uses two instead of three parameter types, a $33.3\%$ reduction; all 256 Gaussians remain in the fitted representation. The correct key still recovers the message without error. However, wrong-key BER rises from $0.514$ to $0.571$, moving farther from random guessing ($0.5$).

</details>


### [77] [CausalDriveBench: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32157)
*Narendiran Chembu,Navvrat Rao,Shreedhar Shreeshail Kodate,Gayatri Srujana Banda,Arko Sarkar,Abhinav Khanna,Rajarshee Das,Umesh Kanala,Siddarth Khandelwal,Kumar Aman,Aish Dubey,Kaustubh Beedkar,Arjun Jain*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出CausalDriveBench，一个基于Pearl因果层级（PCH）的评测框架，用于检验自动驾驶视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的因果推理能力，并发现现有模型的推理与轨迹预测均不足以证明其具备因果理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶VLA模型在输出轨迹的同时会给出自然语言推理，但这类推理是否反映了场景的因果结构尚缺乏检验，现有评测难以区分感知显著性与因果相关性。

Method: 基于nuScenes构建因果场景图，区分因果活跃、休眠与干扰实体，并据此生成覆盖PCH四个层级（关联、干预、反事实及因果发现）的结构化视觉问答（QA）；对高层级还提供场景修改下的参考轨迹，实现对推理层与动作层的双重验证。共构建7,285个已验证因果QA对与1,000条反事实轨迹，并评测10个驾驶专用VLA与3个通用VLM。

Result: 最佳模型QA准确率仅70.6%，13个模型中有4个低于随机水平；与共享语言骨干的通用VLM相比，驾驶微调在因果QA上的代价为2至34个百分点，差异由后训练设计解释；因果QA准确率与轨迹准确率在模型间统计上不相关，反事实提示下预测轨迹要么过度反应，要么退化到观测场景基线。

Conclusion: 流畅的推理文本与准确的观测场景轨迹都不能作为模型具备因果理解的证据，自动驾驶VLA的因果推理能力仍存在显著缺陷。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving produce natural-language reasoning alongside predicted trajectories, but whether this reasoning reflects the causal structure of the scene remains untested. We introduce CausalDriveBench, an evaluation framework grounded in Pearl's Causal Hierarchy (PCH) that tests causal reasoning in driving-specific VLAs through structured visual question answering (QA) and alternative-trajectory prediction. To this end, we construct causal scene graphs over nuScenes that distinguish causally active, dormant, and distractor entities, separating perceptual salience from causal relevance. The benchmark spans all four rungs of PCH (association, intervention, and counterfactual along with causal discovery) for QA generation. For the higher rungs, we additionally provide reference trajectories under specified scene modifications, enabling action-level verification that complements reasoning-level evaluation. In total, the benchmark contains 7,285 verified causal QA pairs and 1,000 counterfactual trajectories derived from nuScenes. We evaluate 10 driving-specific VLAs and 3 general-purpose VLMs, and report three findings. First, the best model reaches only 70.6% QA accuracy, and 4 of 13 models score below random chance. Second, comparing each driving VLA to the general-purpose VLM that shares its language backbone, the cost of driving fine-tuning ranges from 2 to 34 percentage points on causal QA, with post-training design explaining the spread. Third, causal QA and trajectory accuracy are statistically uncorrelated across models: under counterfactual prompts, predicted trajectories either over-react or collapse onto the observed-scene baseline. Taken together, these results show that neither fluent rationales nor accurate observed-scene trajectories constitute evidence of causal understanding.

</details>


### [78] [PruneForget: Joint Unlearning and Pruning of Vision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32162)
*Yu-Shan Tai,Amber Yijia Zheng,Raymond A. Yeh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 PruneForget，将机器遗忘与模型剪枝联合求解，把遗忘集作为剪枝引导，使二者相互受益，在图像分类器和生成模型上取得接近 oracle 的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中遗忘与剪枝常需同时满足：模型既要支持遗忘请求（如安全考虑），又要满足延迟和内存预算。现有工作通常将两者独立处理（如先遗忘再剪枝），忽略了二者内在联系。作者指出编码被遗忘样本信息的参数天然是剪枝目标，因为遗忘与剪枝都需要"删除"这些参数，因此应联合求解、相互感知。

Method: 提出 PruneForget 方法，使用遗忘集（unlearn set）作为剪枝的指导信号，使遗忘与剪枝相互促进、彼此受益，实现二者的联合优化。

Result: 在图像分类器和生成模型上的大量实验表明，PruneForget 在消除被遗忘样本影响的同时，产生更紧凑的模型并降低推理成本，其性能与"从头重训练完成遗忘后再剪枝"的 oracle 相比差距可忽略。

Conclusion: 遗忘与剪枝本质上是自然对齐的，应联合求解而非顺序独立处理；PruneForget 通过以遗忘集引导剪枝，实现了遗忘效果与模型紧凑性的双赢，接近 oracle 上界表现。

Abstract: Machine unlearning and model pruning are increasingly coupled in the real world. Models must support unlearning requests, e.g., for safety concerns, while also meeting requirements in latency and memory budget. Until recently, existing works have studied each aspect as an independent problem, e.g., running unlearning and pruning sequentially. In this work, we show that unlearning and pruning are naturally aligned and should be solved jointly to be made aware of each other. Intuitively, parameters that encode information of the unlearned samples are natural pruning targets, as unlearning and pruning both call for the "deletion" of such parameters. We propose PruneForget, a method that uses the unlearn set as a guide for pruning, so that unlearning and pruning mutually benefit each other. Extensive experiments on image classifiers and generative models show that PruneForget removes the influence of the unlearned samples while producing a more compact model with reduced inference cost. It achieves a negligible performance gap relative to an oracle that retrains from scratch for unlearning and then prunes.

</details>


### [79] [PQR3D: Progressive Query Refinement over Reference-Conditioned Temporal Windows for Multi-View 3D Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32163)
*Hui Ye,Yudong Liu,Yiran Chen,Rajshekhar Sunderraman,Shihao Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PQR3D，一种参考条件时间窗口内的渐进式查询细化方法，用ViT-L在nuScenes测试集上达到71.6 NDS和64.9 mAP的最新最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间上下文对纯视觉多视角3D目标检测很关键，但现有流式检测器需维护并传递跨帧查询状态，导致必须进行序列感知训练和按时序推理，缺乏灵活性。

Method: 在参考条件时间窗口内进行渐进式查询细化，支持随机帧采样与独立推理，无需持久查询记忆；窗口内将运动对齐的高置信查询从较早时刻逐步传递到目标帧；引入掩码自注意力调节常规、传播与去噪查询的交互，并隔离去噪监督；采用阶段解耦的锚点嵌入，在自注意力前注入位置，在自注意力后注入尺寸、朝向和速度。

Result: 使用ViT-L骨干网络，在nuScenes测试集上取得71.6 NDS、64.9 mAP，刷新最优结果。源码已开源。

Conclusion: PQR3D通过窗口内渐进查询细化摆脱了流式检测器的持久记忆依赖，实现了灵活的随机采样与独立推理，并在nuScenes上达到新的SOTA。

Abstract: Temporal context is essential for camera-only multi-view 3D object detection. Existing streaming detectors maintain and propagate query states from one frame to the next, requiring sequence-aware training and chronological inference. We propose PQR3D, which performs progressive query refinement within referenceconditioned temporal windows. This design enables random frame sampling and independent inference without persistent query memory. Within each window, PQR3D progressively transfers motion-aligned high-confidence queries from earlier timestamps toward the target frame. We further introduce masked selfattention to regulate interactions among regular, propagated, and denoising queries while keeping denoising supervision isolated from detection queries. In addition, a stage-decoupled anchor embedding injects position before self-attention and size, orientation, and velocity afterward, reducing interference from temporally inconsistent attributes. With a ViT-L backbone, PQR3D sets a new state of the art on the nuScenes test set, achieving 71.6 NDS and 64.9 mAP. Source code is available at https://github.com/huiyegit/PQR3D

</details>


### [80] [OneFixer: High-Quality and Consistent One-Step Autoregressive 3DGS Refinement for Driving Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32175)
*Boseong Jeon,Junhyeop Lee,Juhan Cha,Hayoung Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OneFixer 是一种单步自回归视频扩散修复器，通过"部署匹配的共享 rollout"策略，让模型自身的一步预测同时作为流匹配的因果上下文和像素级感知监督目标，从而在单个任务适配阶段内联合学习保真度与自回归鲁棒性，在自动驾驶 3DGS 仿真中实现低延迟、高质量、时序一致的视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS 在自动驾驶仿真中的渲染需要"render-time fixer"来提升画质，但部署要求低延迟下的高视觉质量与时序一致性。对单步因果生成而言，每一帧的不完美预测会立即成为后续帧的上下文，误差累积严重。现有方法依赖多模块分阶段训练和 rollout 感知正则化来稳定 rollout，但单步质量仍不达部署要求。

Method: 核心思想是"部署匹配的共享 rollout"：模型自身的一步预测被用作流匹配的因果上下文，使训练直接暴露于部署时的误差；同时同一 rollout 接受直接的像素空间感知监督以保留细节。由于用于优化当前帧质量的预测正是被复用为未来上下文的预测，保真度与自回归鲁棒性得以联合学习，无需双向到因果的转换或教师-学生蒸馏。此外，模型利用驾驶仿真易得的线索（车道几何与动态智能体状态）提升几何保真度。整个方法在单个任务特定适配阶段内完成训练。

Result: 在 Waymo 与私有驾驶场景、900 帧 rollout 下，OneFixer 在单步设置中取得了所有基线中最低的 FVD、LPIPS 与 DISTS，时序一致性匹配或超过多阶段 DMD 流水线。在相同骨干与条件下，其 GPU 耗时不到多阶段 DMD-with-Self-Forcing 流水线的一半，且性能在对方平台期之后仍持续提升。在闭环仿真中，相对原始 3DGS 渲染，OneFixer 将碰撞率降低三分之一。

Conclusion: OneFixer 通过部署匹配的共享 rollout 与像素级感知监督，在单阶段训练内实现了高保真、高时序一致的实时单步自回归视频扩散修复，兼顾效率与下游闭环仿真安全性，验证了"训练-部署一致性"设计对自动驾驶 3DGS 仿真的价值。

Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion is a promising render-time fixer for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) in autonomous-driving simulation, but deployment demands high visual quality and temporal consistency at low latency. This is especially hard for one-step causal generation, where each imperfect prediction immediately becomes context for subsequent frames. Existing approaches stabilize rollouts through staged training with multiple modules and rollout-aware regularization, yet one-step quality still falls short of what deployment requires. We introduce OneFixer, a one-step autoregressive video-diffusion fixer trained in a single task-specific adaptation stage. Our key idea is a deployment-matched shared rollout: the model's own one-step predictions serve as the causal context for flow matching, exposing training to deployment-time errors, while the same rollout receives direct pixel-space perceptual supervision to preserve fine detail. Because the predictions optimized for current-frame quality are exactly those reused as future context, fidelity and autoregressive robustness are learned jointly, without bidirectional-to-causal conversion or teacher-student distillation. OneFixer further exploits cues that driving simulation readily provides, lane geometry and dynamic-agent states, to improve geometric fidelity. On Waymo and proprietary driving scenes with 900-frame rollouts, OneFixer achieves the lowest FVD, LPIPS, and DISTS among all baselines at one step, with temporal consistency matching or exceeding multi-stage DMD pipelines. Under identical backbone and conditioning, it matches a multi-stage DMD-with-Self-Forcing pipeline in under half the GPU-hours and keeps improving beyond its plateau. In closed-loop simulation with a driving policy, OneFixer reduces the collision rate by a third relative to raw 3DGS rendering. Project page: https://onefixer-web.vercel.app/

</details>


### [81] [Federated 3D Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction at Wireless Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32177)
*Guanlin Wu,Chao Hu,Pu Chen,Juyong Zhang,Han Hu,Shuguang Cui,Jie Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种资源高效的联邦学习框架，用于在无线边缘资源受限条件下高效训练大规模场景的3D高斯泼溅（3D-GS）模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在无线边缘训练大规模3D-GS模型面临诸多挑战：边缘设备通信、计算和GPU内存资源有限；各本地模型间存在结构不一致问题，阻碍有效聚合；原始视觉内容和相机参数存在隐私泄露风险。

Method: 首先提出端上模型轻量化机制，自适应地选择和剪枝高斯点以平衡渲染质量与训练效率，量化评估各高斯点重要性，并采用新颖的"重要性-时延比"准则在GPU内存和计算/通信时延约束下确定剪枝数量；其次提出3D-GS模型恢复机制，在无需访问私有相机参数的情况下恢复各本地模型间的结构一致性，从而实现向全局模型的有效聚合。

Result: 大量实验表明，与最先进的联邦3D-GS基线相比，本方法显著加速收敛、保持高渲染质量并降低训练时延。

Conclusion: 该框架通过模型轻量化与结构一致性恢复，有效解决了边缘资源受限与隐私保护下的大规模3D-GS联邦训练问题。

Abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) Gaussian splatting (3D-GS) has emerged as a promising technique for large-scale scene reconstruction due to its high rendering efficiency and fidelity. However, the training of large-scale 3D-GS models at wireless edge faces various technical challenges including the limited communication, computation, and graphics processing unit (GPU) memory resources at edge devices, the structural inconsistency issue across local models hindering their effective aggregation, as well as privacy leakage risks associated with raw visual content and camera parameters. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel resource-efficient federated learning framework for efficiently training 3D-GS models of large scenes under severe resource constraints. First, we propose an on-device model lightweighting mechanism that adaptively selects and prunes Gaussian points to balance the rendering quality and training efficiency. In this mechanism, we quantitatively evaluate the importance of different Gaussian points at each device to facilitate the pruning, and use a novel importance-to-latency ratio criterion to determine the number of pruned Gaussian points under GPU memory and computation/communication latency constraints. Furthermore, we develop a 3D-GS model recovery mechanism that restores structural consistency across local 3D-GS models without accessing private camera parameters, enabling their effective aggregation towards a global model. Finally, extensive experiments show that our approach significantly accelerates convergence, maintains high rendering quality, and reduces training latency compared to state-of-the-art federated 3D-GS baselines.

</details>


### [82] [Binaural Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32180)
*Saijun Wang,Guanfeng Tang,Hongbo Zhao,Zhicheng Lei,Yutong Zhang,Wei Ye,Rui Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出双耳视听实例分割（BiAVIS）新任务，利用同步双耳音频与视频帧分割发声实例，构建两个基准数据集并提出相应模型，在解决类内实例歧义上显著优于单耳方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视听分割方法多基于单耳音频设置，主要依赖跨模态语义对应，难以区分同一语义类下视觉相似的实例。而人类利用双耳听觉（耳间差异与头/耳廓产生的方向相关声学滤波）获得物理空间线索，从而准确定位声源。受此启发，作者希望引入双耳线索提升实例级分割能力。

Method: 1) 提出 BiAVIS 新任务，使用同步双耳音频和视频帧进行发声实例分割；2) 通过人工标注现有双耳视听数据集并采集新数据集 BiAVIS-Bench，建立两个基准；3) 提出 BiAVIS 模型：先用纯音频声源定位网络从双耳音频中学习发声实例的空间与语义先验；再引入查询级视听融合策略，将这些先验注入实例分割解码器。

Result: 在两个基准上的大量实验表明，BiAVIS 模型优于以往单耳 AVS 方法，尤其擅长解决实例级类内歧义。在更具挑战性的 BiAVIS-Bench 上，模型相较最佳单耳基线分别提升 mAP 17.22% 和 FSLA 7.71%。

Conclusion: 双耳空间线索对实例级视听分割有重要价值，BiAVIS 任务与模型为后续研究提供了新方向与基准，并验证了其在复杂场景下的有效性。

Abstract: Audio-visual segmentation (AVS) aims to segment sounding objects at the pixel level by integrating auditory and visual cues. However, existing methods are predominantly developed under the monaural setting and primarily rely on cross-modal semantic correspondence, which limits their ability to distinguish visually similar instances of the same semantic class. In contrast, humans naturally exploit binaural hearing, where interaural differences and direction-dependent acoustic filtering introduced by the head and pinnae provide physically grounded spatial cues for accurate sound source localization. Motivated by this observation, we introduce binaural audio-visual instance segmentation (BiAVIS), a new task that leverages synchronized binaural audio and video frames to segment sounding instances. To advance research on this task, we establish two benchmarks by manually annotating an existing binaural audio-visual dataset and collecting a new real-world dataset, BiAVIS-Bench, in more challenging and diverse scenarios. We further propose a BiAVIS model, which leverages an audio-only sound source localization network to learn spatial and semantic priors for sounding instances from binaural audio. A query-level audio-visual fusion strategy is subsequently introduced to inject these informative priors into the instance segmentation decoder. Extensive experiments conducted on the two proposed benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance of the BiAVIS model over previous monaural AVS methods, especially in resolving instance-level intra-class ambiguity. On the more challenging BiAVIS-Bench, the proposed BiAVIS model outperforms the best-performing monaural baselines by 17.22\% in mAP and 7.71\% in FSLA, respectively.

</details>


### [83] [KeyRec: Bounded Visual Memory for Streaming and Long-Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32182)
*Zihan Chen,Xuejian Rong,Xiaojuan Wang,Boqing Gong,Adi Zicher,Yael Pritch,Nikhil Karnad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: KeyRec：一种无需训练的有界视觉记忆框架，通过“近期缓存+结构化事件库”和查询时的固定读取预算分配，在仅用10%视觉token预算下取得领先的压缩性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频与连续流导致密集视觉token随视频时长累积，长上下文推理成本过高。现有免训练token选择方法虽降本，但易丢失连贯事件证据，且难以区分近期细节与长期历史。

Method: 提出KeyRec免训练框架构建有界视觉记忆：查询无关写入阶段，将细粒度近期观测保留在视觉缓存，并将历史证据组织为结构化事件库；依据相对已存事件的新颖性提出候选事件，并通过在线“添加-合并-淘汰”更新维护。查询到来时，用纯文本路由器在近期记忆与事件记忆间自适应分配固定读取预算，无需重处理历史帧。方法作用于模型可见的视觉嵌入，兼容模块化编码器-投影器VLM及无编码器-投影器的NEO-ov架构。

Result: 在四个流式与长视频基准、三个VLM骨干上，KeyRec在15个设置中的13个取得最佳压缩性能，仅使用10%的密集解码器可见视觉token预算；实时问题上超越最强压缩基线2.21–18.37分；在6个长视频设置中5个取得最佳压缩结果；在所有NEO-ov 2B设置中均最佳。

Conclusion: KeyRec以有界视觉记忆与自适应预算分配，在极低token预算下实现稳健的长视频/流式理解，兼具高效性与广泛架构兼容性。

Abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used to understand long videos and continuous streams. However, dense visual tokens accumulate with video duration, making long-context inference prohibitively expensive. Existing training-free visual-token selection methods reduce this cost by retaining informative tokens, but may lose coherent event evidence and fail to distinguish detailed recent observations from long-range history. We propose \textbf{KeyRec}, a training-free framework for constructing bounded visual memory. During query-agnostic writing, KeyRec preserves fine-grained recent observations in a visual cache and organizes historical evidence into a structured event bank. Candidate events are proposed according to their novelty relative to previously stored events and maintained through an online add--merge--evict update. When a question arrives, a text-only router adaptively allocates a fixed readout budget between recent and event memory, without reprocessing historical frames. KeyRec operates on model-facing visual embeddings and supports both modular encoder--projector VLMs and the encoder- and projector-free NEO-ov architecture. Across four streaming and long-video benchmarks and three VLM backbones, KeyRec achieves the best compressed performance in 13 of 15 settings using only 10\% of the dense decoder-facing visual-token budget. It outperforms the strongest compressed baseline by 2.21--18.37 points on real-time questions, achieves the best compressed result in five of six long-video settings, and performs best in every NEO-ov 2B setting.

</details>


### [84] [Scalable In-Domain Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Dense Representation Transfer in High-Resolution Plant Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32183)
*Junlin Guo,Sharmin Majumder,Isaac Lyngaas,John Lagergren,Xiao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出面向高分辨率、高像素多物种植物图像的可扩展域内自监督预训练基础模型，用MAE+ViT在超1000万多视角图块上分布式预训练，在密集预测与全局识别任务上均优于基于自然图像的MAE，证明域内自监督规模化可缩小域差、提升密集表征迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率植物成像可精细刻画植物形态，但密集科学分析受限于昂贵的像素级标注、巨大的图像像素尺寸以及成像条件的显著差异，现有基础模型在密集特征表示与迁移上存在域差。

Method: 以ViT为骨干的掩码自编码器（MAE），在超过1000万多视角植物图像图块上进行分布式预训练，构建域内自监督基础模型；随后在细粒度密集预测和粗粒度全局特征识别两类任务上系统评测，重点关注有限监督和真实下游成像条件。

Result: 在有限标注、跨视角变化和分辨率退化等实验中，域内基础模型取得Mean Dice 0.8686、Pooled Dice 0.8959，分别比在大规模自然图像上预训练的MAE高出0.0694和0.0613；且增大预训练规模可持续提升密集特征迁移效果。

Conclusion: 规模化域内自监督预训练能够缩小域差，为高像素科学成像提供更具迁移性的密集表征。

Abstract: High-resolution plant imaging enables detailed characterization of plant morphology, but dense scientific analysis remains limited by costly pixel-level annotations, large image pixel dimensions, and substantial variation in imaging conditions. This work proposes a scalable in-domain self-supervised pretrained foundation model for high-resolution, high-pixel-dimension multi-species plant imagery. A masked autoencoder with a ViT backbone is pretrained on more than 10 million multi-view plant image tiles using distributed training. Following scalable pretraining, the learned foundation-model representations are comprehensively benchmarked across fine-grained dense prediction and coarse global feature recognition, with particular emphasis on limited supervision and realistic downstream imaging conditions. This work focuses on the domain gap of existing foundation models in dense feature representation and transfer. Through extensive experiments involving limited annotations, cross-view variation, and resolution degradation, the in-domain FM achieves a Mean Dice of 0.8686 and a Pooled Dice of 0.8959, outperforming an MAE counterpart pretrained on large-scale natural-image data by 0.0694 and 0.0613, respectively. The results further indicate that increasing pretraining scale produces consistent improvements in dense feature transfer. Overall, these findings suggest that scaling in-domain self-supervised pretraining can reduce the domain gap and improve transferable dense representations for high-pixel-dimension scientific imaging.

</details>


### [85] [Contamination, Prior, or Evidence? Decomposing and Training Evidence Use in Whole-Slide Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32185)
*Wenhao Zhang,Zhongliang Zhou,Shiyuan Zhang,Yiqing Yang,Pinqiao Wang,Lehan Yang,Hanyin Wang,John Kang,Sheng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 CleanSlide 基准与 Pair-DPO 方法，用于解耦数据集污染、先验知识与图像证据，使病理视觉语言模型真正基于图像证据作答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有病理视觉语言模型（VLM）通常仅用准确率评价，但准确率无法衡量模型是否真正使用了图像证据。作者在淋巴结转移预测的初步研究中发现，多数公开病理 VLM 在输入全切片图像、标注病灶或完全不输入图像时表现差异极小，说明准确率可能混淆了数据污染、先验知识与图像证据等因素。

Method: 工作包含两部分：(1) CleanSlide，一个基于 TCGA 构建的 VQA 基准，旨在消除图像侧与问题侧的污染，包含覆盖 9,985 张切片的 149K 道经审核的多选题，并采用患者与组织来源互斥的划分；每道题都针对选项捷径、题干泄漏、跨划分重复及盲答可解性进行审核。(2) Pair-DPO，一种在来自同一问题与来源的反事实切片对上定义的偏好损失，通过控制共同混杂因素抵消问题可归因信号，使图像证据成为偏好的来源；每对由两张具有相反且经核实结论的真实切片组成，不引入编辑伪影，也不为侵袭、坏死、肿瘤分级等弥散或分级特征使用未验证标签。

Result: 实验显示，该方法在 CleanSlide 上从图像证据中获得 15.29% 的提升，而最佳已发表模型仅为 2.81%。在外部 CPTAC 与 BCNB 队列上，方法准确率分别为 57.6% 与 59.0%，比所有其他评估模型分别高出 9.7% 与 3.4%。

Conclusion: 仅靠准确率不足以评估病理 VLM 是否真正利用图像证据。通过去污染的 CleanSlide 基准与基于反事实切片对的 Pair-DPO，可有效解耦并提升图像证据的贡献，方法在内部与外部队列上均优于现有模型。作者将公开基准与代码。

Abstract: Pathology vision-language models (VLMs) are conventionally evaluated by accuracy, but accuracy alone does not measure evidence use: it may conflate dataset contamination, prior knowledge, and image evidence. In a motivating study of lymph-node metastasis prediction, we found that most public pathology VLMs showed minimal differences when changing from feeding the models with whole-slide images, an annotated lesion, or no image at all. To better understand the specific features leveraged by these models, this paper presents two contributions aimed at disentangling these factors. First, we present CleanSlide, a TCGA-based VQA benchmark designed to eliminate image- and question-side contamination. It contains 149K audited multiple-choice questions over 9,985 slides, with patient- and tissue-source-disjoint splits. Every question is audited for option shortcuts, stem leakage, cross-split duplication, and blind solvability. Second, we propose Pair-DPO, a preference loss over counterfactual slide pairs from the same question and source. By controlling for shared confounding factors, Pair-DPO cancels out the question-attributable signal and leaves image evidence as the source of preference. Specifically, each pair consists of two real slides with opposite, verified findings, introducing neither editing artifacts nor unverified labels for diffuse or graded features such as invasion, necrosis, and tumor grade. Experiments show that our method gains 15.29% from image evidence on the CleanSlide, compared with 2.81% for the best published model. On the external CPTAC and BCNB cohorts, our method achieves accuracies of 57.6% and 59.0%, outperforming all other evaluated models by 9.7% and 3.4%, respectively. We will release the benchmark and code.

</details>


### [86] [Presence Is Not Faithfulness: Figurative Vehicle Intrusion in Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32188)
*Xiaoyu Ma,Chen Yang,Hao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"喻体入侵"（Figurative Vehicle Intrusion）这一失败模式：在文本到图像生成中，本应作为喻体引导本体描绘的内容被错误渲染为可见物体，指出"视觉存在"不等于"忠实"。作者构建多语言基准VISTA并提出版本V-Score诊断指标，发现喻体入侵在多种语言和图类中普遍存在，并提出VISTA-Guard作为轻量缓解方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到图像（TTI）模型已能依据自然语言提示生成高质量图像，但在处理比喻性语言时暴露缺陷：喻体内容被赋予错误的视觉角色，被当作可见物体直接渲染出来。这种"文本上有依据、视觉角色却错误"的现象说明视觉存在并不等同于忠实，而现有偏向"是否出现"的评估方式会漏检此类错误。因此需要系统研究该问题。

Method: 作者提出两项工具：（1）VISTA（Vehicle Intrusion and Semantic Tenor Assessment），一个多语言比喻提示基准，按比喻形式（Figurative Form）和映射机制（Mapping Mechanism）组织；（2）V-Score，一种基于诊断式问答的指标，用于评估生成图像中角色感知的比喻忠实度。此外提出VISTA-Guard作为轻量缓解方法。

Result: 在近期表现优异的TTI模型上进行评估，结果显示喻体入侵在不同语言和比喻类别中持续存在。VISTA-Guard作为轻量缓解手段可部分减少喻体入侵。

Conclusion: 喻体入侵是当前TTI模型在比喻语言处理上的系统性缺陷，说明以"视觉存在"为导向的评估不足；VISTA基准与V-Score指标为该问题提供了系统研究工具，VISTA-Guard给出了通往更具比喻忠实度生成的可行路径。所有资源将公开发布。

Abstract: Text-to-image (TTI) models increasingly generate high-quality images from natural-language prompts, yet figurative language exposes a failure: a vehicle that should guide the depiction of a tenor may instead be rendered as a visible object. We call this failure Figurative Vehicle Intrusion: the intruding content is textually licensed, but it is assigned the wrong visual role, showing that visual presence is not always faithfulness and that presence-oriented evaluation can miss such errors. To study it systematically, we introduce Vehicle Intrusion and Semantic Tenor Assessment (VISTA), a multilingual benchmark of figurative prompts organized by Figurative Form and Mapping Mechanism. We further propose V-Score, a diagnostic question-answering metric that evaluates role-aware figurative faithfulness in generated images. Evaluations on recent high-performing TTI models show that vehicle intrusion persists across languages and figurative categories. As a lightweight mitigation, we introduce VISTA-Guard, which partially reduces vehicle intrusion and suggests a practical path toward more figuratively faithful TTI generation. All resources will be released publicly.

</details>


### [87] [Evaluating Single and Multi-Omics Based Explainable Artificial Intelligence (MOXAI) for Molecular Subclass Classification of Adult-Type Diffuse Gliomas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32190)
*Md Zahangir Alom,Quynh T. Tran,Breuer Alexandar,Brent A. Orr*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MOXAI框架，整合DNA甲基化与拷贝数变异数据进行成人型弥漫性胶质瘤分子亚型分类，并结合CAM/Grad-CAM实现可解释性，多模态模型交叉验证准确率达92.98%，独立验证集最高达94.25%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算模型通常分别分析甲基化与拷贝数变异数据，无法捕捉两者融合的互补信息；同时缺乏类似肿瘤分级的类内风险评估机制，也没有成熟的可解释性方法能将分类决策归因到具体基因组位点。因此需要构建多组学整合且可解释的分类框架。

Method: 基于TCGA队列，从甲基化芯片中整合DNA甲基化与拷贝数数据，构建MOXAI深度学习框架。分别训练ResNet50、DINOv2、GAT模型，覆盖单模态（仅甲基化、仅拷贝数）与多模态组合；并开发基于类别激活图（CAM）与梯度加权CAM（Grad-CAM）的可解释AI方法，定位与分类决策相关的CpG位点、基因及染色体区域。

Result: 多模态模型交叉验证准确率最高达92.98%，优于仅使用CNV数据的模型；DINOv2泛化能力最强，在独立验证集上以置信度>0.9达到94.25%的准确率。可解释性结果与成人型弥漫性胶质瘤亚型的已知分子特征一致，验证了框架的生物学可解释性。

Conclusion: MOXAI成功实现了多组学整合与可解释分类，证明融合甲基化与拷贝数数据能提升成人型弥漫性胶质瘤分子亚型分类性能，且XAI结果具备生物学合理性，为肿瘤诊断提供了兼具准确性与可解释性的工具。

Abstract: DNA methylation (DNAM) profiling has emerged as a powerful diagnostic tool for classifying brain and solid tumors. However, existing computational models typically analyze methylation and copy number variation (CNV) data separately, failing to capture the complementary information their integration could provide. Moreover, current classification models lack mechanisms for within-class risk assessment analogous to traditional tumor grading, and no established explainability method can attribute classification decisions to specific genomic loci. In this paper, we present MOXAI (Multi-Omics Based Explainable AI), a deep learning framework that integrates DNA methylation and copy number data from methylation arrays to classify molecular subtypes of adult-type diffuse gliomas, alongside single-modality variants for comparison. Using a cohort from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), we trained ResNet50, DINOv2, and Graph Attention Network (GAT) models on methylation data alone, copy number data alone, and combined multimodal data. We further developed explainable AI (XAI) methods based on class activation maps (CAMs) and gradient-weighted CAM (Grad-CAM) to identify the specific CpG sites, genes, and chromosomal regions most relevant to each classification decision. The multimodal model achieved up to 92.98% cross-validation accuracy, outperforming models trained on CNV data alone. DINOv2 showed the strongest generalization, reaching 94.25% accuracy (confidence >0.9) on independent validation sets. XAI results aligned with established molecular features of adult-type diffuse glioma subtypes, confirming the biological interpretability of the framework.

</details>


### [88] [Devol-ONE: One Autoregressive Mixture of Transformers to Unify Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32193)
*Hongyi Cai,Yi Herng Ong,Tingshiuan C. Wu,Lim Chiew Hui,Hanxia Li,Kehong Guo,Sze Yuan Cheong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Devol-ONE，一种 Mixture of Transformers 架构，将视觉语言理解、潜在世界动态预测与动作生成统一在单一自回归框架中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型直接基于当前视觉和语言上下文生成动作，缺乏对场景在候选动作下如何演变的显式建模；而 WAM 虽预测未来状态，却将预测与策略学习在架构上分离，仅通过预测输出相连（如像素视频生成或独立训练的潜在预测模块）。

Method: Devol-ONE 在视觉语言流与 V-JEPA 预训练动态流上联合进行自回归预测，每层都关注视觉语言 key-value 缓存，在语言引导下预测未来潜在状态；动作专家持续受到语义推理与预测物理动态的塑造，而非依赖预先计算的固定表示。

Result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-PLUS、RoboTwin2.0 以及 Flexiv 单臂与双臂真实世界设置上进行了大量实验；消融研究验证了动态流预测与逐层统一注意力的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过将动态流预测与逐层统一注意力整合进单一自回归框架，Devol-ONE 验证了其架构的一致性与有效性。

Abstract: Vision Language Action (VLA) models condition actions directly on current visual and language context, without an explicit account of how the scene evolves under candidate actions. World Action Models (WAM) attempt to address this limitation by predicting future states, but existing designs keep prediction and policy learning architecturally separate, connecting them only through the predicted output, whether through pixel space video generation or a latent forecasting module trained independently of the policy. We present Devol-ONE, a Mixture of Transformers architecture that unifies vision language understanding, latent world dynamics prediction, and action generation within a single autoregressive framework. Instead of encoding vision language tokens once and feeding them to the action expert, Devol-ONE runs autoregressive prediction jointly across a vision language stream and a V-JEPA pretrained dynamics stream, attending to the vision language key-value cache at every layer to forecast future latent states under language guidance. The action expert is in turn shaped continuously by semantic reasoning and predicted physical dynamics rather than by a fixed representation computed in advance. Extensive experiments are conducted on LIBERO, LIBERO-PLUS, RoboTwin2.0 along with real-world evaluation on Flexiv single-arm and dual-arm setups. Ablation studies show the effectiveness of dynamic stream prediction and layer-wise unified attention to validate our model architectural coherency.

</details>


### [89] [Kernel-Based Steering of CLIP with Vision-Language Model Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32203)
*Sajjad Ghiasvand,Haniyeh Ehsani Oskouie,Sina Mansouri,Mahnoosh Alizadeh,Farzan Farnia,Ramtin Pedarsani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ASK方法，将大视觉语言模型的视觉相似性偏好迁移到CLIP中，在保持图文能力的同时显著提升检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（VLMs）能判断视觉相似性，但其判断无法直接作为紧凑的图像嵌入用于高效比较。作者希望将这种偏好迁移到CLIP中，同时保留CLIP原有的图像-文本能力。

Method: 提出ASK（基于核的引导方法）：从小图像组中构建半正定目标核，无需访问教师嵌入或收集新的人工相似性标注；结合视觉核匹配与图像-文本分布锚定；采用低秩适配器联合更新视觉和文本编码器，并将预测正则化向冻结的CLIP靠拢；适配后检索仅用CLIP图像嵌入和余弦相似度，无需调用VLM。

Result: 在5个图像领域、4个CLIP骨干和6个评判者上进行实验，评估教师一致性、检索和识别保持能力。ViT-B/16上，适配外类别的平均检索mAP从53.8提升到75.0（DINOv2目标+KL锚定为71.7）；联合适配编码器的平均零样本准确率从61.8%提升到62.4%（12个基准和5个适配领域平均）。提示提供了额外能力：可选择学生学习的视觉区分。四个数据集的人工标注评估支持这种准则特定的控制。

Conclusion: ASK能有效将VLM的视觉相似性偏好以核引导方式迁移到CLIP，既大幅提升检索性能，又保持甚至略微提升零样本识别能力，并支持通过提示控制学习哪些视觉区分。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (VLMs) can judge visual similarity, but their judgments are not directly available as compact image embeddings for efficient comparison. We study how to transfer these preferences into CLIP while retaining its image--text capabilities. We introduce ASK, a kernel-based steering method that learns from elicited pairwise judgments without accessing teacher embeddings or collecting new human similarity annotations. ASK constructs positive semidefinite target kernels within small image groups and combines visual kernel matching with an image--text distributional anchor. Low-rank adapters jointly update the visual and text encoders while regularizing predictions toward frozen CLIP. After adaptation, retrieval uses CLIP image embeddings and cosine similarity, with no VLM calls. Experiments across five image domains, four CLIP backbones, and six judges evaluate teacher agreement, retrieval, and recognition retention. For ViT-B/16, mean retrieval mAP on classes excluded from adaptation increases from 53.8 to 75.0, compared with 71.7 for DINOv2 targets with KL anchoring. Mean zero-shot accuracy with jointly adapted encoders increases from 61.8\% to 62.4\%, averaged over 12 benchmarks and the five adaptation domains. Prompting provides an additional capability: selecting which visual distinctions the student learns. Human-annotated evaluations across four datasets support this criterion-specific control.

</details>


### [90] [Geometry-Preserving Blind Watermarking for Raw 3D Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32222)
*Rungui Zhou,Chuanzhi Zhou,Ruihuan Wang,Peng-Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种直接作用于xyz坐标的盲水印框架，基于八叉树前馈架构联合学习嵌入与提取，在物体级和场景级点云上实现鲁棒消息恢复且几何失真低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始3D点云是核心几何表示，但其点集不规则、非结构化，且常经重采样和几何预处理改变，导致确立点云所有权十分困难。现有方法多依赖原始点云、颜色、法线或网格连接信息，实用性受限。

Method: 方法直接在xyz坐标上操作，验证时仅凭观测点云即可恢复嵌入消息，无需原始点云、颜色、法线或网格连接。采用前馈八叉树架构联合学习水印嵌入与提取，实现大规模点集的多尺度几何推理。训练中引入随机变换层使解码器接触常见几何扰动，并用渐进式位姿对齐提升对位姿变化的鲁棒性。

Result: 在物体级与场景级基准测试中，常见几何处理下实现可靠的消息恢复，同时保持较低的几何失真。定性比较显示，所学扰动相比手工设计的替代方案视觉上更不显眼、空间结构更弱。

Conclusion: 该盲水印框架支持物体级与场景级点云，仅需观测点云即可验证，兼顾鲁棒性与低失真，且扰动隐蔽性优于手工方法。
