Abstract: Raw 3D point clouds are a core geometric representation. Establishing their ownership is challenging because point sets are irregular, unstructured, and frequently altered by resampling and geometric preprocessing. We present a blind watermarking framework that operates directly on xyz coordinates and supports both object-level shapes and scene-scale scans. At verification time, the embedded message is recovered from the observed point cloud alone, without access to the original point cloud, color, normals, or mesh connectivity. The method jointly learns watermark embedding and extraction through a feed-forward octree-based architecture, enabling efficient multi-scale geometric reasoning on large point sets. During training, a stochastic transformation layer exposes the decoder to common geometric perturbations, while progressive pose alignment improves robustness to pose changes.
  Experiments on object-level and scene-level benchmarks demonstrate reliable message recovery under common geometric processing while maintaining low geometric distortion. Qualitative comparisons further show that the learned perturbations are less visually conspicuous and less spatially structured than those of handcrafted alternatives.

</details>


### [91] [Skeletons in Flow: Graph Structured Flow Matching for Human Motion Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32231)
*Yixuan Wang,Brandon C. Fallin,Warren E. Dixon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出图结构流匹配（GSFM），用单一条件速度场传输完整未来骨骼轨迹，结合时空注意力与单位球切空间演化保持骨骼长度，在AMASS上取得竞争力，并可零样本迁移到Human3.6M。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人体运动预测需要多样化且与观测运动和身体关节结构一致的未来轨迹。骨骼约束限制单帧姿态，而协调运动依赖关节间的空间交互与时间瞬刻间的时序交互，如何在这些约束与交互下进行预测是核心问题。

Method: GSFM将整个未来骨骼轨迹作为整体，通过一个条件速度场进行传输，形成时空骨骼图；用空间与时间注意力依据骨骼关系和物理时间偏移耦合其演化。骨骼方向表示于相对根关节的单位球上，通过切空间演化在生成过程中保持输入骨骼长度。速度场以条件流匹配方式训练，沿测地路径连接以最后观测姿态为中心的随机轨迹与真实未来轨迹。

Result: 在AMASS数据集上评估了预测精度、多样性校准与运动统计，并通过消融实验验证了空间和时间消息传递的贡献。在AMASS上训练的GSFM在无参数更新或再训练的情况下，在Human3.6M骨骼上表现具有竞争力，显示对未见骨骼结构的适用性。

Conclusion: GSFM通过时空图注意力与单位球切空间演化，在满足骨骼约束和时空交互的同时实现多样化人体运动预测，并具备跨骨骼结构的泛化能力。

Abstract: Human motion prediction requires diverse future trajectories that remain consistent with observed motion and the articulated physical structure of the body. Skeletal constraints restrict individual poses, while coordinated motion depends on spatial interactions (between connected joints) and temporal interactions (between time instants). To facilitate human motion prediction in light of these constraints and interactions, we introduce Graph Structured Flow Matching (GSFM), which transports the complete future skeletal trajectory through a single conditional velocity field. The trajectory produces a spatiotemporal skeleton graph, and spatial and temporal attention couple its evolution according to skeletal relations and physical time offsets. Bone directions lie on unit spheres relative to a root joint, and tangent evolution preserves input bone lengths throughout generation. We train a learned velocity field through conditional flow matching along geodesic paths connecting random trajectories centered on the last-observed pose to recorded future trajectories. Experiments on the Archive of Motion capture As Surface Shapes (AMASS) dataset evaluate prediction accuracy, diversity calibration, and motion statistics. We demonstrate the contributions of spatial and temporal message passing in the developed architecture through an ablation study. GSFM models trained on AMASS also perform competitively on the Human3.6M skeleton without parameter updates or retraining, demonstrating applicability to an unseen skeletal structure.

</details>


### [92] [Two-Stage Multi-View Gait Recognition with a Re-Embedding Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32244)
*Long Hoang Le,Trung Thanh Ngo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出两阶段步态识别框架TFTR：先"翻译"再"推理"，用浅层Siamese网络将GEI映射到视图特定嵌入空间，再用12层Transformer编码器处理各视图token并重新投影以提高余弦可分性，支持任意数量视图灵活融合，在OU-MVLP和CASIA-B上取得高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单阶段步态识别方法常面临严重过拟合与僵化的视角约束两大挑战。本文希望解决这些问题，并突破以往方法固定输入视图数量的限制。

Method: TFTR两阶段框架。第一阶段：浅层Siamese卷积网络配合triplet loss，将Gait Energy Images（GEI）映射至128维的视图特定嵌入空间。第二阶段：把每个视图的嵌入视为token，交由12层Transformer编码器处理，将其重新投影到具有更好余弦可分性的新空间。该设计使推理时可灵活融合任意数量的视图。

Result: 在OU-MVLP（6000名受试者）上训练，在未见过的CASIA-B上以正常、背包、穿外套三种条件评估：OU-MVLP上单视图准确率96.91%，三视图准确率99.49%；CASIA-B三视图准确率达100%。

Conclusion: TFTR通过"先翻译后推理"的两阶段设计，有效缓解了单阶段方法的过拟合与视角约束问题，实现了任意视图数量的灵活融合，并在跨数据集评测中取得优异性能。

Abstract: Gait recognition always remains challenging due to severe overfitting and the rigid view constraints common in single-stage approaches. We propose a two-stage framework, termed Translate-First-Then-Reason (TFTR), to address these issues. In the first stage, a shallow Siamese convolutional network with triplet loss maps Gait Energy Images (GEIs) into a 128-dimensional view-specific embedding space. In the second stage, these per-view embeddings are treated as tokens and processed by a 12-layer Transformer encoder, which re-projects them into a new space with improved cosine separability. This design enables flexible fusion of an arbitrary number of views at inference, overcoming the fixed-input limitations of prior methods. Trained on the OU-MVLP dataset (6,000 subjects) and evaluated on unseen CASIA-B across normal, bag-carrying, and coat-wearing conditions, our pipeline achieves 96.91\% single-view and 99.49\% three-view accuracy on OU-MVLP, and attains 100\% accuracy on CASIA-B with three views.

</details>


### [93] [RoboSTAR: Next-Scale Autoregressive Sign Language Translation for Humanoid Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32250)
*Yujia Zeng,Chensheng Peng,Yuxin Chen,Alex Shao,Nathan Jew,Masayoshi Tomizuka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RoBoSTAR是一个文本条件的机器人手语生成框架，通过部件化有限标量量化与下一尺度自回归实现由粗到细的手语动作生成，并可重定向至人形机器人执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共传播中的手语翻译依赖合格的专业手语译员，难以规模化，因此需要机器人手语作为补充性的无障碍交互界面。

Method: 采用部件化有限标量量化（part-wise FSQ）结合下一尺度自回归（next-scale autoregression），在逐步变细的时间分辨率上生成动作，并在每步并行预测同步的身体与手部token；采用由粗到细的建模方式，配合自条件化与上下文损坏机制提升鲁棒性；生成动作随后重定向用于实体人形机器人执行。

Result: 通过大量定性与定量评估验证了RoBoSTAR的有效性。

Conclusion: RoBoSTAR为可规模化、可机器人执行的文本条件手语生成提供了一种有效方案。

Abstract: Sign-language interpretation in public communication relies on qualified professional interpreters and can be difficult to scale, motivating robotic signing as a complementary accessibility interface. We present RoBoSTAR, a text-conditioned sign language production (SLP) framework for generating human-centric sign motion that can be retargeted for robotic execution, with speech supported optionally through an external ASR front end. Conventional autoregressive approaches flatten motion into a single full-resolution token sequence, forcing long-range and local dependencies to be modeled at a uniform temporal granularity. RoBoSTAR instead combines part-wise Finite Scalar Quantization with next-scale autoregression, generating motion over progressively finer temporal resolutions while predicting synchronized body and hand tokens in parallel within each step. This coarse-to-fine formulation provides compact long-range context before progressively refining motion details, while self-conditioning and context corruption improve robustness to cross-scale prediction errors. The generated motion is subsequently retargeted for physical humanoid execution. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations are conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of RoBoSTAR.

</details>


### [94] [FSS-UBrain: Multi-region Few-Shot Brain Tumor MRI Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32273)
*Truong Viet Vu,Nguyen Phuc Nguyen,Dang Thi Thu Hang,Tran Thien Thanh,Vo Nguyen Quoc Bao,Nguyen Thai Anh,Ngo Hoang Tu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FSS-UBrain区域级单样本分割框架，用带标注正支持切片分别条件化WT/TC/ET的二分类查询分割，在BraTS 2020/2023/Africa上取得领先的少样本分割表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态MRI中全肿瘤(WT)、肿瘤核心(TC)、强化肿瘤(ET)的精确勾画面临标注有限、跨队列差异大、目标稀疏等挑战，需在无目标域微调条件下实现可迁移的少样本分割。

Method: 采用区域级单样本(one-shot)分割：以单个带标注正支持切片分别条件化WT、TC、ET的二分类查询分割；支持集导出的前景/背景描述符引导查询特征适配、瓶颈交互、解码器侧重构与边界精修；训练中引入难负样本、全负查询及空查询正则化以抑制区域缺失时的虚假前景激活；推理基于二维支持-查询切片对，但检查点选择、阈值校准与评估在体数据重建后进行。

Result: BraTS 2020留出集上WT/TC/ET体素Dice为89.82%、82.14%、77.42%，HD95分别为11.12、9.01、4.46 mm；在BraTS 2023与BraTS-Africa目标支持跨队列协议下取得对比方法中最高平均Dice与最低有限配对平均HD95点估计。

Conclusion: 结果支持目标条件化的少样本分割，同时表明该方法对支持切片选择与队列间差异较为敏感。

Abstract: Accurate delineation of whole tumor (WT), tumor core (TC), and enhancing tumor (ET) from multimodal magnetic resonance imaging remains challenging under limited annotation, cross-cohort variation, and severe target sparsity. We propose FSS-UBrain, a region-wise one-shot segmentation framework that uses a labeled positive support slice to condition binary query segmentation separately for WT, TC, and ET. Support-derived foreground and background descriptors guide query-feature adaptation, bottleneck interaction, decoder-side reconstruction, and boundary refinement. Episodic training additionally incorporates hard-negative and fully negative queries with empty-query regularization to suppress spurious foreground activation when the selected region is absent. Although inference operates on two-dimensional support--query slice pairs, checkpoint selection, threshold calibration, and final evaluation are performed after volumetric reconstruction. FSS-UBrain is evaluated on a held-out BraTS 2020 split and under target-supported cross-cohort protocols on BraTS 2023 and BraTS-Africa. Cases used as target support are excluded from the query cohorts, and no target-domain fine-tuning or test-time parameter updates are performed. On BraTS 2020, FSS-UBrain achieves volumetric Dice scores of 89.82%, 82.14%, and 77.42% for WT, TC, and ET, respectively, with corresponding 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) values of 11.12, 9.01, and 4.46 mm. It also achieves the highest mean Dice and lowest finite-pair mean HD95 point estimates on BraTS 2023 and BraTS-Africa among the compared few-shot methods. These findings support target-conditioned few-shot segmentation while highlighting sensitivity to support selection and cohort-specific variation.

</details>


### [95] [HeroFrame-Bench: Reference-Anchored Evaluation via Rubric--Ranking Co-Evolution for Movie Hero Frame Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32280)
*Weitai Kang,Hanieh Deilamsalehy,Yumo Xu,Dewang Sultania,Serdar Cellat,Yan Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出“英雄帧选择”任务并构建HeroFrame-Bench基准，通过VLM-as-a-Judge框架与评分标准-排序协同演化方法实现可扩展、可扩展的评估，实验证明该设计提升了与人类判断的一致性，且该任务仍具挑战性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 英雄帧是电影宣传物料的首个视觉入口，影响观众的第一印象与观看意愿，其选择需兼顾内容相关性与美学吸引力。然而现有的关键帧选择基准偏重相关性而非美学，且其标注要么有限（排除合理备选），要么依赖VideoQA而将选择质量与下游模型能力纠缠在一起，缺乏可靠的评估方式。因此需要一个专门且可扩展的基准来评估英雄帧选择。

Method: 提出HeroFrame-Bench，采用可扩展的VLM-as-a-Judge框架：利用多样化元数据构建多模态上下文，以Reference-anchored Percentile对所选帧评分——将每帧插入可复用的预排序参考链中获得百分位，实现直接、可扩展且可靠的评估。为降低主观判断的歧义，提出Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution，生成影片专属评分标准来约束VLM评判，并与排序结果联合优化评分标准；同时引入可验证信号（尤以Inverted Rubric Attack为代表）来筛选稳健的评分标准。

Result: HeroFrame-Bench在204部电影上实例化，包含2,031条参考链和1,970条学习到的评分标准。构建标注界面进行人类对齐研究，结果显示该构建设计将VLM与人类判断的一致性从77.56%提升至83.78%。在多种方法上的评估表明英雄帧选择仍然具有挑战性。

Conclusion: 论文确立了英雄帧选择这一新任务并给出可扩展、可靠的评估基准HeroFrame-Bench，通过参考锚定百分位与评分标准-排序协同演化提升了VLM评判与人类的一致性，同时表明该任务对现有方法仍是开放挑战。

Abstract: Hero frames are in-film stills used as source imagery for theatrical posters, streaming cover art, film database listings, and other promotional placements. As the first visual entry point, they shape audiences' initial impressions of the movie and their subsequent willingness to watch it. Selecting these frames, a task we term hero frame selection, requires balancing content relevance with aesthetic appeal. A related task is keyframe selection, yet its benchmarks prioritize relevance over aesthetics, using either finite annotations that exclude valid alternatives or VideoQA that entangles selection quality with downstream model capability. We therefore introduce HeroFrame-Bench, built through a scalable VLM-as-a-Judge framework. We construct multimodal contexts from diverse metadata to ground a VLM judge that scores selected frames using our Reference-anchored Percentile. The percentile is obtained by inserting each frame into reusable, pre-ranked reference chains, enabling direct, extensible, and reliable evaluation. To reduce ambiguity and improve consistency in these subjective judgements, we further propose Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution, which generates movie-specific rubrics to condition the VLM judge and refines rubrics jointly with the resulting rankings. Within this process, we introduce several verifiable signals, most notably the Inverted Rubric Attack, to select robust rubrics. Finally, HeroFrame-Bench is instantiated over 204 movies with 2,031 reference chains and 1,970 learned rubrics. We build an annotation interface for human-alignment studies which show that our construction design improves VLM agreement with human from 77.56% to 83.78%. Evaluation on multiple methods show that hero frame selection remains challenging.

</details>


### [96] [One Perception, All Maneuvers: Directional Traffic Signal Understanding for Maneuver-Level Signal Intent Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32316)
*Ang Zou,Runzhe Zheng,Zhigang li,Zhen Yang,Han Xia,Xuewei Li,Zequn Qin,Xi Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将交通信号感知从实例级检测/颜色识别重构为面向决策的"方向性交通信号理解"任务，预测直行、左转、右转、掉头四个机动方向的结构化信号状态（颜色+通行许可），基于OpenLane-V2构建方向级基准并提出方向感知基线，实验证明方向级建模在复杂多信号路口优于图像级分类器与检测导向流水线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交通信号灯是自动驾驶在城市路口的关键调控信号，但现有感知主要被建模为实例级检测或颜色识别。这类建模只能回答"信号灯在哪里、显示什么颜色"，却留下一个关键语义鸿沟：每个可见信号究竟控制自车的哪一个机动动作，以及该信号对该机动表达何种动态通行许可。这一鸿沟直接影响下游规划。

Method: 形式化提出"方向性交通信号理解"这一面向决策的任务：从单张前视图像预测直行、左转、右转、掉头四个机动的结构化信号状态，每个状态包含关联信号颜色与信号隐含的可通行性。基于OpenLane-V2构建方向级基准，提供机动级监督，并设计覆盖颜色识别、可通行性、整帧一致性和安全关键错误的评测指标。提出方向感知基线，融合全局上下文、局部交通灯证据与机动特定表示。

Result: 实验表明，方向级建模在可通行性预测上优于图像级分类器和检测导向的流水线，在复杂的多信号路口尤为明显。

Conclusion: 所得到的表示与拓扑、路线及周围智能体信息一起，为下游规划提供了一个直接且可解释的交通信号接口。

Abstract: Traffic lights are a key regulatory signal for autonomous driving at urban intersections, yet existing traffic signal perception is still predominantly formulated as instance-level detection or color recognition. Such formulations identify where traffic lights are and what colors they display, but leave a critical semantic gap before downstream planning: which ego maneuver is controlled by each visible signal and what dynamic permission the signal expresses for that maneuver.
  In this paper, we formulate Directional Traffic Signal Understanding, a decision-oriented task that predicts structured signal states for straight, left-turn, right-turn, and U-turn maneuvers from a front-view image. Each state contains the associated signal color and signal-implied passability. Based on OpenLane-V2, we provide a direction-level benchmark with maneuver-level supervision and metrics for color recognition, passability, full-frame consistency, and safety-critical errors. A direction-aware baseline combines global context, localized traffic-light evidence, and maneuver-specific representations. Experiments show that direction-level modeling improves passability prediction over image-level classifiers and detection-oriented pipelines, particularly at complex multi-signal intersections. The resulting representation provides a direct and interpretable traffic-signal interface for downstream planning together with topology, route, and surrounding-agent information.

</details>


### [97] [FoundDSR: A Generalizable Foundation Model with Guided 2D Gaussian Splatting for Depth Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32323)
*Zhengxue Wang,Zhiqiang Yan,Yuan Wu,Guangwei Gao,Xiang Li,Jian Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FoundDSR：基于引导式2D高斯泼溅与异构联邦学习的可泛化深度重建基础模型，零样本评测超越现有SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决深度重建模型在未见数据分布上的泛化与鲁棒性问题；同时应对大规模异构训练数据带来的分布差异，导致的训练不稳定与对主导数据源的偏置。

Method: 1) 引导式2D高斯泼溅策略，利用高分辨率RGB作为提示优化高斯参数，使高斯基元沿高频结构方向各向异性变形，得到高斯上采样表示；2) 通过深度重建分支将其映射为高分辨率深度；3) 引入异构联邦学习，将各数据源分配到独立客户端做本地优化并全局聚合。

Result: 在合成、真实、任意尺度及噪声条件下的广泛零样本评测中，FoundDSR持续优于现有最先进方法，验证了其对未知场景的强鲁棒性与泛化能力。

Conclusion: FoundDSR是一种可泛化的深度重建基础模型，兼具稳定可扩展性，能有效适应多样且大规模的异构训练数据，并具备良好的跨域泛化表现。

Abstract: We introduce FoundDSR, a generalizable foundation model for robust depth reconstruction across unseen data distributions using RGB-D pairs. FoundDSR begins with a guided 2D Gaussian Splatting strategy to model depth representations with Gaussian primitives. This strategy employs high-resolution RGB as prompts to optimize the Gaussian parameters, thereby encouraging each Gaussian primitive to anisotropically deform along high-frequency structural directions. The resulting Gaussian-upsampled representations are then mapped to high-resolution depth through an effective depth reconstruction branch. Furthermore, to mitigate training instability and bias toward dominant sources caused by distribution gaps in large-scale heterogeneous data, we introduce heterogeneous federated learning that allocates each data source to an independent client for local optimization and global aggregation. This design effectively endows FoundDSR with stable scalability to diverse and large-scale training data. Extensive zero-shot evaluations on synthetic, real-world, arbitrary-scale, and noisy conditions demonstrate that FoundDSR consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches, confirming its strong robustness and generalization to unknown scenes.

</details>


### [98] [Progressive-View On-Policy Distillation for Regional-to-Global Transfer in Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32333)
*Shanfeng Huang,Zhou Fang,Song Xiao,Hai Du*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出渐进视角在线策略蒸馏（PVD），通过引入保持长宽比的填充裁剪视角，使学生视角分布从裁剪逐步过渡到全图，并结合区域优势加权，显著提升多模态模型的全图理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 区域到全局蒸馏利用裁剪条件引导提升全图理解，但难点在于如何把教师基于裁剪的优势有效迁移到学生的全图推理中，避免直接由裁剪到全图的分布鸿沟。

Method: PVD在多个阶段中让学生视角分布逐步从裁剪转向全图，中间采用保持长宽比的填充裁剪，既保留区域内容又匹配全图的视觉token网格；各阶段视角混合逐步提高全图概率。同时引入轻量区域优势加权，依据裁剪条件下师生对数概率差重新分配token级监督：差距小时温和重加权，差距大时强调高差距token。并用Jensen-Shannon度量分解解释该调度是从匹配输入模仿向部署目标转变。

Result: 在感知、视觉数学和通用多模态问答等基准上，PVD-full三个随机种子平均准确率达77.51，比无奖励蒸馏基线提高2.01分，比奖励匹配变体提高1.00分；在无奖励设定下，PVD-distill仍提升1.16分。

Conclusion: 通过渐进视角分布调度与区域优势加权，PVD有效弥合了裁剪到全图的蒸馏差距，在多个多模态基准上取得稳定且一致的性能提升。

Abstract: Regional-to-global distillation uses crop-conditioned guidance to improve full-image understanding. The challenge is to effectively transfer the teacher's crop-based advantage to the student's full-image inference. We propose progressive-view on-policy distillation (PVD), which shifts the student's view distribution from the crop toward the full image through an intermediate aspect-preserving padded crop. The padded crop preserves regional content while matching the full image's visual-token grid. Across stages, the view mixture assigns increasing probability to the full image. A lightweight regional-advantage weighting reallocates token-level supervision using the crop-conditioned teacher-student log-probability gap. Evaluated under each sampled input, it applies mild reweighting when the gap is small and emphasizes higher-gap tokens when the gap widens. A Jensen-Shannon metric decomposition interprets this schedule as a shift from matched-input imitation toward the deployment objective. Across benchmarks spanning perception, visual mathematics and general multimodal question answering, PVD-full reaches an average accuracy of 77.51 over three seeds, improving on the reward-free distillation baseline by 2.01 points and on its reward-matched variant by 1.00 point. In the reward-free setting, PVD-distill still gains 1.16 points.

</details>


### [99] [SGA-Flow-GRPO: Spatial Gradient-Guided Credit Assignment for Flow-GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32340)
*Yunkai Yang,Yudong Zhang,Xinying Chen,Bin Luo,Jienan Lyu,Kunquan Zhang,Weitao Wan,Runmin Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对Flow-GRPO在时空维度上使用统一标量优势、忽略图像空间结构的问题，提出面向DiT的梯度引导空间信用分配框架，通过token级重要性采样比与奖励梯度衍生的连续空间信用图（结合MAD鲁棒归一化与温度缩放），在GenEval上实现SOTA对齐质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Flow-GRPO作为无评论家的高效强化学习范式，在采样候选轨迹上计算优势，但其标准做法在时间去噪步与空间潜维度上统一施加标量优势，未显式考虑生成图像的空间结构，可能导致策略更新次优。因此需要一种更精细的空间信用分配机制。

Method: 1）将Flow-GRPO中的转移级对数似然重构为与DiT patch架构原生对齐的token级表示，构建空间细粒度的重要性采样比；2）引入由奖励梯度导出的连续空间信用图，避免刚性且边界敏感的分割启发式；3）采用基于中位数绝对偏差（MAD）的离群值鲁棒归一化并结合温度缩放，在抑制梯度噪声的同时突出与提示对齐的功能性区域。

Result: 在GenEval上的广泛评估表明，该方法达到SOTA对齐质量，收敛速度与DiffusionNFT等顶级方法相当，并在对齐性能上显著优于基于Flow-GRPO的方法。

Conclusion: 梯度引导的空间信用分配框架为DiT类流式生成模型的强化学习对齐提供了细粒度、鲁棒且高效的解决方案，在保持快速收敛的同时显著提升对齐质量。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has proven effective in aligning flow-based generative models with human preferences. Recently, Flow-GRPO has emerged as an efficient critic-free paradigm by calculating advantages over sampled candidate trajectories. However, standard Flow-GRPO applies a uniform scalar advantage across both temporal denoising steps and spatial latent dimensions, without explicitly accounting for the spatial structure of generated images, which may lead to sub-optimal policy updates. To address this, we propose a novel gradient-guided spatial credit assignment framework tailored for Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). We first reformulate the transition-level log-likelihood in Flow-GRPO into a token-wise representation natively aligned with DiT patch architectures, constructing spatially fine-grained importance sampling ratios. To allocate localized credit without rigid, boundary-sensitive segmentation heuristics, we introduce a continuous spatial credit map derived from reward gradients. Crucially, we employ an outlier-robust normalization scheme based on Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) coupled with temperature scaling, effectively eliminating gradient noise while highlighting functional prompt-aligned regions. Extensive evaluations on GenEval show that our approach delivers SOTA alignment quality, achieving a convergence rate comparable to top-tier methods like DiffusionNFT while substantially improving upon Flow-GRPO-based methods in alignment performance.

</details>


### [100] [OpenMASC: An Open-Source Pipeline for Cross-Trajectory Metal-Aware Sampling and Correction in Accelerated MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32343)
*Zhengyi Lu,Ming Lu,Chongyu Qu,Junchao Zhu,Junlin Guo,Marilyn Lionts,Yanfan Zhu,Yuechen Yang,Tianyuan Yao,Jayasai Rajagopal,Bennett Allan Landman,Xiao Wang,Xinqiang Yan,Yuankai Huo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 OpenMASC，一个从数据生成到部署的开源全流程框架，用于金属植入物场景下轨迹无关的加速 MRI 采集与重建联合优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金属植入物会污染整个 k 空间的 MRI 测量，但现有加速 MRI 方法默认数据干净，而多数金属伪影抑制方法又假设全采样。此外，缺少同一解剖结构含/不含金属的配对 k 空间与图像公开数据集，也没有同时处理伪影感知采集与重建的框架。

Method: 包含三部分：(1) 基于物理的数据生成模块，将公开 CT 体数据转换为笛卡尔与径向两种格式的配对干净/金属污染 MRI 数据；(2) MA-VarNet，带逐级联 DC Rectifier 的展开重建网络，用于纠正数据一致性步骤从污染测量中重新引入的伪影；(3) 强化学习智能体主动选择 k 空间读出，并通过解耦三阶段流程与重建网络协同训练。除数据一致性算子外框架轨迹无关，无需改动架构即支持笛卡尔与径向采集。

Result: 在两个数据集、4× 与 8× 加速倍数下的实验表明，该方法在两种轨迹上均持续优于传统与学习型基线。

Conclusion: OpenMASC 首次提供了配对金属伪影数据的开源流程，并实现了采集与重建的联合优化，验证了轨迹无关框架在金属伪影 MRI 加速中的有效性。

Abstract: Metal implants corrupt MRI measurements throughout $k$-space, yet existing accelerated MRI methods assume clean data and most metal artifact reduction approaches assume fully sampled acquisitions. No public dataset provides paired $k$-space and images with and without metal for the same anatomy, and no framework jointly addresses artifact-aware acquisition and reconstruction across sampling trajectories. We present OpenMASC, an open-source pipeline covering the full workflow from data generation to deployment. A physics-based data generation module converts public CT volumes into paired clean and metal-corrupted MRI data in both Cartesian and radial formats. MA-VarNet, an unrolled reconstruction network with a per-cascade DC Rectifier, corrects artifacts that data-consistency steps reintroduce from corrupted measurements. A reinforcement learning agent actively selects $k$-space readouts and co-trains with the reconstruction network through a decoupled three-stage procedure. The framework is trajectory-agnostic except for the data-consistency operator, supporting both Cartesian and radial acquisition without architectural changes. Experiments on two datasets at $4\times$ and $8\times$ acceleration demonstrate consistent improvements over conventional and learned baselines on both trajectories.

</details>


### [101] [EyeVQA: Benchmarking Ophthalmic Vision-Language Models from Recognition to Spatial Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32352)
*Gujie Shao,Zixun Xie,Xuechun Xing,Ruixiang Wang,Ziyun Lan,Yanlin Qi,Gangyi Zhang,Yuxin Yang,Dawei Li,Haiming Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EyeVQA，一个统一的眼科视觉问答基准，包含2万问答对，覆盖6个疾病组和7种题型，用于系统评估眼科视觉语言模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 眼科视觉语言模型能力尚未被充分刻画，已有数据集多针对单一疾病或专门任务，难以系统评估模型是否具备跨病种比较推理和细粒度空间定位能力。

Method: EyeVQA由21个眼科数据集构建，含20,000问答对，涵盖6类疾病组和7种题型（单选、多选、变项选择、判断、排序、点定位、边界框）。金标准答案由源数据提供的诊断、严重度分级、临床发现、分割掩膜、边界框和解剖标志确定，确保可复现且不依赖模型生成标注；44.5%的问题需跨多张图像推理。在统一零样本协议下评测14个代表性通用、科学及医学专用视觉语言模型。

Result: 最佳模型总体得分仅62.8，在空间定位和跨任务泛化方面存在明显差距。

Conclusion: 现有视觉语言模型在综合眼科视觉理解上仍有局限，EyeVQA可作为诊断性基准，推动更可靠、具备空间定位能力的眼科多模态模型发展。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for medical image understanding, yet their capabilities in ophthalmic imaging remain insufficiently characterized. Existing ophthalmic datasets are typically designed for individual diseases or specialized tasks, making it difficult to systematically evaluate whether VLMs can move beyond disease recognition toward comparative reasoning and fine-grained spatial grounding. We introduce EyeVQA, a unified visual question answering benchmark for comprehensive evaluation of ophthalmic VLMs. EyeVQA is constructed from 21 available ophthalmic datasets and contains 20,000 question-answer pairs spanning six disease groups and seven question types: Single-Choice, Multi-Select, Variable-Select, True-False, Ranking, Point Location, and Bounding Box. Gold answers are deterministically derived from source-provided diagnoses, severity grades, clinical findings, segmentation masks, bounding boxes, and anatomical landmarks, enabling reproducible evaluation without relying on model-generated annotations. Notably, 44.5% of the questions require reasoning across multiple images, extending evaluation beyond conventional single-image medical VQA. We benchmark fourteen representative general-purpose, scientific, and medically specialized VLMs under a unified zero-shot protocol. The best-performing model only achieves an overall score of 62.8, while substantial gaps remain in spatial grounding and cross-task generalization. These results highlight the limitations of current VLMs in comprehensive ophthalmic visual understanding and establish EyeVQA as a diagnostic benchmark for developing more reliable and spatially grounded ophthalmic multimodal models. The project page is available at https://github.com/PKUTHM/EyeVQA.

</details>


### [102] [Fewer Tokens, More Self-Teaching: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Extreme Visual Token Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32353)
*Junxian Li,Ruixuan Yang,Tianao Zhang,Tiange Xu,Weisheng Dong,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LT-OPD训练框架，通过on-policy自蒸馏实现极端视觉token压缩下MLLM能力恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉token压缩能加速多模态大模型，但极端低token预算下性能急剧下降；作者希望探索重度压缩模型如何从自身生成的状态中学习。

Method: 采用on-policy自蒸馏：学生模型仅用少量视觉token生成响应，冻结的同源全token模型作为教师在这些学生轨迹上提供分布监督；并引入逐步降低token预算的budget-level课程以稳定训练。

Result: 在Qwen3.5-4B的九个基准上，5%视觉token保留率下平均保留性能从68.6%提升至82.3%，超越同类预算下的训练-free、训练-based和强化学习基线；在Qwen3.5-9B、GLM-4.6V-9B、LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B上同样有效；KV-cache降低85.2%，prefill FLOPs降低85.4%，无额外推理开销。

Conclusion: on-policy学习能显著恢复极端视觉token压缩所损失的能力，验证了LT-OPD框架的有效性与可迁移性。

Abstract: Visual token reduction is an effective way to accelerate multimodal large language models (MLLMs), but performance deteriorates rapidly under extremely low token budgets. Existing work has explored both visual-token selection and training-based adaptation to reduced visual inputs. We take a step further by asking how a heavily compressed MLLM should learn from the states induced by its own generations. This setting naturally calls for on-policy self-distillation: a heavily compressed model is supervised on the states induced by its own generations, while its full-token counterpart serves as an information-rich teacher. Based on this insight, we propose LT-OPD, a training framework for extreme visual-token reduction. The student rolls out responses with only a small fraction of visual tokens, and a frozen full-token copy of the same MLLM provides distributional supervision along these student-generated trajectories. To stabilize on-policy learning when visual evidence is severely limited, we further introduce a budget-level curriculum that progressively decreases the token budget during training. Across nine benchmarks on Qwen3.5-4B, LT-OPD raises average retained performance under 5% visual-token retention from 68.6% to 82.3%, outperforming training-free, training-based, and reinforcement-learning baselines at the same budget. The gains transfer consistently to Qwen3.5-9B, GLM-4.6V-9B, and LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B. LT-OPD also reduces KV-cache usage by 85.2% and prefill FLOPs by 85.4% without additional inference overhead, demonstrating that on-policy learning can substantially recover capabilities lost to extreme visual-token reduction.

</details>


### [103] [StegGNN: Learning Graphical Representation for Image Steganography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32362)
*Abhinav Kumar,Shorya Singhal,Agam Pandey,Tushar Kumar,Sukrit Jindal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出StegGNN，一种基于图神经网络(GNN)的自动编码器式、与载体无关的图像隐写框架，将图像建模为图结构以克服CNN的网格化局限，实验表明其性能与现有CNN基准相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前深度学习图像隐写主要依赖CNN及其变体（逆神经网络、自动编码器、GAN等），但CNN将图像视为规则网格，受限于感受野大小和空间局部性偏好，表达能力受限。而GNN（如ViG）在多种计算机视觉任务中已展现强大适应性并达到SOTA，因此作者希望将GNN引入隐写领域，探索更灵活的表示方式。

Method: 提出StegGNN——一种新颖的、基于自动编码器、与载体无关(cover-agnostic)的图像隐写框架。核心思想是把图像建模为图结构，从而利用GNN的表示灵活性替代传统CNN的网格刚性。

Result: 在标准基准数据集上进行大量实验，评估视觉质量与不可感知性。结果显示，该GNN方法的性能与现有CNN基准相当(comparable)。

Conclusion: GNN为隐写嵌入提供了一种有前景的替代表示，为深度学习隐写领域进一步探索基于GNN的架构开辟了方向。

Abstract: Image steganography refers to embedding secret messages within cover images while maintaining imperceptibility. Recent advances in deep learning - primarily driven by Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and architectures such as inverse neural networks, autoencoders, and generative adversarial networks - have led to notable progress. However, these frameworks are primarily built on CNN architectures, which treat images as regular grids and are limited by their receptive field size and a bias toward spatial locality. In parallel, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have recently demonstrated strong adaptability in several computer vision tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance with architectures such as Vision GNN (ViG). This work moves in that direction and introduces StegGNN - a novel autoencoder-based, cover-agnostic image steganography framework based on GNNs. By modeling images as graph structures, our approach leverages the representational flexibility of GNNs over the grid-based rigidity of conventional CNNs. We conduct extensive experiments on standard benchmark datasets to evaluate visual quality and imperceptibility. Our results show that our GNN-based method performs comparably to existing CNN benchmarks. These findings suggest that GNNs provide a promising alternative representation for steganographic embedding and open the field of deep learning-based steganography to further exploration of GNN-based architectures.

</details>


### [104] [An End-to-End Latent-Rollout Approach for Pushing Few-Step ImageNet-$256$ Generation to FID $1.11$ without Fréchet Losses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32376)
*Xiaoran Xu,Yujing Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FiST（Flow-in-Stage Transformer），采用"先蒸馏后精炼"策略实现少步生成：先在潜空间用教师模仿建立强初始化，再对完整潜变量 rollout 进行端到端对抗式精炼，在 ImageNet 256×256 类别条件生成上以三阶段达 FID 1.11、两阶段达 FID 1.15。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迭代生成本质上是一个跨步骤的联合优化问题：中间预测会影响后续计算并最终决定输出分布。从预训练扩散/流匹配模型蒸馏得到的少步生成器，使这种端到端优化在计算上变得可行。作者希望利用这一机会，在不显式最小化 Fréchet 距离的前提下，通过可学习的分布级监督实现有竞争力的少步生成。

Method: 采用 distill-then-refine（先蒸馏后精炼）两阶段方法。架构为 FiST（Flow-in-Stage Transformer），使用共享 Transformer 在少阶段（few stages）中组合学习到的潜状态转移，并支持可选的跨阶段隐层通信。蒸馏阶段：对教师轨迹上的选定状态施加 teacher-forced 回归，为少步 rollout 提供强初始化。精炼阶段：用对抗目标和辅助分类目标替代回归监督，作用于最终潜输出；训练一个判别器模块，其输入是由冻结的、经 REPA 预训练的 SiT 骨干网络从干净真实潜变量与生成潜变量中提取的语义丰富特征。全部训练在潜空间完成，不进行图像解码。精炼时 FiST 消费自身中间预测，端点梯度穿过每个生成阶段。

Result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 类别条件生成任务上，三阶段达到 FID 1.11（IS 282），两阶段达到 FID 1.15（IS 280）。消融实验刻画了蒸馏、预训练检查点选择、精炼监督方式以及跨阶段隐层通信对生成质量的影响。

Conclusion: 结果表明，通过可学习的分布级监督、而非显式的 Fréchet 距离最小化，可以实现有竞争力的少步生成，验证了蒸馏初始化加端到端潜空间精炼这一范式的有效性。

Abstract: Iterative generation poses a joint optimization problem across steps, as intermediate predictions shape subsequent computations and ultimately determine the final output distribution. Few-step generators distilled from pretrained diffusion and flow-matching models make such optimization computationally practical end to end. We build on this opportunity with a distill-then-refine approach that uses teacher imitation to establish a strong initialization for a few-step rollout in latent space, then shifts to end-to-end refinement of the complete latent rollout against real data. We introduce FiST (Flow-in-Stage Transformer), an architecture that composes learned latent-state transitions in a few stages using a shared Transformer, with optional cross-stage hidden communication. Distillation applies teacher-forced regression to selected states along teacher trajectories; refinement replaces this supervision with adversarial and auxiliary classification objectives on the final latent output. A trainable discriminator module operates on semantically rich features extracted from clean real and generated latents by a frozen SiT backbone pretrained with REPA. All training takes place in latent space, without image decoding. During refinement, FiST consumes its own intermediate predictions, and endpoint gradients pass through every generation stage. For class-conditional generation on ImageNet at $256\times256$, our approach achieves FID 1.11 (IS 282) with three stages and FID 1.15 (IS 280) with two. These results demonstrate competitive few-step generation through learned distribution-level supervision, without explicit Fréchet-distance minimization. Ablations characterize how distillation, pretrained checkpoint choices, refinement supervision, and cross-stage hidden communication affect generation quality.

</details>


### [105] [RefCompose: Multi-Reference Image Generation via LoRA-Conditioned Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32389)
*Sai Sri Teja Kuppa,Parth Shinde,Priyadharsan Balaji S,Jinka Harshavardhan,Sriprabha Ramanarayanan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 RefCompose 像素空间组合条件框架，用固定分辨率参考画布与双流 LoRA 解耦"位置"与"外观"，实现参考数量增加时内存恒定、多参考高保真组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 影视与视觉创作常需将多个参考、人物、场景、道具、文化元素组合进同一画面，但现有工具要么在参考数量稍多时失效（逐参考分词使内存随数量 N 线性增长），要么在过程中破坏细粒度主体身份，生成内容偏离给定参考。

Method: RefCompose 在像素空间做组合条件化，将"放哪里"与"长什么样"解耦：使用单一固定分辨率参考画布，使条件规模与参考数量无关；推理时由冻结的扩散 Transformer 诱导空间布局并经 Grounding DINO 提取，无需 LLM 或专用布局模型；采用双流 LoRA 适配器，把布局导出的深度图与编码画布经由两条独立低秩流注入，分离几何骨架与局部外观。

Result: 在 Dense Layout 协议上，RefCompose 在颜色、纹理、形状、空间准确度以及身份/内容保真度上，于更高参考数量下持续优于基于布局的方法与当前最优多参考基线，且推理内存恒定。

Conclusion: RefCompose 可作为生产级多主体影视构图的实用模块，在参考数扩展性与主体身份保持之间取得平衡。

Abstract: Filmmakers and visual artists routinely need to compose multiple references, actors, locations, props, cultural elements, into a single coherent shot, but existing tools either fail to scale past a handful of references or destroy fine grained subject identity in the process, since per reference tokenization scales memory linearly with reference count $N$ and generated content often departs from the given references rather than reproducing them. We propose \textbf{RefCompose}, a pixel space compositional conditioning framework that decouples \emph{where} things go from \emph{what} they look like, via a single fixed resolution reference canvas that keeps conditioning size constant regardless of reference count. Spatial layout is induced at inference time from a frozen diffusion transformer and extracted via Grounding DINO, requiring no LLM or dedicated layout model, while dual stream LoRA adapters inject a layout derived depth map and the encoded canvas through separate low rank streams, disentangling geometric scaffolding from localized appearance. On the Dense Layout protocol, RefCompose consistently outperforms layout based and state of the art multi reference baselines on color, texture, shape, spatial accuracy, and identity/content preservation at higher reference counts, all with constant inference memory, making it a practical building block for multi subject cinematic composition at production scale.

</details>


### [106] [Endo-TSR: Temporal Spectral Modeling of Appearance and Motion for Endoscopic Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32399)
*Taoyu Wu,Yiyi Miao,Qi Shao,Zhuoxiao Li,Zhe Tang,Limin Yu,Baoru Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Endo-TSR，在可变形高斯泼溅中加入有界傅里叶颜色残差与独立平移残差，并配合 Matérn 谱先验和多尺度拉普拉斯监督，提升内窥镜场景重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内窥镜场景重建需同时建模组织运动、时间外观变化并恢复精细表面细节。可变形高斯模型虽提供显式轨迹，但其固定颜色系数缺乏专门的时间表示来刻画光度变化。

Method: 在可变形高斯泼溅基础上引入有界傅里叶颜色残差和独立平移残差，二者共享时间频率；颜色残差捕捉局部外观变化；用 Matérn 谱先验正则化运动修正；联合图像拟合时采用多尺度拉普拉斯监督引导组织细节恢复。

Result: 在 EndoNeRF 和 StereoMIS 数据集上取得最优渲染质量，所有评估序列均获得最高 PSNR。消融实验显示，时间外观带来的 PSNR 增益最大；在固定高斯数量下，外观与细节监督共同改善渲染效果。

Conclusion: Endo-TSR 通过显式时间外观表示与细节监督，有效提升了内窥镜可变形高斯重建的渲染质量，消融结果验证了各模块的必要性与贡献差异。

Abstract: Endoscopic scene reconstruction requires modeling tissue motion and temporal appearance while recovering fine surface detail. Deformable Gaussian models provide explicit trajectories, but their fixed colour coefficients lack a dedicated temporal representation for photometric changes. We propose Endo-TSR, which augments deformable Gaussian splatting with bounded Fourier colour residuals and independent translation residuals on shared temporal frequencies. The colour residuals capture local appearance changes, while a Matérn spectral prior regularises motion corrections. Multi-scale Laplacian supervision guides tissue-detail recovery during joint image fitting. Extensive experiments on the EndoNeRF and StereoMIS datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art rendering quality, with the highest PSNR across all evaluated sequences. Ablation studies show that temporal appearance yields the largest PSNR gain among the tested component additions, while appearance and detail supervision jointly improve rendering with fixed Gaussian counts.

</details>


### [107] [Toward On-Chip Training of Spiking Neural Networks for Dense Event-Based Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32405)
*Maxime Vaillant,Axel Carlier,Lai Xing Ng,Christophe Hurter,Benoit R. Cottereau*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出DELL（Dense Event-driven Local Learning），一种用于密集事件视觉的块级局部学习方案，用局部密集监督替代全局梯度传播，在全脉冲U型架构上验证了光流回归与语义分割任务，显著降低训练内存并提升光流精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机为资源受限机器人提供低延迟异步视觉感知，SNN能自然处理事件流，但基于BPTT训练深层SNN需要大量内存且在神经形态硬件上困难。现有局部学习虽避免全局误差传播，却主要针对分类任务，而非密集预测。

Method: 提出DELL，一种块级局部学习方案，用可学习的、空间结构化的局部头在每个块的适当分辨率上进行监督，同时保留块内的时间动态，取代全局梯度传播，并采用全脉冲U型架构。

Result: 在DSEC光流任务上，DELL相比端到端BPTT减少39.6%峰值训练内存并提升精度，官方测试benchmark端点误差1.670 px（端到端为1.941 px）；块分离更像正则化而非约束。相较DECOLLE基线，端点误差降低3.9倍，并在所有光流指标上超越端到端训练。分割任务上恢复了大部分性能差距，但仍落后端到端几个mIoU点。仅2.3M参数（比最强SNN基线少24倍），骨干仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: DELL将局部学习扩展到密集事件视觉预测，同时大幅降低训练内存，为资源受限场景下的事件视觉提供有效方案。

Abstract: Event cameras provide low-latency, asynchronous visual sensing for resource-constrained robotics. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) process event streams naturally, but training deep SNNs with backpropagation through time (BPTT) requires substantial memory and remains difficult on neuromorphic hardware. Local learning avoids this by restricting error propagation to local blocks, but existing methods mainly target classification rather than dense prediction. We introduce DELL (Dense Event-driven Local Learning), a block wise scheme for dense event-based vision that replaces global gradient propagation with local dense supervision. Learnable, spatially structured local heads supervise each block at its appropriate resolution while preserving temporal dynamics within blocks. We evaluate DELL on optical-flow regression and semantic segmentation with a fully spiking U-shaped architecture. On DSEC optical flow, DELL reduces peak training memory by 39.6% relative to end-to-end BPTT while improving accuracy, reaching 1.670 px endpoint error on the official test benchmark versus 1.941 px for the same backbone trained end-to-end. Block detachment behaves more like a regularizer than a constraint. DECOLLE, the existing local-learning baseline, relies on fixed random local read-outs poorly suited to dense regression, resulting in a 3.9x higher endpoint error; learnable local heads recover this loss and outperform end-to-end training across all optical-flow metrics. On segmentation, they recover most of the performance gap, although DELL remains a few mIoU points behind end-to-end training. With 2.3M parameters, 24x fewer than the strongest SNN baseline, the backbone remains competitive with the SNN state of the art on DSEC. These results extend local learning to dense event-based prediction while substantially reducing training memory.

</details>


### [108] [RefAdapt-DiT: Adaptive Joint Attention for Reference-Conditioned Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32415)
*Jian Tang,Jiawei Fan,Qiannan Zhou,Qingbin Liu,Jiang Bian,Zang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出免训练的 RefAdapt 框架，通过自适应控制参考流与目标流的联合注意力计算，加速条件生成中的扩散 Transformer，在少量步数设置下最高实现 3.54 倍加速且视觉质量相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散 Transformer 在条件生成任务中计算开销大，原因在于双向联合注意力需反复处理大量参考流。现有优化方法依赖粗粒度静态复用，忽视了参考表示与目标表示的动态差异：参考表示沿生成轨迹变化缓慢，而目标对参考的注意力权重往往较小，二者共同决定陈旧参考状态对目标的影响。

Method: 提出免训练框架 RefAdapt，自适应控制参考与目标之间的联合注意力。方法结合连续目标 Q 的变化量与先前观测到的目标对参考的注意力质量，以块粒度自适应控制参考计算，替代僵化的静态策略。

Result: 在超少步设置下，RefAdapt 在 4 步 MiniMax H3 上实现最高 2.097 倍加速，在 8 步 Qwen Image Edit 上实现 3.54 倍加速，同时保持相当的视觉质量。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了参考漂移与目标到参考曝光对陈旧参考状态影响的作用机制，并提出一种无需训练、基于块粒度的自适应计算控制方法，有效加速条件生成的扩散 Transformer 而不损失视觉质量。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become the standard backbone for high-quality generative modeling, yet deploying them in conditional generation tasks remains computationally prohibitive because bidirectional joint attention repeatedly processes large reference streams. While existing optimization schemes mitigate generic temporal redundancy, they typically rely on coarse-grained static reuse and overlook the distinct dynamics of references and targets. Specifically, we observe that reference representations often evolve slowly along the generation trajectory, while the target often assigns little attention mass to them; reference drift and this target-to-reference exposure jointly shape how strongly stale reference states affect the target. To exploit these patterns, we introduce \RefAdapt, a training-free framework for adaptive control of joint attention between references and targets. Instead of rigid static strategies, \RefAdapt combines consecutive target-Q change with previously observed target-to-reference attention mass to control reference computation adaptively at block granularity. Under ultra-few-step settings, \RefAdapt enables speedups of up to $2.097\times$ on 4-step MiniMax H3 and $3.54\times$ on 8-step Qwen Image Edit, while maintaining comparable visual quality.

</details>


### [109] [CityToolVQA: Tool-Augmented Visual Question Answering for 3D Spatial Cognition in Urban Low-Altitude Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32427)
*Boao Yu,Yingzhen Nie,Yue Hu,Zhengqiu Zhu,Rusheng Ju*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CityToolVQA通过将定量问题交由外部视觉-几何工具链处理，显著提升VLM在城市低空视觉问答中的定量任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在城市低空视觉问答的定量任务上表现较弱，尤其是度量距离与物体尺寸估计能力受限，需要外部显式3D几何计算来补充。

Method: 将七类任务分为定性与定量两组：定性问题由VLM直接回答；定量问题由外部视觉-几何工具链处理，包括目标定位、分割、深度反投影与空间计算。工具链可以零样本方式挂载到不同VLM上；当主链检测无效或不可靠时触发Depth-Assisted Prompt Inference（DAPI）回退机制；CityToolVQA-SFT用于让8B骨干适配工具条件输入。

Result: 在73,324题的Open3D-VQA-v2测试集上，CityToolVQA-SFT（Qwen3-VL-8B）达到67.6%的整体准确率；将工具链挂载到十个开源VLM上，定量任务准确率提升12.7-36.9个百分点。

Conclusion: 将显式3D几何计算外部化，能有效弥补仅依赖RGB的VLM在度量距离和物体尺寸估计方面的能力不足。

Abstract: CityToolVQA addresses the weak performance of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on quantitative tasks in urban low-altitude visual question answering. We divide the seven tasks into qualitative and quantitative groups: qualitative questions are answered directly by the VLM, whereas quantitative questions are handled by an external visual-geometric toolchain that performs object grounding, segmentation, depth back-projection, and spatial computation. The toolchain can be attached to different VLMs in a zero-shot manner; a Depth-Assisted Prompt Inference (DAPI) fallback is triggered when the main-chain detection is invalid or unreliable, and CityToolVQA-SFT adapts the 8B backbone to tool-conditioned inputs. On the 73,324-question Open3D-VQA-v2 test set, CityToolVQA-SFT (Qwen3-VL-8B) reaches 67.6% overall accuracy, and attaching the toolchain to ten open-source VLMs improves quantitative-task accuracy by 12.7-36.9 percentage points. These results indicate that externalizing explicit 3D geometric computation effectively complements the limited ability of RGB-only VLMs to estimate metric distances and object sizes.

</details>


### [110] [De-biasing Skeleton-based Action Recognition with Convex Hull Adaptive Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32454)
*Mengyuan Liu,Yuhang Wen,Yi Zhang,Songtao Wu,Hong Liu,Junsong Yuan,Beichen Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出凸包自适应平移归一化方法CHASE，缓解骨骼动作与交互识别中的实体偏置，在7个数据集上即插即用地提升多种骨干性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有骨骼动作/交互识别多采用晚期融合，假设各实体独立同分布以训练共享权重的实体编码器；但世界坐标系原点的初始配置导致实体偏置，违背该假设，使骨干优化次优、识别结果出错。因此需要一种归一化方法来减少实体偏置。

Method: 1）提出凸包自适应平移CHASE，对输入骨架自适应施加合理平移；2）设计即插即用的参数化网络，约束平移后的世界原点落在骨架凸包内，通过限制搜索空间避免不收敛；3）引入基于成对分布距离的辅助目标引导优化；4）提出子实体策略统一单实体与多实体动作的建模；5）兼容骨骼、速度等多种骨架内模态。

Result: 在7个数据集上的大量实验表明，CHASE可无缝集成到多种骨干网络中，并显著提升其识别性能。

Conclusion: CHASE本质上是一种减少实体偏置的归一化方法，能使后续分类器在多样设置下获得更优的识别性能，具有良好兼容性与适应性。

Abstract: Skeleton sequences can represent both individual actions and multi-entity interactions, encompassing human bodies, hands, objects, and robots. Existing approaches to recognize skeleton-based actions and interactions usually adopt a late fusion strategy, which expects individuals are independent and identically distributed to train a robust weight-shared entity encoder. However, observed entity bias in various skeletal data violates this assumption, leading to suboptimal optimization of backbone models that might produce wrong recognition results. This bias arises from the world coordinate system's initial configuration, where the choice of origin often creates bias in representation. To this end, we propose a Convex Hull Adaptive Shift based normalization method to reduce Entity bias (CHASE), improving performance across a variety of skeleton-based action and interaction recognition tasks. To adaptively apply plausible shifts to the input skeletons, we formulate a plug-and-play parameterized network that ensures the relocated world origin lies within the skeleton convex hull, which avoids non-convergence by limiting the search space. To further minimize entity bias, we incorporate an auxiliary objective that leverages pair-wise distribution distances to guide network optimization. To support both single- and multi-entity actions, we propose a sub-entity strategy that offers a consistent formulation for both scenarios. Moreover, CHASE demonstrates compatibility with various intra-skeleton modalities, such as bones and velocities, highlighting its adaptability. Essentially, our method works as a normalization approach to reduce entity bias, enabling subsequent classifiers to achieve improved recognition performance across diverse settings. Extensive experiments on 7 datasets verify our approach by seamlessly integrating with various backbones and significantly boosting their performance.

</details>


### [111] [QuacamFM: Quaternion-Constrained Flow Matching for Camera Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32455)
*Bao-Long Tran,Cuong Le,Tahereh Dehdarirad,Fredrik Viksten,Per-Erik Forssén*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出QuacamFM，一种四元数约束的流匹配框架，通过在整个流轨迹上保持单位四元数表示并利用球面线性插值实现最优传输，提升稀疏视角相机位姿估计精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏视角下相机位姿估计因几何约束不足而存在固有歧义。现有基于扩散模型的概率方法虽能生成多个相机位姿假设以捕捉不确定性，但多数用单位四元数表示旋转时将其当作无约束4D向量处理，忽略了单位范数约束，导致生成轨迹不平滑且次优。

Method: 提出QuacamFM，一个四元数约束的流匹配（flow matching）框架，在整个流轨迹上保持单位四元数表示；采用平滑的球面线性插值（slerp）设计四元数流的最优传输。

Result: 在CO3Dv2上实验表明，方法在相机位姿精度上优于基于扩散的方法和经典SfM方法；四元数约束公式优于将标准流匹配朴素应用于4D四元数向量的做法；且在跨数据集和野外样本上泛化良好。

Conclusion: 通过保持单位四元数约束并采用球面线性插值，QuacamFM能更准确、平滑地估计稀疏视角相机位姿，并具备良好泛化能力。

Abstract: Camera pose estimation from multi-view images remains a challenge in computer vision. Traditional methods often address this problem using Structure-from-Motion (SfM) with bundle adjustment. However, camera poses estimated from sparse views are inherently ambiguous due to insufficient geometric constraints. Recent work leverages probabilistic models, such as diffusion models, to generate multiple camera pose hypotheses and therefore capture this uncertainty better. Most of these methods represent camera rotations using unit quaternions, but treat them as unconstrained 4D vectors during the generative processes, thereby ignoring the unit-norm constraint of quaternions. Unconstrained quaternions create non-smooth and suboptimal generation trajectories. To this end, we propose *QuacamFM*, a quaternion-constrained flow matching framework for camera pose estimation that preserves unit quaternion representations throughout the entire flow trajectory. We design the optimal transport of the quaternion flows using smooth spherical linear interpolation. Experiments on CO3Dv2 demonstrate our method's advantage in camera pose accuracy over diffusion-based methods and classical SfM approaches. We further show that our quaternion-constrained formulation outperforms the naive application of standard flow matching to 4D quaternion vectors on sparse-view camera pose estimation. Finally, it is observed that QuacamFM generalizes well across datasets and in-the-wild examples.

</details>


### [112] [Seeing Parts, Reasoning about Worlds: Visual Inference under Partial Observation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32456)
*Wei Wang,Wenqiao Zhang,Yutong Lin,Jun Xiao,Yueting Zhuang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出WorldScope，通过可能世界语义研究部分观测下的世界建模，构建120万问答对数据集与4800组反事实世界监督，并设计WorldFlow模型，在WorldScope-Bench上以64.34%准确率显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部分观测下，遮挡物体与未观测区域会留下多种可能的世界状态，额外视角可排除替代方案。论文希望系统研究观测证据如何约束可能世界、并支撑结论强度这一过程。

Method: 构建WorldScope-1.2M数据集（120万问答对，覆盖8种世界属性、10种任务接口、3种观测协议，答案含已确认事实、支持性边界与未决可能性），并提供4800组认证反事实世界组作为歧义物理见证与训练标签；提出WorldFlow，将跨视角实体证据与支持面覆盖组合为图像子集证据格，用反事实兼容性与转移目标训练子集表示，再由共享答案生成器预测最强支持结论。

Result: 在WorldScope-Bench的5000题测试集上，WorldFlow达到64.34%精确准确率，较同一骨干仅用QA训练提升24.88个百分点；在3000题结构不相交场景上仍保持50.43%准确率。

Conclusion: WorldScope与WorldFlow表明，显式建模可能世界兼容性与视角诱导的排除关系，可有效提升部分观测下的证据依赖推理能力，并具备一定的结构泛化性。

Abstract: World modeling under partial observation requires reasoning about the complete worlds that remain compatible with limited visual evidence. Occluded objects and unseen regions can leave several world states possible; additional views can exclude alternatives and strengthen the conclusions supported by the observations. We introduce WorldScope to study this process through possible-world semantics, evidence-grounded data, and learned visual representations. WorldScope-1.2M provides 1.2 million English question-answer pairs spanning eight world properties, ten task interfaces, and three observation protocols. Its answers encode confirmed facts, supported bounds, and unresolved possibilities. Complementary supervision comprises 4,800 certified counterworld groups with equivalent base observations and different hidden object configurations and query answers. These groups provide physical witnesses of ambiguity and training-only labels for world compatibility and view-induced exclusions. We propose WorldFlow, which composes cross-view entity evidence and support-surface coverage into an image-subset evidence lattice. Counterworld compatibility and transition objectives train subset representations to reflect how new observations constrain possible worlds. A shared answer generator uses these representations to predict the strongest supported conclusion. WorldScope-Bench evaluates claim judgments and evidence-dependent conclusions as views are selected, combined, removed, or ordered. On its 5,000-question test set, WorldFlow reaches 64.34% exact accuracy, improving over the same backbone trained on QA alone by 24.88 percentage points. It retains 50.43% accuracy on the 3,000 questions from structure-disjoint scenes.

</details>


### [113] [REMEDY: How Far Is Video Generation from Medical Education World Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32460)
*Lixing Tan,Yanghao Zhou,Qing Xia,Yuting Guo,Shuai Li,Aimin Hao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出REMEDY，首个用于评估AI生成医学教学演示的基准，覆盖12项任务、4类场景，测试5个开源视频生成模型共4500个视频，发现视觉逼真并不代表临床动作正确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成模型日益成熟并有望成为世界模型的基础，这为生成医学教学演示带来机会，但此类应用既要求视觉质量又要程序动作准确。目前尚无衡量现有生成器是否满足这些要求的标准。

Method: REMEDY提供来自真实演示视频的900个首帧，涵盖手术室、影像、门诊与床旁、复苏四类场景共12项任务。五个当代开源视频生成模型基于这些首帧生成4500个视频。评估结合任务专用临床检查表与视频、运动质量指标，从临床动作遵循、临床画像、视频质量、运动质量四个维度进行评价。

Result: 结果表明，逼真的外观和时间一致性并不能保证临床动作正确。即使最先进的MiniMax-H3在严格临床成功率上也仅达28.25%，细粒度临床动作仍是难点。

Conclusion: 该研究为未来医学教育世界模型的开发奠定了基础并提供了路线图。

Abstract: Recent video generation models produce realistic videos and show potential as a foundation for world models. These advances create opportunities for generating medical teaching demonstrations, which requires both convincing visual quality and precise procedural actions. However, whether current generators can meet these requirements has not been measured. To address this problem, we introduce Readiness Evaluation of Medical Education Demonstration sYnthesis (REMEDY), to our knowledge, the first benchmark for AI-generated medical teaching demonstrations. REMEDY provides 900 first frames from real demonstration videos, covering 12 tasks across four scenarios: operating room, imaging, clinic and bedside, and resuscitation. Five contemporary open-source video generation models produce 4,500 videos from these frames. We combine task-specific clinical checklists with video and motion quality metrics. Evaluation covers four dimensions: clinical action following, clinical profiles, video quality, and motion quality. Our results show that realistic appearance and temporal consistency do not ensure correct clinical actions. Even the most advanced MiniMax-H3 achieves only 28.25% on strict clinical success rate, and fine-grained clinical actions remain challenging. These findings establish a foundation and roadmap for developing future medical education world models.

</details>


### [114] [Can Motion-Language Models Ground Structure? STRIDE for Evaluating the Evaluators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32462)
*Lixing Tan,Qing Xia,Yuting Guo,Shuai Li,Aimin Hao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出STRIDE基准（5869条三元组），系统评估运动-语言评估器对时间顺序、镜像反射与动作身份的结构性对齐能力，发现现有评估器结构对齐薄弱且镜像敏感性严重不足，并通过引入结构难负样本显著提升对比学习表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运动-语言模型通常依赖运动-语言评估器进行打分，但这些评估器在多大程度上真正理解语言结构（如时间顺序、镜像反射、动作身份）尚不明确，且常用评测协议无法暴露这些缺陷。

Method: 构建STRIDE基准，包含5869个三元组（运动、原始描述、扰动描述），覆盖长短描述；对描述对进行似然平衡以降低纯文本偏差，并在无关运动下估计评估器的描述偏好作为基线，从而衡量匹配运动带来的判别增益；进一步分析纯文本先验、检索与分布指标对结构破坏的响应，并提出结构难负样本的对比学习干预。

Result: 实验揭示审计的评估器结构对齐能力薄弱、镜像敏感性严重不足；纯文本先验即可在现有数据集的朴素扰动测试中取得高分，而常用检索与分布指标对镜像造成的结构破坏几乎无响应。

Conclusion: 标准评测协议掩盖了评估器的结构性缺陷，结构难负样本是有效干预手段，简单修改对比学习即可显著提升时间顺序与镜像反射任务的表现；基准与代码将开源。

Abstract: Motion-language models are typically scored by motion-language evaluators, but how well these evaluators ground language structure remains unclear. Here, we introduce the Structure grounding via Temporal-order, Reflection, and Identity Diagnostic Evaluation (STRIDE) benchmark to systematically evaluate the ability of evaluators to track temporal order, mirror reflection, and action identity. STRIDE comprises $5{,}869$ triples, each consisting of a motion, its original caption, and a perturbed caption, spanning both short and long descriptions. We likelihood-balance caption pairs to reduce text-only bias and estimate each evaluator's caption preference under unrelated motions to measure the discrimination gain from matched motions relative to this baseline. Our experiments reveal weak structural grounding and severe deficits in mirror sensitivity among the audited evaluators, which commonly used evaluation protocols fail to expose. To understand why these limitations go undetected in standard tests, we examine the evaluators more closely. We find that text-only priors alone can solve naive perturbation tests on existing datasets, while common retrieval and distributional metrics barely respond to structural corruption introduced by mirroring ground-truth motions. These findings suggest a natural intervention: structural hard negatives. Our experiments show that a simple modification to contrastive learning substantially improves performance on temporal order and mirror reflection. The benchmark and code will be released.

</details>


### [115] [Back-Tracking from Clarity: Self-Learning to See Text from Afar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32477)
*Duc-Tri Tran,Phi Le Nguyen,Minh Hoai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出自监督框架，通过视频回溯源生成伪标签，提升场景文本检测器对远距离、小尺寸、模糊文本的早期检测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统场景文本检测模型在文本实例距离远、尺寸小、模糊时常常漏检。作者希望借助已有模型对清晰大文本的高精度能力，自动为退化帧生成标签，避免人工标注，从而提升早期文本检测性能。

Method: 利用现有文本检测模型在清晰大文本上的高置信检测结果作为监督信号，通过视频时间回溯，将这些检测结果传播到此前远距离文本仍模糊或过小的帧，自动合成伪标签；据此训练专门用于早期文本检测的学生模型。为保证伪标签质量，设计了能够在复杂视频序列中保持文本身份一致性的场景文本跟踪器。此外构建多语言户外数据集SceneText50用于训练和评估。

Result: 实验表明，该框架在不同场景和语言下显著提升了早期检测的准确性与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该自监督回溯源框架无需人工标注即可有效提升远距离、退化文本的检测能力，并提供了新数据集与公开代码数据。

Abstract: We propose a self-supervised framework designed to enhance the capability of scene text detectors in identifying and recognizing text in scenarios where instances are shown at significant distances, typically small, blurred, and frequently missed by conventional models. Our approach leverages the high-fidelity performance of existing text spotting models on large, clear text as a foundational supervisor. By temporally back-tracking these high-confidence detections through video sequences, we automatically synthesize pseudo-labels for preceding frames where the distant text is still visually degraded or undersized. These pseudo-labels enable training a student model specialized for early text detection, without requiring any manual annotation. The success of this approach depends on accurate pseudo-label generation, for which we develop a dedicated scene text tracker capable of maintaining consistent text identities across challenging video sequences. In addition, we propose SceneText50, a diverse multilingual outdoor dataset to facilitate training and evaluation. Experiments show that our framework significantly improves early detection accuracy and robustness across varied scenes and languages. Code and data are at \href{https://github.com/trid2912/BackTrackingText}{https://github.com/trid2912/BackTrackingText}.

</details>


### [116] [JEPA Learns What the Mask Leaves Unrecoverable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32481)
*Peng Xie,Amr Alanwar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文从"线性测量"视角解释JEPA对掩码方式的敏感性：掩码是在小波基下的线性测量，隐藏区内支撑的原子落入零空间而无迹可循；若目标能被低层先验恢复，就会产生"捷径"，只有掩码留下不可恢复的粗尺度内容才能消除捷径。作者在151次预训练中验证了该理论的多项独特预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）对输入掩码方式异常敏感——块状掩码有效、散点掩码无效，但现有解释仅停留在经验层面，缺乏理论机制说明"为什么"。论文试图给出一个可测量、可预测的机理解释。

Method: 将掩码建模为线性测量：在紧支撑小波基下，凡支撑位于隐藏区内的原子都落在测量零空间，不在数据中留下痕迹。JEPA损失只要求编码上下文足以预测目标，因此低层先验可恢复的目标存在捷径，且移动平均目标编码器可使其自洽。消除捷径的关键在于掩码留下的"不可恢复的粗尺度内容"，并需保证每个目标有足够上下文可及。作者在训练前对该内容打分，并在151次预训练运行中检验理论预测。

Result: ImageNet-100上：条带掩码在面积与连续性上与块状相当却可恢复，线性top-1为40.3%，随机掩码40.8%，块状为64.3%；同一几何族内，不可恢复内容最少的放置比最多的低6.5分（五对种子）；像素目标跨度7分而潜目标跨度25分；冻结目标时随机与块状差距（19分）缩至1.5，说明几何通过编码器自产目标起作用。UCF101上掩码比例决定"内容"还是"可及性"起作用；整帧掩码在空间不可恢复但可由邻帧恢复，两种比例下都最差。V-JEPA掩码上，整批保留而非截断变化很小（36.0% vs 35.1%）；使块内100个目标token可见提升至48.7%，而隐藏块外100个上下文token则无效（33.7%）。

Conclusion: JEPA的掩码敏感性可由"线性测量零空间+低层捷径+不可恢复粗尺度内容"的测量理论统一解释，且理论的多项独特预测在151次预训练中得到验证；块状掩码有效在于留下不可恢复内容并保留足够可及上下文，而非单纯的几何形状。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures are unusually sensitive to how the input is masked: block masks work, scattered masks do not, and the explanations are empirical. We give a measurement account. A mask is a linear measurement, and in a compactly supported wavelet basis every atom whose support lies inside the hidden region falls in the measurement's null space and leaves no trace in the data. The JEPA loss asks only that the encoded context suffice for the target, so a target that a low-level prior can recover admits a shortcut, one the moving-average target encoder can make self-consistent. What removes the shortcut is the coarse-scale content the mask leaves unrecoverable, provided enough context stays within reach of each target. We score that content before training and test the account's distinctive predictions in 151 pre-training runs. On ImageNet-100, strip masks match blocks in area and contiguity yet are recoverable, and they land at 40.3% linear top-1, beside random masks at 40.8%, against 64.3% for blocks; within one geometry family, the placements that leave the least unrecoverable content lose 6.5 points to those that leave the most, over five seed pairs; pixel targets span 7 points where latent targets span 25; and against a frozen target the gap between random and block masks, 19 points on the same kind of GPU, closes to 1.5, so the geometry acts through the target the encoder produces for itself. On UCF101 the masking ratio decides which condition, content or reach, binds; removing whole frames, unrecoverable in space but recoverable from neighbouring frames, is worst at both ratios; and on V-JEPA's own masks, batching them intact instead of truncated changes little (36.0% against 35.1%), whereas making 100 target tokens inside the blocks visible lifts them to 48.7% and hiding 100 context tokens outside the blocks does not (33.7%).

</details>


### [117] [GeoCR: Learning a Generalist Cloud Removal Prior from Heterogeneous Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32510)
*Jeonghyeok Do,Munchurl Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoCR是一个通用的云去除生成模型，用单一网络统一处理RGB与多光谱、单/多时相、可带SAR引导的任务，在10个数据集联合预训练（883,331张无云目标图像），无需微调即可推理并支持LoRA适配，在多个测试集上取得最优FID与DISTS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有云去除方法通常针对特定数据集和输入配置专门设计，难以跨传感器、光谱波段和观测设置复用，泛化性与可重用性受限。

Method: 构建通用模型GeoCR：在冻结的预训练RGB自编码器基础上，用紧凑的输入/输出stem扩展以适配不同光谱与传感域，形成共享潜空间接口；由单个flow transformer在分别的带云观测流与可选SAR token条件下，联合建模清晰RGB与非RGB潜变量；在10个数据集训练集上联合预训练，学习跨异构配置的共享去云先验，并支持LoRA高效适配。

Result: 在贡献数据集测试集的全波段与仅RGB设置下，与通用图像复原及云去除方法比较，GeoCR在全波段SEN12MS-CR、Sen2_MTC_New和仅RGB的CUHK-CR2上取得最佳FID和DISTS，优于现有模型。

Conclusion: 单一可复用的生成模型能够跨多样光谱、传感与观测配置有效去云，验证了统一预训练加轻量适配范式的有效性。

Abstract: Cloud removal methods are typically specialized to individual datasets and input configurations, limiting reuse across sensors, spectral bands, and observation settings. We introduce GeoCR, a generalist model that unifies RGB-only-based CR and multispectral-based CR from single- or multi-temporal cloudy observations, with optional SAR guidance, within a single network. To accommodate different spectral and sensing domains, compact input and output stems extend a pretrained RGB autoencoder while keeping its encoder and decoder trunks frozen. This shared latent interface enables a single flow transformer to jointly model clean RGB and non-RGB latents, conditioned on separate cloudy-observation streams and optional SAR tokens. Through joint pretraining on the training splits of ten datasets comprising 883,331 cloud-free target images, GeoCR learns a shared cloud removal prior across these heterogeneous configurations. The same pretrained checkpoint supports direct inference without dataset-specific fine-tuning and efficient adaptation through low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We evaluate GeoCR against general image restoration and cloud removal methods on test splits of the contributing datasets under full-band and RGB-only settings. GeoCR achieves the best FID and DISTS on full-band SEN12MS-CR and Sen2_MTC_New and RGB-only CUHK-CR2, outperforming existing models and demonstrating the effectiveness of a reusable generative model across diverse settings.

</details>


### [118] [Cross-Domain Few-Shot Writer Adaptation for Real-World Handwritten Mathematical Expression Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32513)
*Paulo Grane Gabriel Silva,Lorenz Bernard Marqueses,Joel Ilao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文关注手写数学表达式识别（HMER）中的领域差距与书写者自适应问题，通过对图像碎片化和笔画宽度分析刻画数字图像与相机拍摄图像之间的领域差距，并将书写者自适应微调流程引入MFH-CoMER模型。作者构建了来自两位作者的五个手写类别子集，并用McNemar检验与置换检验进行评估。结果显示数字手写体识别率提升、CER下降，物理手写体结果则更具差异性，但五个子集中有四个得到改善，表明书写者自适应在HMER任务中具有一定可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HMER的最先进系统均无法适应特定个人的书写方式，且训练图像（通常为数字或完全二值化图像）与推理时相机实拍图像之间存在领域差距，该问题在此任务中关注甚少。因此作者希望刻画这一领域差距并尝试通过书写者自适应来缓解。

Method: 作者通过碎片化和笔画宽度分析来刻画图像领域差距；提出一种书写者自适应微调流程并应用于MFH-CoMER模型；构建了作者专属数据集，包含来自两位作者的五个手写类别子集；采用适应小数据量的McNemar检验和置换检验进行评估。

Result: 对于数字手写体，表达式识别率提升且CER下降；对于物理手写体，结果更为多样，模型在基准模型已能很好评估的手写体上表现吃力。尽管如此，五个子集中有四个的自适应模型结果得到改善。统计检验表明，在两个作者专属子集上改善具有一致性。

Conclusion: 研究结果指向书写者自适应在HMER任务中具有潜在可行性。

Abstract: Handwritten mathematical expression recognition (HMER) refers to the task of recognizing and converting handwritten mathematics into a parsable markup language, usually LaTeX. No current state-of-the-art-competitive system adjusts to the way a specific person writes, and the domain gap between training images (usually digital or perfectly binarized) and images physically taken with a camera used in inference has received fairly little attention for this specific problem. We characterize this domain gap through fragmentation and stroke-width analyses of the images as well as introduce a writer-adaptive fine-tuning pipeline to MFH-CoMER in an attempt to address it. We further introduce sample author-specific datasets, consisting of five handwriting category subsets from two authors, and evaluate using a McNemar's test and permutation tests adapted to limited data. Results suggest an increase in expression recognition rate and a decrease in CER for digital handwriting but more varied results for physical handwriting, with the model struggling for handwriting articles that the base model can already evaluate well. Nonetheless, adapted models were found to have improved results for four out of five subsets. Statistical testing results suggest a consistency in improvement for two of the tested author-specific subsets. Our results point towards the potential feasibility of writer adaptation for the HMER task.

</details>


### [119] [UnStep: Training-Free Acceleration of Causal Video Diffusion with Fewer Steps Than Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32518)
*Youssef Mansour,Enis Simsar,Fadime Sener,Markos Georgopoulos,Albert Pumarola,Ali Thabet,Edgar Schoenfeld*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UnStep 是一种无需训练、即插即用的推理加速方案，通过减少扩散步数和限制注意力 KV 缓存窗口，并配合两种质量恢复机制与运行时优化，将因果视频扩散模型提速至单卡 H100 上 50 FPS、GB200 上 77 FPS，且无质量损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步因果视频扩散模型虽然比其教师模型快很多，但仍达不到实时生成的速度要求，需要一种无需重新训练的推理加速方法来进一步提速。

Method: 提出 UnStep 训练无关包装器：以比蒸馏时更少的 DiT 步数运行模型，并限制注意力 KV 缓存中保留的时间窗口；为弥补质量损失，采用两种仅推理的机制——(1) 将生成的潜帧重新加噪至接近干净水平并复用已有干净缓存进行精修，(2) 对 DiT 注意力的 value 与输出投影做截断 SVD；同时引入保质量的运行时优化栈，包括更高效的注意力调用与 KV 索引、融合 Triton RoPE（带缓存系数）、以及优化内存布局、精度和卷积核的 VAE 解码。

Result: 通过减少计算量并优化运行时栈，UnStep 在单张 H100 上达到 50 FPS、在 GB200 上达到 77 FPS，速度显著快于现有方法，且无需重新训练、无质量损失。

Conclusion: UnStep 为因果视频扩散建立了新的吞吐量范式，证明通过纯推理层面的步数缩减、注意力窗口限制、质量恢复机制与运行时优化，可以在不重训练的前提下实现实时且无损的流式视频生成。

Abstract: Distilling bidirectional multi-step video diffusion transformers into few-step causal models has become a common approach for streaming video generation. While these few-step students are significantly faster than the teachers they are distilled from, they remain slow for real-time generation. In this work we present UnStep, a training-free wrapper that accelerates few-step causal video models at inference by running them with fewer diffusion transformer (DiT) steps than during distillation and limiting the temporal window retained in the attention KV cache. We propose two inference-only mechanisms to recover quality lost by step reduction and attention windowing: renoising the generated latent frames to a near-clean level and reusing the existing clean-cache pass to refine them, and applying truncated SVD to the DiT attention value and output projections. We also accelerate inference with a quality-preserving runtime stack for the DiT and VAE decoder, including more efficient attention calls and KV indexing, fused Triton RoPE with cached coefficients, and VAE decoding with optimized memory layout, precision, and convolution kernels. By reducing computation and optimizing the runtime stack, UnStep sets a new throughput regime for causal video diffusion, by running substantially faster than current methods, reaching 50 FPS on a single H100 without quality loss, and 77 FPS on GB200, all without retraining.

</details>


### [120] [SetOPD: From Few Visual Exemplars to Multimodal Candidate Sets for Remote-Sensing Open-Prompt Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32529)
*Jinlong Hu,Yi Zhang,Zhiqi Xia,Yikang Zhou,Shunping Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出集合视角下的开放提示检测器——setopd，保留各模态独立的解码状态，在候选状态层面进行显式的多模态协作；并引入Base-Residual提示与配对查询仲裁（PQA）两项设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放提示检测器在两个层面上对视觉模态利用不足：一是多个示例常被压缩为单一类级嵌入，使视觉提示"文本化"，在仅有少量异构示例时效果不佳；二是现有方法主要在提示空间或表示空间交互，发生在模态特定的检测状态形成之前。

Method: 提出setopd，从集合视角解决上述问题。针对第一点，引入Base-Residual（BR）提示，将每个带框示例在其完整场景上下文中读取，并把聚合的支持证据分解为Base锚点与可学习的Residual修正，使提示容量与示例数量无关，并驱动自身的视觉检测通路。针对第二点，将文本—视觉协作从表示级融合重构为候选集合建模问题，提出配对查询仲裁（PQA）：两个读出器共享查询初始化，使候选按索引配对，学习门控在每对内部进行仲裁，随后由置换等变模块对融合集合进行推理。

Result: 摘要未给出具体实验数值结果；核心结论为：BR提示使提示容量与示例数量解耦，PQA实现在模态特定候选状态形成后的跨模态状态仲裁。

Conclusion: 开放提示检测应避免将视觉示例压缩为单一类级嵌入，也不应仅在表示空间融合；保留模态特定解码状态并在候选状态层面显式协作，是更合理的多模态提示设计方向。

Abstract: Open-prompt detectors allow users to specify targets with text, visual exemplars, or both. We argue that existing designs underuse the visual modality in two ways. First, multiple exemplars are commonly compressed into a single class-level embedding. This textualizes visual prompting: the resulting vector plays the role of another class name, is often aligned to or injected into the text pathway, and may be suboptimal when only a few heterogeneous exemplars are available. Second, existing methods interact primarily in prompt or representation space, before modality-specific detection states are formed. We address both issues from a set perspective: \setopd preserves modality-specific decoding states from a shared prompt-conditioned initialization and performs explicit multimodal collaboration at the candidate-state level. For the first issue, we introduce \br prompting, which reads every boxed exemplar in its full scene context and decomposes the pooled support evidence into a Base anchor and a learned Residual correction; the resulting prompt has fixed capacity regardless of the number of examples and drives its own visual detection pathway. For the second, we recast text--visual collaboration from representation-level fusion into a candidate-set modeling problem. Paired-Query Arbitration (\pqa) then performs explicit cross-modal state arbitration only after modality-specific candidate states have been formed. The two readers share query initialization so their candidates are paired by index; a learned gate arbitrates within each pair, followed by a permutation-equivariant module that reasons over the fused set.

</details>


### [121] [DepthBench: Measuring How Residual Connections Enable More Computational Depth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32534)
*Keyu Wang,Yangyi Huang,Jiale Kang,David González-Martínez,Weiyang Liu,Shiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出DepthBench受控基准，系统研究架构深度能否转化为有效计算深度，发现残差连接设计是关键决定因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度是提升Transformer计算能力的自然途径，但随深度增大，深层贡献会衰减。近期通过改进归一化（如LayerNorm Scaling）或残差连接（如mHC、AttnRes）来改善信息流与深度利用，但这些方法是否真正把架构深度转化为有效计算深度尚不清楚，其收益是否源于更好的跨层信息访问、还是混杂因素，也未被厘清。

Method: 提出DepthBench受控基准，在保持模型规模与预训练配方固定的前提下，系统变化宽深比（d_model/n_layer），从浅宽到深窄构型，覆盖10种代表性架构，并进行受控的层级分析。

Result: 将更多容量分配给深度的收益强烈依赖架构。标准Pre-LN及多数基于归一化和缩放的变体收益甚微，甚至随模型更深更窄而性能下降；而HC和Full AttnRes即使在极端深窄构型下也持续提升。这些增益不仅体现在预训练损失上，还一致地转化为领域特定性能与有效计算的提升。

Conclusion: 残差连接设计是深度能否成为有意义扩展轴的关键决定因素，它决定了额外的架构深度能否转化为有效计算。层级分析显示HC与Full AttnRes的增益与更有效地利用额外层相关，揭示了不同架构间计算深度的不同机制。

Abstract: Depth is a natural way to increase the computational capacity in Transformers, yet the contribution of deeper layers can diminish as depth grows larger. Recent approaches enhance normalization (\text{e.g.}, LayerNorm Scaling) or residual connections (\text{e.g.}, mHC, AttnRes) to enable better information flow and depth utilization. However, it remains unclear whether they truly translate increased architectural depth into effective computational depth, and whether their reported gains stem from better access to information across depth, or unaccounted-for confounding factors. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{DepthBench}, a controlled benchmark for studying computational depth across various architectures. We systematically vary the width--depth aspect ratio ($d_{\text{model}}/n_{\text{layer}}$) from shallow--wide to deep--narrow shapes, while keeping the model size and pre-training recipe fixed. Across 10 representative architectures, we find that the benefit of allocating more capacity to depth is strongly architecture-dependent. Standard Pre-LN and most of its norm- and scaling-based variants provide little benefit and can even degrade performance as models become deeper and narrower, whereas HC and Full AttnRes improve consistently even at extreme deep shapes. These gains extend beyond pre-training loss and consistently translate into improved domain-specific performance and effective computation. Controlled layer-level analyses further show that the gains of HC and Full AttnRes are associated with more effective utilization of additional layers, revealing distinct mechanisms of computational depth across architectures. Overall, our results identify residual connection design as a key determinant of whether depth can serve as a meaningful scaling axis by enabling additional architectural depth to translate into effective computation.

</details>


### [122] [RIPE-MambaSpike: Resolution-Independent Spiking-State-Space Interfaces for Parameter-Efficient Event-Based Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32537)
*Md Muhiminul Islam,Shoaib Ahmed Dipu,Sayeed Shafayet Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RIPE-MambaSpike，用固定通道宽度的分层多分辨率桥替换分辨率相关投影，实现参数量恒定仅0.870M的事件视觉识别模型，在多个基准上取得帕累托最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脉冲-Mamba混合模型在事件视觉上精度高，但参数量常达数千万。作者发现主要开销来自脉冲前端与状态空间主干之间的分辨率相关投影连接，而非混合架构本身：某代表模型中单个投影即占33.55M/36.25M参数。

Method: 提出RIPE-MambaSpike（分辨率无关、参数高效），以固定通道宽度的分层多分辨率桥替代原投影；并设计重参数化脉冲阶段、时间解耦调制，以及动态凸包约束的双流膜电位注意力，在紧凑设计下保持精度。

Result: 在CIFAR10-DVS、N-Caltech101、DailyDVS-200上均达到帕累托最优。部署参数量0.870M，在43倍输入面积范围内保持恒定。在200类DailyDVS-200上，8.04M扩展配置达45.7% top-1，为该基准最佳脉冲结果，且比稠密ANN少3.0–15.1倍参数。

Conclusion: 研究表明竞争性的事件识别不依赖分辨率相关的参数增长。

Abstract: Spiking-Mamba hybrids reach strong accuracy on event-based vision, but existing designs often require tens of millions of parameters. Much of that cost comes from how the spiking front-end is connected to the state-space backbone rather than from the hybrid architecture itself. In a representative model, a single resolution-dependent projection accounts for 33.55M of 36.25M parameters. To that end, we introduce RIPE-MambaSpike (Resolution-Independent, Parameter-Efficient), which replaces that projection with a hierarchical multi-resolution bridge of fixed channel width. Its deployed footprint is 0.870M parameters, constant at fixed time steps and widths across a 43x range of input areas. Reparameterized spiking stages, temporal decoupled modulation, and a dynamic convex-hull-bounded dual-stream membrane-potential attention preserve accuracy under this compact design. Result-wise, RIPE-MambaSpike is pareto-optimal on CIFAR10-DVS, N-Caltech101, and DailyDVS-200. Notably, on the 200-class DailyDVS-200, a scaled 8.04M configuration achieves 45.7% top-1 accuracy, the best reported spiking result on that benchmark, and outperforms prior spiking methods with 3.0-15.1x fewer parameters than dense ANNs. Overall, our findings demonstrate that competitive event-based recognition does not require resolution-dependent parameter growth. Code is available at https://github.com/MuhiminOsim/RIPE-MambaSpike.

</details>


### [123] [In-Flight KV Cache with Clean Anchors for Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32540)
*Yikai Wang,Xiao Han,Mengmeng Xu,Juan Camilo Perez,Yiannis Douratsos,Sen He,Zijian Zhou,Fei Zhang,Zhaochong An,Juan-Manuel Perez-Rua,Chen Change Loy,Tao Xiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlashForward 通过复用去噪前向中已计算的 KV 缓存，避免额外的缓存更新前向，并用稀疏干净锚点 KV 补偿质量损失，实现更快且时序一致的长视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步自回归视频扩散按时间块逐块生成，为记忆已生成内容，以往方法需要额外前向来重建干净或低噪的 KV 缓存，而这些前向本身就已经计算了当前块的 KV，造成大量冗余计算。

Method: 直接复用每个去噪阶段已产生的 in-flight KV 缓存，使阶段专属缓存可在下一块生成时立即使用；通过为每个阶段分配一块 GPU，让不同块在不同阶段并发执行；同时预先生成稀疏的干净锚点 latent，提供粗粒度长程双边结构引导，与密集的阶段匹配历史（细粒度近期演化）形成两个时间尺度的双面条件。

Result: 在最多 4 块 GPU 下，20 秒以上、16 FPS 的 1.3B 与 14B 模型（480p、720p）上，比 HiAR 快 1.16–1.69 倍，比 Self-Forcing 快 1.42–2.92 倍；在 VBench 上 1.3B/480p 取得更高分数，并在 20s、35s、65s 时长下保持稳定。

Conclusion: FlashForward 以复用 KV 缓存加稀疏干净锚点的双面条件，实现了跨时长高质量、时序一致且显著加速的长视频生成。

Abstract: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion generates a long video by splitting the video into temporal chunks and generating chunk-by-chunk, each through a short sequence of denoising stages. To memorize chunks that are already generated, previous methods reconstruct a clean or less-noisy key--value (KV) cache by additional forwards to build the cache without advancing an output latent. However, every denoising forward itself already computes the in-flight KV of the current chunk. We introduce FlashForward, which directly reuses this cache to avoid the heavy cache-update-only model forwards. After the current chunk completes one denoising stage, its stage-specific cache is already available for the next chunk. Assigning one GPU to each stage therefore lets different chunks occupy different stages concurrently. This early availability has a quality cost: the resulting stage-matched history is noisy, causing appearance and motion drift among chunks. To complement it, FlashForward produces sparse auxiliary clean anchor latents before the corresponding region is generated so the generation trajectories can be stabilized by this two-sided conditioning. The two memories operate at different temporal scales: sparse clean anchor KV supplies coarse, long-range two-sided structural guidance, while dense stage-matched history preserves fine, recent evolution. With up to four GPUs, FlashForward runs $1.16$--$1.69\times$ faster than HiAR and $1.42$--$2.92\times$ faster than Self-Forcing for 16 FPS videos of 20 seconds or longer across 1.3B and 14B backbone scales at 480p and 720p. On VBench, for the 1.3B model at 480p, it achieves higher scores and remains stable at longer durations, demonstrating that FlashForward generates high-quality and temporally consistent videos across durations of 20s, 35s and 65s at a much faster generation speed.

</details>


### [124] [Harnessing Coupled Stream Completion For Human-Object Ineraction Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32551)
