The tasks instantiate a unified engineering state representation spanning objects, relations, constraints, and design objectives, and T2--T4 are scored against structured reference answers with atomic criteria. Across open- and closed-weight multimodal models, stronger grounding does not reliably translate into better diagnosis or intervention, and the best open-weight model trails the best closed model by 14.7 percentage points on the T2--T4 average. Removing or shuffling visual evidence consistently degrades performance, while benchmark-specific supervised fine-tuning improves T1 but not T2--T4. T4 further exposes a large gap between satisfying individual revision criteria and producing a fully valid intervention. Engineering reasoning thus requires not only recovering the current state, but also reliably using it to reason about constraints and post-intervention consequences. Code and benchmark artifacts are available at https://github.com/changcv2021/EngIntervene

</details>


### [193] [VehDyn: A Driving World Model Benchmark for Vehicle Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33264)
*Tianyi Wang,Wangsheng Du,Jiazhou Chen,Tianyi Zeng,Xiangyu Li,Jiseop Byeon,Yujin Wang,Yiming Xu,Yangyang Wang,Bingzhao Gao,Sikai Chen,Zhaomiao Guo,Junfeng Jiao,Christian Claudel,Alexandre Bayen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VehDyn——面向车辆动力学的驾驶世界模型基准，基于CARLA-CarSim联合仿真构建10,080组配置数据集，从轨迹、运动学、动力学三个层次评估12个SOTA视频世界模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型基准主要评估视觉保真度和粗略物理合理性，无法证明生成的驾驶未来是否符合真实车辆运动学与动力学；同时缺乏车辆、道路、机动、速度条件可独立控制且车辆状态真值与视频同步记录的数据集。

Method: 构建CARLA-CarSim联合仿真平台，将照片级渲染与经验证的多体动力学模型耦合；采用全因子设计生成10,080组配置（5种车型×4种轮胎-路面摩擦系数×3种机动×4种目标速度×14个场景×3种光照），每组配同步的位置、速度和姿态序列；并提出分层评估框架，测量轨迹对齐、运动学一致性与动力学一致性。

Result: 基准测试12个SOTA视频世界模型：轨迹级指标接近饱和（12个中10个在真值20%以内），但无模型在动力学一致性上达到真值的92%；视觉质量指标与车辆动力学保真度仅弱相关。DrivingWorld得分最高，其次是Cosmos 3 Nano和LTX-Video 2.5，VehDyn得分与人工判断高度一致。

Conclusion: VehDyn为开发物理一致且视觉逼真的驾驶世界模型提供了系统化基础。

Abstract: Video world models are emerging as data engines, action planners, and generative simulators for autonomous driving, but existing benchmarks primarily assess visual fidelity and coarse physical plausibility, providing limited evidence on whether generated driving futures obey realistic vehicle kinematics and dynamics. This limitation is further compounded by the lack of datasets in which vehicle, road, maneuver, and speed conditions are independently controlled, and ground-truth vehicle states are recorded in synchrony with videos. We introduce VehDyn, a driving world model benchmark for vehicle dynamics. VehDyn is built on a CARLA-CarSim co-simulation platform where photorealistic rendering is coupled with a validated multi-body dynamics model, and it contains 10,080 configurations from a full factorial design over five vehicle types, four tire-road friction coefficients, three maneuvers, four target speeds, 14 scenes, and three illuminations, each paired with synchronized position, velocity, and attitude sequences. Built on this dataset, VehDyn introduces a hierarchical evaluation framework that measures trajectory alignment, kinematic consistency, and dynamic consistency, and benchmarks 12 state-of-the-art video world models. We further assess the video quality using two established protocols and correlate it with the VehDyn score. Trajectory-level metrics are nearly saturated, with ten of twelve models within 20\% of ground truth, while no model reaches 92\% of ground truth on dynamic consistency, and visual-quality metrics are only weakly correlated with vehicle-dynamics fidelity. DrivingWorld achieves the highest VehDyn score, followed by Cosmos 3 Nano and LTX-Video 2.5, and the VehDyn score agrees closely with human judgment. VehDyn provides a systematic foundation for developing driving world models that are physically consistent and visually realistic.

</details>


### [194] [InfoEdit: Probing Global Layout Reasoning in Infographic Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33286)
*Cheng Yang,Chufan Shi,Huijuan Wang,Bo Shui,Yaokang Wu,Muzi Tao,Yibo Yan,Xuezhe Ma,Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 InfoEdit 基准，用于评测结构化视觉内容（信息图）编辑中的全局布局重排（reflow）能力，发现现有前沿编辑模型在此类任务上表现极差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态基础模型在自然照片编辑上已达生产级质量，但在信息图等结构化视觉内容上表现不佳。原因在于信息图通过逻辑关系编码信息，编辑一个元素往往需要调整其周边元素，这种全局布局推理能力（reflow）尚未被现有图像编辑基准单独建模或评估，因此需要一个专门的诊断性基准来揭示这一核心挑战。

Method: 作者构建了 InfoEdit 基准，包含 1,000 张信息图，覆盖八类逻辑关系族，并配套 4,000 条编辑指令，分为四种编辑任务；同时设计了具备 reflow 感知能力的评估协议。基于该基准，对八个前沿编辑器进行了系统评测，并对比了像素级编辑与代码级编辑的表现。

Result: 在八个前沿编辑器中，仅 GPT-Image-2 的平均成功率超过 60%，多数模型低于 7%；即便在目标定位完全准确的情况下，也没有任何编辑器在 Swap-Block 任务上超过 36% 的成功率。此外，代码级编辑在部分任务上可匹配最强的像素级编辑器，显示出两类方法在不同任务上的互补优势。

Conclusion: InfoEdit 将 reflow 确立为结构化视觉内容编辑的核心挑战，并提供了一个诊断性基准，为未来研究进展提供衡量与推动工具。该工作同时表明像素级与代码级编辑各有优势，未来方法可探索二者结合。

Abstract: Multimodal foundation models edit natural photographs at production quality, yet the same models struggle with structured visual content such as infographics. Unlike photographs, infographics encode information through logical relations; editing one element often requires surrounding elements to be adapted. We refer to this global layout reasoning capability as reflow. Existing image-editing benchmarks neither provide a dedicated setting for structured visual content nor evaluate the reflow capability. We introduce InfoEdit, a novel benchmark of 1,000 infographics across eight logical-relation families, paired with 4,000 editing instructions across four editing tasks, and a reflow-aware evaluation protocol. Across eight frontier editors, only GPT-Image-2 clears 60% average success rate; most models fall below 7%, and no editor exceeds 36% on the Swap-Block task even with perfect target localization. We further show that code-level editing can match the strongest pixel-level editor, revealing complementary strengths across tasks. InfoEdit identifies reflow as a central challenge in structured visual content editing and provides a diagnostic benchmark to facilitate future progress.

</details>


### [195] [Informative Viewpoint Selection for Episodic-Memory Embodied Question Answering using Omnidirectional Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33288)
*Kaname Kitamura,Asako Kanezaki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向开放词汇情景记忆式具身问答（EM-EQA）的视点选择方法，将全景图经立方体贴图投影转为透视视图，用微调BLIP-2估计问题相关度，并通过多样性感知贪心选择信息量高且多样的视点，在OpenEQA的HM3D子集上取得报告模型结果中的最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景图能提供大视场、无需显式旋转即可捕获周围上下文，适合EM-EQA；但等距柱状投影带来严重几何畸变，降低VLM识别精度，同时直接输入等距柱状图像会引入大量无关背景，既降低答案准确率又增加视觉token负担。因此需要有效的视点选择。

Method: 将等距柱状全景观测经立方体贴图投影转换为透视视图；用微调后的BLIP-2估计各视图与问题条件相关的相关性；通过多样性感知的贪心选择策略挑选信息丰富且多样的视点。

Result: 在OpenEQA的Habitat-Matterport 3D（HM3D）子集上，该方法在使用等距柱状观测的报告模型结果中达到最优性能；去掉旋转视图后观测帧减少65.5%，答案准确率仍基本保持。

Conclusion: 通过立方体贴图投影与问题条件相关度加多样性贪心的视点选择，可有效缓解全景畸变与冗余背景问题，在显著减少输入帧数的情况下维持EM-EQA的答题准确率。

Abstract: Embodied Question Answering (EQA) requires agents to answer natural language questions about surrounding environments from visual observations. In this work, we focus on open-vocabulary episodic-memory EQA (EM-EQA), where an agent answers free-form questions using recorded observation histories. Omnidirectional images are promising for this task, as they provide wide field-of-view observations that can capture surrounding context without requiring explicit camera rotations. However, omnidirectional images introduce two challenges for EQA: (i) equirectangular projection causes severe geometric distortion that degrades vision-language model (VLM) recognition accuracy, and (ii) feeding equirectangular images directly into VLMs introduces excessive irrelevant background information, reducing answer accuracy and increasing the visual-token burden. To address these challenges, we propose a viewpoint selection method for EM-EQA using omnidirectional images. Our method converts equirectangular observations into perspective views via cubemap projection, estimates question-conditioned relevance with fine-tuned BLIP-2, and selects informative and diverse viewpoints through diversity-aware greedy selection. Experiments on the Habitat-Matterport 3D (HM3D) subset of OpenEQA show that our method achieves state-of-the-art model performance among the reported model results with equirectangular observations. Moreover, after removing rotation views, which reduces observation frames by 65.5%, our method largely maintains its answer accuracy.

</details>


### [196] [Relevance Does Not Imply Applicability: Experience Activation for Personal GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33304)
*Fuyao Zhang,Xuan Wang,Zherui Li,Jiaming Zhang,Longtao Huang,Wei Yang Bryan Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ExpActivator，一个免训练框架，将个性化GUI智能体中的经验使用从"任务级检索追加"重构为"决策时情境激活"，显著提升步骤成功率与主动建议准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有个人GUI智能体依赖检索任务相关历史并追加到策略上下文中，隐含假设任务相关经验对每一步决策都有用。但作者发现这种帮助主要集中在首步：检索历史显著改善开局，却对剩余90%的步骤几乎没有持续收益，也难以判断是否该主动建议。根本问题在于"相关性不等于适用性"——相关性在任务层确定，而适用性取决于决策时的具体情境。

Method: 作者将个性化重构为"经验激活"，提出免训练的ExpActivator。在执行中，它将每个新屏幕与冻结GUI主干潜空间中的历史状态匹配，并提供对应动作作为参考；在执行前，仅当当前时间和场景提供足够支持时才激活重复性意图，否则主动弃权。

Result: 在四个GUI主干上，ExpActivator平均提升轨迹内步骤成功率28%，在每个主干上都取得最佳个性化执行效果，同时使用的历史token仅约五分之一；其Matthews相关系数约为最强主动基线方法的2.3倍。

Conclusion: 经验的价值在于被激活而非被追加。通过情境级激活而非任务级检索，个人GUI智能体能更有效地利用历史经验，并更准确地判断是否主动提出建议。

Abstract: Personal Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents rely on interaction history to infer what a user wants from ambiguous instructions and to anticipate recurring routines. Existing approaches retrieve task-relevant history and append it to the policy's context, implicitly assuming that experience relevant to a task remains useful for each decision within it. We find that this help is largely spent at the first decision: retrieved history strongly improves the opening step of an episode, yet provides little sustained benefit over the remaining 90\% of steps, and offers weak guidance on whether a proactive suggestion is warranted. A relevant record may tell the agent where to begin, but not which past action applies to the current screen or whether a routine is due now. The underlying issue is that relevance does not imply applicability}: relevance is determined at the task level, whereas applicability depends on the situation at decision time. We therefore recast personalization as experience activation and introduce ExpActivator, a training-free framework that activates only the experience applicable to the current situation. During execution, ExpActivator matches each new screen to historical states in the frozen GUI backbone's latent space and supplies the corresponding action as a reference. Before execution, it activates a recurring intent only when the current time and scenario provide sufficient support, and otherwise abstains. Across four GUI backbones, ExpActivator improves within-trajectory step success by 28\% on average, achieves the best personalized execution on every backbone while using about one-fifth as many history tokens, and reaches approximately 2.3$\times$ the Matthews correlation coefficient of the strongest proactive baseline. Experience pays where it is activated, not where it is appended.

</details>


### [197] [LoopTrack: A Simple Baseline for Parameter-Efficient Transformer Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33306)
*Liang Peng,Chenxiao Li,Libo Zhang,Xingping Dong,Heng Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出参数高效的Transformer跟踪框架LoopTrack，通过共享参数的循环结构显著减少参数量，并在多个数据集上取得良好的精度-参数权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Transformer的跟踪方法通常堆叠多个独立参数的Transformer块来建模模板与搜索区域间的交互，导致参数量庞大，难以部署在资源受限设备上。

Method: LoopTrack采用循环架构，重复应用一组共享参数的Transformer块进行特征交互；并引入两个轻量设计：目标感知循环（TAL），利用上一循环产生的中间目标信息指导后续循环的特征交互以实现渐进式特征细化；门控目标记忆（GTM），跨帧维护紧凑记忆并融入循环过程，提供长期信息以缓解时序漂移。

Result: 在多个数据集上实验显示良好的精度-参数权衡：LoopTrack_One仅用单个共享Transformer块、3.4M参数即在LaSOT上达到66.2% SUC；LoopTrack_Three使用三个共享块、6.4M参数达到69.3% SUC，超越同等或更大模型规模的现有参数高效跟踪方法。

Conclusion: LoopTrack以更少参数实现多轮特征交互，为参数高效Transformer跟踪建立了简单而强力的基线，代码与模型将开源。

Abstract: Current Transformer-based tracking methods typically stack multiple Transformer blocks with separate parameters to model interactions between the target template and the search region for target localization. These trackers often incur substantial parameter overhead from stacked blocks, making their deployment on resource-limited devices difficult. To address this, we propose a parameter-efficient Transformer tracking framework, dubbed LoopTrack, which repeatedly applies a set of Transformer blocks with shared parameters to interact features in a looped architecture for tracking, significantly reducing the number of parameters. To further exploit target cues, we present two lightweight designs, including target-aware looping (TAL) and gated target memory (GTM). The former applies intermediate target information generated by one loop to guide feature interaction in the subsequent loop, enabling progressive feature refinement, while the latter maintains a compact memory across frames, which is incorporated into the loop process to provide long-term information to the tracker, mitigating temporal drift in tracking. Compared to existing Transformer trackers, LoopTrack enables multiple rounds of feature interaction with fewer model parameters, making it resource-friendly for deployment. In extensive experiments on multiple datasets, LoopTrack shows a favorable accuracy-parameter trade-off. In particular, our LoopTrack$_{\rm One}$, with a single shared Transformer block, achieves 66.2\% SUC score on LaSOT with only 3.4M parameters, while LoopTrack$_{\rm Three}$, using three shared blocks, achieves 69.3\% SUC score with 6.4M parameters, surpassing existing parameter-efficient tracking methods with comparable or larger model size. With LoopTrack, we aim to establish a simple yet strong baseline for parameter-efficient Transformer tracking. Our code and models will be released.

</details>


### [198] [PIC-UIE: Predicting Image-Adaptive Corrections for Lightweight Underwater Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33318)
*Cunhao Zhu,Dongliang Xu,Xiangtao Kong,Xiaoyan Lu,Tianyu Wang,Yue Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出轻量级预测器-执行器框架PIC-UIE，在YCbCr空间对水下图像进行结构化校正，仅9486参数即可实现高效增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有水下图像增强方法依赖大骨干网络和密集的图像到图像预测，实用性和边缘部署受限；且完全在单一色彩空间操作会将退化估计与亮度、色度校正耦合在一起。

Method: PIC-UIE从固定的256×256 RGB缩略图预测图像自适应校正，并应用到原生分辨率的YCbCr输入上。预测器输出7个结果，分为空间校正、非线性亮度与耦合色度映射、图像级色彩校准。训练时用深度图正则化透射代理，推理时仅需RGB输入。

Result: 在256×256下具有9486个参数和0.094 GFLOPs，在UIEB-90上达到24.137 dB PSNR和0.9216 SSIM，在零样本LSUI上达到21.320 dB PSNR；在对比协议下以55.0 FPS处理原生4K图像。

Conclusion: 结构化校正预测为水下图像增强提供了一种有效且实用的替代方案，可取代密集RGB重建。

Abstract: Underwater image enhancement (UIE) aims to restore visibility, color fidelity, and structural detail from images degraded by wavelength-dependent attenuation and backscatter. State-of-the-art UIE methods often rely on large backbones and dense image-to-image prediction, limiting their practicality for edge deployment. Moreover, operating entirely in a single color space couples degradation estimation with luminance and chroma correction. To address these challenges, we propose PIC-UIE, a lightweight predictor--executor framework that predicts image-adaptive corrections from a fixed $256\times256$ RGB thumbnail and applies them to the native-resolution input in the YCbCr color space. The predictor produces seven outputs, organized into spatial correction, nonlinear luminance and coupled chroma mapping, and image-level color calibration. A depth map regularizes the transmission proxy during training, whereas inference uses only the RGB input. With 9,486 parameters and 0.094 GFLOPs at $256\times256$, PIC-UIE achieves 24.137 dB PSNR and 0.9216 SSIM on UIEB-90 and 21.320 dB PSNR on zero-shot LSUI. It further processes native 4K images at 55.0 FPS under the comparison protocol. These results show that structured correction prediction provides an effective and practical alternative to dense RGB reconstruction for underwater image enhancement.

</details>


### [199] [VisionHOPE: Visual Backbones as Self-Modifying Learning Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33325)
*Siran Peng,Tianshuo Zhang,Tianyu Fu,Weisong Zhao,Haoyuan Zhang,Jiankuo Zhao,Minghui Wu,Ping Jiang,Xiangyu Zhu,Chenxu Zhao,Zhen Lei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VisionHOPE，首个将通用视觉骨干网络建模为自修改学习系统的框架，通过五耦合记忆实现“记忆内容”与“学习方式”在单张图像内的协同演化，并引入稳定性匹配的步长控制保证动力学非扩张，在ImageNet-1K、COCO、ADE20K上取得有竞争力结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉骨干从CNN的局部聚合，演进到ViT的全局交互、SSM的输入依赖状态转移以及TTT层的内层学习器自适应，计算过程越来越依赖输入。但适应规则仍主要由训练好的骨干网络预先规定，缺乏让“记什么”与“如何学”随输入共同演化的自修改学习视角。

Method: 基于Nested Learning的自指构造，VisionHOPE用五个耦合记忆分别存储内容、生成键值表示、调控学习率与保留率，随视觉上下文累积联合演化。针对直接自指更新带来的不稳定，提出稳定性匹配的步长控制：对自指注入做软上限、对保留记忆转移做谱截断，并证明沿扫描方向的记忆动力学非扩张。对二维特征图，将NL的分块公式对齐到图像行与列，并跨四个方向扫描。

Result: 在ImageNet-1K、COCO和ADE20K上取得有竞争力的结果，验证自修改学习系统可作为通用视觉骨干的实用基础。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 将视觉骨干表述为自修改学习系统是可行且有效的，稳定性匹配的步长控制是使其在视觉任务中落地的关键，为通用视觉骨干提供了新的建模范式。

Abstract: Visual backbones have evolved from Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with local aggregation to Vision Transformers (ViTs) with global interactions, State-Space Models (SSMs) with input-dependent state transitions, and Test-Time Training (TTT) layers that adapt an inner learner while processing an image. Across this progression, visual computation has become increasingly adaptive to each input, yet the rules governing that adaptation remain largely prescribed by the trained backbone. We introduce VisionHOPE, the first generic visual backbone formulated as a self-modifying learning system, in which what the model remembers and how it learns co-evolve within an image. Building on the self-referential construction of Nested Learning (NL), VisionHOPE realizes this co-evolution through five coupled memories that store content, generate key and value representations, and govern learning rate and retention. These memories evolve jointly as visual context accumulates along each scan. However, directly applying the unconstrained self-referential update to a visual backbone leads to instability. We therefore derive a stability-matched step-size control scheme that combines a soft cap on self-referential injection with a spectral clamp on the retained memory transition, and prove that the resulting memory dynamics are non-expansive along each scan. For two-dimensional feature maps, we adapt NL's chunk formulation by aligning chunks with image rows and columns across four directional scans. The proposed VisionHOPE achieves competitive results on ImageNet-1K, COCO, and ADE20K, establishing self-modifying learning systems as a practical foundation for general-purpose visual backbones. The code is available at https://github.com/PSRben/VisionHOPE.

</details>


### [200] [FeCoSplat: Feedback-Guided Compression for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33330)
*Yuxuan Li,Yihang Chen,Yufeng Zhang,Jianfei Cai,Weiyao Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 FeCoSplat，一种面向前馈 3DGS 的反馈引导压缩框架，通过压缩紧凑的中间特征而非输入图像或高斯原语，在压缩效率与接收端复杂度之间取得更佳平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈 3DGS 虽能高效地从稀疏多视图合成新视角，但其表示存储与传输成本高。既有方法或压缩输入图像（导致接收端重建负担重），或压缩重建出的高斯原语（因其属性异构且不规则而难以压缩），均存在明显缺陷。

Method: FeCoSplat 采用两阶段反馈引导压缩：先压缩多视图特征得到中间 3DGS；再利用其渲染视图作为反馈，指导第二阶段的压缩以进一步精炼；最终将比特流解码为紧凑隐式状态，并通过轻量级预测器重建最终高斯原语。

Result: 实验表明 FeCoSplat 取得了良好的率失真性能，尤其在低码率下表现突出，同时接收端高斯重建仅需 3.45M 参数。

Conclusion: 通过压缩紧凑中间特征并引入反馈引导机制，FeCoSplat 在压缩效率与接收端复杂度之间实现了更优权衡，代码将随后开源。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables efficient novel-view synthesis from sparse multi-view images, yet its representations remain costly to store and transmit. Existing approaches compress either the input images, incurring heavy receiver-side reconstruction, or the reconstructed Gaussian primitives, which are difficult to compress due to their heterogeneous and irregular attributes. We instead compress compact intermediate features, providing a better balance between compression efficiency and receiver-side complexity. Based on this paradigm, we propose FeCoSplat, a feedback-guided compression framework for feed-forward 3DGS. FeCoSplat first compresses multi-view features to obtain an intermediate 3DGS, whose rendered views are used as feedback to guide a second-stage compression for further refinement. The resulting bitstreams are decoded into a compact implicit state, from which the final Gaussian primitives are reconstructed with a lightweight predictor. Experiments demonstrate that FeCoSplat achieves favorable rate--distortion performance, particularly at low bitrates, while requiring only 3.45M parameters for receiver-side Gaussian reconstruction. Code will be released soon.

</details>


### [201] [OPERA: A Unified Omnimodal Progressive Spatio-Temporal Reasoning Agent for Referring Video Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33338)
*Jingchen Ni,Yuji Wang,Shannan Yan,Haoru Li,Sitong Chen,Chun Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OPERA 是一个基于单一 MLLM 的统一推理智能体，通过三个专门阶段进行双轴渐进推理，实现多模态（文本、音频、参考图像）指代视频分割，并在 OmniAVS 与 Ref-AVS 上取得新 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构多模态查询（文本、音频、参考图像）的指代视频分割需要同时具备鲁棒的跨模态理解和精确的时空推理能力，现有方法难以兼顾。

Method: 提出 OPERA（Omnimodal Progressive spatio-tEmporal Reasoning Agent），基于单一 MLLM 构建，进行双轴渐进推理：时间轴上用 Temporal Reasoning Agent 通过粗到细过滤缩小帧搜索空间，定位关键帧；空间轴上用 Distillation Agent 进行跨模态语义蒸馏确定"找什么"，用增强 GRPO 的 Grounding Agent 确定"目标在哪"，并通过稠密掩码传播完成像素级输出。

Result: 在 OmniAVS 和 Ref-AVS 上取得新的 state of the art，并零样本迁移至标准指代视频分割基准。

Conclusion: OPERA 通过统一的单 MLLM 智能体与双轴三阶段渐进推理，有效融合多模态查询并实现精确的时空定位，具备良好的泛化迁移能力。

Abstract: Referring video segmentation with heterogeneous multimodal queries---spanning text, audio, and reference images---demands both robust cross-modal understanding and precise spatio-temporal reasoning. We propose OPERA (Omnimodal Progressive spatio-tEmporal Reasoning Agent), a unified reasoning agent built on a single MLLM that performs dual-axis progressive reasoning via three specialized stages. Along the temporal axis, a Temporal Reasoning Agent narrows the frame search space through coarse-to-fine filtering to identify the most informative key frame. Along the spatial axis, a Distillation Agent establishes what to locate via cross-modal semantic distillation, and a Grounding Agent enhanced with GRPO determines where the target appears, with dense mask propagation completing the pixel-level output. OPERA sets a new state of the art on OmniAVS and Ref-AVS and transfers zero-shot to standard referring video segmentation benchmarks.

</details>


### [202] [ReLoc: Rethinking Scene Coordinate Regression Architecture for Robust Outdoor LiDAR-based Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33344)
*Heejoon Moon,Yurim Cho,Je Hyeong Hong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ReLoc，一种改进的场景坐标回归（SCR）架构，用于LiDAR定位，通过重新设计全局嵌入模块和引入注意力机制的局部特征增强模块，在保持实时推理的同时实现了当前最优精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LiDAR场景坐标回归方法存在两个问题：一是基于场景分类的全局嵌入难以对邻近位置进行细粒度区分；二是训练时对局部特征均匀采样，对所有点赋予同等重要性，从而传播动态物体或不稳定区域的特征，降低训练稳定性。

Method: ReLoc包含两项改进：（1）重新设计全局嵌入模块，将可学习的上下文token与特征聚合器结合，捕获更丰富、更具判别性的场景上下文；（2）引入基于注意力的局部特征增强模块，抑制噪声局部特征的影响，并促进上下文一致的结构，获得更鲁棒的局部特征表示。

Result: 在两个大规模户外数据集上的实验表明，该方法在精度上超越了此前的SCR方法，达到当前最优，同时保持实时推理性能。

Conclusion: ReLoc通过改进全局与局部特征表示，有效缓解了传统SCR方法的局限，在不牺牲实时性的前提下提升了LiDAR定位精度。

Abstract: Scene Coordinate Regression (SCR) has recently emerged as a promising approach for LiDAR-based localization, achieving accurate localization without requiring an explicit 3D map. Despite their effectiveness, existing SCR methods rely on scene classification-based global embedding that struggles to provide fine-grained discrimination among nearby locations. Moreover, their reliance on uniform sampling of local features during training assigns equal importance to all points, thereby inadvertently propagating features from dynamic objects or unstable regions and potentially degrading training stability. In this paper, we present ReLoc, a revamped SCR architecture that can effectively address these limitations. First, we redesign the global embedding module by combining learnable context tokens with a feature aggregator to capture richer and more discriminative scene context. Second, we introduce an attention-based local feature enhancement module to mitigate the impact of noisy local features while encouraging context-consistent structures, yielding more robust local feature representations. Experimental results on two large-scale outdoor datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art accuracy over previous SCR-based methods while maintaining real-time inference performance.

</details>


### [203] [Focus and Supplement: Dual-Enhanced Vision Transformer for Multi-Class Anomaly Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33353)
*Xurui Li,Enjie Xu,Chenzhou Li,Shilei Zeng,Dayou Huang,Tianyi Ma,Yu Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MACO框架用于多类工业异常分类，学习全面表示并动态估计类别数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多类工业视觉异常分类面临异常表示噪声大/不完整以及异常类别数量未知的挑战。

Method: 使用soft-focus注意力聚焦异常区域并抑制背景噪声；引入辅助分类[A-CLS]token与[CLS]token共同关注多样异常子区域；并提出基于相关性的类别数量估计策略，将已标注类的可分离性线索迁移到无标注集。

Result: 在MVTec AD和MTD数据集上，已知类别数时ARI分别提升6.5%和16.3%；未知类别数时MTD的NMI提升11.2%，MVTec AD的UPS超越现有估计策略24.1%。

Conclusion: MACO在已知和未知类别数场景下均优于现有方法，代码将开源。

Abstract: Multi-class anomaly classification in industrial vision remains challenging due to noisy/incomplete anomaly representations and the unknown number of anomaly classes. To overcome this, we propose MACO, a novel multi-class anomaly classification framework that learns comprehensive representations and dynamically estimates class number without prior knowledge. First, a soft-focus attention uses anomaly maps to concentrate on relevant abnormal regions, while suppressing background noise. Second, auxiliary classification ([A-CLS]) tokens complement the [CLS] token. They collectively attend to diverse anomaly sub-regions, yielding more holistic and discriminative features. These [A-CLS] tokens are also effective across more tasks and domains. To infer the class number, we propose Correlation-based Number Estimation strategy. It computes the average correlation among labeled classes and transfers its separability cue to the unlabeled set. Experiments on MVTec AD and MTD datasets demonstrate our superiority. Under known class number, MACO improves ARI by 6.5% and $\textbf{16.3%}$ on both datasets, respectively. In the more challenging unknown number scenario, it achieves an $\textbf{11.2%}$ NMI gain on MTD and outperforms existing number estimation strategies by $\textbf{24.1%}$ UPS on MVTec AD. Code will be released at https://github.com/HUST-SLOW/MACO.

</details>


### [204] [When Does Geometric View Synthesis Help Wine Label Retrieval? A Public One-Shot Benchmark Across Self-Supervised and Vision-Language Backbones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33359)
*Yueh-Cheng Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 几何视图合成可显著提升早期DINO自监督编码器在酒标识别中的准确率，但对更强的SigLIP 2文本监督编码器仅带来小幅增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 几何视图合成能从单张酒标照片扩展出训练集，但其与预训练图像编码器结合的实际价值尚不明确，需要系统评估。

Method: 在WineSensed衍生的公开基准上（1,000类、每类一张注册照片、4,295条真实查询）进行评测，比较DINO ViT-S/16与冻结SigLIP 2-B，并使用SAM定位、LoRA及验证集选择的全量微调等策略，构建两条几何流水线。

Result: DINO配方下几何视图将top-1从34.1%提升至62.6-63.7%（约为2D增强增益的三倍）；冻结SigLIP 2-B已达94.7%，线性头借助SAM定位的几何流水线提升1.2-1.3个百分点，其他流水线仅0.3-0.6；LoRA与验证集微调无明确增益，固定预算全量微调下降9-24点；SAM定位对99%来源可提供全部六视图（边缘前端仅43%）。

Conclusion: 几何合成对测试的自监督配方有支持作用，对文本监督编码器通过冻结特征适配增益较小；两种柱面构造的差异受裁剪与画布约定混淆，柱面灵敏度未在真实照片上得到印证。

Abstract: Geometric view synthesis can expand a single wine-label photograph into a training set, but its value with pretrained image encoders is unclear. We study this on a public WineSensed-derived benchmark of 1,000 classes, one enrollment photograph per class, and 4,295 real queries. With the earlier DINO vision transformer (ViT-S/16) recipe, geometric views raise top-1 accuracy from 34.1% to 62.6-63.7%, about three times the gain from two-dimensional (2D) augmentation. Frozen SigLIP 2-B already reaches 94.7%. A linear head over its frozen features gains 1.2-1.3 percentage points with the two geometric pipelines localized by the Segment Anything Model (SAM), while the other pipelines gain an inconclusive 0.3-0.6 points. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and validation-selected full fine-tuning show no clear gain within the reported confidence intervals; fixed-budget full fine-tuning loses 9-24 points. SAM localization supplies all six views for 99% of sources, compared with 43% for the edge-based front end. Recognition differences between the two cylinder constructions depend on the training recipe and are confounded by their crop and canvas conventions. Rendered-cylinder tests show different responses to source tilt, but an uncalibrated rim-ratio proxy establishes no corresponding trend in recognition on real photographs. An author-confirmed audit of 50 residual errors identifies 21 query-enrollment appearance mismatches, without establishing an irreducible error rate. These results support geometric synthesis for the tested self-supervised recipe and a smaller benefit through frozen-feature adaptation of the text-supervised encoder.

</details>


### [205] [PulseQuant: Propagation-Guided Subspace Correction for 4-Bit Video Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33384)
*Yutong Wang,Xingtong Ge,Enhuai Liu,Yunke Wang,Tianfan Xue,Xinyuan Chen,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PulseQuant，一种4比特训练后量化方法，通过轨迹敏感性与激活几何引导离线校准，在多种视频扩散Transformer模型上提升关键一致性指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散Transformer中，量化误差会被后续去噪更新放大或衰减，因此局部重建误差无法完整预测最终影响，需要超越局部重建目标的校准方法。

Method: PulseQuant结合轨迹敏感性与激活几何引导离线校准：通过孤立块-步干预估计传播风险，优先处理敏感轨迹状态以进行行半径选择；在半径固定后，用响应子空间校正通过邻近码编辑减少沿主导激活方向的残差分量，两阶段均保持原始4比特权重表示。

Result: 受控干预表明，短时域传播误差比即时块输出误差更可靠地预测最终潜变量误差；在Wan模型、Self Forcing和MiniMax-H3上评估，关键一致性与稠密参考指标均有提升，其他属性在模型规模与生成范式上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 支持校准目标应超越局部重建，轨迹传播误差是更有效的预测与优化信号。

Abstract: Quantization errors in video diffusion transformers can be amplified or attenuated by subsequent denoising updates, making local reconstruction error an incomplete predictor of final impact. We introduce PulseQuant, a 4-bit post-training quantization method that combines trajectory sensitivity with activation geometry to guide offline calibration. Isolated block--step interventions estimate propagation risk, which prioritizes sensitive trajectory states during row-radius selection. With these radii fixed, response-subspace correction uses neighboring-code edits to reduce residual components along dominant activation directions. Both stages preserve the original 4-bit weight representation. Controlled interventions show that short-horizon propagated error predicts final latent error more reliably than immediate block-output error, supporting calibration beyond local reconstruction objectives. Evaluations on Wan models, Self Forcing, and MiniMax-H3 demonstrate improvements in key consistency and dense-reference metrics while remaining competitive on other attributes across model scales and generation paradigms.

</details>


### [206] [SciGen-Verifier: A Multimodal Reasoner for Explainable Verification in Scientific Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33399)
*Jiali Chen,Zhengteng Lin,Zuqi Wang,Shirong Lin,Xi Yu,Xusen Hei,DingBa Fu,Jiayuan Xie,Yi Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建了科学图像生成可解释验证基准SciGen-Verify，并提出推理驱动的多模态验证器SciGen-Verifier，通过冷启动监督微调与课程式两阶段强化学习训练，在验证性能上媲美更大的专有模型，并可作为在线批评器用于迭代图像修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实教育中，解答常以图形（电路、几何作图、函数图像）而非纯文字呈现，教师需像批改文字一样仔细评判图形。近年统一多模态模型已能生成科学图像，但验证这些专业视觉输出的正确性仍是关键瓶颈：错误往往源于复杂领域知识、结构推理和多步指令，而非表面瑕疵。现有验证器主要面向自然图像且将判断压缩为标量分数，科学覆盖度与可解释反馈均未被充分探索。

Method: (1) 构建SciGen-Verify基准，覆盖指令遵循、多学科推理与世界知识领域，包含二元判断、解释、纠错编辑指令三层级联协议；(2) 提出SciGen-Verifier，采用冷启动监督微调后接课程式两阶段强化学习管线，先以评分标准引导的过程奖励强化科学推理探索，再用结果奖励对齐真实标注。

Result: 在SciGen-Verify上，SciGen-Verifier相对于规模大得多的专有模型取得有竞争力的性能；并可充当实用的在线批评器，用于迭代图像修正。

Conclusion: 面向科学图像生成的可解释验证在基准、模型与训练方法三方面得到系统推进，验证器不仅可给出解释与纠错指令，还能作为在线批评器驱动迭代式图像修正。

Abstract: In realistic education, a solution is often expressed not only in words but in a drawing--a circuit, a geometric construction, a function plot--and a teacher must grade the drawing as carefully as the text. Recent advances in unified multimodal models have enabled scientific image generation, yet verifying the correctness of these specialized visual outputs remains a critical bottleneck: errors often arise from intricate domain knowledge, structural reasoning, and multi-step instruction rather than surface-level artifacts. Existing verifiers mainly target natural images and compress judgement into scalar scores, leaving scientific coverage and explainable feedback for error correction underexplored. To bridge this gap, we make three main contributions. (1) We construct SciGen-Verify, a benchmark dedicated to explainable verification of scientific image generation, spanning instruction following, multidisciplinary reasoning, and world knowledge domains. It contains a three-tier hierarchical protocol over the binary judgement, supporting explanation, and corrective editing instruction. (2) We develop SciGen-Verifier, a reasoning-driven multimodal verifier trained via cold-start supervised fine-tuning followed by a curriculum-based two-stage reinforcement learning pipeline. The rubric-guided process rewards first strengthen scientific reasoning exploration and outcome rewards subsequently align output with ground-truth annotation. (3) On SciGen-Verify, SciGen-Verifier achieves competitive performance against much larger proprietary models. It further serves as a practical online critic for iterative image rectification.

</details>


### [207] [Groupwise Selective State-Space Filtering for Accurate and Streaming Action Boundary Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33400)
*Mustafa Bora Çelik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种边界检测适配器，在预提取视频特征上通过学习分组选择性扫描获取时序表示，实现类别无关的动作边界检测，并支持流式推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无修剪视频中的动作边界检测需要在不分配动作类别的情况下划分区间，现有方法在时序表示学习与流式推理方面存在不足。

Method: 在预提取视频特征上构建边界检测适配器，利用分组选择性扫描学习时序表示；通过分组融合与时序建模生成转移分数，再解码为边界时间戳；采用边界时间监督进行训练。

Result: 在 Breakfast、GTEA 和 50Salads 数据集上评估，边界 F1 分数分别为 0.457、0.622 和 0.611；有状态变体支持零神经前瞻、单样本峰值确认与有界内存的流式推理。

Conclusion: 该类别无关的边界检测方法可实现有效的动作边界定位，且具备流式推理能力，便于下游系统进行动作类别分配。

Abstract: Action boundary detection partitions untrimmed video into intervals without assigning action classes. We present a boundary-detection adapter operating on pre-extracted video features, learning temporal representations via groupwise selective scans. Learned group fusion and temporal modeling convert these into transition scores, which are decoded into boundary timestamps. Trained with boundary-time supervision, the class-agnostic model is evaluated on Breakfast, GTEA, and 50Salads using temporal tolerances and bipartite matching, achieving boundary $F_1$ scores of 0.457, 0.622, and 0.611. A stateful variant enables feature-streaming inference with zero neural look-ahead, one-sample peak confirmation, and bounded memory. Downstream systems can subsequently assign s

</details>


### [208] [VaME: Exploring Variational Latent Reasoning for Multimodal Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33402)
*Peixi Wu,Mingzhou Jiang,Feipeng Ma,Biao Yang,Yunhao Zhou,Wei Yuan,Bosong Chai,Huizu Lin,Jie Chen,Zhangchi Hu,Fan Yang,Wenwu Ou,Hebei Li,Xiaoyan Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出VaME框架，将多模态嵌入的潜在推理建模为可学习的轨迹分布，通过变分潜在推理与强化学习优化，在多任务检索基准上超越显式CoT模型和潜在推理基线，并实现至少4.25倍推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多模态检索需要紧凑嵌入以保留跨模态的任务相关语义。已有工作将潜在推理引入多模态嵌入学习来精炼信息，但大多局限于确定性的潜在路径，未探索其他轨迹以发现更优嵌入。

Method: 提出VaME框架，将潜在推理建模为轨迹上的可学习分布：（1）变分潜在推理VLR，通过轻量解码器的答案重构引导，实现潜在空间的自回归探索；（2）在原始嵌入token读出基础上增加潜在融合嵌入，便于后续强化学习中的探索；（3）通过强化学习在随机变分轨迹上优化潜在推理，使用语义解码奖励SDR偏好具有可解释解码结果的语义有意义的轨迹。

Result: 在涵盖图像、视频和视觉文档检索的78任务MMEB-V2基准上，VaME优于大多数显式CoT模型和所有潜在推理基线；在MRMR等推理密集型基准上表现稳健，强化学习后收益显著；相比确定性潜在自回归基线，实现至少4.25倍推理加速。

Conclusion: VaME通过变分轨迹分布建模潜在推理并结合强化学习优化，在保持语义信息的同时提升多模态检索性能与推理效率，代码将公开。

Abstract: Universal multimodal retrieval requires compact embeddings that preserve task-relevant semantic information across diverse modalities. Prior works have incorporated latent reasoning into multimodal embedding learning to refine this information before embedding extraction. However, most existing approaches remain confined to deterministic latent paths, without exploring alternative trajectories to discover better embeddings. Thus, we propose VaME (Variational Multimodal Embeddings), a framework that models latent reasoning as a learnable distribution over trajectories. Specifically, we first introduce Variational Latent Reasoning (VLR) to enable autoregressive exploration in latent space, guided by answer reconstruction through a lightweight decoder. Meanwhile, we augment the original embedding-token readout with a latent-fused embedding to facilitate exploration during subsequent reinforcement learning. Finally, we optimize latent reasoning over stochastic variational trajectories through reinforcement learning, using Semantic Decoding Reward (SDR) to favor semantically meaningful trajectories with interpretable decoded outcomes. On the 78-task MMEB-V2 benchmark, spanning image, video, and visual-document retrieval, VaME outperforms most explicit CoT-based models and all latent-reasoning baselines. VaME also demonstrates robust performance on reasoning-intensive benchmarks such as MRMR, with substantial gains after reinforcement learning. Importantly, VaME achieves these gains with at least a 4.25x inference speedup over the deterministic latent autoregressive baselines. The code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [209] [Resolving State-Representation Mismatch: State-Space Visual Reasoning for Open-Loop VLA Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33412)
*Junhao Xiao,Haoxiang Zhao,Menghao Fang,Jinkui Zhang,Jinghan Yu,Xinyu Huang,Zhiyu Wu,Kaiming Xu,Yi Chen,Youjun Bao,Zhiyuan Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SSVR，通过解耦静态视觉上下文、语言约束与循环隐状态，解决VLA开环规划中的状态表示不匹配问题，在多个基准上大幅领先并显著加速推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型在开环规划中存在"状态表示不匹配"的根本问题：仅凭初始观测，模型需内部模拟动作条件下的状态转移，而文本、像素、隐空间推理分别面临空间压缩损失、视觉生成误差累积、中间隐token被绕过等问题，导致长时程规划不可靠。

Method: SSVR将静态视觉上下文、语言约束与循环隐状态解耦：仅编码一次初始图像和指令，随后每个动作预测以隐状态为条件，并用动作条件下的GRU更新该隐状态。骨干网络采用Qwen2.5-VL，同时复用静态视觉-文本上下文并维护紧凑循环状态以实现高效多步推理。

Result: 在FrozenLake、Maze、MiniBehavior上分别取得99.5/99.6、96.3/98.0、83.9/90.6的EM/PR，显著优于先前方法；在输入变换和迁移设置下验证了循环状态建模的有效性；预构建prefix cache时，Maze解码rollout比基线快达98.58倍。

Conclusion: 循环状态建模对VLA开环规划有效，SSVR在多个基准上性能领先且推理高效，验证了状态解耦与循环更新设计的优越性。

Abstract: Despite rapid progress in vision-language-action (VLA) models, existing reasoning paradigms still face a fundamental \emph{state-representation mismatch} in open-loop planning. Given only an initial observation, models must internally simulate action-conditioned state transitions, whereas text-, pixel-, and latent-space reasoning can suffer from lossy spatial compression, error-accumulating visual generation, and bypass of intermediate latent tokens, respectively, undermining reliable long-horizon planning. We propose \textbf{State-Space Visual Reasoning} (SSVR), which decouples static visual context, language constraints, and a recurrent latent state. SSVR encodes the initial image and instruction once, then conditions each action prediction on the latent state and updates it with an action-conditioned GRU. Using Qwen2.5-VL as the backbone, SSVR achieves 99.5/99.6, 96.3/98.0, and 83.9/90.6 EM/PR on FrozenLake, Maze, and MiniBehavior, substantially outperforming prior methods. Extensive experiments support the effectiveness of recurrent state modeling for VLA open-loop planning across input transformations and transfer settings. By reusing static visual-textual context and updating a compact recurrent state, SSVR supports efficient multi-step inference, achieving up to $98.58\times$ faster Maze decoding rollouts than the evaluated baselines with the prefix cache prebuilt.

</details>


### [210] [TTRSD: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning with Self-Distillation for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33414)
*Shuning Wang,Zhiheng Wu,Xun Zhou,Chongyang Cui,Chen Jia,Bowen Liu,Chuanjie Li,Xiang Chen,Yi Yang,Yumeng Zhang,Wenjie Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TTRSD框架，结合多视角答案级自蒸馏与视觉对比token选择，在无标签条件下提升VLM的测试时强化学习效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时强化学习在固定视觉条件下重复采样会强化共享的感知错误，而序列级奖励无法定位视觉感知这一基础瓶颈，可能导致预训练推理能力退化。

Method: 共享策略将原始、裁剪、下采样三种视角的教师预测聚合为答案分布；从原始图像生成的学生轨迹依据其最终答案在该分布中的支持度获得奖励；通过对比同一采样token在原始与视觉消融输入下的对数概率（固定文本前缀），选取视觉敏感位置进行策略梯度更新，将更新方向（组相对优势）与更新位置（视觉敏感性）分离。

Result: 仅用20个无标签适配样本，在7个基准和3个VLM上均有提升，InternVL3-2B的MMMU准确率从35.79%提升至49.32%（+13.53%），并展现出跨数据集泛化能力，同时保持固有推理完整性。

Conclusion: TTRSD无需真值标签、外部验证器或独立教师模型，即可实现视觉感知与推理的协同优化，有效提升VLM测试时适应性能。

Abstract: Test-time reinforcement learning enables vision-language models (VLMs) to adapt using unlabeled inputs. However, repeated sampling under fixed visual conditions can reinforce shared perceptual errors, while sequence-level rewards fail to isolate visual perception the foundational bottleneck that anchors multimodal reasoning risking the degradation of pre-trained reasoning capabilities. We propose TTRSD, a test-time reinforcement learning framework combining multi-view answer-level self-distillation with visual contrastive token selection. A shared policy aggregates teacher predictions across original, cropped, and downsampled views into an answer distribution. Student trajectories generated from the original image receive rewards based on the support for their final answers in this distribution. To allocate this feedback precisely toward perceptual bottlenecks, we compare the log-probabilities of the same sampled tokens under original and visually ablated inputs while holding their textual prefixes fixed, selecting visually sensitive positions for policy-gradient updates. TTRSD separates update direction, determined by group-relative advantages, from update position, determined by visual sensitivity, without requiring ground-truth labels, external verifiers, or a separate teacher. With only 20 unlabeled adaptation samples, TTRSD improves performance across seven benchmarks and three VLMs, raising InternVL3-2B's MMMU accuracy from 35.79% to 49.32%(+13.53%), demonstrating cross-dataset generalization while preserving inherent reasoning integrity.

</details>


### [211] [TT-VidT: Decoupling the Temporal Axis for Efficient Motion-Centric Video Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33419)
*Shih-Ying Yeh,Daniel Z. Kaplan,Xuehai Wang,Fu-En Yang,Min-Hung Chen,Shang-Hong Lai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对视频自监督学习中"完整训练配方"难以归因方法本身的问题，构建了24组匹配的架构-目标组合研究，并提出TT-VidT方法，在多个动作敏感数据集上取得领先的微调效果，同时显著降低计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频自监督学习的对比往往评估整套训练配方（架构、目标、数据、调度、规模、解码器容量同时变化），难以判断哪些设计真正产生了"运动优先"的表征。作者希望在控制变量的条件下，识别出能带来帧间变化敏感表征的关键选择。

Method: 在约170M~190M编码器规模、约1.7M OpenVid和Moments-in-Time v2视频片段、8个epoch的设置下，进行4×6=24组架构-目标匹配实验。提出TT-VidT：将DINOv3初始化的ViT-B/16逐帧空间路径与紧凑的Temporal Transfer Layer结合，用Diff Compression训练，以首帧外观锚点加逐帧运动token重建目标帧。

Result: 扫描表明，TT3D与Diff Compression结合（而非任一单独组件）才能进入最强的运动敏感区间；解码器消融偏好紧凑的视频预训练解码器。最终比较中，TT-VidT在Jester、Something-Something V2、ARID、Diving48微调上同时领先，较最强非TT方案提升54%~121%，且编码器FLOPs比DisMo少48%、比VideoMAE或V-JEPA2少55%。HMDB51、IARD、EPIC-Kitchens则构成结论的边界限制。

Conclusion: 在受控的架构-目标匹配比较下，运动优先表征源自TT3D与Diff Compression的协同，而非单一组件。TT-VidT在运动敏感任务上取得领先并更省算力，但其优势并非在所有数据集上普遍成立。

Abstract: Comparisons in video self-supervised learning often evaluate complete training recipes rather than isolating the method itself: architecture, objective, data exposure, schedule, scale, and decoder capacity can all vary at once. This makes it hard to identify which choices yield motion-prioritized representations, whose gains concentrate on frame-to-frame change while retaining useful appearance. We address this with a matched $4 \times 6 = 24$ architecture-objective study at roughly 170M ~ 190M encoder scale on $\sim$1.7M OpenVid and Moments-in-Time v2 clips for 8 epochs, and propose TT-VidT. TT-VidT combines a DINOv3-initialized ViT-B/16 per-frame spatial path with a compact Temporal Transfer Layer, trained by Diff Compression to reconstruct target frames from a first-frame appearance anchor and frame-specific motion tokens. The sweep shows that TT3D with Diff Compression, not either component alone, enters the strongest motion-sensitive regime, and decoder ablations favor a compact video-pretrained decoder. In final comparison, TT-VidT leads Jester, Something-Something V2, ARID, and Diving48 fine-tuning simultaneously, improving over the strongest non-TT row by 54% ~ 121%, while using 48% fewer encoder FLOPs than DisMo and 55% fewer than VideoMAE or V-JEPA2. HMDB51, IARD, and EPIC-Kitchens bound the claim.

</details>


### [212] [TC-ADA: One-Shot Active Domain Adaptation for Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33432)
*Weihao Yan,Yeqiang Qian,Yueyuan Li,Tao Li,Chunxiang Wang,Ming Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一次性图像级主动域适应设置下的TC-ADA方法，联合设计图像采集与目标域校准的适应策略，在少量标注下接近全监督性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手动密集标注是语义分割模型在新驾驶环境部署的主要障碍；现有主动域适应（ADA）方法多依赖多轮采集-标注-重训练流程，效率低、不实用，因此研究更实用的单轮一次性图像级设置。

Method: 提出目标域校准主动域适应（TC-ADA），分两阶段：阶段1利用视觉基础模型（VFM）的视觉表征与固定无监督域适应模型的语义预测，在无目标标注下选取具有代表性和信息量的目标图像；阶段2联合使用有标注源域、有标注目标域及剩余无标注目标域数据，在有限目标标签下校准源域与目标域监督信号。

Result: 在五个合成到真实及真实到真实的驾驶迁移任务上，相比代表性ADA基线取得一致提升；在四个迁移任务仅用23至46张标注目标图像、Mapillary用140张时，与仅目标域全监督的mIoU差距在1.9点以内。

Conclusion: TC-ADA在实用的一次性图像级主动域适应设置下实现了高标注效率的语义分割迁移，性能接近目标域全监督，验证了联合图像采集与目标域校准设计的有效性。

Abstract: Manual dense annotation remains a major obstacle to deploying semantic segmentation models in new driving environments. Active domain adaptation (ADA) seeks label-efficient transfer by annotating only a selected portion of the target domain. Existing ADA methods commonly implement this process through multiple rounds of acquisition, annotation, and retraining. We study a practical one-shot image-level setting that selects and densely annotates a fixed target subset in a single round, followed by uninterrupted adaptation. Within this setting, we develop Target-Calibrated Active Domain Adaptation (TC-ADA) as a joint design of complete-image acquisition and target-calibrated adaptation. Stage~1 uses visual representations from a vision foundation model (VFM) together with semantic predictions from a fixed unsupervised domain adaptation model to select representative and informative target images without target annotations. Stage~2 jointly uses labeled source data, labeled target data, and the remaining unlabeled target data, while calibrating source and target supervision under limited target labels. Extensive experiments across five synthetic-to-real and real-to-real driving transfers show consistent improvements over representative ADA baselines. With only 23 to 46 labeled target images on four transfers and 140 on Mapillary, TC-ADA stays within 1.9 mean intersection over union (mIoU) points of target-only full supervision. Code will be available at https://github.com/ywher/TC-ADA.

</details>


### [213] [Concept Score Relearning: A Unified Cross-Architecture Attack on Concept Erasure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33445)
*Hong Xi Tae,Jiaming Zhang,Wenwen He,Xuan Wang,Wei Yang Bryan Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出统一的概念重激活框架CSR，在U-Net与Transformer两类生成模型上验证被擦除概念的可恢复性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念擦除的鲁棒性评估多依赖针对特定模型架构设计的重学习攻击，缺乏跨架构的统一评估手段。

Method: 提出概念分数重学习（CSR），一种参数级统一框架，在各模型原生预测空间内进行优化以重激活被擦除概念；无需外部目标概念图像数据集，对U-Net版Stable Diffusion与Transformer版FLUX采用相同的概念导向目标。

Result: 在多种概念和多种擦除方法上实现一致的概念重激活；在严格禁裸露设置下，CSR在FLUX上平均ASR达50.47%，在Stable Diffusion上达40.29%，在所有评估安全设置中均排名第一。

Conclusion: CSR具有跨架构适用性，表明看似被擦除的概念仍可被持续恢复。

Abstract: Concept erasure aims to suppress undesirable knowledge in text-to-image generative models. However, existing robustness evaluations typically rely on relearning attacks tailored to specific model architectures. We study concept reactivation across two substantially different generative paradigms: noise-prediction U-Nets and flow-matching Transformers. We introduce \textbf{Concept Score Relearning (CSR)}, a unified parameter-level framework that reactivates erased concepts by optimizing each model within its native prediction space. CSR requires no external target-concept image dataset and applies the same concept-directed objective to both U-Net-based Stable Diffusion and Transformer-based FLUX. Experiments across diverse concepts and multiple erasure methods demonstrate consistent concept reactivation across both architectures, highlighting the cross-architecture applicability of CSR and the persistent recoverability of apparently erased concepts. For strict nudity, CSR reaches average ASRs of 50.47\% on FLUX and 40.29\% on Stable Diffusion, consistently ranking first across all evaluated safety settings.

</details>


### [214] [A Visual Classification Dataset and Model Evaluation for Historical Manuscript Illustrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33449)
*Yoav Evron,Michal Bar-Asher Siegal,Michael Fire*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建了包含22个类别、15000幅历史手稿插图的人工标注数据集，并系统评测了CNN、Transformer、CLIP及视觉语言模型在插图分类任务上的表现，发现微调图像分类器效果最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 历史手稿插图蕴含丰富的文化视觉证据，大规模数字化虽使其可在线获取，但缺乏有意义类别的提取系统使海量藏品难以检索与探索，存在分类标注数据与评测基准的空白。

Method: 构建15000幅、跨22类、可追溯数百年的手稿插图人工标注数据集；对比微调CNN与Transformer分类器、零样本CLIP、基于嵌入的分类器以及直接使用视觉语言模型的方法，并分析类别可分性与语义重叠。

Result: 微调图像分类器整体表现最佳，ConvNeXt达88.9%准确率与81.3%宏F1；CLIP嵌入配合XGBoost是强有力的替代方案；零样本CLIP与直接视觉语言模型分类明显较差。

Conclusion: 微调专用模型在该领域显著优于通用模型，暴露出通用模型在此类任务上的局限；部分错误源于类别体系本身的语义重叠，提示分类体系也构成性能上限的一部分。

Abstract: Historical manuscript illustrations preserve rich visual evidence of past cultures. They depict people, animals, plants, diagrams, music notations, and decorative forms. Although large digitization projects have made many manuscripts available online, the material itself remains difficult to explore at scale. Extraction systems can find illustrations on manuscript pages, but without meaningful categories, large collections remain hard to search and explore. We address this gap by introducing a manually labeled dataset of 15,000 illustrations from manuscripts dating back hundreds of years across 22 categories, and evaluating modern vision models for image classification on this task. The problem is challenging due to stylistic diversity, degradation, and semantic ambiguity, with many images that fit more than one category. We compare fine-tuned CNN and Transformer-based classifiers, zero-shot CLIP, embedding-based classifiers, and direct vision-language models. Results show that fine-tuned image classifiers perform best overall, with ConvNeXt reaching 88.9% accuracy and 81.3% macro-F1. Using CLIP embeddings with XGBoost provides a strong alternative. In contrast, zero-shot CLIP and direct vision-language classification perform substantially worse, highlighting the limits of general-purpose models in this domain. Beyond overall performance, the analysis reveals which categories are visually separable and where errors reflect genuine semantic overlap, suggesting that some limitations arise from the taxonomy itself.

</details>


### [215] [Native Association: Confidence-Aware Human Perception in the Wild with a Foundation VLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33450)
*Igal Dmitriev,Ofir Liba*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将人物属性（位置、队伍、号码）的关联内化为文法约束的序列生成任务，微调0.77B视觉语言模型单次前向输出结构化结果，无需后处理绑定，关联错误率大幅降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方案将检测器、OCR引擎与分类器拼接，后处理绑定步骤在遮挡下会张冠李戴（把正确读出的号码绑到错误球员）。作者希望让关联成为模型原生能力，从根本上消除后处理绑定环节。

Method: 微调Florence-2（0.77B）视觉语言模型，使其以文法约束的单一序列输出每个人的全部属性，每个属性生成在其所属人物的块内，结构上保证每帧输出符合schema。额外一次前向得到逐字段置信度，支持拒识选项并可路由到免训练的“缩放重读”处理小目标球员。

Result: 残差误关联纯属感知错误，约为零样本提示前沿API的1/4（0.057 vs 0.21–0.24）；冻结的多运动测试集上单次通过达0.95检测F1（API为0.65–0.75）；球衣精度0.71→0.96（一半覆盖率）。在WIDER-Attribute上给框设定下达93.1 mAP，并首次给出检测耦合的端到端标准协议结果（84.5 mAP）。

Conclusion: 文法学会后，在测试的适配配置下进一步的参数高效微调无显著增益，收益来自结构而非额外权重。同一配方在WIDER-Attribute上复现相同调优结论。

Abstract: Extracting who is where, on which team, wearing which number from a broadcast frame is typically done by stitching a detector, an OCR engine, and classifiers together -- and the stitching step swaps identities under occlusion. We make association native instead: a 0.77B vision-language model (Florence-2) is fine-tuned to emit all per-person attributes as one grammar-constrained sequence, with each attribute generated inside its owner's block. Output is therefore schema-valid on every frame by construction, and no post-hoc binding step exists to attach a correctly read number to the wrong player: residual misassociation is pure perception error, $\approx4\times$ rarer than zero-shot-prompted frontier APIs' (0.057 vs. 0.21-0.24). On a frozen multi-sport test set, this single pass reaches 0.95 detection F1 (APIs: 0.65-0.75). A single extra forward pass yields a per-field confidence that supports a reject option (jersey precision $0.71\rightarrow0.96$ at half coverage) and routes a training-free zoom-and-re-read for small players. Surprisingly, once the grammar is learned, further parameter-efficient tuning yields no measurable gain under the adaptation configurations we test; the identical recipe on WIDER-Attribute reaches 93.1 mAP given-box, yields the first detection-coupled end-to-end results under its standard test protocol (84.5 mAP), and reproduces the same tuning result. In this regime, the gains live in the structure, not in added weights.

</details>


### [216] [SphMind: Towards Robust, Training-Free VLM-based Spatial Reasoning with a 360 Camera](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33462)
*Shriram Damodaran,Soumyaratna Debnath,Cheston Tan,Lin Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SphMind是一个免训练、即插即用的框架，通过解耦语义感知与几何推理，让MLLM无需重训练即可胜任全景360图像的球面空间推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景/360相机为具身智能体提供全方位视野，但现有MLLM多在传统2D透视图像上训练，难以应对球面几何带来的严重畸变与环绕不连续问题，要实现向非欧3D空间的泛化而无需重训练颇具挑战。

Method: 提出免训练、即插即用的SphMind框架，将语义感知与几何推理解耦：保留MLLM的语义能力，在外部处理几何。引入基于球谐函数的空间图（SHSG），通过球面上的等变变换建模空间关系；并结合推理时几何接地（IGG），一个模型无关的闭环优化过程，在推理时将MLLM表示与球面几何约束对齐。

Result: 在三个基准上，SphMind在MP3D和Stanford2D-3D的方向推理上平均提升超21.4%，在真实世界ODI-Bench上比提示工程基线高8.7%，全景旋转下旋转不变性提升5.9%，且无需额外训练或数据集特定调优。真实场景评估显示其能解决基线视觉语言模型无法正确回答的方向推理问题。

Conclusion: SphMind通过外部几何建模与推理时对齐，无需训练即可显著提升MLLM的全景球面空间推理与旋转不变性，具备良好的泛化性和实用性。

Abstract: Omnidirectional or 360 cameras provide embodied AI agents with a holistic, wide field-of-view (FoV) view of their surroundings, motivating the use of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for omnidirectional spatial reasoning. However, most MLLMs are trained on conventional 2D perspective images and struggle with the severe distortions and wrap-around discontinuities induced by spherical geometry. Enabling them to generalize to non-Euclidean 3D spaces without retraining therefore remains challenging. We propose SphMind, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that decouples semantic perception from geometric reasoning. Rather than requiring MLLMs to learn spherical geometry internally, SphMind preserves their semantic capabilities while handling geometry externally. We introduce a Spherical Harmonics-based Spatial Graph (SHSG) that models spatial relationships through equivariant transformations on the sphere, together with Inference-Time Geometric Grounding (IGG), a model-agnostic closed-loop optimization process that aligns MLLM representations with spherical geometric constraints during inference. Experiments on three benchmarks show that SphMind achieves over 21.4% average improvement in directional reasoning on MP3D and Stanford2D-3D, outperforms prompt-engineering baselines by 8.7% on the real-world ODI-Bench, and improves rotational invariance by 5.9% under panorama rotations, without additional training or dataset-specific tuning. In-the-wild evaluations further show that SphMind resolves directional reasoning queries that baseline vision-language models fail to answer correctly.

</details>


### [217] [Printability-Constrained Adversarial Decals for Near-Nadir Aerial Perception: Measured Ink Gamuts, Nested Realism Constraints, and a Physical-World Bound](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33513)
*Sandesh Shrestha,K. T. Yasas Mahima,Asanka G. Perera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文在优化阶段即引入打印机色域、面板尺寸与高空成像细节损失三项物理约束，隔离墨色集合（均匀色立方 vs. 实测色域）进行对比，发现实测色域的影响因受害模型而异，且色域"低彩度低频率"的直觉解释不成立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗贴片用于空中感知时通常按数字合成图像评估，打印仅被视为实现细节。作者希望把物理可行性（可打印色域、可用面板尺寸、成像细节损失）前置到优化中，并重点考察"可用墨色"这一因素本身是否影响攻击效果，而非仅在事后检验。

Method: 在两个贴片间固定全部17项优化设置，仅改变可用颜色：一个约束在均匀色立方，另一个约束在通过打印并扫描216色图表测得的色域。每个贴片在3个随机种子下优化，并在13种受害条件下评估，所有成功率均与尺寸匹配的优化对照组对比。另构造11个贴片检验"可打印调色板彩度更低、频率更低"的解释，包括匹配基数、匹配亮度彩度仅改变色调位置等对照。

Result: 实测色域的效果依受害模型而定：在六个闭集分割模型中的三个上净攻击成功率上升，且这类模型的两种墨色种子区间不相交，DeepLabv3-R101 为 +0.120，SegFormer-B0 为 +0.041；色立方贴片在开放词汇分割器以及四个检测器中的两个上更强，但两种墨色下检测器净提升均不超过 +0.026。额外11个贴片否定了彩度/频率解释：基数匹配后，与色立方同样高彩度的调色板攻击效果相当；基数从3到32无明显趋势；在基数、亮度、彩度匹配、仅色调位置不同的调色板间，成功率跨度为0.035至0.136。带印刷贴花的物理评估未检测到迁移，将迁移率上界限定为0.133，未排除0.121的仿真值。

Conclusion: 墨色集合对对抗贴片的影响并非统一，而是高度依赖受害模型；"可打印调色板彩度/频率更低"这一自然解释不成立。物理评估未能检测到迁移，但上界0.133无法排除仿真值0.121，说明结论对物理与仿真差距仍保持开放。

Abstract: Adversarial patches for aerial perception are typically evaluated as digital composites, with printing left as an implementation detail. This study imposes three physical constraints during optimization rather than after it: the color range a particular printer can reproduce, the size of the flat panel a vehicle offers, and the loss of fine detail incurred when the patch is imaged from altitude. The principal comparison isolates the ink set. Two patches share all seventeen recorded optimization settings and differ only in the colors available to them. One is constrained to a uniform color cube; the other to a gamut measured by printing and scanning a 216-patch chart. Each was optimized at three seeds and evaluated against thirteen victim conditions, with every rate reported against a size-matched optimized control. The effect of the measured gamut is victim-dependent rather than uniform. Net attack success rises on three of six closed-set segmentation victims, and for these the seed ranges of the two ink sets are disjoint: $+0.120$ on DeepLabv3-R101 and $+0.041$ on SegFormer-B0. The color-cube patch is consistently stronger on the open-vocabulary segmenter and on two of four detectors, though no detector exceeds a net of $+0.026$ under either ink set. The natural explanation is that a printable palette is simply less chromatic and lower in frequency than a digital one. Eleven further patches test this account and it does not hold. Once cardinality is matched, a palette as chromatic as the cube attacks equally well. Cardinality itself shows no trend from three inks to thirty-two. Palettes matched on cardinality, lightness and chroma, and differing only in hue placement, span $0.035$ to $0.136$. A physical evaluation with printed decals did not detect transfer; it bounds the transferred rate at $0.133$, which does not exclude the simulated value of $0.121$.

</details>


### [218] [SceneScaffold: Active Scene-State Construction for Unified 3D Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33518)
*Xiangqi Li,Libo Huang,Jiarui Zhao,Weilun Feng,Chuanguang Yang,Zhulin An,Yongjun Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SceneScaffold将3D-LMM的视觉瓶颈从被动压缩器改造为主动场景组织器，构建角色感知的空间脚手架，提升统一3D场景理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D大型多模态模型的视觉瓶颈被动地将异构3D证据压缩为同质化的以物体为中心的token序列，导致场景空间组织表征不足，LLM需从扁平token序列中恢复空间关系，在关系密集和空间模糊场景中推理不稳定。

Method: 提出SceneScaffold框架，将视觉瓶颈重构为主动场景组织器，在语言推理前构建角色感知的空间脚手架。具体将超点级视觉证据组织为不同结构角色的场景状态组件：实体状态保留核心物体语义，场景框架状态通过边界和区域锚点维持空间参照，关系状态编码物体-环境交互线索，全局摘要提供紧凑上下文。

Result: 在3D视觉定位、问答和密集描述等统一3D场景理解任务上验证了有效性，诊断结果进一步表明其在关系密集和空间模糊场景中的适用性。

Conclusion: SceneScaffold通过角色感知的场景状态构建，为LLM提供空间组织化的场景表征，有效改善统一3D场景理解及空间关系推理。

Abstract: Recent 3D large multimodal models (3D-LMMs) rely on a visual bottleneck to compress complex 3D scene evidence into a limited number of visual tokens compatible with large language models (LLMs). Current visual bottlenecks, however, often passively compress heterogeneous 3D evidence into a homogeneous object-centric token sequence, leaving the spatial organization of the scene under-represented. This under-representation forces the LLM to recover spatial relations from a flattened token sequence, leading to unstable reasoning in relation-intensive and spatially ambiguous scenes. To address this issue, we propose SceneScaffold, an active scene-state construction framework for unified 3D scene understanding. SceneScaffold reformulates the visual bottleneck from a passive feature compressor into an active scene organizer, constructing a role-aware spatial scaffold before language reasoning. Specifically, SceneScaffold organizes superpoint-level visual evidence into scene-state components with distinct structural roles: entity states preserve core object semantics, scene-frame states maintain spatial references via boundary and region anchors, relation states encode object-environment interaction cues, and a global summary provides compact context. Through this role-aware construction, SceneScaffold provides the LLM with a spatially organized scene representation before language reasoning. Experiments on unified 3D scene understanding tasks, including 3D visual grounding, question answering, and dense captioning, demonstrate the effectiveness of SceneScaffold, while diagnostic results further show its applicability to relation-intensive and spatially ambiguous cases. Code is available at https://github.com/lixiangqi707/SceneScaffold.

</details>


### [219] [Anatomy-Structured Hierarchical MIL for Weakly-Supervised Thoracic Disease Detection in Chest X-rays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33520)
*Jeongin Kim,Sohyun Ahn,Seo Young Kang,Jaeyi Sung,Soomin Kim,Sungho Cho,Rena Lee,Kwanchang Kim,Junhyug Noh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ASH-MIL框架，通过解剖结构化的多分支与层次化MIL聚合，在胸片弱监督疾病检测中实现更精准的定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胸片弱监督疾病检测面临病灶表现细微、解剖结构重叠的挑战，而现有解剖感知方法多依赖粗糙区域代理或静态空间先验，限制了动态实例发现与小结节的精确定位。

Method: ASH-MIL引入并行解剖结构观察分支（心脏、肺部、不可知三类），结合层次化MIL聚合；将解剖先验作为软空间偏置注入解码器交叉注意力，从而在无病灶框监督下生成解剖有依据的证据图；实例定位直接由MIL加权的交叉注意力图导出。

Result: 在CXR8及跨域MIMIC-CXR留出集上，方法较既有弱监督与解剖感知方法取得一致提升，在更严格的定位标准下尤为明显。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 解剖结构化的分支设计与层次化MIL聚合，能在无框监督下实现动态实例发现与更精确的病灶定位，验证了解剖感知建模在弱监督胸片检测中的有效性。

Abstract: Weakly-supervised thoracic disease detection in chest X-rays (CXR) is challenging due to subtle appearances and complex anatomical overlap, motivating anatomy-aware modeling for improved localization. However, prior anatomy-aware methods typically rely on coarse region proxies or static spatial priors, which may restrict dynamic instance discovery and limit precise localization of small abnormalities. We propose Anatomy-Structured Hierarchical Multiple Instance Learning (ASH-MIL), a framework that introduces parallel anatomy-structured observation branches (cardiac, pulmonary, and agnostic) combined with hierarchical MIL aggregation. Anatomical priors are injected as soft spatial biases into decoder cross-attention, enabling anatomically grounded evidence maps without disease bounding-box supervision. Instance localization is derived directly from MIL-weighted cross-attention maps without bounding box supervision. Experiments on CXR8 and cross-domain MIMIC-CXR held-out sets demonstrate consistent improvements over prior weakly-supervised and anatomy-aware approaches, particularly under stricter localization criteria. Our code is available at https://github.com/jn-kim/ash-mil.

</details>


### [220] [In-Token Learning for High-Fidelity Image Restoration via Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33523)
*Xingfu Yi,Xiaoxue Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 In-Token Learning，一种基于条件矫正流匹配、适配预训练扩散 Transformer 的图像修复框架，并引入 Direct Low-Quality Guidance（DLG）实现无需 ControlNet 的低质引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望利用预训练扩散 Transformer 的能力，构建一个统一的图像修复框架，避免引入可训练的 ControlNet 式分支或图像描述生成，同时保持给定分辨率下的图像 token 数量不变。

Method: 方法包括：1）条件矫正流匹配，监督从高斯噪声到修复图像的传输，并将干净目标与退化输入配对；2）将空间对齐的退化图像 token 与演化中的潜变量 token 沿通道维度融合；3）Direct Low-Quality Guidance（DLG）通过原生条件路径将冻结的退化图像嵌入与固定任务提示结合。

Result: 在 DIV2K、LSDIR、FFHQ、RealLQ250、RealPhoto60 上评估超分辨率与去噪，在 DIV2K、LSDIR 上评估自动上色。结果显示在所评估协议下具有竞争力的保真度与感知质量，但在 RealLQ250 上泛化较弱。报告了全图 QHD（2560×1440）推理以及对《清明上河图》的 12K 分块修复演示，注意力开销仍随分辨率增加。

Conclusion: In-Token Learning 提供了一个统一、无需 ControlNet 的图像修复框架，在各任务上表现具竞争力，但泛化能力与高分辨率下的注意力开销仍存在局限。本技术报告保留了 Fill2SR 背后的早期更广泛研究，后者后续发展为真实世界超分辨率方向。

Abstract: We present In-Token Learning, an image restoration framework that adapts a pretrained diffusion transformer using conditional rectified flow matching. Clean targets paired with degraded inputs supervise transport from Gaussian noise to restored images. Spatially aligned degraded-image tokens are fused with evolving latent tokens along the channel dimension, preserving the image-token count at a given resolution. Direct Low-Quality Guidance (DLG) combines frozen degraded-image embeddings with a fixed task prompt through the native conditioning pathway, without a trainable ControlNet-style branch or image captioning. We evaluate super-resolution and denoising on DIV2K, LSDIR, FFHQ, RealLQ250, and RealPhoto60, and automatic colorization on DIV2K and LSDIR. The tasks use separately trained checkpoints under the same framework. Results show competitive fidelity and perceptual quality under the evaluated protocols, with weaker generalization on RealLQ250. We report full-image QHD ($2560{\times}1440$) inference and a tiled $12$K restoration demonstration of Along the River During the Qingming Festival. Attention cost still increases with resolution. This technical report preserves the early broader study underlying Fill2SR, which subsequently developed the real-world super-resolution direction.

</details>


### [221] [PGL-3D: Towards Progressive Geometric Learning for 3D Visual Query Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33558)
*Liang Peng,Shizhuo Mu,Bohan Tan,Wenyuan Wang,Chen Zhao,Xingping Dong,Heng Fan,Libo Zhang,Bo Du*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PGL-3D框架，利用中间3D cuboid指导特征聚合与查询更新，在3DVQL基准上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DVQL基准方法在特征建模后才预测cuboid，导致中间cuboid的几何信息未能用于后续特征优化。

Method: 采用"预测-选择-精化-重预测"框架：共享头为每个proposal预测完整cuboid；QTM模块结合proposal关联、cuboid质量、帧响应和目标缺失选择参考观测；以cuboid的中心、尺寸和朝向构造软池化权重，池化后的记忆更新查询与proposal表示并重预测；训练目标ST-D9O通过边界、符号距离和软重叠项监督各阶段几何。

Result: 在3DVQL上平均stAP达0.270±0.004，远高于LaF的0.044；消融验证几何引导特征更新的收益；用ST-D9O替换PROT3D原几何目标后，GSOT3D的mAO从21.63%提升至25.78%。

Conclusion: 中间cuboid的几何信息能有效改善查询与proposal表示，PGL-3D在3DVQL及GSOT3D上均验证了其有效性，代码与模型将开源。

Abstract: 3D Visual Query Localization (3DVQL) retrieves the latest contiguous occurrence of a queried object in an RGB--point-cloud sequence and predicts a 9-DoF cuboid for every response frame. The query is captured independently of the search sequence, so its annotated pose may differ from how the object appears in the search frames. The benchmark baseline predicts cuboids after feature modeling, leaving their geometry unused for subsequent feature refinement. We investigate whether complete intermediate cuboids can improve query and proposal representations before final decoding. We introduce Progressive Geometric Learning for 3DVQL (PGL-3D), a predict--select--refine--re-predict framework that uses intermediate cuboids to guide the aggregation of search evidence and update query and proposal representations. A shared head first predicts a complete cuboid for every proposal. Query--Tube--Memory (QTM) then selects reference observations by combining proposal association, cuboid quality, frame response, and target absence, since association confidence alone establishes neither target presence nor geometric accuracy. The center, size, and orientation of each selected cuboid define soft pooling weights over query-conditioned proposal features. The pooled memory updates the query and proposal representations, and the head re-predicts from the updated features. A training-only objective, ST-D9O, supervises cuboid geometry at every stage by adding boundary, signed-distance, and soft-overlap terms to parameter regression. PGL-3D achieves a mean stAP of $0.270 \pm 0.004$ on 3DVQL, compared with $0.044$ reported for LaF. Ablations support the benefits of geometry-guided feature updates, while stage-wise analyses show improved cuboid accuracy. Replacing the geometry objective in our PROT3D reproduction with ST-D9O improves mAO on GSOT3D from $21.63\%$ to $25.78\%$. Our code and models will be released.

</details>


### [222] [ForeFly: A Dual-Horizon World Action Model for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33581)
*Kunhui Wang,Xintong Zhang,Junyu Gao,Changsheng Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ForeFly双时域潜在世界动作模型，通过近端与路线关键未来预测提升无人机视觉语言导航性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无人机视觉语言导航方法多为反应式或仅限单一时域预测，忽略了不同时间尺度上互补的未来线索，难以在复杂3D环境的长轨迹中保持可靠的指令跟随。

Method: ForeFly预测近端未来以维持局部连续性，并预测自适应的路线关键未来以提供长程引导；采用时域特定的前瞻查询，结合近期与路线关键的视觉记忆进行初始化，提供历史感知上下文；提出Foresight-Guided Action Refinement (FGAR)，非对称地利用近端前瞻增强局部动作、利用路线关键前瞻进行特征校正与路线级引导。

Result: 在TravelUAV和UAV-ON基准上，ForeFly在已见与未见设置中均持续优于强基线。

Conclusion: 双时域前瞻与FGAR学习机制有效，验证了其在该任务中的优越性；代码已开源。

Abstract: Aerial Vision-Language Navigation (AVLN) requires UAVs to maintain reliable instruction following over long trajectories in complex 3D environments. However, existing AVLN approaches are predominantly reactive or limited to single-horizon prediction, overlooking complementary future cues across different temporal horizons. To address this limitation, we propose ForeFly, a dual-horizon latent world action model that predicts both a proximal future for local continuity and an adaptive route-critical future for long-range guidance. Horizon-specific foresight queries are primed with recent and route-critical visual memories, providing history-aware context for future prediction. To exploit their distinct roles in action generation, we introduce Foresight-Guided Action Refinement (FGAR), which asymmetrically exploits proximal foresight for local action enhancement and route-critical foresight for feature-wise correction and route-level guidance. Experiments on the TravelUAV and UAV-ON benchmarks show that ForeFly consistently outperforms strong baselines across seen and unseen settings, validating the effectiveness of dual-horizon foresight and FGAR learning. The code is available at: https://github.com/kunhuiW/ForeFly

</details>


### [223] [Fill2SR: Repurposing Inpainting Diffusion Transformers for Real-World Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33582)
*Xingfu Yi,Xiaoxue Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Fill2SR，将掩码修复扩散Transformer重用于真实图像超分，无需额外空间分支。通过IIEA将低质图像写入原生掩码槽位，实现仅LoRA微调的反向退化条件校正流；RCDT离线蒸馏退化描述子。支持QHD级混合分辨率训练，单张32GB GPU可跑1536²推理，多基准上LPIPS与无参考质量表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有真实世界图像超分方法常基于T2I骨干添加ControlNet风格分支或空间条件token，导致内存与计算随分辨率增长，且训练常被限制在固定尺度，缺乏灵活性与可扩展性。

Method: 1) Fill2SR复用掩码修复扩散Transformer做SR，无需额外空间分支；2) IIEA（Inpainting-Interface Evidence Adapter）在全图掩码下将LQ观测写入原生掩码图像槽，把修复转化为反向退化条件校正流，仅用LoRA微调；3) RCDT离线流程：用冻结开源模型从无配对真实图像蒸馏退化描述子并迁移至干净目标。

Result: 支持最高QHD的混合分辨率训练，在512/1024/2048输出上性能稳定；合成基准中，带IIEA的基模型在DIV2K与LSDIR取得最佳LPIPS；加入RCDT后LPIPS略降但RealLQ250与RealPhoto60无参考质量持续更强；内存可预测，单张32GB GPU完成1536²推理，并通过分块修复扩展至多兆像素输出。

Conclusion: Fill2SR以极简接口设计规避额外空间分支，实现分辨率可扩展、内存可预测的真实图像超分，兼顾合成与真实场景质量，具备多兆像素扩展能力。

Abstract: Recent real-world image super-resolution (SR) methods often adapt text-to-image (T2I) backbones with ControlNet-style branches or spatial conditioning tokens, which increases memory and computes with resolution and often constrains training to a fixed scale. We propose Fill2SR, which repurposes a masked-inpainting Diffusion Transformer for SR without extra spatial branches. Our Inpainting-Interface Evidence Adapter (IIEA) writes the low-quality (LQ) observation into the native masked-image slot under a full-image mask, turning inpainting into a reverse-degradation conditional rectified flow trained with LoRA-only tuning. We further introduce RCDT, an offline pipeline that distills degradation descriptors from unpaired real images and transfers them onto clean targets using frozen open-source models. Fill2SR supports mixed-resolution training up to QHD and yields stable performance across $512/1024/2048$ outputs. On synthetic benchmarks, our base model with IIEA achieves the best LPIPS on DIV2K and LSDIR; adding RCDT trades a small LPIPS drop for consistently stronger no-reference quality on RealLQ250 and RealPhoto60. Fill2SR remains memory-predictable, running $1536^2$ inference on a single 32GB GPU and extending to multi-megapixel outputs via tiled restoration.

</details>


### [224] [IVT-Guard: All-in-One Reasoning Model for AI-Generated Content Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33585)
*Hongwei Niu,Yunpeng Luo,Hanjun Li,Ziyin Zhou,Jianghang Lin,Ke Yan,Shouhong Ding,Shengchuan Zhang,Liujuan Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出IVT-Set数据集（含152K图像、视频、文本样本及多粒度CoT推理轨迹）与IVT-Guard框架，实现跨图像、视频、文本模态的统一可解释AIGC检测，通过三阶段训练范式解决推理-检测优化困境，在域内、域外及跨数据集设置下均达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AIGC检测器多局限于单一模态且仅输出二分类结果而无推理过程；多模态大模型（MLLM）虽有潜力，但受限于多模态推理数据稀缺，以及"推理-检测优化困境"（显式推理监督会损害检测准确率）。

Method: 1) 构建IVT-Set数据集，含超152K图像/视频/文本样本与多粒度CoT推理轨迹；2) 提出IVT-Guard统一可解释检测框架，覆盖图像、视频、文本三模态；3) 设计三阶段训练范式：伪影感知预训练、基于伪影感知注入的伪影到证据监督微调、证据-判定一致性组相对策略优化（GRPO）。

Result: 大量实验表明，IVT-Guard在域内、域外及跨数据集设置下均取得最先进的检测性能，同时提供忠实可靠的推理过程。

Conclusion: IVT-Guard通过数据集与三阶段训练范式，成功缓解推理-检测优化困境，实现跨模态统一、可解释且高性能的AIGC检测，代码与数据将开源。

Abstract: The rapid proliferation of highly realistic AI-Generated Content (AIGC) necessitates robust and interpretable detection mechanisms. However, existing detectors are predominantly confined to single modalities and provide binary outputs without reasoning. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) present a promising solution, their development is constrained by the scarcity of multimodal reasoning data and the reasoning-detection optimization dilemma, where explicit reasoning supervision can compromise detection accuracy. To this end, we introduce IVT-Set, a comprehensive dataset comprising over 152K diverse image, video, and text samples equipped with multi-granularity Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning trajectories. Based on it, we propose IVT-Guard, a pioneering framework for unified and interpretable AIGC detection across image, video, and text modalities. Furthermore, to overcome the aforementioned optimization dilemma, we design a novel three-stage training paradigm: Artifact-Aware Pre-training, Artifact-to-Evidence Supervised Fine-Tuning via artifact-aware injection, and Evidence-Verdict Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IVT-Guard achieves state-of-the-art detection performance across in-domain, out-of-domain, and cross-dataset settings while delivering faithful reasoning. Code and data will be released.

</details>


### [225] [LoopLUT: 3D Lookup Tables with Progressive Region Refinement for Real-Time 4K Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33593)
*Yang Ye,Jiajun Ma,Chen Wu,Wei Wang,Dianjie Lu,Guijuan Zhang,Linwei Fan,Zhuoran Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LoopLUT 提出一种区域级联 3D LUT 与渐进细化机制，在 4K 实时画质增强中显著提升效果并保持效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4K 图像色彩增强需在严格算力预算下达到高质量。3D LUT 支持低分辨率决策、全分辨率逐像素查表，适合实时增强；但单一全局 LUT 具有空间不变性，无法表达空间异构需求——相同像素值的欠曝阴影与正常曝光区域会被相同校正，因此需要能表达区域差异的映射。

Method: 提出 LoopLUT：区域级联 3D LUT 与渐进细化。先由全局 LUT 做整体校正，随后进行 K-1 次循环迭代。每次迭代中，门控头在低分辨率预测仍需校正的区域，并仅基于该区域颜色统计构建残差 LUT。级联门控构成单位分解，输出为 K 个查表结果的逐像素凸组合，融合由门控自身完成，无需独立融合模块，也避免多轮插值误差累积。决策阶段固定 256x256 分辨率，与输出分辨率无关。

Result: 在四个基准上，LoopLUT 相比最强先前方法 PSNR 最高提升 2.81 dB，同时保持 4K 实时吞吐；4K 图像仅需 K 次纯查表。该方法在水下增强数据集上也表现出良好泛化性。

Conclusion: 通过区域级联与渐进细化的 3D LUT 设计，LoopLUT 在满足实时 4K 约束的同时实现了更强的空间自适应色彩增强，并具备跨数据集泛化能力。

Abstract: Color enhancement of 4K images must meet a quality target under a tight compute budget. Three-dimensional lookup tables (3D LUTs) dominate real-time enhancement because they decide at low resolution and apply a per-pixel lookup at full resolution. A single global LUT, however, is spatially invariant, so an underexposed shadow and a well-exposed region that share a pixel value receive identical corrections. Spatially heterogeneous demands cannot be expressed by such a mapping. We propose LoopLUT, a region-cascaded 3D LUT with progressive refinement. A global LUT performs the overall correction, followed by K-1 loop iterations. In each iteration a gating head predicts at low resolution the region that still needs correction, then builds a residual LUT from the color statistics of that region alone. The cascaded gates form a partition of unity, so the output is a per-pixel convex combination of the K lookup results. Fusion is therefore performed by the gates themselves, with no separate fusion module and no interpolation error accumulating across rounds. The decision stage runs at a fixed 256x256 resolution, independent of output resolution, so a 4K image costs only K pure lookups. Extensive experiments across four benchmarks show that LoopLUT improves PSNR by up to 2.81 dB over the strongest prior method, while keeping real-time throughput at 4K. The same decomposition also generalizes well to underwater enhancement datasets.

</details>


### [226] [ViCoR: Reliable Molecular Structure Extraction via Spatially Aligned Verification and Executable Revision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33603)
*Yujian Yuan,Xin Cai,Yufan Chen,Jiaxin Xu,Mengdi Liu,Zhichao Tan,Long Chen,Hanyu Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ViCoR框架，通过"先修复后拒绝"的迭代验证与修正机制，提升光学化学结构识别（OCSR）的可靠性，在两个真实基准上大幅提升准确率与接受覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠的OCSR对构建高质量化学数据至关重要，但即使微小识别错误也会传播到化学数据库和下游模型。实际中识别结构常需人工检查修正，导致大规模数据整理成本高、难以扩展。仅选择（selection-only）方法虽能通过拒绝提升可靠性，却无法在基础识别器输出之外创造更多正确结果。

Method: 提出ViCoR，一种"先修复后拒绝"的框架，用于迭代验证与修正（VerIfiCatiOn and Revision）。核心是显式建立观测-预测对应关系：坐标保持渲染在源图像与预测结构间建立空间对应；索引锚定将局部视觉差异映射为可执行的图编辑，而无需整结构重生成。共享的VLM从验证逐步训练到修正。

Result: 在两个真实OCSR基准上，ViCoR将整体准确率从73.53%提升至88.26%，从61.83%提升至84.32%；在85–89%覆盖率下实现超过97%的接受准确率。所得分子数据进一步提升反应抽取F1 15.5个点，并提升文献来源反应预测准确率7.7和5.8个点。

Conclusion: ViCoR证明了自动化可靠性控制对科学数据整理与下游化学学习的价值，兼顾高准确率与高覆盖率。

Abstract: Reliable optical chemical structure recognition (OCSR) is essential for building high-quality chemical data from scientific literature, yet even small recognition errors can propagate into chemical databases and downstream models. In practice, recognized structures often require manual inspection and correction before use, making large-scale data curation costly and difficult to scale. We therefore study Selective Structure Recognition (SSR), a post-recognition setting that automatically produces reliable structured outputs while rejecting unresolved cases. Selection-only approaches can improve reliability by rejection, but cannot create additional correct outputs beyond those produced by the base recognizer. We propose ViCoR, a repair-before-rejection framework for iterative VerIfiCatiOn and Revision. Its key idea is to make observation-prediction correspondence explicit: coordinate-preserving rendering establishes spatial correspondence between the source image and predicted structure, while index anchoring maps localized visual discrepancies to executable graph edits without full-structure regeneration. A shared VLM is progressively trained from verification to revision. On two real-world OCSR benchmarks, ViCoR improves overall accuracy from 73.53\% to 88.26\% and from 61.83\% to 84.32\%, while achieving over 97\% accepted accuracy at 85--89\% coverage. The resulting molecular data further improve reaction-extraction F1 by 15.5 points and literature-sourced reaction prediction accuracy by 7.7 and 5.8 points, demonstrating the value of automated reliability control for scientific data curation and downstream chemical learning.

</details>


### [227] [Anguinus Sculpturae: Compositional Synthesis of Peak-Enhancement Breast DCE-MRI Scans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33611)
*Benjamin Hamm,Nico Albert Disch,Maximilian Rokuss,Yannick Kirchhoff,Constantin Ulrich,Klaus Maier-Hein*

Main category: cs.CV
