In addition, variance consistency regularization, as part of dual consistency regularization, aligns the variances of weak, strong, and mixup-augmented features to improve resilience against augmentation-induced perturbations. Empirical evaluations on various benchmark datasets under SSDAR settings demonstrate that the proposed WhiteCon achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing methods, effectively addressing domain shifts in regression tasks. The code for WhiteCon is available at https://github.com/sejin-sim/WhiteCon.

</details>


### [262] [Advancing Wildlife Conservation through Multimodal Animal Re-Identification with Environmental Metadata](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34094)
*Yuzhuo Li,Di Zhao,Tingrui Qiao,Yihao Wu,Bo Pang,Yun Sing Koh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出包含环境元数据的多模态动物重识别数据集MetaWild及轻量级Meta-Feature Adapter（MFA）模块，验证了引入元数据可提升重识别性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动物重识别（Animal ReID）数据集仅依赖视觉数据，忽略了生态学家认为与动物行为和身份高度相关的环境元数据（如温度、昼夜节律），同时现有视觉语言模型（VLM）资源未能充分利用其文本处理潜力。

Method: 构建多模态Animal ReID数据集MetaWild，涵盖六个物种共20,890张图像，并配有从相机陷阱叠加层和场景上下文提取的环境元数据；提出轻量级Meta-Feature Adapter（MFA）模块，可嵌入现有基于VLM的ReID方法中，使模型同时利用环境元数据与视觉信息。

Result: 在MetaWild上的实验显示，将基线ReID模型与MFA结合以引入元数据，相比仅使用视觉信息可一致地提升性能。

Conclusion: 引入环境元数据能够有效提升动物重识别性能，验证了多模态信息在Animal ReID中的价值。

Abstract: Identifying individual animals is crucial for effective wildlife monitoring and conservation efforts. Recent advancements in computer vision have shown promise in animal re-identification (Animal ReID) by leveraging data from camera traps. However, existing Animal ReID datasets rely exclusively on visual data, overlooking environmental metadata that ecologists have identified as highly correlated with animal behavior and identity, such as temperature and circadian rhythms. Meanwhile, modern vision-language models (VLMs) offer rich multimodal reasoning capabilities, but existing resources underutilize their text-processing potential. To address these limitations, we propose MetaWild, a multimodal Animal ReID dataset comprising 20,890 images across six species, paired with environmental metadata extracted from embedded camera trap overlays and scene contexts. Additionally, to facilitate the use of metadata in existing ReID methods, we propose the Meta-Feature Adapter (MFA), a lightweight module that can be incorporated into existing VLM-based ReID methods, allowing ReID models to leverage both environmental metadata and visual information to improve ReID performance. Experiments on MetaWild show that combining baseline ReID models with MFA to incorporate metadata consistently improves performance compared to using visual information alone, validating the effectiveness of incorporating metadata in re-identification.

</details>


### [263] [The Devil is in the Spectrum Bias: Spectrum-Balanced Feature Matching for Robust Representation Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34106)
*Kuniaki Saito,Yoshitaka Ushiku*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SpecMatch，一种频谱均衡的特征匹配蒸馏目标，解决传统L2特征匹配偏向主导频谱方向的问题，在42种师生组合中40种优于传统方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉基础模型迁移能力强，但由于规模庞大部署困难。特征匹配是一种流行的知识蒸馏方法，可在无标签数据下将教师表示迁移到更小的学生模型。然而传统基于L2距离的特征匹配目标存在固有偏差：它倾向于重建教师表示的主导频谱方向，而低估了那些虽方差较低却常包含任务相关信息的低方差方向，导致蒸馏效果受限。

Method: 提出频谱均衡特征匹配（SpecMatch）：一个简洁的目标函数，自适应地强调被低估（欠优化）的频谱方向，同时保留主导方向的相对重要性。该方法实现简单，计算开销可忽略不计。

Result: 在图像识别任务上的大量实验表明，SpecMatch在图像分类、异常检测、医学图像分析和域泛化等多种下游任务中一致地提升适应性能。在42种师生模型与训练设置组合中，SpecMatch有40种优于传统特征匹配，且在所有设置中均优于原始学生模型。此外，该目标还可推广至视觉之外的领域，在六项蛋白质理解任务上提升了下游性能。

Conclusion: SpecMatch通过校正特征匹配中的频谱偏差，有效提升了知识蒸馏的下游适应能力，方法简单通用，不仅在视觉任务上表现优越，还具备跨领域（如蛋白质理解）的推广能力。

Abstract: Large visual foundation models have demonstrated remarkable transferability across a wide range of downstream tasks. To deploy such models efficiently, feature matching has become a popular knowledge distillation approach that transfers teacher representations to smaller student models without requiring labeled data. However, we show that the conventional feature matching objective with L2-distance is inherently biased toward reconstructing dominant spectral directions of the teacher representation, while under-optimizing low-variance directions that often contain task-relevant information. To address this, we propose Spectrum-Balanced Feature Matching, SpecMatch, a simple objective that adaptively emphasizes under-optimized spectral directions while preserving the relative importance of dominant directions. SpecMatch is easy to implement and introduces negligible computational overhead. Extensive experiments on image recognition demonstrate that SpecMatch consistently improves downstream adaptation across diverse tasks, including image classification, anomaly detection, medical image analysis, and domain generalization. In particular, SpecMatch outperforms conventional feature matching in 40 of 42 teacher--student and training-setting combinations, while consistently improving over the original student model in all settings. We further demonstrate that the proposed objective generalizes beyond vision, improving downstream performance across six protein understanding tasks.

</details>


### [264] [SpatialSkill: Self-Evolving Skills for Cross-View Spatial Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34124)
*Ruifan Zuo,Guocheng Hu,Wanshui Gan,Junyi Wang,Xiang Lei,Tian Gan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SpatialSkill，一种无需更新权重的框架，让冻结的视觉语言模型从离线轨迹中积累显式的自然语言推理技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨视角空间推理要求模型对齐不同视角形成一致的场景表征，但对视觉语言模型仍具挑战性。现有方法多通过更新模型权重来提升空间推理，导致所学知识隐含且与特定backbone绑定。

Method: SpatialSkill不更新权重，从离线轨迹中提取显式自然语言技能；因感知技能无法仅靠执行验证，故仅在接受视觉grounding与可执行性检查后保留候选技能，对人工演化施加约束以防有害回归，并按空间推理类别路由技能以减少负迁移；技能存于带版本管理的自然语言手册中。

Result: 在CityCube上，跨四个冻结执行器均取得一致提升；配备SpatialSkill的9B执行器超过评测中最强的闭源参考模型。

Conclusion: 该框架使推理策略显式可审计，且无需修改模型参数，为冻结视觉语言模型的空间推理提供了可复用、可迁移的技能积累方式。

Abstract: Cross-view spatial reasoning requires a model to align different viewpoints into a coherent spatial representation, yet this ability remains challenging for vision-language models despite being natural to humans. Existing methods typically improve spatial reasoning by updating model weights, which keeps the acquired knowledge implicit and tied to a specific backbone. We propose \textit{SpatialSkill}, a weight-update-free framework that enables a frozen vision-language model to accumulate explicit natural-language reasoning skills from offline trajectories. Unlike symbolic tasks, perceptual skills cannot be reliably verified simply by executing them: a plausible spatial rule may lack visual support or require transformations that the frozen model cannot perform. SpatialSkill therefore admits candidate skills only after visual-grounding and executability checks, constrains manual evolution to prevent harmful regressions, and routes skills by spatial-reasoning category to reduce negative transfer. On CityCube, across four frozen executors, SpatialSkill yields consistent gains, and a 9B executor equipped with SpatialSkill surpasses the strongest closed-source reference in our evaluation. The skills are stored in a versioned natural-language manual, making the reasoning strategies explicit and auditable without modifying model parameters. Code at https://github.com/vindahi/SpatialSkill.

</details>


### [265] [PrefLUT: Reusable and Refinable Personalized Color Editing from Pairwise Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34133)
*Chuanzhi Xu,Langyi Chen,Chengkun Yue,Xuanhua Yin,Boyu Wei,Qingwen Zeng,Zihan Deng,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PrefLUT 是一个可复用、可细化的用户偏好建模框架，将有序偏好图像对编码为轻量“可复用用户画像”，结合查询图像预测 3D LUT 与编辑强度，实现无需逐用户优化的个性化色彩编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 照片色彩编辑具有高度主观性，同一张图对不同用户可能过暖、过灰或已满意；现有 LUT 与参考图引导方法多针对某一指定外观，无法从用户反复选择中建模其持久偏好。

Method: 将有序的偏好/非偏好图像对编码为轻量的“可复用用户画像”，可跨查询复用并借助新偏好对细化，无需逐用户优化。由查询条件 LUT 预测器结合画像与图像预测 LUT 隐向量和编辑强度，再经身份残差 LUT 解码器与编辑强度控制器生成可导出的 3D LUT。另提出 PCVP 评估协议，通过控制改变用户画像、偏好顺序、配对对应关系和查询图像，验证个性化编辑是否真正依赖用户偏好与查询图像。

Result: 在三个数据集上实现了有效的个性化编辑与通用增强；量化后的用户画像仅需 260 字节，在 RTX 5090 GPU 上编辑耗时为 1.365 ms/图。

Conclusion: PrefLUT 以极小存储与极低延迟实现了可复用、可细化的个性化 3D LUT 色彩编辑，并通过 PCVP 协议验证了个性化编辑确实依赖用户偏好与查询图像。

Abstract: Photographic color editing is inherently personal: the same image can appear too warm, too muted, or already satisfactory to different users. Most lookup table (LUT) and reference-guided methods target a specified appearance rather than model persistent preferences from repeated user choices. To address this gap, we introduce PrefLUT, a reusable and refinable user-preference modeling framework for deployable 3D LUTs, encoding ordered preferred/non-preferred image pairs into a lightweight Reusable User Profile that is reused across queries and refined using additional user preference pairs, without per-user optimization. A Query-Conditioned LUT Predictor combines this profile with each image to predict a LUT latent vector and edit strength. An Identity-Residual LUT Decoder and Edit-Strength Controller then produce an exportable 3D LUT. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate effective personalized editing and general-purpose enhancement. Each quantized profile requires only 260 bytes, and editing takes 1.365 ms/image on an RTX 5090 GPU. We also introduce the Preference-Conditioning Verification Protocol (PCVP), an evaluation protocol to verify whether personalized image edits depend on user preferences and the query image through controlled changes to user profiles, preference orders, pair correspondences, and query images.

</details>


### [266] [Analytical and Convolutional Neural Network-Based Motion-Vector Propagation for Efficient Video Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34142)
*Ashiyana Abdul Majeed,Mahmoud Meribout,Neethu Joseph*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出复用编解码器运动矢量的硬件-软件协同设计方法，实现低延迟、低功耗的连续视频分析目标定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续视频分析需要嵌入式功耗预算下的低延迟精确定位，逐帧检测开销大，需利用帧间冗余降低计算与能耗。

Method: 在检测器调用之间复用编解码器运动矢量，提出两种模型：解析式运动矢量传播（Analytical-MV）和基于CNN的学习式传播（CNN-MV）；CNN-MV采用卷积操作与独立目标更新以适配边缘GPU并行执行，并支持在DLA上执行。

Result: Analytical-MV取得F1=0.909、平均端到端延迟9.03 ms、每帧能耗0.177 J，较逐帧检测降低延迟25.9%、能耗36.4%；CNN-MV最快配置将召回率由0.871提升至0.890，平均功耗由19.64 W降至17.32 W，但延迟18.42 ms、每帧能耗0.319 J；DLA执行进一步降低时均GPU利用率。

Conclusion: 联合设计时序模型及其执行流水线可显著改善延迟与能耗，两种方法提供不同权衡，可按召回率或功耗需求选择。

Abstract: Continuous video analytics requires accurate localization at low latency within embedded power budgets. This paper presents a hardware-software design methodology that reuses codec motion vectors (MVs) between detector invocations. Two alternative models support translation and scale changes: analytical motion-vector propagation (Analytical-MV) and learned propagation using a convolutional neural network (CNN) (CNN-MV). The learned model uses convolutional operations and independent object updates suited to parallel execution on an edge graphics processing unit (GPU). Analytical-MV combines a harmonic-mean precision-recall score (F1) of 0.909 with a mean end-to-end latency of 9.03 ms and an energy consumption of 0.177 J per frame, yielding the lowest latency and energy among the evaluated configurations. Relative to detection on every frame, it reduces mean latency by 25.9% and energy per frame by 36.4%. CNN-MV offers a different trade-off: its fastest configuration raises recall from 0.871 for Analytical-MV to 0.890 and lowers mean power from 19.64 to 17.32 W, while achieving a latency of 18.42 ms and an energy consumption of 0.319 J per frame. It is therefore useful when recall or operating power is more important than minimum latency and energy. Execution on a deep learning accelerator (DLA) further reduces time-averaged GPU utilization relative to GPU execution. Host-processing optimization substantially improves both latency and energy, demonstrating the value of jointly designing temporal models and their execution pipelines.

</details>


### [267] [Beyond Geometry: Benchmarking and Consistency Reasoning for 3D Logical Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34143)
*Zhiqiang Qin,He Xie,Junfei Yi,Yang Yang,Hao Wang,Yunkang Cao,Hui Zhang,Yaonan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出3D逻辑异常检测任务，构建首个面向工业点云逻辑异常的大规模基准数据集ILGAD，并提出一致性推理框架，在多个数据集上实现优越的对象级检测与点级定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D工业异常检测主要针对局部几何偏差，但许多工业异常实际上违反了对象级的设计或装配规则（即3D逻辑异常），这类异常尚未被现有方法和数据集覆盖。

Method: 构建ILGAD数据集（2,774个样本、15个类别、点级标注，涵盖存在性、规格、姿态和装配状态错误）；提出一致性推理框架，评估局部几何、结构覆盖和空间关系是否符合正常设计，从而检测几何变化、缺失的预期结构和异常局部排布。

Result: 在ILGAD、Anomaly-ShapeNet和IEC3D上的实验表明，该方法在对象级检测和点级定位方面均表现优越，并能有效检测逻辑异常同时泛化到传统几何缺陷。

Conclusion: 该工作定义了3D逻辑异常检测问题，提供了可扩展的基准数据集和有效的一致性推理框架，推动了工业点云异常检测从局部几何偏差向对象级逻辑规则的方向拓展。

Abstract: Existing 3D industrial anomaly detection mainly targets local geometric deviations. In contrast, many industrial anomalies violate object-level design or assembly rules, which we define as 3D logical anomalies. To address these challenges, we introduce the Industrial Logical Anomaly Detection Dataset (ILGAD), the first scalable benchmark dedicated to logical anomalies in industrial point clouds. ILGAD contains 2,774 samples from 15 categories with point-level annotations and covers existence, specification, pose, and assembly-state errors. To detect such 3D logical anomalies, we propose a consistency reasoning framework that assesses whether local geometry, structure coverage, and spatial relations conform to the normal design. The framework detects geometric changes, unsupported expected structures, and abnormal local arrangements. Experiments on ILGAD, Anomaly-ShapeNet, and IEC3D demonstrate superior object-level detection and point-level localization, showing that the framework effectively detects logical anomalies and generalizes to conventional geometric defects.

</details>


### [268] [CAST: Reconstruction-Coupled Acceleration of Interactive World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34144)
*Leyang Chen,Junyi Wu,Fanqing Kong,Shaoqiu Zhang,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CAST推理框架，通过交互敏感锚点选择与相位感知重建加速交互式世界模型，在保持画质的同时实现2.15x–3.48x加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式世界模型需快速响应控制并保持场景一致性，但现有加速方法在恢复被跳过特征时，会忽略异质的控制响应与空间传输，导致近似误差。

Method: 观察到交互引起的特征变化与近似误差相关、低频插值误差具相位敏感性且相位演进可预测，据此设计CAST：按交互敏感度与跨层覆盖选择锚点；用频率与置信度感知的相位感知重建（PAR）恢复被跳过的残差；并按下游重建责任协调历史KV路由。

Result: 在Matrix-Game 3.0与HY-World 1.5上分别取得2.15x和3.48x加速，视觉质量接近Native；在对比方法中取得最高VBench分数，并在WorldMark十三个维度中于非原生基线上分别领先七个和六个。

Conclusion: CAST在实时控制下实现了生成速度、视觉质量与交互响应性的平衡，代码已开源。

Abstract: Interactive world models must respond quickly to controls while preserving scene consistency. Existing acceleration methods can miss heterogeneous control responses and spatial transport when recovering skipped features. We observe that interaction-induced feature changes correlate with approximation error, while low-frequency interpolation errors are phase-sensitive and show more predictable phase progression. These findings motivate CAST, a reconstruction-coupled inference framework. CAST selects anchors by interaction sensitivity and cross-layer coverage, reconstructs skipped residuals with frequency- and confidence-aware Phase-Aware Reconstruction (PAR), and coordinates historical KV routing according to downstream reconstruction responsibility. On Matrix-Game 3.0 and HY-World 1.5, CAST achieves 2.15x and 3.48x speedups, respectively, while maintaining visual quality close to Native (Figure 1). It also attains the highest VBench scores among compared methods and leads non-native baselines on seven and six of thirteen WorldMark dimensions, demonstrating a balance of generation speed, visual quality, and interactive responsiveness under real-time control. Code is available at https://github.com/lokiniuniu/CAST.

</details>


### [269] [Geometric Encoding for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34148)
*Antonio Jun,Haoshui Yu,Zhengyi Lu,Huirong Fu,Yao Qiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Geometric Code 的感知到几何流水线，将视频显式计算出的空间结构（位置、尺寸、距离、顺序、房间几何等）以文本形式注入 VLM 提示，无需任何训练即可提升小模型的空间推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 在识别视频内容方面较可靠，但在空间与时间属性推理（如度量距离、物体尺寸、跨帧一致身份）上表现较差。作者希望用显式计算的几何信息补足这一短板。

Method: 两阶段流水线：感知层对单目 RGB 视频做分割、分类并恢复深度、相机位姿与内参；随后确定性几何引擎对输出进行反投影、融合与清理，生成空间代码（含每物体位置、尺寸、数量、物体间距离、出现顺序、房间几何），并序列化进 VLM 提示，可与视频并列或完全替代视频。全流程无任何训练或微调组件。

Result: 在 VSI-Bench 上，为 2B 与 4B 开源模型加入空间代码后，平均准确率较仅帧基线提升 +4.1 点；数值估计类任务增益最大，如绝对距离提升 +24.1 点。

Conclusion: 通过语言通道传递显式计算几何，可恢复小型 VLM 无法单靠像素获得的空间能力，说明感知与几何显式解耦、以文本注入的方式是提升 VLM 空间推理的有效途径。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are far more reliable at recognizing what appears in a video than at reasoning about its spatial and temporal properties, such as metric distances, object dimensions, and consistent object identities across frames. We present Geometric Code, a perception-to-geometry pipeline that computes explicit spatial structure from video and supplies it to VLMs as context to augment reasoning. A perception layer segments and classifies objects and recovers depth, camera pose, and intrinsics from monocular RGB video. A deterministic geometric engine then back-projects, merges, and cleans these outputs into a spatial code, including per-object positions, dimensions, counts, inter-object distances, appearance order, and room geometry. The code is serialized into VLMs' prompts, either alongside the video or replacing it entirely. Specifically, there is no component trained or fine-tuned in our approach. On VSI-Bench, augmenting 2B and 4B open models with the spatial code improves average accuracy by +4.1 points over the frames-only baseline, with the largest gains on numeric estimation tasks such as absolute distance (+24.1 points). The results suggest that explicitly computed geometry, delivered through the language channel, recovers spatial competence that small VLMs cannot extract from pixels alone.

</details>


### [270] [Functional Hand Type Prior for 3D Hand Pose Estimation and Action Recognition from Egocentric View Monocular Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34149)
*Wonseok Roh,Seung Hyun Lee,Won Jeong Ryoo,Jakyung Lee,Gyeongrok Oh,Sooyeon Hwang,Hyung-gun Chi,Sangpil Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过引入基于功能视角的手部类型分类并利用其语义先验，提升第一人称视角动作识别中动态手部运动的感知能力，在FPHA和H2O基准上超越当前最优方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有第一人称视角动作识别方法仅依赖几何或物理信息，难以感知动态手部运动，导致对真实场景的解读不够精细。作者希望通过理解功能性手部配置与物体之间的关联来改善这一问题。

Method: 提出基于功能视角的手部类型分类体系，并对现有数据集进行逐帧手部类型标注；构建新的手部动作识别框架，将手部类型的语义细节作为先验。整体流程包含三个模块：(1) 特征提取；(2) 第一人称知识模块，利用短期线索估计3D手部姿态、物体类别和手部类型；(3) 第一人称动作模块，在较长时间跨度上聚合包括手部类型文本嵌入在内的逐帧知识。

Result: 在FPHA和H2O两个大规模基准上的大量实验表明，该模型性能优于当前最先进方法。

Conclusion: 将功能性手部类型作为语义先验融入识别框架，有助于网络理解动作序列中连续的手部交互，从而显著提升第一人称视角动作识别效果。

Abstract: Current methods for egocentric view action recognition often face challenges in perceiving dynamic hand movements relying solely on geometrical or physical information. In this work, we effectively address this problem by gaining insights into the correlation between functional hand configurations and objects, which improves the detailed interpretation of real-world scenarios. To this end, we introduce a practical taxonomy of hand types based on the functioning perspective and utilize it for per-frame hand type labeling on existing datasets. We also propose a novel hand action recognition framework considering semantic details of the hand type as prior. This approach boosts the network's understanding of the continuous hand interaction throughout the action sequence. Our whole pipeline consists of three main modules: (1) Feature Extraction, (2) Egocentric Knowledge Module, which estimates 3D hand pose, object category, and hand type leveraging short-term cues, and (2) Egocentric Action Module, which aggregates per-frame knowledge, including text embeddings of hand type, over a longer time. In our extensive experiments with large-scale benchmarks, FPHA and H2O, our model outperforms current state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating its superior performance.

</details>


### [271] [Natural Image Autoencoder-Based fMRI Representations for Trait and State Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34167)
*Juhyeon Park,Yeonwoo Kim,Peter Yongho Kim,Yansen Wang,Mingqing Xiao,Dongqi Han,Dongsheng Li,Taesup Moon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出FReD，用仅在自然图像上预训练的冻结DCAE提取fMRI表征，配合任务特定读出，在特质与状态预测上媲美甚至超越fMRI基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: fMRI基础模型虽在下游任务表现优异，但预训练需耗费大量数据与算力。作者希望探究：这种性能到底需要多少fMRI专属预训练，即fMRI专属表征预训练是否真的必要。

Method: FReD从仅在自然图像上预训练的冻结DCAE中提取fMRI表征，并配任务特定读出。特质预测：对逐帧表征取时间均值与对数标准差，线性探测，并融合两种归一化方案；状态预测：将每帧表示为单一token，用浅层Transformer建模时间依赖。

Result: 在4个静息态数据集、6个特质预测目标上，冻结DCAE特征的线性探测普遍优于fMRI基础模型表征，并与全微调的fMRI基础模型相当。在3个任务fMRI状态预测任务上，DCAE特征的时序读出与最强基础模型表现相当。高斯注入分析显示，冻结DCAE特征对局部信号变化的恢复比所评估的基础模型表征更准确。

Conclusion: 当前fMRI基准上的强性能并不需要fMRI专属表征预训练，冻结自然图像特征可作为评估此类预训练附加价值的有效基线。

Abstract: Foundation models pre-trained on large-scale fMRI datasets have shown strong downstream performance, but at substantial data and computation cost. To investigate how much fMRI-specific pre-training is actually needed for such performance, we introduce FReD, which derives fMRI representations from a frozen Deep Compression AutoEncoder (DCAE) pre-trained exclusively on natural images and pairs them with a task specific readout. For trait prediction, FReD summarizes frame-wise representations by their temporal mean and log-standard deviation and applies linear probing, with late fusion across two normalization schemes. For state prediction, it represents each frame as a single token and models temporal dependencies with a shallow Transformer. Across four resting-state datasets spanning six trait-prediction targets, linear probes on frozen DCAE features generally outperform those on fMRI foundation model representations and remain competitive with fully fine-tuned fMRI foundation models. On three task-fMRI state-prediction tasks, a temporal readout on DCAE features performs comparably to the strongest foundation models evaluated. A Gaussian injection analysis further shows that localized signal changes are recovered more accurately from the frozen DCAE features than from the evaluated foundation-model representations. Together, these results show that strong performance on current fMRI benchmarks is possible without fMRI-specific representation pre-training, making frozen natural-image features as a useful baseline for assessing its added value.

</details>


### [272] [AGILE-GS: Anchor-Guided Fast Next-Best-View Selection for Active 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34176)
*Amirhossein Mollaei Khass,Nader Motee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出AGILE-GS，一种锚点引导的3DGS下一最佳视角选择方法，将"信息搜索"与"相机选择"解耦：先在SE(3)上优化虚拟锚点姿态，再据此对候选池打分并蒸馏出短名单，避免对全池候选渲染或计算Fisher信息，显著降低选择延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 辐射场重建需要大量视角，且视角的布局与数量同样重要。现有3D Gaussian Splatting的下一最佳视角（NBV）方法通常需要对候选池中每个候选打分再择优，代价高昂。作者认为"搜索信息"与"选择相机"是两个可分离的问题，从而可以避免对全部候选进行昂贵评估。

Method: 方法名为AGILE-GS。首先在SE(3)上通过黎曼梯度上升优化一个虚拟锚点姿态，以最大化期望信息增益；该锚点无需可达、也不必在候选池中，仅用于标示模型最不确定的位置。然后依据锚点的观测几何对候选进行打分，并用贪心岭杠杆（ridge-leverage）步骤将候选池蒸馏为一个小的、非冗余的短名单，且过程中不渲染任何候选。短名单有两种用法：AGILE-GS直接取短名单第一个视角作为下一视角，不计算任何候选的Fisher信息；AGILE-GS+则对短名单内视角计算Fisher信息增益并取最优，使昂贵评估只作用于少数视角而非整个池。

Result: 在标准基准测试与闭环具身采集任务中，AGILE-GS与AGILE-GS+均达到或超过现有基线，同时将选择延迟降低一到两个数量级。

Conclusion: 通过解耦信息搜索与相机选择、引入虚拟锚点与短名单机制，AGILE-GS在保持或提升NBV性能的同时大幅提升效率，为3DGS主动视角选择提供了高效方案。

Abstract: Radiance fields need hundreds of views, and their placement matters as much as their number. Next-best-view (NBV) selection for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) usually scores every candidate in the pool and keeps one. Searching for information and choosing a camera, however, are separable problems. We present AGILE-GS, an anchor-guided NBV method that separates the two. A virtual anchor pose is optimized on SE(3) by Riemannian gradient ascent on expected information gain. It need not be reachable or in the pool; it marks where the model is most uncertain. Candidates are scored against the anchor's viewing geometry, and a greedy ridge-leverage step distills the pool into a small, non-redundant shortlist without rendering any candidate. The shortlist can be used in two ways. AGILE-GS takes the first view on it as the next view, so no Fisher information is computed for any candidate. AGILE-GS+ computes the Fisher information gain of each shortlisted view and picks the best, so the expensive evaluation runs on a handful of views rather than the whole pool. On standard benchmarks and in closed-loop embodied acquisition, both match or exceed existing baselines while cutting selection latency by one to two orders of magnitude.

</details>


### [273] [Enhanced Video Text Editing with Trajectory-Aligned Glyph Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34178)
*Shulian Zhang,Xiangyu Shu,Wenbo Li,Jian Chen,Yong Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出轨迹对齐字形渲染参考与深度归一化识别器特征监督，解决视频文本编辑中复杂笔画错乱问题，并构建VTEdit基准，句级准确率达0.9408。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频文本编辑需每帧文字正确且随场景连贯运动，但现有视频扩散模型难以复现精确笔画结构，常产生乱码或错字，尤其对复杂笔画字符。

Method: 提出轨迹对齐字形渲染参考，按文本位置与透视提供逐帧显式字形引导；提出深度归一化识别器特征监督，用冻结文本识别器的多深度特征并以逐深度归一化误差监督生成文本，针对扩散损失忽略的笔画错误。

Result: 构建VTEdit基准，含288个真实场景片段、440条标注文本轨迹，覆盖文本替换与添加；实验显示在文本准确率和背景保持上优于图像文本编辑方法、视频编辑方法及商业模型，句级准确率0.9408，用户研究偏好最高。

Conclusion: 通过显式字形引导与识别器多深度特征监督可显著改善视频文本编辑的笔画准确性，VTEdit基准将公开以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Video text editing aims to replace or add text in a video while keeping the rest of the video unchanged, which requires the edited text to be correct in every frame and to move coherently with the scene. Despite the remarkable progress of video diffusion models, they struggle to reproduce exact stroke structures and often produce garbled or wrong characters, especially for characters with complex strokes. To address this, we propose a trajectory-aligned glyph rendering reference that provides explicit per-frame glyph guidance following the position and perspective of the text, and a depth-normalized recognizer feature supervision that supervises the generated text on multi-depth features of a frozen text recognizer with per-depth normalized errors, targeting stroke errors overlooked by the diffusion loss. We further build VTEdit, a benchmark of 288 real-scene clips with 440 annotated text trajectories covering text replacement and text addition, which will be publicly released to facilitate future research. Experiments on VTEdit show that our method outperforms image text editing methods, video editing methods, and commercial models in text accuracy and background preservation, achieving a sentence accuracy of 0.9408, and receives the highest preference in a user study.

</details>


### [274] [CRF Loss is How Networks Should Learn Boundaries in Weakly Supervised Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34183)
*Joshua Li,Yuri Boykov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出DS-CRF框架，将CAM软伪标签作为一元监督、SAM边界作为二元监督，通过各自独立的损失联合训练单阶段模型，在MS COCO上达到56.5% mIoU的新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有WSSS方法关注从CLIP等大模型提取更粗的CAM，但忽略了边界精度，将其交给DenseCRF等后处理。DenseCRF依赖低级颜色线索，当相邻像素颜色相近时会翻转正确标签。SAM虽被用作替代，但仅作为中间"精修"步骤输出one-hot伪标签，丢弃了CAM中的重要不确定性，把边界处的错误变成自信的错误目标。

Method: 受CRF势函数启发，作者提出一个将软伪标签解耦为"一元监督"、将二值边缘图作为"二元监督"的框架，并在单阶段模型DS-CRF中实现：CAM来自dino.txt，边界来自SAM，两者各用各自的损失进行监督，而非融合为单一硬目标。

Result: DS-CRF在MS COCO数据集上取得56.5% mIoU，刷新了该任务的state-of-the-art。

Conclusion: CAMs应与SAM边界通过各自损失共同监督训练，而非融合为单一硬目标；该解耦思路能有效保留CAM不确定性并提升边界精度，验证了DS-CRF的有效性。

Abstract: Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation (WSSS) learns pixel-level predictions from image-level tags. Recent work focuses on improving coarse CAMs extracted from large vision-language models (commonly CLIP), but does little to improve their accuracy along segment boundaries. That job is instead delegated to a post-processing method like DenseCRF. However, because DenseCRF relies on low-level colour cues, it can flip correct labels to incorrect ones when neighbouring pixels share similar colours. SAM has recently been adopted as a natural alternative, yet it simply takes on DenseCRF's role as an intermediate "refinement" step that outputs one-hot pseudo-labels in prior work. By discarding the valuable uncertainty in CAMs, these one-hot pseudo-labels turn borderline errors into confidently wrong targets. Our key insight is that CAMs should supervise training alongside SAM boundaries, each through its own loss, rather than being fused together into a single hard target. Inspired by CRF potentials, we propose a framework that disentangles soft pseudo-labels as unary supervision and binary edge maps as pairwise supervision. We realize our framework in a single-stage model, DS-CRF, using CAMs from dino.txt and boundaries from SAM. DS-CRF sets a new state-of-the-art of 56.5% mIoU on MS COCO.

</details>


### [275] [MotionSpaceFlow: Representation-Aware Flow Matching in Direct Motion Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34190)
*Qing Yu,Kent Fujiwara*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MotionSpaceFlow（MSFlow），一种表示感知的流匹配框架，直接在连续运动空间中预测干净运动，无需学习的编码器或解码器，实现文本到运动生成的SOTA性能，并支持零样本推理时对任意关节或帧的控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散与流模型虽改进了文本驱动的人体运动生成，但大多在低维、时间下采样的隐空间中进行，且该隐空间主要为正则化重建而学习，形成瓶颈，限制生成质量，且无法直接操控单帧和单关节。

Method: MSFlow在连续运动空间直接预测干净运动，避免编码器/解码器。针对直接运动表示的各向异性结构，提出表示感知的噪声缩放，并揭示初始高斯源尺度如何决定中间概率路径边缘分布的协方差。进一步提出表示感知多模态扩散Transformer（RA-MMDiT），通过联合注意力同步更新token级语言与全分辨率运动特征，并根据运动表示调整时间信息流：对帧间变化定义的增量特征使用因果注意力，对绝对关节坐标等全局特征使用双向注意力。

Result: 在不同数据集和运动表示上，MSFlow均达到文本到运动任务的SOTA性能。其全局表示变体还能通过投影采样实现零样本、推理时对任意关节或帧的控制，无需控制条件训练，在精确满足约束的同时提供领先的运动质量。

Conclusion: MSFlow通过在连续运动空间直接建模并结合表示感知的噪声缩放与注意力设计，突破了隐空间瓶颈，兼顾生成质量与可控性，为文本到运动生成提供了新的有效范式。

Abstract: Recent advances in diffusion and flow models have substantially improved text-driven human motion generation. Yet most methods generate in low-dimensional, temporally downsampled latent spaces learned primarily for reconstruction, a bottleneck that can limit generation quality and preclude direct manipulation of individual frames and joints. We introduce MotionSpaceFlow (MSFlow), a representation-aware flow-matching framework that predicts clean motion directly in continuous motion space without a learned encoder or decoder. To account for the anisotropic structure of direct motion representations, we propose representation-aware noise scaling and show how the initial Gaussian source scale governs the covariance of intermediate probability-path marginals. We further introduce a Representation-Aware Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (RA-MMDiT), which jointly updates token-level language and full-resolution motion features through joint attention while adapting temporal information flow to the motion representation: causal attention for incremental features defined by frame-to-frame changes, and bidirectional attention for global features such as absolute joint coordinates. Across different datasets and motion representations, MSFlow achieves state-of-the-art text-to-motion performance. Its global representation variant additionally enables zero-shot, inference-time control over any joint or frame through projection sampling without control-conditioned training, delivering leading motion quality with exact constraint satisfaction.

</details>


### [276] [ConvCue: Complementary Visual Inductive Biases for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34196)
*Zixuan Lan,Shichu Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CONVCUE，通过将冻结预训练CNN的深层特征经由可学习适配器和门控交叉注意力融入VLM原生视觉表示，在不替换原编码器的情况下提升多模态理解性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代视觉语言模型在需要细粒度判别和空间理解的视觉问题上仍表现不佳。作者希望探究是否可以通过补充额外的视觉表示来改进现有VLM，而非替换其原生视觉编码器；预训练卷积网络的局部连接和空间权重共享特性使其成为候选特征来源。

Method: CONVCUE用并行的冻结预训练CNN的末阶段特征增强预训练VLM的原生视觉表示。可学习适配器将卷积特征映射到原生视觉特征维度，门控交叉注意力让原始视觉token从CNN特征中检索信息。增强后的token经过原有的视觉到语言投影器，模型通过两阶段训练流程进行适配。

Result: 在Qwen3-VL-2B、Qwen3-VL-4B和LLaVA-OneVision-7B上，跨13个涵盖VQA、文档与图表理解、多模态推理的基准评测，CONVCUE在三个骨干上均优于原始模型和匹配的两阶段微调对照组。在Qwen3-VL-4B上，它在全部13个基准上均优于原始模型，并将平均分从75.00提升至78.82（相对匹配微调对照）。

Conclusion: 预训练卷积表示在通过学习的自适应与融合进行整合后，能够在不替换原始视觉编码器的情况下提升现有VLM的视觉理解能力。

Abstract: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance across a broad range of multimodal tasks, yet still struggle with visual questions that require fine-grained discrimination and spatial understanding. These limitations motivate investigating whether supplementary visual representations can improve existing VLMs without replacing their native visual encoders. Pretrained convolutional networks offer a candidate feature source, motivated by their local connectivity and spatial weight sharing. We introduce CONVCUE, which augments the native visual representations of a pretrained VLM with final-stage features from a parallel, frozen pretrained CNN. A learnable adapter maps convolutional features to the native visual feature dimension, while gated cross-attention allows the original visual tokens to retrieve information from the CNN features. The enhanced tokens are passed through the original visual-to-language projector, and the model is adapted through a two-stage training procedure. We evaluate CONVCUE on Qwen3-VL-2B, Qwen3-VL-4B, and LLaVA-OneVision-7B across 13 multimodal benchmarks covering visual question answering, document and chart understanding, and multimodal reasoning. CONVCUE improves average benchmark performance over both the original models and matched two-stage fine-tuning controls on all three backbones. On Qwen3-VL-4B, it improves over the original model on all 13 benchmarks and raises the average score from 75.00 to 78.82 relative to the matched fine-tuning control. These results show that pretrained convolutional representations, when integrated through learned adaptation and fusion, can improve the visual understanding of existing VLMs without replacing their original visual encoders.

</details>


### [277] [WorldGuide: Learning Success-Failure Boundaries in Latent World Models for Vision-Language-Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34206)
*Lin Liu,Lu Zhang,Ziying Song,Wu Yang,Yuzheng Zhuang,Yunzhi Zhuge,Shuai Tao,Wulong Liu,Huchuan Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出WorldGuide框架，在潜空间中学习成功与失败的区分并用于指导VLA策略训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜世界模型能通过捕捉动作后果改进VLA策略，但仅用专家示范训练的模型接触失败样本有限，难以区分视觉相似的成功与失败交互。

Method: 结合成功与失败轨迹的预测预训练，以及配对成功-失败样本的对比学习；学到的预测器提供可微奖励，指导策略与视觉编码器的联合优化，训练后丢弃预测器，部署无需额外世界模型推理。

Result: 大量实验表明WorldGuide显著提升VLA可靠性，在LIBERO 100和SimplerEnv上分别达到96.8%和72.0%的SOTA性能。

Conclusion: WorldGuide通过潜空间区分成功与失败交互来指导策略训练，提升VLA可靠性且不增加部署开销。

Abstract: Latent world models offer a promising way to improve Vision-Language-Action policies by capturing the consequences of actions. However, models trained primarily on expert demonstrations have limited exposure to failure outcomes and may struggle to distinguish visually similar successful and failed interactions. We propose \textbf{WorldGuide}, a framework that learns these distinctions in latent space and uses them to guide policy training. WorldGuide combines predictive pretraining on successful and failed trajectories with contrastive learning on matched success--failure pairs. The learned predictor then provides a differentiable reward to guide joint optimization of the policy and visual encoder. The predictor is discarded after training, so deployment requires no additional world-model inference. Extensive experiments show that WorldGuide substantially improves VLA reliability and achieves state of the art performance on LIBERO 100 and SimplerEnv, reaching \textbf{96.8\%} and \textbf{72.0\%}, respectively. Code will be publicly available.

</details>


### [278] [WorldWeave: Growing Persistent Geometric Worlds for Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34221)
*Yifan Huang,Lifan Jiang,Qingyue Hao,Cheng Chen,Boxi Wu,Xiaoxue Ren,Xiaofei He,Dehai Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出WorldWeave框架，将世界状态维护与视觉渲染解耦，构建可扩展的显式3D世界模型，实现无预定义边界下的持续场景扩展与跨视角一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型缺乏显式、持久的结构记忆，在持续场景扩展和跨视角重访时难以保持世界结构的一致性。

Method: 1) 地形模块：基于扩散图像外扩（outpainting），在邻域条件与边界约束下生成连续公制高程图；2) 智能体：融合用户意图、地形证据与跨区域连通性约束，通过层次化语义规划、确定性几何编译和局部修正构建场景；3) 视觉生成：规划相机轨迹通过只读接口查询世界几何，生成深度序列引导视频合成，且不将生成结果写回世界状态。

Result: 结构记忆与短窗口视频生成相互独立，支持在无预定义地图边界的条件下持续扩展，并为不同轨迹及重复访问的观测提供一致的几何基础。

Conclusion: 通过解耦世界状态维护与视觉渲染，WorldWeave实现了可增量扩展的显式结构记忆，提升了世界模型在持续扩展与跨视角重访中的结构一致性。

Abstract: Despite rapid progress, world models still lack explicit, persistent structural memory, making it difficult to preserve consistent world structure during continual scene expansion and cross-view revisits. To address this limitation, we present WorldWeave, a world generation framework that decouples world-state maintenance from visual rendering. Specifically, WorldWeave combines continual elevation-map generation with agent-guided scene organization and stitching to build an expandable explicit 3D world that incrementally extends structural memory while preserving existing structure. First, its terrain module uses diffusion-based image outpainting to generate continuous metric elevation maps under neighborhood conditioning and boundary constraints. Next, an agent integrates user intent, terrain evidence, and cross-region connectivity constraints to construct scenes through hierarchical semantic planning, deterministic geometry compilation, and local revision. Finally, during visual generation, planned camera trajectories query world geometry through a read-only interface, producing depth sequences that guide video synthesis without writing the generated results back into the world state. As a result, structural memory remains independent of short-window video generation, enabling continual expansion without predefined map boundaries and providing a consistent geometric basis for observations across trajectories and repeated visits.

</details>


### [279] [Uncovering Ordinal-Matching Bias in Audio-Visual LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34223)
*Jihoo Jung,Youngjoon Jang,Hyebin Cho,Suho Yoo,Joon Son Chung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文发现当前音视频大语言模型在多说话人场景中依赖“顺序匹配偏置”（按人脸排列顺序对应语音顺序）而非真实视听线索来关联说话人，并提出仅用400个合成视频的Ordinal-Decoupled Fine-Tuning (OD-FT)方法来缓解该问题，并提升真实场景表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多说话人场景中，音视频大语言模型（AVLLMs）经常无法正确地将语音与对应的可见说话人关联。作者希望揭示这种失败的规律，并寻找有效的改进方法。

Method: 1) 构建一个合成诊断数据集：多个可见说话人各说一个单词，用于分析模型行为。2) 在三个最新开源AVLLM上分析错误模式，发现“ordinal-matching bias”：模型仅按语音顺序匹配从左到右、从上到下的人脸排列，而非依赖唇同步等视听线索。3) 提出OD-FT：在说话人空间位置与说话顺序被独立随机化的合成视频上对模型进行微调。

Result: 分析发现三个开源AVLLM存在一致的ordinal-matching bias。使用仅400个合成训练视频的OD-FT不仅抑制了该偏置，还改善了真实视频上的音视频理解能力：在三个音视频基准上，Qwen2.5-Omni平均提升8.27%，video-SALMONN2+平均提升2.57%。

Conclusion: AVLLM在多说话人说话人关联任务上存在系统性顺序匹配偏置，而通过简单的顺序解耦微调（OD-FT）即可有效缓解，并泛化提升真实世界音视频理解性能，说明诊断性合成数据可用于纠正模型的捷径学习。

Abstract: This work aims to improve how audio-visual large language models (AVLLMs) associate speech with the correct visible speaker in multi-speaker scenes. We find that current AVLLMs frequently fail at this task, and analyze the nature of these failures. To this end, we construct a synthetic diagnostic dataset in which multiple visible speakers each utter a single word. Analysis on this corpus reveals a consistent error pattern across three recent open-source AVLLMs: models attribute utterances by simply matching the order of spoken sentences with the left-to-right, top-to-bottom arrangement of visible faces, rather than relying on audio-visual cues such as lip synchronization. We term this behavior \emph{ordinal-matching bias}. We further show that this bias can be substantially mitigated through a simple remedy, Ordinal-Decoupled Fine-Tuning (OD-FT), in which models are fine-tuned on synthetic videos where spatial positions of speakers and speaking order are independently randomized. Despite using only 400 synthetic training videos, OD-FT not only suppresses ordinal-matching bias but also improves audio-visual understanding on real-world videos, yielding average gains of 8.27\% for Qwen2.5-Omni and 2.57\% for video-SALMONN2+ across three audio-visual benchmarks.

</details>


### [280] [ReGDiff: Guided Diffusion in Regulated Latent Space for Exploring Metamaterial Voxel Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34231)
*Wangzhi Zhan,Jianpeng Chen,Dongqi Fu,Dawei Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出REGDIFF，一个将体素表示与潜空间正则化及引导扩散相结合的生成框架，用于超材料几何生成，缓解合理性—新颖性权衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超材料性能由几何而非成分决定，体素表示可统一表达桁架、壳体和多孔等多种结构。然而体素生成面临合理性—新颖性权衡：靠近已知几何可保持规律性，但偏离则可能产生退化几何，因此需要一种兼顾两者的生成方法。

Method: 提出REGDIFF框架，将体素表示与潜空间调节和引导扩散耦合。引入repel-and-sink（RAS）机制平滑合理几何的潜分布，并采用short-range repulsion（SRR）引导抑制生成与已知样本过近的结果，同时保持几何合理性。此外构建了覆盖桁架和壳体型超材料几何的体素基准及评估模块，用于衡量几何合理性、新颖性和多样性。

Result: 实验表明REGDIFF优于基于体素的生成基线，在两个数据集上平均实现几何合理性+8.9%、新颖性+46.4%、多样性+128.6%。

Conclusion: REGDIFF可作为下游评估的强几何候选生成器，代码已开源。

Abstract: Metamaterials are artificially engineered structures whose mechanical and physical behaviors are strongly shaped by geometry rather than composition. Voxel representation provides a unified format for metamaterial geometry generation, as it can express diverse classes such as truss, shell, and porous structures within a single cubic discretization. However, voxel-based generation faces a plausibility-novelty trade-off: staying close to known geometries helps preserve geometric regularities, while moving away from them is necessary for novelty but may produce degenerate geometries. To address this challenge, we propose REGDIFF, a generative framework that couples voxel representation with latent space regulation and guided diffusion. REGDIFF introduces a repel-and-sink (RAS) mechanism to smooth the latent distribution of plausible geometries, and short-range repulsion (SRR) guidance to discourage generation overly close to known samples while maintaining geometric plausibility. We further contribute a voxel-based benchmark covering truss- and shell-type metamaterial geometries, together with an evaluation module for geometric plausibility, novelty, and diversity. Experiments show that REGDIFF outperforms voxel-based generative baselines, achieving +8.9% in geometric plausibility, +46.4% in novelty, and +128.6% in diversity on average across two datasets. These results suggest that REGDIFF is a strong geometry candidate generator for downstream evaluation. Our code is provided at https://github.com/wzhan24/ReGDiff.

</details>


### [281] [Trustworthy synthetic visual media: Evidence across the media lifecycle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34232)
*Zexi Jia,Zhiqiang Yuan,Jie Zhou,Jinchao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文综述了生成式系统对媒体可信性的冲击，主张可信媒体不依赖单一真实性标记，而需结合可从媒体中恢复的证据与生产时记录并随传播保存的证据，并考察这些证据在常规处理或蓄意篡改后是否仍有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像和视频曾帮助人们理解事件经过与作品产生过程，但生成系统使逼真媒体可在不留稳定历史的情况下被生产和修改，外观不再能揭示内容是被拍摄、合成还是被改动，因此信任必须转向解释资产路径与使用情境的证据。

Method: 这是一篇综述，将两类方法整合：一类是从媒体本身恢复证据，另一类是在生产过程中记录并随资产流通而保存的证据；并进一步追问这些主张在常规处理或蓄意操纵之后是否仍然有意义。

Result: 论文论证可信媒体并不取决于某一种通用的真实性标记，证据必须与所面对的问题相匹配、能够到达作出判断的人，并在出现更好信息时保持可修正性。目标是让媒体的历史在媒体本身持续变化时仍保持可理解。

Conclusion: 该综述提出以情境化、可传递且可纠正的证据体系来维护媒体历史，而非依赖单一真实性标识，从而在生成式媒体不断演变的环境下维持可信性。

Abstract: Images and videos have long helped people understand what happened and how a work came into being. Generative systems complicate that role. Realistic media can now be produced and revised without leaving a stable history, so appearance no longer reveals whether a scene was captured, synthesized, or altered along the way. Trust must instead come from evidence that explains the path an asset has taken and the circumstances in which it was used. Some of this evidence can be recovered from the media, while some must be recorded during production and preserved as the asset circulates. This review brings those approaches together and asks when their claims remain meaningful after ordinary processing or deliberate manipulation. We argue that trustworthy media do not depend on one universal marker of authenticity. The evidence must suit the question at hand, reach the person making the judgment, and remain open to correction when better information emerges. The larger goal is to keep the history of media intelligible even as the media itself continues to change.

</details>


### [282] [SegBanana: Steering Unified Multimodal Models into Medical Segmenters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34235)
*Xiaoye Liang,Ye Yan,Mingze Yin,Shikun Feng,Mai Xu,Haiguang Liu,Lai Jiang,Yiheng Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出SegBanana，首个面向免训练医学图像分割的智能体式视觉生成框架，基于冻结的统一多模态模型，通过解剖知识检索、比较式质量批判与状态感知控制器迭代优化分割结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像分割在实际部署中面临两大挑战：模型难以泛化到训练数据分布之外，且适配时通常缺乏高质量像素级标注。受大语言模型跨任务迁移能力启发，作者希望探究统一多模态模型能否在无需任务特定后训练的情况下，将其预训练的视觉理解、推理与生成能力迁移到医学图像分割中。

Method: 将分割重构为结构化视觉生成任务，先验证前沿统一多模态模型（如Nano Banana）已具备基础分割能力但难以应对需要专业解剖或领域知识的困难任务。据此提出SegBanana框架：以冻结的统一多模态模型为核心生成模型，引入解剖感知知识检索（Anatomy-Aware Knowledge Retrieval）与比较式质量批判（Comparative Quality Critique）两项工具，并由状态感知多模态控制器（State-Aware Multimodal Controller）维护结构化状态、迭代编排工具调用，反复精炼中间预测以获得更高质量掩码。缓解手段包括利用上下文示例中的视觉解剖知识、重复采样扩展候选解、以及针对性编辑优化次优预测。

Result: 在八个医学分割数据集上，SegBanana 平均 mDice 达到 77.45%，比代表性通用基线（SAM3、SegGPT）和医学专用基线（BiomedParse、MedSAM3）至少高出 14.93 个点，同时对域外视觉支持保持稳健。

Conclusion: 统一多模态模型经合适工具增强与智能体式编排后，可在完全免训练条件下实现强医学图像分割性能，验证了跨任务能力迁移在医学视觉分割中的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Medical image segmentation remains challenging in practical deployment, as models often struggle to generalize beyond the distributions covered by their training data and high-quality pixel-level annotations are typically unavailable for adaptation. Inspired by the cross-task transferability of large language models, we investigate whether unified multimodal models (UMMs) can transfer their pretrained visual understanding, reasoning, and generation capabilities to medical image segmentation without task-specific post-training. By recasting segmentation as structured visual generation, we find that frontier UMMs (e.g., Nano Banana) already exhibit basic segmentation capabilities across diverse clinical scenarios, but still struggle with challenging tasks requiring specialized anatomical or domain-specific knowledge. We further show that these limitations can be effectively mitigated by incorporating visual anatomical knowledge from in-context exemplars, expanding candidate solutions through repeated sampling, and refining suboptimal predictions via targeted editing.Motivated by these observations, we propose SegBanana, to our knowledge, the first agentic visual generation framework for training-free medical image segmentation. SegBanana builds on a frozen UMM as the core generative model, augmented with Anatomy-Aware Knowledge Retrieval and Comparative Quality Critique to unlock its potential segmentation capability. A State-Aware Multimodal Controller maintains structured state and iteratively orchestrates these tools, repeatedly refining intermediate predictions toward higher-quality masks. Across eight medical segmentation datasets, SegBanana achieves an average mDice of 77.45%, outperforming representative generalist (SAM3 and SegGPT) and medical-specific (BiomedParse and MedSAM3) baselines by at least 14.93 points, while remaining robust to out-of-domain visual supports.

</details>


### [283] [DecFlowEdit: Self-Localized Flow-based Image Editing via Guidance Decoupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34237)
*Zheyuan Zhan,Can Wang,Jiawei Chen,Chun Chen,Siwei Lyu,Zeyu Zheng,Defang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DecFlowEdit 解耦了流模型图像编辑中定位与编辑所需的最优引导尺度，在无需训练与反演的情况下显著改善背景保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FlowEdit 采用非对称源/目标尺度的默认 CFG 配置，导致严重的背景泄漏；而将引导尺度匹配（如去除 CFG）虽能改善编辑相关定位，却严重损害可编辑性。作者希望同时兼顾定位与编辑效果。

Method: 提出 DecFlowEdit：首先在无 CFG 条件下评估速度差并进行时间聚合，提取编辑相关先验；随后用该先验对默认 CFG 下的原始更新重新加权。方法保持免训练、免反演，无需外部空间掩码或注意力操作。

Result: 在 PIE-Bench 上基于 FLUX、SD3 和 SD3.5 的实验显示，在编辑保真度相当的情况下，相比 FlowEdit，结构距离降低约 61%~73%，背景 LPIPS 降低 68%~80%。

Conclusion: DecFlowEdit 通过解耦引导尺度有效缓解背景泄漏，在保持编辑能力的同时大幅提升背景保持，且无需训练、反演或额外掩码/注意力干预。

Abstract: Flow-based image editing (FlowEdit) enables inversion-free semantic changes through the difference between source and target velocities. In this paper, we observe that FlowEdit's default classifier-free guidance (CFG) configuration, with asymmetric source and target scales, causes substantial background leakage. Matching these guidance scales, for example by removing CFG, improves edit-relevant localization but severely degrades editability. To get the best of both worlds, we propose DecFlowEdit, which decouples the optimal guidance scales for localization and for editing in flow-based generative models. In particular, DecFlowEdit first extracts an edit-relevant prior by temporally aggregating velocity differences evaluated without CFG, and then uses this prior to reweight the original updates under default CFG. Our method remains training-free and inversion-free, requiring neither external spatial masks nor attention manipulation. Experiments on PIE-Bench across FLUX, SD3, and SD3.5 show that DecFlowEdit improves background preservation, reducing structure distance by approximately 61 to 73 percent and background LPIPS by 68 to 80 percent relative to FlowEdit at comparable editing fidelity.

</details>


### [284] [Scaling Versatile 3D Assets Editing with a Million-Scale Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34271)
*Badi Li,Tianxin Huang,Yu Zhou,Wei-Shi Zheng,Yi Ma,Shenghua Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Alchemy3D，一个涵盖数据构建、模型架构与基准评测的统一框架，用于可控3D资产编辑，并构建了大规模数据集与开放式基准，在多个指标上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D生成模型虽能产出日益逼真的资产，但可控的3D资产编辑仍面临挑战，主要受限于训练数据稀缺、源感知建模不足以及缺乏实用的评测协议。

Method: 1) 构建大规模3D编辑数据集 Alchemy3D-1M，包含125万资产与138万编辑对，覆盖七种编辑类型；2) 在该数据上训练一族生成流模型，支持图像与文本条件编辑、少步推理，并可迁移至多视角3D部件分割；3) 提出开放式大规模基准 GEdit3D-Bench 及多维度评测协议。

Result: 在现有及新引入的基准上，该方法在编辑保真度、源保持和视觉质量的大多数指标上均优于先前方法。

Conclusion: Alchemy3D 通过数据、模型与评测三位一体的统一框架，有效推动了通用可控3D资产编辑的发展。

Abstract: Although recent 3D generative models produce increasingly realistic assets, controllable 3D asset editing remains challenging. Existing methods are limited by scarce training data, insufficient source-aware modeling, and a lack of practical evaluation protocols. To address these limitations, we present Alchemy3D, a unified framework for training and evaluating versatile 3D asset editors that covers data construction, model architecture, and benchmark evaluation. Specifically, we curate Alchemy3D-1M, a large-scale 3D editing dataset containing 1.25M assets and 1.38M editing pairs across seven editing types. On this data, we train a family of generative flow models for general-purpose 3D asset editing. The model family supports image- and text-conditioned editing, few-step inference, and transfer to multi-view 3D part segmentation. We further introduce GEdit3D-Bench, a large-scale, open-world benchmark with a multi-dimensional evaluation protocol. Across existing and newly introduced benchmarks, our method outperforms prior methods on most metrics of editing fidelity, source preservation, and visual quality.

</details>


### [285] [See, Measure, and Reason: Learning Visually Grounded Reasoning in Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34277)
*Chengyang Zhang,Wenchuan Zhang,Bo Li,Mengran Li,Xinyu Liu,Jiaming Yang,Jie Chen,Zhang Zhang,Yuhao Yi,Hong Bu,Jiancheng Lv*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ASPECT，通过显式监督细胞外观与数量来提升病理视觉语言模型的细粒度视觉推理能力，并构建 PathoVernier 基准以同时评估最终答案与中间测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理评估依赖对组织学图像细粒度视觉细节的识别，而现有视觉语言模型对这类细节的感知不足，导致即便最终答案正确，其细胞层面的观察仍可能不准确。

Method: ASPECT 通过病理特征重建、细胞特征对齐和计数监督训练中间视觉 token；采用三阶段监督微调使模型学会感知、生成视觉 token 和推理，随后用强化学习奖励答案正确性与所报告测量的一致性。

Result: 在 PathoVernier（759 道专家审核问题、来自五个数据集、覆盖四类细胞组成任务）上，ASPECT 相对最强基线 Gemini-3.1-Pro 取得约 19.2% 的相对准确率提升，相对 Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干提升 99.3%；RAWR（衡量正确回答中的计数错误）分别降低 28.1% 和 42.7%。在三个外部病理基准的分类与问答任务上亦优于骨干模型。

Conclusion: 显式监督细胞外观与数量可有效改善病理视觉语言模型的视觉 grounding 推理，同时揭示被答案准确率掩盖的中间测量错误，并具备跨任务泛化能力。

Abstract: Pathological assessment relies on recognizing fine-grained visual details in histological images. Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly support pathology interpretation, yet their ability to perceive these details remains inadequate. This weakness leads to inaccurate cellular observations that can persist even when final answers are correct. In this paper, we propose ASPECT to improve visually grounded reasoning through explicit supervision of cellular appearance and abundance. ASPECT trains intermediate visual tokens through pathology feature reconstruction, cell feature alignment, and count supervision. Three-stage supervised fine-tuning teaches the model to perceive, generate visual tokens, and reason, followed by reinforcement learning that rewards answer correctness and consistency with reported measurements. We also introduce PathoVernier, a benchmark of 759 expert-reviewed questions from five pathology datasets covering four cellular composition tasks. It evaluates both final answers and intermediate measurements to expose errors hidden by answer accuracy. On PathoVernier, ASPECT achieves relative accuracy gains of approximately 19.2% over the strongest baseline, Gemini-3.1-Pro, and 99.3% over its Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, while reducing RAWR, which measures counting errors within correct responses, by 28.1% and 42.7%, respectively. ASPECT also improves over its backbone on three external pathology benchmarks covering classification and question answering beyond cellular composition tasks.

</details>


### [286] [Dexterous Tactile World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34286)
*Ziyao Zeng,Xiatao Sun,Hao Wang,Yueyang Pan,Zhengxiang Yu,Fengyu Yang,Tianyu Liu,Zhiwen Fan,Daniel Rakita*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DTWM是一个结合触觉信号的手部操作视频世界模型，通过在视频扩散transformer上以零初始化残差注入触觉信息，显著提升了未来帧预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 操作世界模型通常仅从视频训练，但决定操作走向的关键事件（如接触与脱离）难以从视觉中观测，更适合通过触觉感知。

Method: DTWM基于预训练视频扩散transformer，在视频token对应手部位置通过零初始化残差注入每只手的触觉信号，并使用因果掩码防止预测帧访问未来信息。

Result: 相比架构、参数和训练均匹配的纯视觉模型，DTWM将手部运动低估从23%降至9%，手部区域感知误差降低7.4%（三次训练平均）。预测时域越长收益越大，后期预测块的改进约为首块的4.1倍；在同设置下优于其他视觉-触觉世界模型；推理时无触觉输入时训练仍带来提升。

Conclusion: 模型同时受益于力的大小和空间位置，用二值接触状态替代触觉信号会增加预测误差；力的变化过程可指示交互将持续还是改变。

Abstract: World models for manipulation are typically trained from video, yet the events that determine how manipulation unfolds, such as making and releasing contact, are difficult to observe visually and are often easier to sense through touch. We present the Dexterous Tactile World Model (DTWM), a video world model for future-frame prediction of egocentric manipulation from both observed video and tactile signals from a glove worn on each hand. We condition a pretrained video diffusion transformer on each hand's tactile signal through a zero-initialized residual at the corresponding hand location in the video tokens, while a causal mask prevents predicted frames from accessing future information. Compared with a vision-only model matched in architecture, parameters, and training, DTWM reduces the underestimation of hand motion from 23% to 9%, while reducing the perceptual error in the hand region by 7.4% across three training runs per model. The benefit also increases over the prediction horizon, with the improvement in the later predicted chunks being about 4.1x larger than in the first. DTWM also outperforms other visual-tactile world models under the same setting, and training with touch improves future-frame prediction even when no touch is available at inference. Ablations show that the model benefits from both the magnitude and spatial location of force: replacing the tactile signal with binary contact states, either per hand or per location, increases prediction error. The observed course of the force indicates whether the interaction will persist or change.

</details>


### [287] [Semantic Modality Compensation for Unsupervised Visible-Infrared Person Re-identification under Unpaired Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34294)
*Duanning Chen,Ke He,Bin Yang,Yongxiang Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出语义模态补偿（SMC）框架，通过提示组合在共享视觉语义空间中解耦身份语义与模态风格，为缺失跨模态对应的身份合成语义对应物，提升无监督可见光-红外行人重识别性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在无配对的无监督可见光-红外行人重识别（USL-VI-ReID）中，跨模态身份对应常不完整，许多身份在另一模态缺少观测对应。现有方法依赖视觉特征统计进行特征生成或映射，未显式分离身份判别性内容与模态特有风格，导致生成特征扭曲身份线索或继承源模态偏差，削弱跨模态监督的可靠性。

Method: 将无配对跨模态学习建模为语义补偿问题，提出基于提示组合的SMC框架。首先通过增强双对比学习构建判别性ReID空间，得到各模态的伪标签、聚类原型与记忆库；然后在CLIP语义空间中学习可见光与红外模态提示，并将伪标签聚类映射为身份语义令牌；对缺少可靠跨模态匹配的聚类，将其身份令牌与目标模态提示组合，合成缺失模态的语义对应物；最后将其投影回ReID空间，并通过置信度门控注入补偿记忆库。

Result: 在配对与无配对两种设置下的大量实验表明，SMC持续优于现有最先进方法，尤其在身份不匹配严重时提升幅度更大。

Conclusion: 通过将身份语义与模态风格解耦并合成缺失模态的语义对应物，SMC有效缓解了无配对跨模态监督中的身份缺失与偏差问题，是一种通用且有效的无监督可见光-红外重识别方案。

Abstract: Unsupervised visible-infrared person re-identification (USL-VI-ReID) learns person representations that can be compared across modalities without identity annotations. In the unpaired setting, however, identity correspondences between modalities are often incomplete, leaving many identities without an observed counterpart in the other modality. Existing unpaired methods bridge this gap by generating or mapping features for the other modality, mainly by exploiting the statistics of visual features without explicitly separating content that is discriminative for identity from style that is specific to modality. Consequently, the generated features may distort identity cues or inherit bias from the source modality, undermining the reliability of supervision across modalities. We formulate unpaired learning across modalities as a semantic compensation problem and propose Semantic Modality Compensation (SMC), a framework based on prompt composition that decouples identity semantics from modality style within a shared visual semantic space. SMC first constructs a discriminative ReID space through augmented dual contrastive learning, yielding pseudo labels, cluster prototypes, and memory banks for each modality. It then learns visible and infrared modality prompts in the CLIP semantic space and maps clusters obtained from pseudo labels to identity semantic tokens. For each cluster lacking a reliable match in the other modality, SMC combines its identity token with the prompt for the target modality to synthesize a semantic counterpart in the missing modality. The synthesized counterpart is then projected back into the ReID space and injected into a compensation memory through confidence gating. Extensive experiments under both paired and unpaired settings demonstrate that SMC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with particularly large gains when identity mismatch is severe.

</details>


### [288] [PSM: Dataset Distillation Based on Precise Statistical Matching by Difficulty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34299)
*Hongxu Ma,Guang Li,Shijie Wang,Dongzhan Zhou,Suorong Yang,Baoli Sun,Takahiro Ogawa,Miki Haseyama,Zhihui Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出精确统计匹配（PSM）方法，按难度对数据集蒸馏中的统计匹配进行精细化监督，通过难度分组、统计再更新和初始样本筛选，扩展蒸馏样本的难度范围并提升下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有解耦统计匹配方法虽大幅降低蒸馏时间和内存开销，但通常用整个原始数据集估计的运行统计来监督所有蒸馏样本。这些统计主要反映平均特征分布，忽略样本难度差异，难以刻画原始数据的难度结构。

Method: PSM核心包含三部分：1）预训练后用全局精度分数（GPS）估计图像难度，在每类内排序并按IPC划分为若干难度组；2）统计再更新（SUA）通过在各难度组原始样本上前向传播，更新教师BN运行统计，为对应蒸馏批次提供难度特定监督；3）初始样本筛选（ISS）用对应难度组的原始图像初始化蒸馏样本。

Result: 在多个数据集和模型架构上的实验表明，PSM拓宽了蒸馏样本的难度范围，并在大多数评估设置中提升了下游性能。

Conclusion: PSM通过引入难度感知的统计匹配，弥补了传统统计匹配忽视样本难度结构的不足，是一种有效且高效的数据集蒸馏改进方案，代码将公开。

Abstract: Dataset distillation (DD) condenses a large original dataset into a small distilled dataset with high training utility. Decoupled statistical matching methods substantially reduce distillation time and memory overhead while achieving strong performance. However, they typically supervise all distilled samples using running statistics estimated from the entire original dataset. These statistics mainly capture the average feature distribution while overlooking differences in sample difficulty, limiting their ability to characterize the difficulty structure of the original data. To address this issue, we propose Precise Statistical Matching (PSM) by difficulty. After pretraining, PSM uses the Global Precision Score (GPS) to estimate image difficulty, ranks the samples within each class, and partitions each class into IPC (images per class) difficulty groups. During distillation, Statistics Updated Again (SUA) updates the teacher's batch normalization (BN) running statistics through forward passes on original samples from each group, providing difficulty-specific supervision for the corresponding distilled batch. Meanwhile, Initial Sample Screening (ISS) initializes distilled samples using original images from the corresponding difficulty group, providing an effective starting point for precise matching. Experiments across multiple datasets and model architectures demonstrate that PSM broadens the difficulty range of distilled samples and improves downstream performance in most evaluated settings. Code will be released.

</details>


### [289] [CAT-Free: Multi-View Pedestrian Localization without Calibration, Annotations, or Target-Scene Training via Adaptive Geometric Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34302)
*Taigo Sakai,Hiroki Kouno,Naoki Kato,Kazuhiro Hotta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CAT-Free 提出一种免标定、免位置标注、免目标场景训练的多相机行人定位方法，仅依赖同步 RGB 视频，在 WildTrack、MultiviewX、GMVD 上分别达到 82.5、84.5、65.7 MODA，并可无需重调迁移到额外序列与未见过的 8 相机安装场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多相机行人定位适用于公共与商业空间的广域监控，但现有系统在新环境中部署时通常需要大量设置，例如相机标定、位置标注或目标场景训练，导致部署成本高、泛化性差。因此作者希望去除这三项依赖，实现仅凭视频即可部署的定位方法。

Method: CAT-Free 仅使用同步 RGB 视频作为场景特定输入，直接从视频中估计相机配置；随后融合多相机观测来估计行人位置。针对自动相机估计可能不准确、进而产生不可靠位置的问题，引入两个自适应几何滤波器，用于剔除不可靠的位置估计，其阈值由每个输入序列自动估计。整个流程不使用提供的标定、位置标注或目标场景训练。

Result: 在 WildTrack、MultiviewX、GMVD 上分别取得 82.5、84.5、65.7 MODA，且不使用任何场景特定信息。相比之下，使用此类信息的已发表方法在其各自协议下报告 WildTrack 88.2--95.0 MODA、MultiviewX 83.9--96.5。CAT-Free 还能无需重调迁移，在四个额外序列上达到 74.9 MODA，在未见过的 8 相机安装上达到 78.6。此外，定位不确定性可预测 MODA，相关系数 r=-0.98，提供了无需标签的定位可靠性估计。

Conclusion: CAT-Free 证明了在无需相机标定、位置标注和目标场景训练的条件下，多相机行人定位仍可达到具有竞争力的性能，并具备良好的跨场景迁移能力。其不确定性指标还能在无标签情况下估计定位可靠性，为低成本、易部署的广域行人监控提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Multi-camera pedestrian localization is useful for wide-area monitoring in public and commercial spaces. However, deploying these systems often requires considerable setup for each new environment. Existing methods typically require camera calibration, position annotations, or target-scene training. CAT-Free removes all three requirements. It uses synchronized RGB video as its only scene-specific input. Camera configuration is estimated directly from the video. Pedestrian locations are then estimated by combining observations from multiple cameras. Automatic camera estimation is not always accurate. This can produce unreliable pedestrian locations. CAT-Free therefore introduces two adaptive geometric filters. They remove unreliable position estimates. Their thresholds are estimated from each input sequence. CAT-Free achieves 82.5, 84.5, and 65.7 MODA on WildTrack, MultiviewX, and GMVD. It uses no supplied calibration, position annotations, or target-scene training. Published methods using such scene-specific information report 88.2--95.0 MODA on WildTrack and 83.9--96.5 on MultiviewX under their respective protocols. CAT-Free also transfers without retuning. It reaches 74.9 MODA on four additional sequences and 78.6 on an unseen 8-camera installation. Finally, localization uncertainty predicts MODA with $r=-0.98$. This provides a label-free estimate of localization reliability.

</details>


### [290] [MaLiang-Harness: A Programmable Path to Image and Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34309)
*Haoyu Zhao,Zihao Zhang,Xudong Wang,Jiaxi Gu,Zuxuan Wu,Yu-Gang Jiang,Shuicheng Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文定义"程序到视觉（P2V）差距"，即程序可正确执行却违背所需构图、外观或动作要求的问题，并提出了MaLiang-Harness统一框架，将MLLM驱动的视觉生成组织为持续的构建、检查与修订过程，通过PEG状态、TGP追踪与REV验证机制协调规划、执行与视觉反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可执行程序能显式控制图像和视频的构建方式，但生成可运行代码只是视觉创作的起点；程序执行正确却可能违背所要求的构图、外观或动作。作者将这一差异定义为程序到视觉（P2V）差距，并希望以此为基础系统研究MLLM如何将可执行代码转化为视觉结果。

Method: 提出MaLiang-Harness统一框架，核心设计是让不断演化的视觉程序、其构建历史与验证共享同一修订参考。具体包括三项机制：持久化可执行生成（PEG）状态保存程序与任务上下文；可追踪生成过程（TGP）将编辑与渲染证据关联；修订感知的编辑与验证（REV）支持恢复并在完成前检查当前修订。这些机制跨渲染后端协调规划、执行与视觉反馈。作者构建MaLiang-IBench与MaLiang-VBench基准，评测11个强大闭源MLLM（图像）与4个（视频），衡量生成成功率、视觉质量与计算成本。

Result: GPT-6-Astra在两个基准上均达到100%生成成功率，其中96.0%的图像任务和76.9%的视频任务满足全部质量阈值。对比还揭示通用能力得分与视觉生成表现之间存在错配：得分相近的模型在满足视觉要求的能力上差异显著。

Conclusion: MaLiang-Harness为研究MLLM如何将可执行代码转化为视觉结果提供了系统性基础，既展现了可编程生成的潜力，也暴露了通用基准作为该能力预测指标的局限。

Abstract: Executable programs offer explicit control over how images and videos are constructed, but generating runnable code is only the beginning of visual creation. A program can execute correctly while violating the requested composition, appearance, or motion. We define this discrepancy as the Program-to-Visual (P2V) gap and introduce MaLiang-Harness, a unified framework for organizing MLLM-driven visual generation into a persistent process of construction, inspection, and revision. Its central design is to make the evolving visual program, its construction history, and its verification share a common revision reference. We define the Persistent Executable Generation (PEG) state as preserving programs and task context. Traceable Generation Process (TGP) connects edits to rendered evidence, and Revision-aware Editing and Verification (REV) supports restoration and checks the current revision before completion. Together, these mechanisms coordinate planning, execution, and visual feedback across rendering backends. We evaluate 11 powerful closed-source MLLMs on MaLiang-IBench and four on MaLiang-VBench, measuring generation success, visual quality, and computational cost. GPT-6-Astra achieves 100% generation success on both benchmarks, with 96.0% of image tasks and 76.9% of video tasks meeting all quality thresholds. The comparison also reveals a mismatch between general capability scores and visual generation performance, with similarly scored models differing substantially in their ability to satisfy visual requirements. MaLiang-Harness provides a systematic basis for studying how MLLMs translate executable code into visual outcomes, exposing both the potential of programmable generation and the limitations of general benchmarks as predictors of this ability. The project is available at https://github.com/gulucaptain/MaLiang-Harness.

</details>


### [291] [PlaylistEval: Can Video-Language Judges Be Trusted at Day Scale and Beyond?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34314)
*Shayekh Bin Islam,Hwanjun Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PlaylistEval，一个无需人工标注的智能体框架，用于构建面向超长（100 小时级）视频播放列表的视频-语言评判基准，并揭示当前前沿模型在长视频证据检索与判断上的明显不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频-语言模型越来越多地被用作视频理解的评判者（评估模型输出、训练奖励模型），但当证据深埋于长达一天的视频中时，其判断是否可靠尚不清楚。现有基准无法回答这一问题：视频通常仅几分钟长，许多问答对仅凭转录文本即可区分，而人工标注又无法扩展到超长视频。

Method: 提出 PlaylistEval 智能体框架，在超过 100 小时的播放列表集合上自动构建视频-语言评判基准，全程无需人工标注。通过因果退化（causal degradation）控制配对答案之间的差异，使每一对答案都必须跨整个集合进行检索。最终基准包含覆盖七个领域、涵盖静态与动态知识的 630 个问答对。

Result: 在 152 个配对的分层子集上，该基准与人类判断的一致率为 93.0%（IAA 0.781）。对来自八个家族的 17 个全模态与多模态模型进行评估发现，前沿评判模型仅达到 75.4% 的配对准确率，开源评判模型则远远落后。进一步表明检索与最终判断都依赖多模态信息，且随着播放列表集合增大，评判准确率会下降。

Conclusion: PlaylistEval 为超长视频场景下的视频-语言评判提供了可扩展、无需人工标注的基准构建方案，并揭示当前模型在长视频评判上仍有显著差距。流水线、基准与评估代码已发布于 https://playlisteval.github.io。

Abstract: Video-language models are increasingly used as judges of video understanding, both for evaluating model outputs and for training reward models. Whether their judgments remain reliable when the evidence is buried in day-long videos has yet to be established. Existing benchmarks cannot answer this. Their videos are typically only a few minutes long, many answer pairs can be separated from the transcript alone, and collecting human judgments does not scale to ultra-long videos. We introduce PlaylistEval, an agentic framework that builds video-language judge benchmarks over 100-hour playlist collection without human annotation. It automatically generates questions with paired answers whose differences are controlled by causal degradation, so that every pair demands retrieval across the collection. The resulting benchmark contains 630 pairs across seven domains spanning both static and dynamic knowledge, and on a stratified subset of 152 pairs it agrees with human judgments 93.0% of the time (IAA 0.781). Evaluating 17 omnimodal and multimodal models from eight families reveals that frontier judges reach only 75.4% pairwise accuracy, while open-source judge models perform far behind. We further show that both retrieval and final judgment depend on using multiple modalities, and that judge accuracy degrades as the playlist set grows. We release our pipeline, benchmark, and evaluation code at https://playlisteval.github.io.

</details>


### [292] [Text-Vision Synergistic Token Caching: A Training-Free Framework for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34319)
*Qianer Li,Chengjie Zhang,Jingwen Chen,Zanjia Tong,Jiyuan Zhang,Hong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Text-Vision Synergistic Token Caching (TVCache)，一种免训练VLA推理加速框架，通过文本-视觉信息聚焦筛选注意力头、利用文本-视觉熵差选择复用层，在相同token保留率下提升任务成功率并降低FLOPs。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型具备通用机器人控制能力但计算开销大。现有token缓存虽免训练、即插即用，却未充分利用VLA的文本-视觉协同归纳偏置，且在注意力聚合中忽视头级可靠性、在缓存复用中忽视层间稳定性。

Method: TVCache包含两个核心机制：(1) 基于文本-视觉信息聚焦对注意力头进行筛选，以提升任务相关且物理一致的视觉定位；(2) 引入文本-视觉熵差引导的复用层选择机制，避免缓存不稳定表示并优化缓存资源分配。整个过程无需训练。

Result: 在四种代表性VLA模型、两个仿真基准及真实机器人任务上验证有效性与通用性。在相同token保留率下，相比现有VLA缓存方法持续提升任务成功率且计算成本相当。在OpenVLA-OFT上，12.5%保留率时相比VLA-Cache平均成功率提升最多14.5个百分点，同时相对全token推理减少2.45倍FLOPs。

Conclusion: TVCache通过挖掘文本-视觉协同这一VLA关键归纳偏置，实现了免训练、高效的VLA推理加速，在成功率与计算效率上均优于现有缓存方法，具备良好的通用性。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable generalizable robotic control but remain computationally expensive. Token caching provides a training-free, plug-and-play acceleration alternative. However, existing VLA caching does not fully exploit a key inductive bias of VLA models: text-vision synergy, wherein textual semantics guide the precise visual grounding of task-relevant regions. In particular, existing designs insufficiently account for head-wise reliability in attention aggregation and layer-wise stability in cache reuse. To address this, we propose Text-Vision Synergistic Token Caching (TVCache), a training-free framework for efficient VLA inference. TVCache filters attention heads based on text-vision information focus to improve task-relevant and physically consistent visual grounding. Concurrently, we introduce a reuse-layer selection mechanism guided by text-vision entropy differences to avoid caching unstable representations and improve cache resource allocation. Extensive experiments across four representative VLA models, two simulation benchmarks, and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of TVCache. At matched token-retention ratios, TVCache consistently improves task success over existing VLA caching with comparable computational cost. On OpenVLA-OFT, it improves average success by up to 14.5 percentage points over VLA-Cache at 12.5% retention while reducing FLOPs by 2.45x relative to full-token inference.

</details>


### [293] [DORA: Dynamic Online Reinforcement Agent for Token Pruning in Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34325)
*Kaixuan He,Song Chen,Yi Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DORA 是一个面向冻结 ViT 的动态在线强化学习剪枝智能体，能自适应决定何时剪、剪多少、剪哪些 token，在 ImageNet-1K 上实现显著 FLOPs 与吞吐量收益且精度损失极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 token 缩减方法多依赖预设的逐层压缩计划或离线搜索静态掩码，缺乏在线自适应性，无法动态调整剪枝的时机与幅度，导致压缩效率与精度难以兼顾。

Method: 提出 DORA（Dynamic Online Reinforcement Agent）：在每个可剪枝块，层级式 actor 对每张图像演化中的表示决定是否剪枝、剪多少及剪哪些 token；将剪枝建模为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，以处理早期删除对后续状态的影响；采用完整前缀影子评估将最终预测保真度转化为每步局部信用，并通过闭环精度反馈将保真度惩罚调整至共享的精度下降目标；训练时使用特权 critic 与影子计算，部署时仅保留冻结骨干与轻量 actor，配合硬删除与打包变长 FlashAttention 获得实际加速。

Result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上使用 DeiT-Base，DORA 相对未压缩骨干减少 38.4% FLOPs，精度损失在 1 个百分点以内。在四种 ViT 类骨干上以匹配精度平均，FLOPs 比各骨干基线均值少 13.2%，吞吐量高 32.4%；零样本迁移到 ImageNet-A 时，这两项增益分别扩大至 20.3% 和 45.6%。

Conclusion: DORA 通过在线强化学习实现输入自适应的 ViT token 剪枝，兼顾效率与精度，并在跨骨干与迁移场景中展现出良好泛化性与实际加速效果。

Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) incur quadratic self-attention cost in the number of tokens. Most token-reduction methods adapt token identities within a prescribed layer-wise compression schedule, or search a static mask offline, and thus limit online adaptation of when and how much to prune. We propose DORA (Dynamic Online Reinforcement Agent), which learns an input-adaptive pruning policy itself for frozen ViTs. At each eligible block, a hierarchical actor decides whether to prune, how many tokens to remove, and which tokens to remove from each image's evolving representation. Because early deletions change the states observed by later decisions, DORA formulates pruning as a finite-horizon Markov decision process. Complete-prefix shadow evaluations convert final-prediction fidelity into localized per-step credit, while closed-loop accuracy feedback adjusts the fidelity penalty toward a shared accuracy-drop target. A privileged critic and all shadow computations are training-only. Deployment retains the frozen backbone and a lightweight actor that applies hard deletion and packed variable-length FlashAttention, converting token reduction into measured speedups. On ImageNet-1K with DeiT-Base, DORA reduces FLOPs by 38.4% relative to the uncompressed backbone within one percentage point of accuracy loss. Averaged across four ViT-type backbones at matched accuracy, DORA uses 13.2% fewer FLOPs and achieves 32.4% higher throughput than the corresponding per-backbone baseline means. Under zero-shot transfer to ImageNet-A, these gains widen to 20.3% and 45.6%, respectively.

</details>


### [294] [MiCo: Mutual Information Coverage Optimization through Semantic Erasure Modeling for Efficient MLLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34330)
*Tinghao Wang,Yichen Guo,Qizhe Zhang,Yuan Zhang,Weimin Ouyang,Rui Huang,Jiajun Cao,Sixiang Chen,Hao Jiang,Jixian Wu,Zheng Lu,Bofan Zhu,Renyuan Li,Shanghang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无需训练的视觉token剪枝方法MiCo，基于互信息覆盖目标，两阶段贪心选择子集，在多种MLLM和视觉任务上减少token同时保持性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型处理大量视觉token计算成本高，现有剪枝方法多依赖启发式规则，剪枝时易丢失大量视觉信息，导致模型性能下降。

Method: 借助语义擦除模型，从任务对数损失推导出通用互信息覆盖目标；提出无需训练的两阶段剪枝方法MiCo：第一阶段在视觉token进入语言模型前用视觉信号选择代表性候选池，第二阶段在候选池内做任务感知子集选择；每阶段用可观测代理将目标实例化为单调子模覆盖函数，并在token预算下贪心优化。

Result: 在7B至13B的多种MLLM及涵盖通用视觉推理、细粒度OCR与定位、幻觉检测、长视频理解的图像和视频基准上评估，几乎在所有模型和所有剪枝比例下均取得最佳性能；LLaVA-NEXT-13B上仅用5.6%视觉token保留97.5%基线性能，推理加速3.8倍。

Conclusion: 实验证明MiCo及所提出的互信息覆盖目标在视觉token剪枝上的有效性。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in multimodal understanding, but processing large numbers of visual tokens results in high computational costs. While many methods have been proposed to reduce the number of visual tokens, most of them rely on heuristics and are prone to discarding substantial visual information during pruning, leading to degradation in model performance. In this work, by using a semantic erasure model, we derive a general mutual information coverage objective from task log-loss and propose MiCo, a training-free two-stage pruning method. MiCo first uses visual signals to select a representative candidate pool before visual tokens enter the language model, then performs task-aware subset selection within it. At each stage, suitable observable proxies instantiate the derived objective as a monotone submodular coverage function, which MiCo greedily optimizes under the token budget. MiCo is evaluated on diverse MLLMs ranging from 7B to 13B parameters across a broad range of image and video benchmarks spanning general visual reasoning, fine-grained OCR and grounding, hallucination detection, and long-video understanding. MiCo consistently achieves the best performance across nearly all evaluated models under all pruning ratios. On LLaVA-NEXT-13B, MiCo uses only 5.6% visual tokens, retains 97.5% of baseline performance, and achieves a 3.8-fold inference speedup. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MiCo and our mutual information coverage objective for visual token pruning.

</details>


### [295] [SkillPE: Creativity-Oriented Cinematic Skill Evolution for Text-to-Video Prompt Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34335)
*Yanwei Huang,Mingxuan Zhu,Shujie Li,Shiyuan Liu,Yuanxing Zhang,Arpit Narechania*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SkillPE 提示工程框架，从专家撰写的种子中演化可复用的电影化技能，用于文本到视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非专业用户的提示往往缺乏专业叙事与创意设计，难以生成高质量、电影感的文本到视频内容。

Method: 以细粒度格式表示镜头逻辑、构图、灯光、声音设计等电影化线索；检索电影参考并分为共鸣项、不谐项和偏离项，前两者细化技能应用时机与方式，偏离项在保持用户意图下启发不同改动程度的替代电影化实现；通过生成视频从提示保真度、电影质量、叙事吸引力与创意性评估候选技能，构建技能库。

Result: 在 StoryEval 与 VBench 上，7 分制四维评估中较最强外部基线提升至多 1.40 分，较种子技能提升 0.51 分，同时在基准原生指标上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: SkillPE 为电影化文本到视频生成中平衡保真度与创意性提供了实用方法。

Abstract: Achieving high-quality, cinematic results in text-to-video generation remains challenging for non-experts, whose prompts often lack professional narrative and creative design. We propose SkillPE, a prompt engineering (PE) framework that evolves reusable cinematic skills from expert-authored seeds. SkillPE represents shot logic, composition, lighting, sound design, and other filmmaking cues in a fine-grained format, and retrieves movie references categorized as resonators (good matches), dissonants (weak matches), and divergents (creatively useful near-misses). The first two refine when and how a skill should be applied, while divergents inspire alternative cinematic realizations at different degrees of modification while preserving the user intent. Candidate skills are assessed through generated videos along prompt fidelity, cinematic quality, narrative appeal, and creativity to construct the final skill libraries. Experiments on StoryEval and VBench show improvements of up to 1.40 points over the strongest external baseline and 0.51 points over seed skills on 7-point four-dimensional evaluation, while remaining competitive on benchmark-native metrics. Overall, SkillPE offers a practical approach to balancing fidelity and creativity in cinematic text-to-video generation. Code is available at https://github.com/Ais0n/SkillPE .

</details>


### [296] [E-WAVE: Event-based Continuous Optical Flow via Warping-Aligned Visual Encoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34346)
*Jiale Wu,Xiaoyang Bai,Haoming Yu,Yiwei Chen,Yifan Peng,Weiwei Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 E-WAVE，一种无相关性体积的高时间分辨率光流估计框架，用全局注意力与贝塞尔曲线引导的特征扭曲预测轨迹，可在任意时间戳查询且无需重复推理，轨迹误差降低25%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 沉浸式VR/AR需要连续捕捉快速头部、手部和物体运动的高时间密度光流，但帧基方法受时间分辨率与计算成本的权衡制约；事件相机虽具高时间分辨率和能效，但现有事件方法依赖相关性体积来建模成对体素对应，带来大量内存与计算开销。

Method: E-WAVE 不构建全对相关性体积，而是采用全局注意力机制建模长程特征依赖，并利用贝塞尔曲线进行轨迹引导的特征扭曲；通过迭代更新预测轨迹，从而支持在任意时间戳查询而无需重复推理。

Result: 在 MultiFlow 和 DSEC-Flow 数据集上，相比当前最优基线，轨迹误差降低25%，端点光流估计精度相当；在自采集的头戴原型数据上评估，验证其在具有挑战性的真实条件下仍保持稳健。

Conclusion: E-WAVE 为事件流高时间分辨率光流估计提供了无相关性体积的高效方案，兼顾精度与效率，并在真实VR/AR场景中展现出鲁棒性。

Abstract: Temporally dense optical flow is essential for dynamic perception in immersive VR/AR systems, where rapid head, hand, and object motion must be continuously captured and tracked. Existing frame-based optical flow estimation methods are constrained by the tradeoff between temporal resolution and computational cost; while event cameras, with their high temporal resolution and energy efficiency, serve as a natural solution to the dilemma. However, event-based approaches commonly rely on correlation volumes to capture pairwise voxel correspondences, which incur substantial memory and computation overhead. We present E-WAVE, a correlation-free framework for high-temporal-resolution (HTR) optical flow estimation from event streams. Instead of constructing all-pairs correlation volumes, E-WAVE employs global attention mechanism to model long-range feature dependencies and performs trajectory guided feature warping using Bézier curve. Through iterative updates, it predicts trajectories that allow for querying at arbitrary timestamps without repeated inference. Experiments on MultiFlow and DSEC-Flow demonstrate a 25% lower trajectory error and comparable endpoint flow estimation accuracy relative to state-of-the art baselines. Additional evaluations on self-captured data using a head-mounted prototype validate that E-WAVE remains robust under challenging real-world conditions.
