</details>


### [297] [SyncRA: Learning Temporal Correspondence in Omni-Modal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34363)
*Zelong Xu,Yan Li,Wenhe Hu,Xiyang Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 SyncRA（同步引导表征对齐），一种轻量方法，通过利用输入本身的时间信息构造对比监督，强化全模态模型中音视频表征的时间对应关系，在四个模型与五个视频基准上一致优于仅答案微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全模态模型虽具备较强的音视频感知能力，却难以将同一时刻听到与看到的内容对应起来。这种时间对应关系上的弱点会使模型把语音线索关联到错误的视觉场景，从而给出看似合理实则基于错误音视频配对的答案。作者通过受控的时间交换实验诊断出：模型答案并不能可靠地随音视频配对变化而改变。

Method: 提出 SyncRA（Synchrony-Guided Representation Alignment）：在每段视频内部对中间层音视频表征进行对比学习，拉近匹配时刻的表征、推远不匹配时刻的表征，从而在共享的全局语境中捕捉局部时间对应关系。该目标直接由已有的输入时间信息导出监督，无需额外标注，且不改变推理流程。

Result: 在不同规模与架构的四个开源全模态模型、五个公开视频基准上评估。SyncRA 在所有模型—基准组合中均持续优于仅答案微调，并在受控评测中显著提升了跟踪音视频配对变化的能力。

Conclusion: 轻量且有针对性的监督可有效强化时间对应关系，并转化为音视频问答任务的广泛性能提升。

Abstract: Recent omni-modal models demonstrate strong perception of audio and visual inputs, yet often struggle to connect what they hear with what they see at the same moment. This weakness in temporal correspondence can cause models to associate spoken cues with the wrong visual scenes, producing plausible answers grounded in incorrect audio-visual pairings. We diagnose this problem through controlled temporal swaps, revealing that model answers do not reliably follow changes in these pairings. To address it, we propose Synchrony-Guided Representation Alignment (SyncRA), a lightweight method for strengthening temporal correspondence between audio and vision. Specifically, SyncRA contrasts intermediate audio-visual representations within each video, aligning matching moments while separating mismatched ones to capture local temporal correspondence within a shared global context. The objective derives supervision directly from existing input timing, requiring no additional annotations and leaving inference unchanged. We evaluate SyncRA across four open omni-modal models spanning different sizes and architectures on five public video benchmarks. SyncRA consistently outperforms answer-only fine-tuning across all model-benchmark combinations, while substantially improving the ability to track changing audio-visual pairings in controlled evaluations. These results demonstrate that lightweight, targeted supervision can effectively strengthen temporal correspondence and translate into broad improvements in audio-visual question answering.

</details>


### [298] [Rate-Distortion Adaptive Primitive Selection for Omnidirectional Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34367)
*Yulong Cheng,Youneng Bao,Junfeng Zhou,Mu Li,Jie Wen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OIC-GS是一种基于HEALPix分层网格的全景高斯泼溅编解码器，通过消除显式坐标编码、轻量熵模型与球面率失真优化，实现单码流支持全球面、视口依赖和渐进式解码，并自适应基元密度与细节层次。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习式图像编解码器重建质量高但解码速度难以满足沉浸式VR需求；高斯泼溅编解码器渲染快，但重建质量落后，且通常在分配基元时未考虑每个基元的编码代价。

Method: 提出OIC-GS全景GS编解码器，采用分层HEALPix基元网格表示：高斯基元锚定在预定义球面位置，消除显式坐标编码；细层细化粗层祖先，支持由粗到细重建与分层传输；预定义网格支持仅选择视角相关基元以高效视口解码。引入量化基元的轻量熵模型，并在球面率失真目标下优化编解码器。当量化不透明度变为零时自动移除率失真收益不足的基元，从而自适应基元密度与细节层次，无需固定基元预算。

Result: 单个比特流支持全球面、视口依赖与渐进式解码。首个视口仅需解码52%比特流即达到最终质量，随后以1,270 FPS渲染。在100张图像的全景基准上，OIC-GS优于所有评估的GS编解码器，相比GaussianImage++将WS-PSNR BD-rate降低49.6%，相比使用学习熵模型的SGI降低68.6%。

Conclusion: OIC-GS通过分层HEALPix网格、熵模型与球面率失真优化，在保持高重建质量的同时显著提升解码与渲染效率，并支持灵活的多模式解码，为沉浸式VR全景内容传输提供了高效方案。

Abstract: Learned image codecs (LICs) achieve high reconstruction quality, but their decoding speed is often insufficient for immersive virtual reality (VR). Gaussian splatting (GS) codecs render much faster, yet still lag in reconstruction quality and typically decide primitive allocation without considering the coding cost of each primitive. We introduce OIC-GS, an omnidirectional GS codec with a new hierarchical HEALPix primitive grid representation. Gaussian primitives are anchored at predefined spherical locations, eliminating explicit coordinate coding. Finer levels refine their coarser ancestors, naturally supporting coarse-to-fine reconstruction and layered transmission. The predefined grid also enables efficient viewport decoding by selecting only view-relevant primitives. We further introduce a lightweight entropy model for quantized primitives and optimize the codec under a spherical rate-distortion objective. Primitives with insufficient rate-distortion benefit are automatically removed when their quantized opacity becomes zero, allowing OIC-GS to adapt both primitive density and level of detail without a fixed primitive budget. A single bitstream supports full-sphere, viewport-dependent, and progressive decoding. The first viewport reaches final quality after decoding only 52% of the bitstream, and is then rendered at 1,270 FPS. On a 100-image omnidirectional benchmark, OIC-GS outperforms all evaluated GS codecs, reducing WS-PSNR BD-rate by 49.6% over GaussianImage++ and 68.6% over SGI, which uses a learned entropy model.

</details>


### [299] [From Static to Dynamic: On-Policy Distillation from Image to Video Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34371)
*Bingqing Jiang,Li Luo,Zichao Yu,Yujin Han,Zhaolong Su,Difan Zou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MILD框架，用图像专家通过异构潜空间蒸馏来提升视频扩散模型的专项能力，同时保持预训练的视频动态特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于学生自身生成轨迹进行教师监督的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）可用于专业化预训练视频扩散模型。但大型视频教师模型需要昂贵的数据与训练成本，查询延迟也远高于图像专家。图像专家更易获取、查询更便宜，尤其适合美学、OCR等时间无关、可做帧级监督的能力。然而，异构的图像与视频潜空间阻碍了对学生中间状态的直接监督，且图像专家缺乏跨帧运动监督，帧级提升容易破坏时间一致性。

Method: MILD（Motion-Preserving Image-to-Video Latent Distillation）框架：1）使用可学习的线性连接器，将学生潜状态与预测更新对齐到图像专家的对应表征，实现跨异构潜空间的监督迁移；2）将图像引导的修正约束在预训练学生预测附近，以保留视频动态；3）引入基于光流的运动奖励，提升运动质量与时间一致性。

Result: 在多种专用图像专家和多个视频学生主干上，该方法一致优于以视频模型为教师的OPD基线；进一步实验表明其在不同连接器设计和异构架构下均能有效迁移。

Conclusion: 图像到视频蒸馏是利用图像生成生态多样且不断演进的能力来改进视频生成的有效途径。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) specializes pretrained video diffusion models through teacher supervision along the student's own generation trajectory. Although large video models are natural teachers, developing specialized video experts can require costly video data and training, while querying them incurs substantially higher latency than querying image experts. More readily available and cheaper to query, image experts offer a cost-effective alternative, particularly for largely temporal-agnostic capabilities such as aesthetics and OCR that admit frame-level supervision. However, heterogeneous image and video latent spaces prevent direct supervision of intermediate student states, while image experts lack cross-frame motion supervision, making temporal consistency vulnerable to frame-level improvements. In this paper, we propose MILD, a Motion-Preserving Image-to-Video Latent Distillation framework that transfers specialized image expertise while preserving pretrained video dynamics. MILD uses a learnable linear connector that aligns student latent states and predicted updates with those of image experts, enabling supervision transfer across heterogeneous latent spaces. We further constrain image-guided corrections around the pretrained student's predictions to preserve video dynamics and incorporate an optical-flow-based motion reward to improve motion quality and temporal consistency. Across specialized image experts and multiple video-student backbones, our method consistently outperforms video-teacher OPD baselines, with further studies demonstrating effective transfer across connector designs and heterogeneous architectures. These results establish image-to-video distillation as an effective route to improving video generation by drawing on the diverse and evolving capabilities of the image-generation ecosystem.

</details>


### [300] [Marathoner: Ultra-Long-Horizon Autonomous Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34378)
*Zhang Ruiyang,Ou Jinpeng,Xie Yifan,Zhou Jingang,Pan Lirui,Guo Qingpei,Zheng Zhedong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Marathoner，一种具备超长时程执行能力的自主智能体模型，通过完整后训练流水线（任务合成、拒绝采样微调、强化学习与后段奖励）在 5 个基准上取得显著提升，可连续工作 10+ 小时、完成 1000+ 次工具调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类能够为长期目标持续工作数月乃至数年，而现有智能体模型缺乏在挑战性任务上长期、持续执行的能力，因此需要赋予基座模型超长时程执行这一关键能力。

Method: 提出综合后训练流水线：1) 超长时程任务合成，利用 GitHub 仓库中新增 1000+ 行代码的重大发布 PR 作为任务级数据来源；2) 多任务链式组合，将多个生成任务串联成更具前沿难度的单一任务；3) 拒绝采样微调，用强教师模型配合多种执行框架生成轨迹并进行监督微调；4) 强化学习，冷启动模型在独立沙箱中通过执行框架进行真实世界 rollout；5) 提出后段奖励策略，显式鼓励模型在执行后期做出有意义的操作。

Result: 在 5 个包含超长时程任务的基准上，Marathoner 相比基座模型取得一致且显著的提升，甚至超过强闭源模型的表现；分析显示其可在高难度任务上连续工作 10+ 小时并执行 1000+ 次工具调用。

Conclusion: 通过系统化后训练可有效赋予模型超长时程执行能力，Marathoner 在长时程任务上表现优异，验证了任务合成、多任务链式、拒绝采样微调、真实沙箱强化学习与后段奖励相结合的有效性。

Abstract: Humans naturally possess the ability to work persistently toward long-term goals. Given a challenging task, humans can continuously work for months or even years to accomplish a specific objective. In this paper, we propose Marathoner, an autonomous agentic model possessing the ability of ultra-long-horizon execution. Specifically, we propose a comprehensive post-training pipeline to instill this critical capability into base model. For Ultra-Long-Horizon Task Synthesis, we leverage major release PRs containing 1000+ lines of new code from diverse GitHub repositories as the primary source for synthesizing challenging task-level data. Additionally, we introduce Multi-Task Chaining, which chains multiple generated tasks into a single more challenging task, enabling the synthesis of tasks with frontier-level difficulty. For rejection sampling finetuning, we combine strong teacher model with diverse harnesses to generate trajectories on our synthesized tasks and conduct supervised finetuning on base model with rejection sampled trajectories. For reinforcement learning, cold-started model performs real-world execution through harnesses in independent sandboxes during rollout process, effectively facilitating the acquisition of genuine ultra-long-horizon execution capability. We further propose a novel reward strategy, Later Stage Bonus Reward, which explicitly encourages model to perform meaningful maneuvers during later stages of execution. Through extensive evaluation on 5 benchmarks containing ultra-long-horizon tasks, Marathoner achieves consistent and substantial performance improvements over base model and even surpasses performance of strong proprietary model. Further analysis shows that Marathoner can consistently work for 10+ hours and conduct 1000+ tool calls on highly challenging tasks.

</details>


### [301] [Joint and Cross-Modal Video-Audio Generation and Editing: A Unified Formulation and Design Taxonomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34381)
*Abhinav Sharma,Sai Karthik Navuluru,Wang Wei,Daksh Dangi,Xiangbo Gao,Li Li,Bo Ni,Vardhan Dongre,Junda Wu,Xiyang Hu,Jiuxiang Gu,Seunghyun Yoon,Tong Yu,Chien Van Nguyen,Mohamed Elmoghany,Nedim Lipka,Hoda Eldardiry,Hongjie Chen,Tyler Derr,Thien Huu Nguyen,Zhengzhong Tu,Nesreen K. Ahmed,Franck Dernoncourt,Ryan A. Rossi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这是首篇系统梳理"联合音视频生成与编辑"的综述，围绕"跨模态在时间与语义上如何保持一致性"这一核心问题，提出统一形式化框架与五维分类体系，并将联合音视频编辑归纳为九大类、28种编辑类型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频与音频在感知上是共生的，但多数生成模型将二者孤立处理。因此需要系统考察"联合建模双模态、由一模生成另一模、以及耦合式编辑"的方法，并回答跨模态一致性问题。

Method: 将联合生成、跨模态生成与联合编辑统一建模为定义在"音视频对"单一分布上的三类问题；提出沿五个设计维度比较方法的分类体系；系统整理各设定的方法、数据集与评价指标。

Result: 据作者所知，这是首个系统分类联合音视频编辑的综述，将其映射为九种编辑类别、涵盖28种编辑类型，并给出各场景的方法、数据集与指标总结。

Conclusion: 在系统梳理现状的基础上，指出该领域最具影响力的若干开放问题，为后续研究提供方向。

Abstract: Video and audio are perceived together, yet most generative models treat them in isolation. We examine methods that model the two modalities jointly, generate one from the other, or edit them in a coupled manner, organized around a single question: how is the output kept coherent across modalities in time and semantics? A unified formulation casts joint generation, cross-modal generation, and joint editing as three problems defined on a single distribution over audio-visual pairs, and a taxonomy compares methods along five design axes. To our knowledge, this is the first overview to systematically taxonomize joint audio-visual editing, which we map as nine edit categories spanning 28 edit types. We describe methods, datasets, and metrics for each setting and close with the open problems we view as most consequential.

</details>


### [302] [CAR-VLA: Complexity-Aware and Risk-Adaptive Reasoning for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34387)
*Xiaolei Chen,Zhuolin He,Yuxuan Liang,Xu Li,Haotian Chen,Shi Fan,Mengyang Zhao,Wenjuan Meng,Zisheng Chen,Zhihao Zhu,Zhounan Jin,Hengli Wang,Qingfan Wang,Jiamei Liang,Bin Li,Xiangyang Xue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CAR-VLA是一种驾驶视觉-语言-动作模型，联合考虑场景复杂度与动态风险来指导推理深度、紧迫性和焦点，将四类复杂度-风险情形映射到三种推理模式，实现竞争性驾驶性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有驾驶VLA模型的自适应推理方法主要关注"是否推理"，忽略了不同驾驶情境下"如何推理"的差异。作者认为场景复杂度决定推理深度，而动态风险对时间紧迫情境下的推理方式同样关键。

Method: 提出CAR-VLA，联合场景复杂度与动态风险指导推理深度、紧迫性和焦点。将四类复杂度-风险情形映射为三种推理模式：简单低风险的Fast Intuition直接生成轨迹、复杂低风险的Slow Thinking审慎推理、高风险（无论复杂度）的Reflex Response聚焦于最危险要素与即时安全响应。训练采用渐进式监督学习（连接场景评估、推理模式选择、轨迹生成），并结合推理增强强化学习。

Result: 在NAVSIM v1达到91.1 PDMS，NAVSIM v2达到90.3 EPDMS，Navhard达到35.0 EPDMS，展现竞争性驾驶性能。在navtest和内部高风险场景上的定性对比进一步展示了风险感知推理与危险响应式轨迹生成。

Conclusion: CAR-VLA通过联合建模场景复杂度与动态风险，实现了自适应的风险感知推理与轨迹生成，在多个基准上取得竞争性表现，代码将公开。

Abstract: Existing adaptive reasoning methods for driving Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models primarily focus on whether to reason, overlooking how reasoning should differ across driving situations. Our key insight is that while scene complexity informs reasoning depth, dynamic risk is equally critical for deciding how to reason in time-critical situations. We therefore propose CAR-VLA, a unified driving VLA model that jointly considers scene complexity and dynamic risk to guide reasoning depth, urgency, and focus. CAR-VLA maps four complexity--risk categories to three reasoning modes: \textit{Fast Intuition} for direct trajectory generation in simple low-risk scenes, \textit{Slow Thinking} for deliberate reasoning in complex low-risk scenes, and \textit{Reflex Response} for compact, hazard-focused reasoning in high-risk scenes regardless of complexity. Rather than merely shortening deliberation, Reflex Response centers reasoning on the most critical hazard and the immediate safe response. We train CAR-VLA through progressive supervised learning that links scene assessment, reasoning-mode selection, and trajectory generation, followed by reasoning-augmented reinforcement learning to improve driving quality and reasoning behavior. Experiments on NAVSIM v1(91.1 PDMS), NAVSIM v2(90.3 EPDMS), and Navhard(35.0 EPDMS) demonstrate competitive driving performance. Qualitative comparisons on navtest and in-house high-risk scenarios further illustrate risk-aware reasoning and hazard-responsive trajectory generation. The code for this paper will be released publicly at: https://github.com/chenxl124578/CAR-VLA.git

</details>


### [303] [VastMAT: A Large-Scale Multi-Category Benchmark for Multi-Animal Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34390)
*Zhizhen Li,Zan Wang,Huidong Peng,Bohan Tan,Shimin Shan,Yu Liu,Liang Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了VastMAT，一个大规模、广类别、多实例标注的多动物跟踪（MAT）基准，并提出了轻量级Center-Distance-Augmented Association（CDA）模块提升跟踪性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多目标跟踪（MOT）基准主要关注行人和车辆，而专门的多动物跟踪（MAT）基准在动物覆盖范围、大规模视频数据和视频内多实例关联方面仍有不足，为弥补这一空白，作者构建了VastMAT基准。

Method: VastMAT包含2,947个视频、1,002,562帧标注、共27.85小时，涵盖337个动物类别，提供3,663,248个边界框和22,883条身份轨迹，并通过专家迭代审核与独立重标注审计保证质量。作者设立Seen-category和category-disjoint Unseen-category两种协议，评估八种代表性MOT方法，并提出轻量级CDA模块，自适应结合IoU与按框自身尺度归一化的中心相似度。

Result: 在两种协议下，最高基线HOTA分别为66.37%和52.90%，显示出跟踪未见动物类别的挑战性。CDA无需额外训练，即可在两种协议下分别将TrackTrack的HOTA提升1.58和1.31个百分点。

Conclusion: VastMAT为多动物跟踪研究提供了大规模、高质量基准，CDA有效缓解低重叠关联难题，作者将公开基准与代码以促进后续MAT研究。

Abstract: Multi-animal tracking (MAT) supports the study of animal movement, behavior, and group interactions. However, general multi-object tracking (MOT) benchmarks primarily focus on pedestrians and vehicles, whereas dedicated MAT benchmarks remain limited in jointly supporting broad animal coverage, large-scale video data, and extensive within-video multi-instance association. To address this gap, we introduce VastMAT, which has four key characteristics: (1) Large scale. It comprises 2,947 videos with 1,002,562 annotated frames, totaling 27.85 hours. (2) Broad category coverage. These videos cover 337 animal categories with diverse morphologies and motion patterns. (3) Extensive instance annotations. It provides 3,663,248 bounding boxes and 22,883 identity trajectories---to our knowledge, the largest numbers of both among dedicated MAT benchmarks. (4) High-quality annotations. To ensure reliability, annotations undergo iterative expert review and correction, and quality is assessed through an independent reannotation audit. To systematically assess tracking performance and cross-category generalization, we establish Seen-category and category-disjoint Unseen-category protocols, and evaluate eight representative MOT methods under both protocols. Under these protocols, the highest baseline HOTA scores are 66.37\% and 52.90\%, respectively, highlighting the challenge of tracking unseen animals. To address the low-overlap association challenge revealed by our analysis, we propose Center-Distance-Augmented Association (CDA), a lightweight module that adaptively combines IoU with center similarity normalized by the boxes' own scales. Without additional training, CDA improves TrackTrack's HOTA by 1.58 and 1.31 percentage points under the two protocols, respectively. To facilitate further MAT research, we will publicly release our benchmark and code.

</details>


### [304] [HyperDAM: Hyperspectral Distractor-Aware Memory with Amodal Expansion for SAM 3 Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34396)
*Ryoga Yuzawa,Tasuku Takagi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperDAM，一种基于 DAM4SAM3 的高光谱视频跟踪器，通过模态掩码数据集、光谱门控记忆更新与因果时空扩展三项改进，在 HOTC 2026 竞赛中获得第二名（AUC 68.0093%，DP@20 87.7703%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高光谱视频能提供材质线索，可区分伪彩色外观相似的目标，但现有基础模型跟踪器主要依赖空间与外观证据来更新记忆，未充分利用光谱信息，导致对光谱不一致的干扰更新缺乏约束，目标切换与完全遮挡难以处理。

Method: 1) 构建 HOTC2026-Modal，为全部 481 个 HOTC 2026 视频补充人工核验的逐帧模态掩码与紧致边界框；2) 提出帧零校准的 HSI 门控，在不改变当前预测的前提下，拒绝写入干扰消解记忆（DRM）的光谱不一致更新；3) 因果时空扩展器利用冻结的 SAM 特征进行仅向外的非模态修正；此外用静态场景恢复与空掩码 RTS 平滑应对目标切换与完全遮挡。模型选择优先考虑跨域鲁棒性而非榜单特定优化。

Result: 在 HOTC 2026 组织方私有评测中，最终系统排名第二，取得 68.0093% AUC 与 87.7703% DP@20。

Conclusion: 光谱门控记忆更新与冻结特征驱动的非模态修正能有效提升高光谱跟踪的鲁棒性；同时数据集补充与抗过拟合的模型选择策略对跨域泛化与竞赛表现均有正向作用。

Abstract: Hyperspectral video provides material cues that can disambiguate targets with similar false-color appearance, yet foundation-model trackers update memory primarily from spatial and appearance evidence. We present HyperDAM, a DAM4SAM3-based hyperspectral tracker with three principal contributions. First, HOTC2026-Modal adds human-verified frame-wise modal masks and mask-tight boxes to all 481 organizer-provided HOTC 2026 videos. Second, a frame-zero-calibrated HSI gate rejects spectrally inconsistent updates to the distractor-resolving memory (DRM) without altering the current prediction. Third, a causal spatiotemporal expander adds outward-only amodal corrections from frozen SAM features. Static-scene recovery and empty-mask RTS smoothing address target switches and full occlusion. Model selection prioritizes cross-domain robustness over leaderboard-specific optimization. The final system ranked second in HOTC 2026, achieving 68.0093% AUC and 87.7703% DP@20 in the organizer's private evaluation.

</details>


### [305] [Distilling Visual Reasoning into Text Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34408)
*Wenhan Yang,Nilay Naharas,Ali Payani,Baharan Mirzasoleiman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出V2T框架，通过知识蒸馏让LVLM在不生成中间视觉表示的情况下内化视觉推理能力，兼顾性能与训练效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLM在多模态推理上表现良好，但在需要超出图像直接可观察概念的任务上仍有困难。现有方法通过生成中间图像或潜在视觉token来引导推理，但这些表示会引入错误，并随推理推进越来越干扰文本推理。

Method: V2T先用交错的视觉与文本思维链训练教师LVLM；再用知识蒸馏训练学生LVLM，监督信号包括教师logits和来自真实文本推理的交叉熵。当推理图像可映射到原图时，还可蒸馏教师对相应区域的注意力；真实边界框可进一步引导后续强化学习阶段。

Result: 在多个多模态推理基准上，V2T持续优于教师模型和现有基线，在留出集上平均准确率提升14.3%，在更广泛的视觉评测套件上提升2.7%；且轻量SFT配合大幅减少的RL，使训练速度比最先进基线快达42倍。

Conclusion: V2T证明LVLM可在推理时无需生成中间视觉表示即可内化视觉推理，同时实现更高准确率与显著更快的训练速度。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown strong promise for multimodal reasoning, yet often struggle with tasks requiring concepts beyond what is directly observable in the input image. Existing methods generate intermediate images or latent visual tokens to guide reasoning, but these representations can introduce errors and increasingly interfere with textual reasoning as reasoning progresses. We propose Visual-to-Text Chain-of-Thought Distillation (V2T), a framework that enables LVLMs to internalize visual reasoning without generating intermediate visual representations at inference time. V2T first trains a teacher LVLM using interleaved visual and textual chains of thought, and then uses knowledge distillation to train a student LVLM using the teacher's logits and cross-entropy supervision from ground-truth textual reasoning. When reasoning images can be mapped to the original image, V2T can additionally distill the teacher's attention to corresponding regions, while ground-truth bounding boxes can further guide a subsequent reinforcement learning stage. Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that V2T consistently outperforms the teacher and existing baselines, improving average accuracy by 14.3% on a held-out set and 2.7% on the broader visual evaluation suite. Moreover, lightweight SFT and substantially reduced RL make V2T up to 42x faster to train than state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [306] [HUMAN-TCI: Hierarchical Multi-Stream Motion-Aware Network with Torso-Centered Interaction for Text-to-Motion Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34430)
*Muhammad Islam,Euijoon Ahn,Usman Naseem,Tao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HUMAN-TCI，一种分层多流运动感知网络，通过三流架构分别建模上肢、下肢与躯干并显式捕捉交互，实现文本引导的人体运动检索，兼顾简单与复杂多动作描述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本引导的人体运动检索是运动建模与合成的重要前置步骤，但现有方法多针对单一简单动作描述，且将身体部位独立处理或仅拼接特征，未显式建模躯干对其他部位的影响；同时依赖计算量大的模型，处理长或复杂序列时开销显著，导致检索精度、可解释性与效率受限。

Method: 提出HUMAN-TCI分层多流运动感知网络，采用三流架构分别建模上肢、下肢和躯干运动，并显式捕捉三者交互，使躯干运动能够影响其他身体部位的位置与动态；引入定制的躯干注意力机制，以识别复杂运动模式、捕捉细粒度运动关系并处理多动作描述。

Result: 该框架同时支持简单单动作句子与包含顺序或重叠动作的长组合式描述的检索，并且不依赖复杂模型。

Conclusion: HUMAN-TCI通过分层多流结构与躯干注意力机制，弥补了现有方法在躯干建模、复杂描述处理与计算效率方面的不足，提升了文本引导运动检索的准确性与实用性。

Abstract: Accurate retrieval of human motions is a crucial first step in text-guided human motion modeling and synthesis, as it selects semantically relevant sequences from large datasets and provides grounded references for downstream tasks. Retrieving motions from natural language descriptions remains challenging because sentences can describe multiple actions, overlapping movements, and intricate dependencies between body parts. Existing methods often focus on simple, single-action descriptions and typically process body parts independently or by merely concatenating features, without explicitly modeling how torso movements influence other parts. In addition, their processing pipelines often rely on computationally heavy models, introducing considerable overhead, particularly when modeling longer or more complex motion sequences. This limits learning discriminative motion-pattern representations, reducing retrieval accuracy, interpretability, and efficiency in practical applications. To address these limitations, we propose HUMAN-TCI, a Hierarchical Multi-Stream Motion-Aware Network for text-guided human motion retrieval. HUMAN-TCI employs a three-stream architecture that separately models upper-body, lower-body, and torso motions while explicitly capturing their interactions, allowing torso-related movements to influence the positioning and dynamics of other body parts. By incorporating tailored torso attention, our model effectively recognizes complex human motion patterns, captures fine-grained motion relationships and handles complex multi-action descriptions. Our framework supports retrieval for both simple, single-action sentences and long, compositional descriptions containing sequential or overlapping actions without relying on complex models.

</details>


### [307] [Clinical Trajectory Alignment for Medical Vision-Language Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34439)
*Huimin Yan,Xian Yang,Zhi Wang,Liang Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MedCTA 将医学视觉-语言预训练从就诊级图文匹配重构为临床变化学习，在异常与病程两个层面建模纵向演变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学视觉-语言预训练多采用就诊级图文匹配范式，只对齐单次就诊的图像与报告，难以提供纵向临床变化的监督信号（如异常是好转、稳定还是恶化）。同时，自由文本报告中的时间语义是隐式的，且同一患者不同异常的演变可能不同步甚至方向相反，使变化学习具有挑战性。

Method: 提出 MedCTA，不再将病史压缩为单一时间表示，而是在两个互补层面建模临床变化：1）异常层面，用临床相关的查询构建以异常为条件的视觉与文本轨迹，捕捉异质的异常演变；2）病程层面，对全局图像与报告序列建模，捕捉超越单一异常的整体临床进展。此外，通过离线 LLM 解析器从纵向报告中抽取结构化趋势监督，免除人工时间标注，并与静态图文对齐结合训练。

Result: 在时序图像分类、图像-文本检索和零样本分类任务上，MedCTA 相比强医学视觉-语言基线均取得一致提升。

Conclusion: MedCTA 学习到的表示既保留了就诊级的跨模态对应关系，又编码了纵向变化语义，验证了从就诊级匹配转向临床变化学习的有效性。

Abstract: Medical vision-language pre-training largely follows a visit-level image-report matching paradigm, aligning paired images and reports at individual visits. While effective for static cross-modal correspondence, this paradigm provides limited supervision for longitudinal clinical change, such as whether abnormalities improve, remain stable, or worsen over time. Learning such change is challenging because temporal semantics are implicit in free-text reports, and different abnormalities within the same patient may evolve asynchronously or even in opposite directions. We propose MedCTA, which reframes medical vision-language pre-training from visit-level cross-modal matching to learning clinical change. Rather than compressing a patient history into a single temporal representation, MedCTA models clinical change at two complementary scopes. At the abnormality scope, clinically grounded queries construct abnormality-conditioned visual and textual trajectories to capture heterogeneous abnormality evolution. At the patient-course scope, global image and report sequences are modeled to capture overall clinical progression beyond any individual abnormality. Structured trend supervision is extracted from longitudinal reports by an offline LLM parser, removing the need for manual temporal annotations. Combined with static image-report alignment, MedCTA learns representations that preserve visit-level cross-modal correspondence while encoding longitudinal change semantics. Experiments on temporal image classification, image-text retrieval, and zero-shot classification show consistent gains over strong medical vision-language baselines.

</details>


### [308] [When the Score Becomes the Target: Rethinking Metric Validity in Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34440)
*Morui Zhu,Deyuan Qu,Qi Chen,Kentaro Oguchi,Qing Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文质疑：当驾驶基准分数被用作优化目标后，分数提升是否仍能可靠反映驾驶能力的真实提高。作者将评分过程分解为执行、测量、子分数映射与聚合四个环节，通过受控干预与闭环对比，揭示分数对许多行为差异不敏感，且优化增益在改变执行接口后可能反转，说明指标有效性需同时考察评分过程测什么以及被优化行为如何执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驾驶基准分数不仅用于评估，还日益被当作优化目标，因此需要回答一个根本问题：一旦分数本身被优化，分数提升是否仍是驾驶改进的可靠证据。作者希望检验评分过程如何响应驾驶行为变化，以及这些增益在重复执行与重新规划下能否持续。

Method: 将评分过程分解为执行、测量、子分数映射和聚合四个环节；通过受控干预检验行为变化与分数响应之间的关系；并进行闭环对比，考察优化增益在改变执行接口时是否会发生反转。

Result: 受控干预显示，显著的行为变化只带来很小的分数响应，因为在请求运动与执行运动之间，相关区分被省略、被阈值化或被削弱；闭环对比进一步表明，当执行接口改变时，优化增益可能反转，说明增益依赖于请求如何被执行并作为反馈返回。

Conclusion: 这些发现将指标所保留的行为区分与其增益可迁移的条件联系起来。因此，在优化条件下评估指标有效性，必须同时考察评分过程测什么，以及被优化行为如何执行。

Abstract: Driving benchmark scores are increasingly used not only for evaluation but also as optimization targets. This raises a fundamental question: do score gains remain reliable evidence of driving improvement once the score itself is optimized? We address this question by examining how the scoring process responds to changes in driving behavior and whether the resulting gains persist under repeated execution and replanning. We decompose the process into execution, measurement, subscore mapping, and aggregation. Controlled interventions reveal substantial behavioral changes that receive little score response because distinctions are omitted, thresholded, or attenuated between requested and executed motion. Closed-loop comparisons further show that optimization gains can reverse when the execution interface changes, demonstrating their dependence on how requests are executed and returned as feedback. Together, these findings connect the behavioral distinctions preserved by a metric to the conditions under which its gains transfer. Metric validity under optimization therefore requires examining both what the scoring process measures and how the optimized behavior is executed.

</details>


### [309] [Modeling Whole-Slide Images as Dynamic Tumor Microenvironment Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34451)
*Lei Wu,Jiashuai Liu,Di Zhang,Zhangpeng Gong,Yingkang Zhan,Yi Niu,Jiusong Ge,Chunze Yang,Kai Yi,Mireia Crispin-Ortuzar,Chen Li,Zeyu Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出反应扩散启发的TMEvolve框架，将全切片图像建模为潜在肿瘤微环境场，通过图离散化演化过程实现自适应区域形成与边界交互，在六数据集三项任务上优于MIL、病理基础模型与概念引导基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全切片图像为十亿像素级，弱监督分析常被建模为多实例学习，但诊断与预后证据往往来自空间连贯的肿瘤微环境区域及其交互，而非孤立图像块。现有图像块级或静态区域方法忽略了组织区域应如何自适应形成，以及如何通过异质边界间的微环境交互演化。

Method: 提出概念引导肿瘤微环境演化框架TMEvolve，受反应扩散启发，将WSI建模为离散图像块图上的潜在肿瘤微环境场，实现可学习的图离散化演化过程。包括：首先形成自适应软组织区域作为连贯的微环境单元；随后进行伪时间演化，由两种互补局部动力学驱动——区域内扩散（稳定连贯组织区室内的潜在状态）与概念引导边界通量（跨异质区域界面传播视觉特征信号与语言派生概念信号）；最终对演化后的微环境区域聚合以进行切片级预测。

Result: 在六个数据集、三项弱监督WSI任务（生存预测、基因表达预测、组织学亚型分类）上评估，TMEvolve持续优于代表性MIL方法、病理基础模型与概念引导基线。消融实验与可视化进一步验证了其有效性与可解释性，凸显动态区域建模与边界交互的价值。

Conclusion: TMEvolve通过动态区域建模与边界交互，有效刻画了肿瘤微环境的形成与演化，为弱监督全切片图像分析提供了可解释且性能更优的解决方案。

Abstract: Due to the gigapixel-scale nature of whole-slide images (WSIs), weakly supervised WSI analysis is commonly formulated as a multiple instance learning (MIL) problem, where patch-level features are aggregated into slide-level representations. However, diagnostic and prognostic evidence often arises from spatially coherent tumor microenvironment regions and their interactions, rather than isolated patches alone. Existing patch-level or static region-based methods usually overlook how tissue regions should be adaptively formed and subsequently evolved through microenvironment interactions across heterogeneous boundaries. In this paper, we propose Concept-Guided Tumor Microenvironment Evolution (TMEvolve), a reaction-diffusion-inspired framework that models WSIs as latent tumor microenvironment fields over discrete patch graphs. TMEvolve instantiates this view as a learnable graph-discretized evolution process over patch neighborhoods. It first forms adaptive soft tissue regions as coherent microenvironment units, then performs pseudo-time evolution through two complementary local dynamics: intra-region diffusion, which stabilizes latent states within coherent tissue compartments, and concept-guided boundary flux, which propagates visual feature signals and language-derived concept signals across heterogeneous region interfaces. The evolved microenvironment regions are finally aggregated for slide-level prediction. We evaluate TMEvolve on six datasets across three weakly supervised WSI tasks: survival prediction, gene expression prediction, and histological subtype classification. TMEvolve consistently improves over representative MIL methods, pathology foundation models, and concept-guided baselines. Ablation studies and visualizations further support the effectiveness and interpretability of TMEvolve, highlighting the value of dynamic region modeling and boundary interaction.

</details>


### [310] [Precise Editing and Flexible Referencing for Interactable Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34470)
*Xinyao Liao,Xianfang Zeng,Zhu Liang,Zhoujie Fu,Qianxun Xu,Jiachi Liu,Gang Yu,Guosheng Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EditWorld 是一个视频世界模型，支持在可交互世界中进行精确编辑与灵活引用，通过流式编辑指令和参考图像实现自回归生成过程中的内容修改。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型主要聚焦于导航式探索，用户虽能探索生成的世界，但对已有世界内容如何被修改的控制能力有限。论文希望将世界建模从单纯的探索扩展到精确修改。

Method: 提出 Gated Causal Attention 处理随时间变化的编辑条件和参考图像；引入 Sparse Context 机制在长时程推理中维持有界的历史上下文；采用联合自回归与双向训练及退火自采样策略；构建专门的数据合成与标注流程为世界编辑提供监督；并提出 WBench-Editing 评测基准。

Result: 在 WBench-Editing 上取得最佳总体表现，总体得分 73.8，编辑得分 80.0，在编辑相关指标上显著优于现有方法。

Conclusion: EditWorld 将世界模型能力从探索推进到精确修改，借助流式编辑指令与参考图像、专门的注意力与上下文机制以及数据与评测体系，实现了领先的流式世界编辑性能。

Abstract: We present EditWorld, a video world model for precise editing and flexible referencing in interactable worlds. Existing video world models primarily focus on navigation, letting users explore generated worlds but offering limited control over how existing world content is modified. EditWorld extends world modeling from exploration to precise modification by streaming editing instructions and reference images during autoregressive generation. To support these capabilities, EditWorld introduces Gated Causal Attention for temporally varying editing conditions and reference images, together with a Sparse Context mechanism that maintains a bounded historical context for long-horizon inference. We further adopt joint autoregressive and bidirectional training with annealed self-resampling, and construct a dedicated data synthesis and annotation pipeline that provides supervision for world editing. We also present WBench-Editing to systematically evaluate streaming world editing capabilities. EditWorld achieves the best overall performance on WBench-Editing with an overall score of 73.8 and an editing score of 80.0, substantially outperforming existing methods on editing-related metrics. https://github.com/leoisufa/EditWorld

</details>


### [311] [VL-AcneSeg: A Vision-Language Framework for Region-Aware Acne Lesion Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34472)
*Sukju Oh,Soo Ick Cho,Dae Hun Suh,Sukkyu Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VL-AcneSeg，一个基于CLIP与区域级文本提示的多模态痤疮病灶分割框架，无需病灶位置信息即可在整个面部定位病灶，并在内部与外部数据集上取得领先的分割性能，其面积测量与IGA评分的相关性可媲美专家标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统痤疮分级与计数具有主观性且未考虑病灶大小，基于面积的评估虽为有前景的替代方案，但痤疮分割仍依赖通用架构，缺乏针对性设计，因此需要一种能引入空间先验、支持客观面积评估的专用分割方法。

Method: 提出VL-AcneSeg多模态框架，利用CLIP与区域级文本提示引入空间先验，实现全脸病灶定位。以仅需单一全局提示（不含病灶位置信息）为主设置，同时评估区域级提示的效果。

Result: 在内部临床数据集上，主设置（全局提示）下Dice为0.5082、IoU为0.3407，优于所有对比方法（包括获得区域级提示的近期视觉-语言分割方法）；区域级提示提升至0.5296与0.3602。分割所得病灶面积与IGA评分的相关性（Pearson r=0.719）与专家标注（0.658）相当。在外部验证数据集上表现一致，无需额外训练或微调即可在非受控手机图像上稳定工作。

Conclusion: 通过将无需病灶位置信息的协议与基于面积的严重度估计相结合，本工作为临床之外的客观痤疮评估奠定了基础。代码已公开。

Abstract: Acne assessment is crucial for clinical decision-making, yet traditional grading and counting are subjective and fail to account for lesion size. While area-based assessment has emerged as a promising alternative, acne segmentation has continued to rely on general-purpose architectures. To address this gap, we propose VL-AcneSeg, a multimodal framework for acne lesion segmentation that leverages CLIP and region-level text prompts to incorporate spatial priors, enabling lesions to be localized across the whole face. Because region-level prompts indicate which facial areas contain lesions, we report a single global prompt, which requires no such information, as our primary setting. On our internal clinical dataset, VL-AcneSeg achieves a Dice score of 0.5082 and an IoU of 0.3407 under this protocol, the highest among all compared methods, including recent vision-language segmentation methods that are themselves given region-level prompts; region-level prompting raises these to 0.5296 and 0.3602. Moreover, lesion area measurements derived from our segmentation correlate with IGA scores at a level comparable to expert annotations (Pearson r = 0.719 versus 0.658). Notably, our framework maintains consistent performance across external validation datasets, performing reliably even on uncontrolled smartphone images without requiring additional training or fine-tuning. By pairing a protocol that requires no lesion-location information with area-based severity estimation, this work provides a foundation for objective acne assessment outside the clinic. Our implementation is publicly available at: https://github.com/sukjuoh/VL-AcneSeg

</details>


### [312] [SentZero: An Enhanced Sentence-Centric Vision-Language Pretraining for Multi-Task Zero-Shot Chest X-Ray Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34479)
*Hangyul Yoon,Hyungyung Lee,Edward Choi,Eunho Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SentZero是一个面向零样本、多任务胸部X光分析的句子中心视觉-语言预训练框架，通过LLM抽象级句子结构化与映射、假阴性缓解损失以及句子条件残差调制来提升零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于配对CXR图像与放射报告的VL预训练方法仍依赖任务特定的微调，因为放射报告冗长、临床信息密集、难以与简单零样本提示对齐。近期句子级方法利用LLM抽取的临床短语部分缓解了该限制，但忽视了放射学话语的内在特性：正样本对多样性有限，且临床等价的句子在不同患者间频繁重复，在对比学习中造成假阴性。

Method: SentZero提出：(1) 基于LLM的抽象级句子结构化与映射，以扩展正样本对多样性；(2) 增加额外损失项以缓解假阴性问题；(3) 引入句子条件的视觉嵌入残差调制，使视觉特征能够适应每个输入句子的语义特性。

Result: 在多种下游任务和数据集上，SentZero提升了零样本泛化能力，并优于此前多任务零样本方法。

Conclusion: SentZero通过面向放射学话语特性的句子中心预训练设计，有效改善了零样本、多任务CXR分析的泛化性能。

Abstract: Vision-language (VL) pretraining using paired chest X-ray (CXR) images and radiology reports has shown strong potential for medical image understanding. However, existing methods often remain dependent on task-specific finetuning because radiology reports are lengthy, clinically dense, and difficult to align with simple zero-shot prompts. Recent sentence-level approaches partially address this limitation using clinical phrases extracted by large language models (LLMs), but they largely overlook the intrinsic characteristics of radiology discourse. In particular, limited positive-pair diversity constrains further gains, while clinically equivalent sentences frequently recur across patients, creating false negatives in contrastive learning. To address these issues, we propose SentZero, an enhanced sentence-centric VL pretraining framework for zero-shot, multi-task CXR analysis. SentZero introduces LLM-based abstract-level sentence structuring and mapping to expand positive-pair diversity, together with an additional loss term to mitigate false negatives. We further introduce sentence-conditioned residual modulation of visual embeddings, enabling visual features to adapt to the semantic characteristics of each input sentence. Across diverse downstream tasks and datasets, SentZero improves zero-shot generalization and outperforms prior multi-task zero-shot methods.

</details>


### [313] [When Does an Image Determine the Answer? Benchmarking Visual Answerability across Charts and Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34480)
*Sungguk Cha,Mintae Kim,Youngsub Han,Byoung-Ki Jeon,Sangyeob Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个连接"完整问题评估"与显式证据的基准，覆盖PlotQA图表、CLEVR渲染场景和GQA照片，要求模型在证据充分时正确作答、证据不足时正确弃答，结果发现现有模型在完整任务上的成功率最高仅57.0%、43.5%和33.7%，且仅看可答性决策会掩盖大量答案错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠的视觉问答不仅需要在证据充分时给出正确答案，还需要在证据不足时拒答（abstention）。然而现有评估往往只关注"是否可答"这一决策，单独考察可答性会掩盖答案本身的错误，无法真实反映模型在完整任务上的表现。因此需要一个将完整问题评估与显式证据标签相连接、同时考核"支持性答案"与"必要弃答"的基准。

Method: 构建跨三个数据集（PlotQA图表、CLEVR渲染场景、GQA照片）的基准，每个问题将原始图像与编辑后图像成组呈现，且各视图独立评估；成功要求组内每个受支持答案与每个必要弃答全部正确。对图表缺失信息标签，使用可执行见证（executable witnesses）证明：在掩码后像素相同的情况下，不同的合规完整图表会给出不同答案；场景标签依据源程序与编辑构造；照片则通过残差线索分析处理。共收集六种模型配置的72,000条回答进行评估。

Result: 完整任务的最高成功率分别为：PlotQA图表57.0%、CLEVR场景43.5%、GQA照片33.7%。在图表上，最强配置的单视图决策准确率达96.2%，但其835个"每个决策都正确"的问题组中仍有265组包含错误答案。

Conclusion: 将受支持答案与必要弃答联合评估，能够暴露出仅依靠可答性决策所掩盖的失败；即便决策准确率很高，答案层面仍可能存在大量错误，说明可靠的视觉问答评估必须同时考核作答正确性与弃答的正确性。

Abstract: Reliable visual question answering requires correct answers when evidence is sufficient and abstention when it is not. We introduce a benchmark that connects complete-question evaluation with explicit evidence for its labels across PlotQA charts, CLEVR rendered scenes, and GQA photographs. Each question groups original and edited images, presented independently; success requires every supported answer and every required abstention to be correct. For chart missing-information labels, executable witnesses establish that admissible complete charts give different answers but identical pixels after masking. Scene labels follow source programs and edits, with a residual-cue analysis for photographs. Across 72,000 responses from six model configurations, the highest observed complete task success rates are 57.0%, 43.5%, and 33.7%, respectively. On charts, the strongest configuration achieves 96.2% per-view decision accuracy, yet 265 of its 835 groups with every decision correct still contain incorrect answers. Evaluating supported answers and necessary abstentions together exposes failures that answerability decisions alone conceal.

</details>


### [314] [PACER: Progressive Availability-Conditioned Evidence Routing for Radiology Report Generation under Incomplete Clinical Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34487)
*Yulong Chen,Yadong Liu,Haoyu Cao,Sen Xu,Yueying Wang,Jie Wen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PACER框架，通过"精炼-校准-承诺"流水线实现结构化不完整上下文下的放射报告生成，在MIMIC-RG4四种设置上达最优临床效能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 放射报告生成日益融合多视图影像、既往报告等异构临床证据，但可用证据因检查而异。仅"容纳"不同输入组合并不等于"有效利用"证据，生成的报告仍可能遗漏或错误描述临床相关发现，因此需要解决不完整上下文下的证据有效利用问题。

Method: 提出PACER（Progressive Availability-Conditioned Evidence Routing）框架，遵循精炼-校准-承诺三阶段流水线：(1)精炼：在冻结编码器各深度间进行端点保持的逐块路由，融入互补线索同时保留预训练终端表示；(2)校准：根据观测证据与可用性状态校准语言模型前缀，随可用来源集合变化调整共享生成器的条件；(3)承诺：在同一自回归轨迹中先于报告生成极性结构的临床承诺，为后续生成提供结构化临床上下文。

Result: 在MIMIC-RG4的全部四种设置上取得最先进（SOTA）的临床效能，在MIMIC-CXR上表现强劲，同时保持有竞争力的语言生成质量。

Conclusion: PACER通过渐进式、可用性条件化的证据路由与结构化临床承诺，有效应对了异构证据可用性变化导致的证据利用不足问题，验证了Refine-Calibrate-Commit范式在不完整上下文放射报告生成中的有效性。

Abstract: Radiology report generation (RRG) increasingly incorporates heterogeneous clinical evidence, such as multi-view radiographs and previous reports, whose availability varies across examinations. However, accommodating different input combinations does not ensure effective evidence use: generated reports may still omit or inaccurately describe clinically relevant findings. To address this problem, we propose PACER, a Progressive Availability-Conditioned Evidence Routing framework for structured incomplete-context RRG that follows a Refine-Calibrate-Commit pipeline. It first refines observed visual representations through endpoint-preserving patchwise routing across frozen encoder depths, incorporating complementary cues while retaining the pretrained terminal representation. It then calibrates the language-model prefix according to the observed evidence and availability state, adapting the shared generator's conditioning as the available source set changes. Finally, it generates polarity-structured clinical commitments before the report in the same autoregressive trajectory, providing structured clinical context for subsequent generation. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art clinical efficacy across all four MIMIC-RG4 settings and strong MIMIC-CXR performance, while maintaining competitive language-generation quality.

</details>


### [315] [HPMD: A Historical Persian Manuscript Dataset for Word Spotting with Line-Level Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34490)
*Saeid Firouzi Daghigh,Majid Iranpour Mobarakeh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文构建了一个大规模历史波斯语手写数据集（223页、3678行、37631词），并提出一种仅用行级标注训练、但能返回词级位置的词检索基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 历史波斯语手稿已大量数字化，但检索仍缓慢且依赖人工。历史波斯语手写公开数据集稀缺，且词检索模型通常依赖昂贵的词级边界框标注，这两点制约了研究进展。

Method: 收集多样历史波斯语诗歌与散文书籍，构建区域、行、文本三级标注数据集。方法上，微调行检测器定位文本行，微调基于CTC的CRNN识别器为每行生成帧-字符后验矩阵；不逐帧解码最可能字符，而是将查询直接与该后验矩阵打分，从而避免波斯语中形似字符（如be与pe）导致的硬失败，并由帧对齐给出词在行内的水平位置；阈值在验证集上选取。

Result: 测试集上，微调行检测器F1为0.892；基于后验的检索将词检索F1从精确匹配解码文本的0.487提升至0.558。额外在测试时获得oracle词边界的PHOC属性嵌入基线F1仅0.449，低于所提方法。论文还给出数据集分布分析、检索错误分类及分条件性能拆解。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了历史波斯语手写数据集，并证明仅依赖行级标注的帧后验检索可在无需词级标注的情况下有效提升词检索性能，优于需oracle边界的属性嵌入基线。

Abstract: Large collections of historical Persian manuscripts have been digitized, but searching them is still slow and mostly manual. Historians usually want to find where a specific name, date, event, or topic appears, which is a word spotting problem. Progress on this task is limited by two things. First, there is almost no public dataset of historical Persian handwriting; the only notable resource, OpenITI MAKHZAN, contains a relatively small Persian portion. Second, word spotting models usually need word-level bounding boxes, which are very expensive to annotate. In this paper we introduce a new dataset of 223 pages, 3,678 lines, 37,631 words, and 130,630 characters, collected from diverse historical Persian books of poetry and prose and annotated at the region, line, and text level. We also propose a baseline that is trained only with line-level annotations but returns word-level locations. A fine-tuned line detector finds text lines, and a fine-tuned CRNN recognizer trained with CTC produces a frame-by-character posterior matrix for each line. Instead of decoding the most probable character at each frame, the query is scored directly against this matrix, so visually similar characters in Persian such as be and pe no longer cause hard failures. The frame alignment also gives the horizontal position of the word inside the line. On the test set, the fine-tuned line detector reaches an F1 of 0.892, and posterior-based search raises the word spotting F1 from 0.487 to 0.558 compared with exact matching on the decoded text, with the decision threshold selected on a held-out validation set. A PHOC attribute-embedding baseline that additionally receives oracle word boundaries at test time reaches an F1 of 0.449, below the proposed method. We also report a distributional analysis of the dataset, a taxonomy of retrieval errors, and a per-conditionbreakdown of performance.

</details>


### [316] [ConCAD: Constraint-Aware Image-to-CAD Generation with Dual-Granularity Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34494)
*Chenxi Zhai,Xi Cheng,Hang Cheng,Zhicheng Guan,Mingyu Fan,Yanzhe Tang,Pingfa Feng,Long Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ConCAD：约束感知的图像到CAD框架，用GRPO结合代码级约束奖励与执行级几何奖励，并提出G-CSR指标，在DeepCAD/Zero2CAD上IoU、Chamfer及G-CSR均最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像到CAD方法仅用有效性和形状重叠（如体积相似）评估，无法区分体积相近但CAD拓扑/约束关系不同的形状，因而难以真正恢复设计意图。论文希望同时恢复几何与参数化设计意图，并提出能衡量几何约束满足程度的评价方式。

Method: 提出ConCAD框架，基于Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）优化，采用两个互补粒度的奖励：代码级约束奖励（关注参数化程序中的几何约束关系）和执行级几何奖励（保证生成有效3D几何）。同时提出B-rep几何约束满足率（G-CSR），从边界表示中解析并评估几何约束的满足情况。

Result: 在DeepCAD和Zero2CAD数据集上，ConCAD在IoU和Chamfer Distance上优于竞争基线，并在G-CSR上也超过基线，表明其在几何保真度与参数化设计意图恢复方面均更优。

Conclusion: 互补的双粒度奖励设计可消解体积相似但结构不同的形状歧义，同时保证几何有效性；G-CSR为评估设计意图恢复提供了更贴合CAD约束语义的指标，验证了ConCAD在几何与设计意图双方面恢复上的有效性。

Abstract: Image-to-CAD generation seeks executable parametric programs that recover both the geometry and design intent of a reference object. Existing systems are commonly evaluated by validity and shape overlap, although two solids with similar volume can encode different CAD relations. We introduce ConCAD, a constraint-aware image-to-CAD framework optimized via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with rewards at two complementary granularities: a code-level constraint reward and an execution-level geometric reward. This complementary design disambiguates structurally distinct yet volumetrically similar shapes while ensuring valid 3D geometry. To verify that these rewards recover geometry and design intent, we introduce a B-rep geometric constraint satisfaction rate (G-CSR), which analytically extracts and evaluates geometric constraints from boundary representations. Experiments on the DeepCAD and Zero2CAD demonstrate that ConCAD achieves the best IoU and Chamfer Distance over competitive baselines, while also outperforming them on G-CSR, validating its superior recovery of both geometric fidelity and parametric design intent.

</details>


### [317] [Can Attack Difficulty Be Characterized Before Optimization? A Study of Pre-optimization Difficulty in Person-Vanishing Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34501)
*Jingyao Xu,Dongdong Wang,Siyang Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"优化前攻击难度"概念及几何估计器 Quad-CLEVER，证明攻击难度在优化开始前即可预测，并据此构建难度感知攻击框架以更高效地分配优化预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统对抗攻击研究从优化视角出发，将攻击难度视为优化完成后才能观察到的结果，因此无法回答"不同输入的相对攻击难度能否在优化开始前被刻画"这一根本问题。

Method: 针对行人消失攻击，提出优化前攻击难度概念；并设计 Quad-CLEVER —— 一种基于几何的高效估计器，由局部行人消失间隔在最相关攻击方向上的二次近似推导而来。进一步基于该估计提出难度感知攻击框架，在固定计算预算下自适应分配优化预算。

Result: 多种攻击算法实验表明 Quad-CLEVER 与观测到的优化代价持续相关。在 BDD100K 上，图像级攻击成功率最高提升 5.78%，平均优化代价最多减少 11.42 次迭代；在更具挑战性的 EventPed 数据集上节省 2.25 次迭代，同时保持可比的攻击性能。

Conclusion: 攻击难度可在优化前被有效估计，且利用该估计能够实现计算效率更高的对抗攻击。

Abstract: Adversarial attacks against object detectors are traditionally studied from an optimization perspective, where attack difficulty is regarded as an outcome observed only after adversarial optimization. This raises a fundamental question: \emph{can the relative attack difficulty of different inputs be characterized before optimization begins?} In this paper, we investigate this question for person-vanishing attacks by introducing the concept of pre-optimization attack difficulty, which captures intrinsic differences in optimization effort across input images. To estimate this latent difficulty before optimization, we propose Quad-CLEVER, an efficient geometry-based estimator derived from a quadratic approximation of the local person-vanishing margin along the most attack-relevant direction. Extensive experiments across multiple attack algorithms demonstrate that Quad-CLEVER consistently correlates with the observed optimization cost, providing empirical evidence that attack difficulty exhibits a predictable pre-optimization structure. Building upon this finding, we further propose a difficulty-aware attack framework that leverages the estimated difficulty to adaptively allocate optimization budgets for a base attack under a fixed computational budget. On BDD100K, the proposed framework improves the image-level attack success rate by up to 5.78$\%$ while reducing the average optimization cost by up to 11.42 iterations. On the more challenging EventPed dataset, it saves 2.25 optimization iterations while maintaining comparable attack performance. These results demonstrate that attack difficulty can be meaningfully estimated before optimization and that exploiting such estimates enables more computationally efficient adversarial attacks.

</details>


### [318] [SubjectAnchor: Subject-Aware Memory-to-Video for Multi-Shot Storytelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34502)
*Xinyu Wang,Huafeng Shi,Zian Li,Yan Zhou,Xiaoqiang Liu,Yue Ma,Pengfei Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SubjectAnchor，一种主体感知的"记忆到视频"范式，通过显式视觉记忆条件生成多镜头叙事视频，保持主体身份与场景一致性，同时保留逐镜头提示的可控性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多镜头叙事视频生成中，跨剪辑切换时需保持主体身份与场景一致性，同时又要保留逐镜头提示的可控性，现有方法难以兼顾。基于显式视觉记忆的方案有望解决这一问题。

Method: 基于 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B 构建，包含三个关键组件：主体相关记忆构建（追踪每个主体历史出现并检索最相关预计算关键帧，形成紧凑记忆库）；主体感知时间旋转位置编码（不同主体分配至分离的负时间槽以减少身份干扰）；记忆感知注意力分区（在同一骨干网络内调控记忆 token 与生成内容的交互）。记忆帧作为显式视觉条件编码进模型输入。

Result: 实验表明，SubjectAnchor 相比代表性的基于记忆的方法和整体式基线，提升了跨镜头身份一致性，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量。

Conclusion: 该公式化方法既保留了显式视觉记忆的外观锚定能力，又与脚本驱动的逐镜头生成保持兼容，为多镜头叙事视频生成提供了有效方案。

Abstract: We present SubjectAnchor, a Subject-Aware Memory-to-Video paradigm for multi-shot storytelling in which the current shot is generated by conditioning on explicit visual memories extracted from previous shots. The objective is to preserve subject identity and scene consistency across cuts while retaining the controllability of shot-wise prompting. Built on Wan2.2-I2V-A14B, SubjectAnchor contains three key components: subject-related memory construction, subject-aware temporal rotary position encoding, and memory-aware attention partition. For each target shot, the method constructs a compact memory bank by tracing each required subject to its historical appearance and retrieving the most relevant precomputed keyframes. These memory frames are encoded into the model input as explicit visual conditions, while different subjects are assigned to separated negative temporal slots to reduce identity interference. In addition, memory-aware attention partition regulates the interaction between memory tokens and generated content within a shared backbone. This formulation preserves the appearance anchoring of explicit visual memory while remaining compatible with script-driven shot-by-shot generation. Experiments show that SubjectAnchor improves cross-shot identity consistency over representative memory-based and holistic baselines while maintaining competitive visual quality.

</details>


### [319] [XFlow: A Workflow Model for Instruction-Guided Lesion Segmentation in Chest X-rays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34513)
*Geon Choi,Hangyul Yoon,Hyunki Park,Sang Hoon Seo,Edward Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出XFlow，一种模拟放射科医生由粗到细感知流程的指令引导病灶分割工作流模型，结合基于框的定位与多轮点提示细化，在内部和外部评测上取得最佳分割质量，并超越ROSALIA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学文本引导分割模型仅覆盖胸片（CXR）中狭窄的解剖结构与病灶范围，且大多假设查询目标必然存在。指令引导病灶分割（ILS）及首个模型ROSALIA虽解决了这些问题，但其生成的掩码质量有限、常带散乱噪声，且为单次预测，与放射科医生先整体扫查、再定位异常区域、最后精修病灶轮廓的由粗到细多级感知过程根本不同。

Method: 受放射科医生由粗到细、多级感知过程启发，提出XFlow工作流模型，将基于框的定位与多轮点提示细化相结合。XFlow先检测左右肺，判断各肺中是否存在所查询的征象，再用病灶框提示微调后的SAM获得初始掩码；随后通过点提示持续校正该掩码，直至其边界贴合病灶，并使每一中间决策都可见。

Result: 实验表明，XFlow在内部与外部评测上均取得最佳分割质量。尤其在与ROSALIA使用相同病灶标注训练的情况下，XFlow的分割质量仍超过ROSALIA。代码与模型权重将公开。

Conclusion: XFlow通过模拟放射科医生由粗到细的多级感知流程，将框级定位与多轮点细化结合，显著提升指令引导病灶分割的质量与可解释性，并超越现有方法ROSALIA。

Abstract: Existing text-guided segmentation models in the medical domain cover only a narrow set of anatomical structures and lesions in chest X-rays (CXRs), and most of them assume that the queried target is always present in the image. Instruction-guided lesion segmentation (ILS) was introduced to overcome these limitations by segmenting diverse lesion types from simple user instructions while also recognizing when the queried lesion is absent, and ROSALIA was proposed as the first model for this task. However, the masks produced by ROSALIA remain of limited quality, often carrying scattered noise. Moreover, ROSALIA predicts the mask in a single shot, which differs fundamentally from how radiologists perceive and delineate lesions in practice. A radiologist first surveys the entire thorax, then localizes the approximate region of abnormality, and only then refines the lesion contour. Motivated by this coarse-to-fine, multi-level perception process, we present XFlow, a workflow model for ILS that combines box-based localization with multi-turn point refinement. XFlow detects the lungs, decides whether the queried finding is present in each of them, and prompts a fine-tuned SAM with the lesion box for an initial mask. It then corrects that mask through point prompts until its boundary follows the lesion, leaving every intermediate decision visible. Our experiments show that XFlow achieves the best segmentation quality on both internal and external evaluation. Notably, it surpasses ROSALIA in segmentation quality even when the two are trained on the same lesion annotations. Code and model weights will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [320] [Evidence Before Accuracy: A MRI-PET Fusion Network for Alzheimer Disease Classification with Causal Regional Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34520)
*Saeid Firouzi Daghigh,Saeed Ayat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出融合T1 MRI与FDG PET的多平面网络用于AD分类，在取得AUC 0.962的同时，通过捷径控制、标签置换、ROI消融与归因分析，证明模型依赖AD相关神经生物学证据而非数据伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AD分类的深度学习模型常报告近乎完美的判别性能，但很少有工作证明这些性能来自AD相关的神经生物学基础，而非数据集伪影、被试层面泄漏或非脑图像内容。因此需要一套证据框架来验证模型所依赖的信息是否具有生物学合理性。

Method: 构建融合T1 MRI与FDG PET、覆盖轴位/冠状位/矢状位的融合网络，在ADNI的554对配对被试上训练；进行仅验证集上的切片中心与邻层间距搜索以量化模态、平面与切片几何的影响；随后建立证据层，包括捷径控制（轮廓、外部区域、空白图像）、标签置换零假设、正向与反向ROI消融，以及归因方法定量比较（遮挡敏感性）。

Result: 融合模型达到AUC 0.962、准确率0.909、F1 0.891，性能与近期3D CNN及多模态Transformer相当但成本更低。切片几何搜索使MRI的AUC变动0.180、PET变动0.078，MRI倾向窄间距、PET倾向宽间距，所选冠状位中心分别落在海马体与后扣带。捷径控制使模型AUC降至0.622（轮廓）、0.608（外部）、0.500（空白），标签置换零假设为0.456。正向ROI消融显示掩蔽MRI内侧颞叶皮层与PET后部默认模式网络对AD logit影响最大，而面积匹配对照与零假设无异。反向ROI消融显示MRI内侧颞叶单独保留89.2%的高于随机判别力，PET后部DMN单独保留79.0%。遮挡敏感性在AD先验区域内富集达3.5–5.0×，对照区仅0.10–0.43×。

Conclusion: 消融与归因分析独立地确立了一个生物学上正确的双重分离：海马证据由MRI承载，后扣带证据由PET承载，表明该模型的判别性能建立于AD相关神经生物学基础之上，而非数据集伪影。

Abstract: Deep learning models for Alzheimer disease (AD) classification routinely report near-perfect discrimination, yet few are shown to rest on AD-relevant neurobiology rather than on dataset artifacts, subject-level leakage, or non-brain image content. We present a fusion network combining T1 MRI and FDG PET across axial, coronal, and sagittal planes, trained on ADNI consists of 554 paired subjects. The fusion model reaches AUC 0.962, accuracy 0.909, and F1 0.891, competitive with recent 3D CNN and multimodal transformer systems at substantially lower cost. We first quantify how much modality, plane and slice geometry matter. A validation-only search over slice centres and neighbour spacings moves AUC by 0.180 for MRI and 0.078 for PET, selecting narrow spacing for MRI and wide spacing for PET, with the chosen coronal centres falling on the hippocampal body and on the posterior cingulate respectively. The contribution, however, is the evidence layer built around that number. Shortcut controls collapse the model to AUC 0.622 (silhouette), 0.608 (exterior), and 0.500 (blank), and a label-permutation null yields 0.456. Forward region-of-interest (ROI) ablation shows that masking medial temporal cortex in MRI and the posterior default-mode network (DMN) in PET produces the largest shift in the AD logit, while area-matched controls remain indistinguishable from that null. Reverse ROI ablation shows that the medial temporal lobe alone retains 89.2% of above-chance discrimination in MRI and the posterior DMN alone retains 79.0% in PET. A quantitative comparison of attribution methods shows occlusion sensitivity reaching 3.5-5.0* enrichment inside a priori AD regions against 0.10-0.43* in controls. Ablation and attribution independently establish a biologically correct double dissociation: hippocampal evidence is carried by MRI, posterior cingulate evidence by PET.

</details>


### [321] [SAGE: Subspace Alignment for Classifier-Free Guidance in Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34525)
*Boyu Zhang,Yangming Cheng,Ning Zhang,Pengfei Liu,Weijie Li,Yifan Gao,Hangyu Li,Litong Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现扩散Transformer与MoE结合时，CFG两条分支独立路由会导致激活子空间错位，从而在高引导尺度下坍塌；提出SAGE正则化器对齐无条�件激活到条件子空间，无需推理开销，显著改善生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE路由的扩散Transformer是扩展生成模型的主流方案，而CFG对生成质量至关重要。但作者发现二者结合存在一个此前未被报道的失败模式：CFG的两条分支独立路由，导致各自的激活落在不同子空间，无条件写入偏离条件子空间，CFG会随引导尺度线性放大这一残差，引发高引导下的坍塌。

Method: 提出SAGE——一种训练时正则化器。它在不限制路由多样性的前提下，将无条件MoE激活对齐到条件子空间，且不带来任何推理成本。

Result: 玩具实验显示SAGE将极端漂移大幅抑制了9.2倍；扩展到10亿参数文本到图像模型时，显著提升生成质量，DPG-Bench峰值性能提升9.3%。大量实验表明SAGE持续优于基线。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了CFG与MoE扩散Transformer结合中的子空间错位失效机制，并给出一种零推理开销、可扩展的训练时解决方案SAGE，在大规模文本到图像任务上验证了有效性。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing are a leading recipe for scaling generative models. Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is essential for generation quality, yet excessively high guidance scales trigger collapse. We identify a previously unreported failure mode in their combination: the two CFG branches route independently, so their realized activations occupy different subspaces. The unconditional write then leaves the conditional subspace, and CFG amplifies that residual linearly in the guidance scale. We propose SAGE, a training-time regularizer that aligns unconditional MoE activations to the conditional subspace without restricting routing diversity, at zero inference cost. Toy experiments show that SAGE dramatically suppresses extreme drift by 9.2x. When scaled to a 1B-parameter text-to-image model, SAGE significantly improves generation quality, delivering a 9.3% boost in peak DPG-Bench performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAGE consistently outperforms the baseline.

</details>


### [322] [RRG-SLAM: Real-time Reflection-aware Gaussian SLAM for Indoor Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34527)
*Yong Liu,Keyang Ye,Zhexi Peng,Ruixian Mei,Kun Zhou,Tianjia Shao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出首个面向室内场景的实时反射感知高斯SLAM系统，采用反射感知的TSDF-Gaussian混合表示，将漫反射外观与反射分量显式分离，实现三阶段渲染与在线重建，在反射环境下的重建质量、跟踪鲁棒性和新视角渲染上均优于现有方法，且保持实时性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 室内场景中普遍存在镜面/平面反射，会干扰几何重建与相机跟踪。现有多数SLAM系统未显式建模反射分量，导致重建质量下降、跟踪鲁棒性不足，且缺乏实时性。

Method: 提出反射感知的TSDF-Gaussian混合表示：基础场景由TSDF体素与一组基础高斯表示几何与漫反射外观，平面反射由与检测到的反射平面关联的反射高斯组表示。渲染分三阶段：先TSDF光线投射得到表面颜色、深度、平面ID与反射掩码；再对基础高斯做无序渲染与深度剔除并与TSDF输出合成基础图像；最后依据平面ID图将各反射组高斯仅光栅化到对应平面区域生成反射图像，经反射掩码合成输出。在线重建中先经反射感知跟踪估计位姿，抑制反射主导区域干扰，再利用几何、语义与时序线索识别反射平面，将观测融合进带反射感知属性的增强TSDF体积，随后在线初始化、优化与剪枝基础与反射高斯。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在含反射的室内环境下，重建质量、跟踪鲁棒性与新视角渲染效果均优于现有SLAM系统，同时保持实时性能。

Conclusion: 通过显式分离漫反射与反射分量并采用混合表示与三阶段渲染，可在实时约束下有效提升含反射室内场景的SLAM重建与渲染表现。

Abstract: We introduce the first real-time reflection-aware Gaussian SLAM system for indoor scenes. The system features a reflection-aware TSDF-Gaussian hybrid representation that explicitly separates diffuse scene appearance from reflection components. The base scene is modeled by a TSDF volume and a set of base Gaussians capturing geometry and diffuse appearance, while planar reflections are represented by reflection Gaussian groups associated with detected reflective planes. The rendering is performed in three passes: TSDF raycasting first yields surface color, depth, plane IDs and reflection masks; base Gaussians are then rendered order-independently with depth culling and combined with the TSDF output to form the base image; finally, under the guidance of the plane ID map, reflection Gaussians from different reflection groups are rasterized only into their corresponding planar regions to generate the reflection image, which is subsequently composited with the base image via the reflection mask to produce the final output. For online reconstruction, our system first estimates the camera pose through reflection-aware tracking to suppress interference of reflection-dominated regions. It then identifies reflective planes using geometric, semantic, and temporal cues, and fuses the observations into the augmented TSDF volume with reflection-aware attributes. Afterwards the base and reflection Gaussians are initialized, optimized, and pruned online to maintain both reconstruction quality and efficiency. Experiments on a variety of datasets show that our method outperforms existing SLAM systems in reconstruction quality, tracking robustness, and novel-view rendering for indoor environments with reflections, while preserving real-time performance.

</details>


### [323] [Preference-Guided Adaptation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation via Prompt Disagreement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34528)
*Hyun-Kurl Jang,Jihun Kim,Kuk-Jin Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出偏好引导的开放词汇语义分割自适应框架，用二值偏好替代密集掩码监督，在MESS基准上无需像素级标注即取得稳定增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放词汇语义分割在医学影像、遥感、工业检测等专业领域性能下降，而这些领域获取密集像素级掩码成本高且需专业知识。因此需要一种无需密集标注的自适应方法。

Method: 观察到不同提示模板对同一图像产生系统性不同的分割结果（称为提示分歧），将其作为内置的偏好监督来源。从跨模板不确定性高的区域挖掘局部化偏好查询，采用区域局部化偏好优化（RLPO）并结合一致性正则化，稳定查询区域之外的更新。

Result: 在MESS基准上的大量实验中，该方法在多种OVSS骨干网络上无需任何像素级标注即取得一致增益，并在存在噪声偏好时依然有效。

Conclusion: 偏好引导的自适应框架可有效替代密集掩码监督，缓解专业领域OVSS性能退化问题，具有良好的泛化性与鲁棒性，代码已开源。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) enables pixel-level prediction over arbitrary text-specified vocabularies and has shown strong generalization on common benchmarks. However, OVSS performance often degrades in specialized domains such as medical imaging, remote sensing, and industrial inspection, where dense pixel-level masks for adaptation are costly to obtain and require domain-specific expertise. We propose a preference-guided adaptation framework that replaces dense mask supervision with binary preferences. We observe that different prompt templates produce systematically different segmentations for the same image, a phenomenon we call prompt disagreement, and we repurpose it as a built-in source of preference supervision. Building on this, we mine localized preference queries from regions of high cross-template uncertainty, and adapt the OVSS model with Region-Localized Preference Optimization (RLPO) together with consistency regularization that stabilizes updates outside the queried region. Across extensive experiments on the MESS benchmark, the proposed method achieves consistent gains across diverse OVSS backbones without any pixel-level annotation, and remains effective under noisy preferences. Our code is available at https://github.com/blue-531/pref-ovss.

</details>


### [324] [TSGate: Timestep-Aware Gated Attention for Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34539)
*Boyu Zhang,Yifan Liu,Shuxia Lin,Qingjian Ni,Yinfei Xu,Xu Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对扩散Transformer(DiT)在域外(OOD)提示下生成质量下降的问题，提出时间步感知门控注意力TSGate，通过引入时间步条件偏置改善去噪过程中的门控行为，raw-prompt DPG分数较基线提升9.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiT已成高保真图像与视频生成的主流架构，近年系统越来越多采用结构化提示训练以提升描述质量和提示遵循度。然而面对OOD提示（如用户推理时的自由形式描述），生成质量会严重下降。基于LLM的重写虽可将提示转为结构化格式，但无法保证重写结果与训练分布对齐。作者将这种退化归因于attention sink以及早期去噪步骤中图文注意力减弱。

Method: 作者分析发现，仅抑制sink并不足以恢复生成质量；即使有效抑制sink，使用标准门控注意力的模型在早期步骤仍存在图文注意力降低和生成质量欠佳的问题。为此提出Timestep-Aware Gated Attention (TSGate)，在门控信号中注入时间步条件偏置，使门控行为能随去噪步骤自适应调整。

Result: 大量实验表明，TSGate在多个基准上持续优于基线以及标准门控注意力方法，raw-prompt DPG分数相比基线提升9.5%。

Conclusion: 通过引入时间步条件门控偏置，TSGate有效缓解了OOD提示下的生成质量退化问题，验证了时间步自适应门控在提升DiT提示遵循度和生成质量方面的有效性与通用性。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have emerged as the dominant architecture for high-fidelity image and video generation. Recent DiT systems increasingly use structured prompts for training, improving caption quality and prompt adherence. However, their generation quality can degrade severely under out-of-domain (OOD) prompts, including the free-form descriptions supplied by users at inference time. Although LLM-based rewriting can convert these prompts into structured formats, it does not guarantee that the rewritten prompts align with the training distribution. Our analysis links this degradation to attention sinks and reduced early-step image-to-text attention and shows that sink suppression alone is insufficient to restore generation quality. Despite effective sink suppression, models trained with standard gated attention exhibit reduced early-step image-to-text attention and suboptimal generation quality. Based on these insights, we propose Timestep-Aware Gated Attention (TSGate), which injects a timestep-conditioned bias into the gate signal so that gating behavior adapts across denoising steps. Extensive experiments show that TSGate consistently outperforms both the baseline and standard gated attention across multiple benchmarks, improving the raw-prompt DPG score by 9.5% over the baseline.

</details>


### [325] [ActionLens: Diagnosing Spatial-Temporal Binding Failures in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34547)
*Gueter Josmy Faure,Min-Hung Chen,Hao Ping Wang,Timothée Lardy,Hung-Ting Su,Winston H. Hsu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ActionLens诊断基准，含6701道视频选择题，揭示视觉语言模型在时空绑定上的五类失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频视觉语言模型在流行基准上得分超80%，但在时空绑定（把正确动作关联到正确人物、正确时刻）上表现不佳，缺乏针对性诊断工具。

Method: 构建ActionLens：6701道多选题，覆盖过渡检测、特定角色识别、并发动作绑定、有向交互推理、注视检测五项诊断；真值由158万条每秒每人标注确定性推导；经14轮人工质量工程；评测20个VLM，并做参考接口控制与绑定陷阱分析。

Result: 全量集最高分68.8%；人工复核子集上最高65.9%，人类参考91.0%；注视检测接近随机而人类89.6%；关系描述相对静态坐标提升5.55–13.25分，视觉框仍领先各模型1.15–6.50分；模型系统性选错动作归属者。

Conclusion: ActionLens可跨模型族与规模诊断上述不同失败模式并支持直接对比；数据、代码与评测脚本已开源。

Abstract: Video-capable vision-language models score above 80\% on popular benchmarks yet struggle with spatial-temporal binding: associating the right action with the right person at the right moment. We introduce ActionLens, a diagnostic benchmark of 6,701 multiple-choice video questions spanning five targeted diagnostics: transition detection, actor-specific identification, concurrent action binding, directed interaction reasoning, and gaze detection. Ground-truth answers are derived deterministically from 1.58 million per-second, per-person annotations. Fourteen rounds of human quality engineering raised answer clarity from 53% to above 90% human accuracy. Across 20 VLMs, the full-set leader scores 68.8%; on the human-reviewed subset, it scores 65.9% versus 91.0% for the pooled human reference. Gaze detection remains near chance against 89.6% human accuracy. On actor disambiguation, reference-interface controls show that relational descriptions recover 5.55--13.25 points over static coordinates, confirming a substantial numeric-parsing penalty; yet visual boxes still lead every model by 1.15--6.50 points, exposing a residual unboxed actor-resolution gap. A binding-trap analysis shows models systematically select the wrong actor's action. ActionLens provides diagnostic measurements of these distinct failure modes across model families and scales for direct comparison. We release all data, code, and evaluation scripts at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/lmms-eval-2276

</details>


### [326] [ACPruner: Visual Token Pruning as Biased Attention Coverage Maximization in LVLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34558)
*Xu Li,Yuxuan Liang,Yi Zheng,Zhe Liu,Xiaolei Chen,Haotian Chen,Rui Zhu,Fan Shi,Xiangyang Xue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ACPruner，一种免训练的视觉 token 剪枝框架，将剪枝重新建模为“有偏注意力覆盖最大化”问题，在多个 LVLM 上实现性能保持与显著推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLM 因视觉 token 数量庞大而存在计算低效问题。现有视觉 token 剪枝方法主要聚焦于“保留单个重要 token”或“选择互不相同的 token”两种思路，缺乏从整体覆盖角度统一考虑，因此需要新的视角来兼顾重要性与多样性。

Method: 将视觉 token 剪枝重新表述为有偏注意力覆盖最大化问题：选择紧凑的 token 子集，使其在编码器侧的输出注意力能联合覆盖整张图像，同时给信息量更高的区域分配更高的覆盖优先级。ACPruner 首先结合模态内显著性与模态间相关性估计 token 重要性，然后根据视觉编码器内部的注意力模式推导 token 级别的覆盖度，最后通过贪心选择最大化所提出的覆盖目标，全程无需训练。

Result: 在 LLaVA-1.5-7B/13B、LLaVA-NeXT-7B/13B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 等多个 LVLM 骨干上实验，ACPruner 在保持较强性能的同时实现了显著的端到端推理加速，且表现一致稳定。

Conclusion: 从覆盖视角统一处理视觉 token 的重要性与多样性是有效的剪枝思路，ACPruner 作为一种免训练、通用性强的框架，可跨多种 LVLM 架构在效率与性能之间取得良好平衡。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) face significant computational inefficiencies caused by the large number of visual tokens. Existing visual token pruning methods mainly focus on either retaining individually important tokens or selecting mutually diverse ones. In this work, we revisit visual token pruning from a coverage perspective and formulate it as a biased attention coverage maximization problem. The key idea is to select a compact token subset whose encoder-side outgoing attention can jointly cover the image while assigning higher coverage priority to more informative regions. From this perspective, we propose ACPruner, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient LVLM inference. ACPruner first estimates token importance by combining intra-modal saliency and inter-modal relevance, then derives token-wise coverage from attention patterns within the vision encoder, and finally performs greedy selection to maximize the proposed coverage objective. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLM backbones, including LLaVA-1.5-7B/13B, LLaVA-NeXT-7B/13B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and LLaVA-OneVision-7B, show that ACPruner consistently achieves strong performance retention while delivering substantial end-to-end inference speedups.

</details>


### [327] [Rethinking Latent Visual Reasoning: Grounding Latent Reasoning in Visual Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34563)
*Xi Xiao,Tianchen Zhao,Youngeun Kim,Zhuowei Li,Linghan Xu,Jiaye Wu,Zheng Zhang,Xiang Xu,Xuanbai Chen,Farhan Tejani,Jakub Zablocki,Julia Xu,Yifan Xing*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文分析潜空间视觉推理（LVR）存在的问题，提出ReaLVR框架，通过对比正确答案与模型生成的错误答案、以及相关与不匹配的视觉证据，为潜token提供显式监督，在三类模型家族上均超越已有LVR基线，并首次将潜空间视觉推理扩展至235B规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜空间视觉推理让多模态大模型在连续潜token中完成中间计算，而非用文字表达每一步推理。但与文本CoT不同，潜推理不可直接观测，难以监督潜token学到了什么。作者通过分析潜token行为，发现存在"潜证据-信用缺口"：潜token对会改变正确答案的图像扰动反应很弱。作者假设该问题源于GRPO训练中缺乏显式监督，仅靠最终答案奖励无法指导模型保留哪些视觉证据、也无法在潜token间合理分配信用。

Method: 提出ReaLVR，将视觉证据监督引入模型自身自由运行的潜轨迹中。方法包含两方面：一是对比正确答案与模型生成的错误答案，确定哪里需要更强的监督；二是对比相关与不匹配的视觉证据，明确应保留什么内容。

Result: 在三类模型家族上，ReaLVR一致优于所评估的LVR基线，在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上取得五项任务平均63.7%的最高成绩。首次实现潜空间视觉推理的规模化，在高达235B的前沿模型规模上仍能带来稳健提升。进一步分析显示，潜token位置对问题更敏感、与相关视觉区域对齐更强，且最受关注潜token对固定上下文的依赖更大。

Conclusion: ReaLVR通过为潜轨迹引入视觉证据监督，弥补了LVR中潜证据-信用缺口，显著提升多模态推理性能，并首次验证了潜空间视觉推理可扩展至前沿模型规模。

Abstract: Latent visual reasoning (LVR) enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to perform intermediate computation in continuous latent tokens rather than expressing every reasoning step in words. However, unlike textual CoT, latent reasoning is not directly observable, making it difficult to supervise what latent tokens learn. In this work, we first conduct a thorough analysis of latent-token behavior and identify a latent evidence-credit gap: latent tokens respond only weakly to image perturbations that alter the correct answer. We hypothesize that this issue stems from the lack of explicit supervision during GRPO training. These findings suggest that a final-answer reward provides too little guidance on what visual evidence to preserve or how credit should be assigned across latent tokens. To bridge this gap, we propose ReaLVR, which brings visual-evidence supervision to the model's own free-running latent trajectories. ReaLVR contrasts correct and model-generated wrong answers to determine where stronger supervision is needed, and relevant and mismatched visual evidence to specify what to preserve. Across three model families, ReaLVR consistently outperforms evaluated LVR baselines, achieving the highest five-task average of 63.7% on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Crucially, we are the first to scale visual reasoning in latent space, showing that our framework continues to deliver robust improvements at frontier model scales up to 235B. Further analyses show more question-sensitive latent-token positions, stronger alignment with relevant visual regions, and greater fixed-context dependence on the most attended latent tokens.

</details>


### [328] [GLF-Q: Global-Local Feature-based Quantization for Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34564)
*Peilin Sun,Guang Liang,Jin Tong,Jianxin Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 GLF-Q，一种基于全局-局部特征对齐的后训练量化框架，在 3-bit 的 ViT 量化任务上显著超越现有方法，并具备良好的域外校准鲁棒性和 8-bit GPU 部署加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于优化的 PTQ 方法依赖软 logits 或二阶 Hessian 近似进行块重建，前者在有限校准数据上易过拟合，后者存在结构截断误差，导致低比特下 ViT 量化精度严重下降。

Method: GLF-Q 将量化块输出经下游全精度层传播，在局部输出正则下对齐倒数第二层表示，实现无需 Hessian 近似或泰勒展开的下游特征监督；同时引入零运行时开销的离线 Hadamard 变换以分散激活离群值、收缩动态范围；并用 STE 优化该损失以快速收敛，避免 AdaRound 类连续松弛取整。

Result: 在多种代表性 ViT 架构上，GLF-Q 配合标准均匀量化器在 3-bit 图像分类量化下大幅超越 SOTA 方法，并展现出强的域外校准鲁棒性，且在 8-bit GPU 部署下取得加速。

Conclusion: GLF-Q 通过全局-局部特征对齐替代 logits 或 Hessian 监督，并结合 Hadamard 变换与 STE 优化，为低比特 ViT 后训练量化提供了高效且鲁棒的解决方案。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) efficiently compresses Vision Transformers (ViTs) without retraining, yet suffers severe accuracy degradation at low bit-widths. Existing optimization-based PTQ methods guide block reconstruction via either soft logits or second-order Hessian proxies. Logit supervision is prone to overfitting on limited calibration data, while Hessian approximations incur structural truncation errors. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{GLF-Q}, a novel PTQ framework guided by Global-Local Feature alignment. GLF-Q propagates quantized block outputs through downstream full-precision layers to align penultimate-layer representations under local output regularization, providing downstream feature supervision without explicitly approximating the Hessian or using a Taylor expansion. Furthermore, offline Hadamard transformations are introduced with zero runtime overhead to disperse activation outliers across channels, effectively contracting dynamic ranges and reducing quantization errors. Meanwhile, optimizing this loss via a Straight-Through Estimator (STE) achieves rapid convergence, bypassing continuous relaxation rounding formulations such as AdaRound. Extensive experiments across representative ViT architectures demonstrate that GLF-Q with standard uniform quantizers substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods under 3-bit quantization on image classification. In addition, GLF-Q exhibits strong out-of-domain calibration robustness and achieves speedups under 8-bit GPU deployment.

</details>


### [329] [Recent Advances in Agentic Agri-Robotic Phenotyping: A Perspective Review from Fragmented Multimodal Sensing to Unified PhenoAgent Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34567)
*Muhammad Owais,Ehtesham Iqbal,Samee Ullah Khan,Muhammad Umraiz,Yusra Abdulrahman,Irfan Hussain*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该综述回顾了植物表型从人工测量到高通量、机器人化及AI驱动的发展历程，提出将表型研究重新定义为"种子-土壤-植株-环境-管理"（SSPEM）智能问题，并构建了面向作物状态解释与决策支持的PhenoAgent概念框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表型系统虽在成像、自主平台、多模态感知和深度学习方面取得进展，但仍碎片化于传感模态、作物性状、生长阶段、环境与管理目标之间，缺乏时间整合、多模态推理、生物学解释与可执行决策支持。作者因此希望以整体化视角整合分散进展。

Method: 采用综述与概念构建方法：综合传统、高通量、机器人化及AI驱动表型方法的进展与局限，并以SSPEM整合框架重新组织表型问题，提出PhenoAgent智能体概念框架，将多模态表型与智能体AI及闭环决策支持相连接。

Result: 系统梳理了各类表型技术的能力与持续存在的局限；提出PhenoAgent可实现从孤立性状估计转向基于证据的作物状态解释、不确定性感知推理和管理导向支持，回答作物正在发生什么、为何发生、缺失何种证据以及应采取何种行动或补充测量等问题。同时讨论了数据稀缺、标注、基准测试、模型泛化与可解释性等挑战。

Conclusion: 通过将多模态表型与智能体AI及闭环决策支持相结合，该综述为可解释、可扩展且面向部署的作物智能描绘了发展路径。

Abstract: This review examines the evolution of plant phenotyping from conventional manual trait measurement to high-throughput, robotic, and artificial intelligence-driven crop monitoring. Despite significant advances in imaging, autonomous platforms, multimodal sensing, and deep learning, current phenotyping systems remain fragmented across sensing modalities, crop traits, growth stages, environments, and management objectives. We therefore frame phenotyping as an integrated \emph{seed-soil-plant-environment-management} (SSPEM) intelligence problem, where crop performance reflects interactions among seed quality, root-zone conditions, plant development, environmental exposure, and management actions. The review synthesizes conventional, high-throughput, robotic, and AI-driven phenotyping approaches, highlighting their capabilities and persistent limitations in temporal integration, multimodal reasoning, biological interpretation, and actionable decision support. Building on this analysis, we introduce a conceptual PhenoAgent framework that extends phenotyping beyond the estimation of isolated traits to evidence-based crop-state interpretation, uncertainty-aware reasoning, and management-oriented support. The PhenoAgent concept primarily brings together scattered advances in phenotyping to deliver insights ranging from detailed to high-level, such as what is happening in the crop, why it might be occurring, what evidence is missing, and what actions or additional measurements should be considered. We also discuss challenges in dataset scarcity, annotation, benchmarking, model generalization, and explainability. By linking multimodal phenotyping with agentic AI and closed-loop decision support, this review outlines a path to interpretable, scalable, and deployment-oriented crop intelligence.

</details>


### [330] [GenNVS: Geometry-enhanced Novel View Synthesis via Disentangled 3D Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34579)
*Yajiao Xiong,Youyu Luan,Xiaoyu Zhou,Yongtao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GenNVS：通过解耦3D先验与视频扩散模型实现几何增强的单图新视角合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单图新视角合成的核心难点在于底层3D几何高度模糊，现有扩散方法虽能生成看似合理的结果，但难以保持前景物体的几何结构与空间一致性。

Method: 用3D高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）分别对前景物体与背景建模，并通过由粗到细的几何优化对齐，构建统一3D场景；该场景通过提出的双流掩码机制（Dual-Stream Masking）联合利用渲染有效性掩码与几何感知的变形（warping）来条件化视频扩散模型。

Result: 在视觉质量与几何精度两方面均优于近期方法，并天然支持灵活的场景编辑。

Conclusion: 通过解耦的3D先验与双流掩码条件机制，可有效缓解单图新视角合成中的几何歧义问题。

Abstract: Single-image novel view synthesis remains challenging because the underlying 3D geometry is highly ambiguous. Recent diffusion-based approaches produce plausible results, but they often struggle to preserve the geometric structure and spatial coherence of foreground objects. We present GenNVS, a framework for geometry-enhanced novel view synthesis via a disentangled 3D prior. Specifically, GenNVS models foreground objects and the background with 3D Gaussian Splatting and aligns them through a coarse-to-fine geometric optimization process to form a unified 3D scene.
