For example, small objects may be viewed from far away, whereas large objects may be observed at extremely close range, resulting in unreliable observation likelihoods. Second, objects with substantially different sizes and geometries require distinct mapping behaviors, which are difficult to capture with a single shared value estimator. To investigate these challenges, we introduce a large-scale urban semantic mapping dataset featuring realistic city layouts, high-fidelity rendering, and instance-level annotations spanning multiple object scales. We then propose a category-aware likelihood calibration policy that identifies and alleviates unreliable observations according to object category and viewing distance. Because the calibration and motion policies are optimized toward the same mapping objective, they may learn redundant shortcuts and become excessively coupled. We therefore introduce a mutual-information (MI) regularizer that penalizes their estimated representation dependence and encourages complementary behaviors. To better model heterogeneous mapping strategies across object scales, we further employ category-wise value estimators. We formulate their joint optimization as a Pareto optimization problem to mitigate conflicting gradients across categories.

</details>


### [366] [Transform-Aligned Learned Features for Lossy Point Cloud Attribute Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34834)
*Yueru Chen,Pengpeng Yu,Dingquan Li,Wei Gao,Wei Zhang,Fei Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出变换对齐学习特征（TALF），将属性变换显式应用于学习的空间表示，将其与编码目标对齐，并集成到基于变换的属性编解码器中，在三个基准数据集上取得优于传统与学习基线的率失真性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于变换的方法通过将属性表示为变换系数来实现有效的点云属性压缩。若要将学习到的空间上下文引入该框架，需要将空间表示映射到变换域，但这一已知的基变换通常被留给网络隐式学习，缺乏显式对齐，限制了对编码目标的有效利用。

Method: 提出TALF：对学习到的空间表示施加属性变换，使其显式对齐编码目标。理论分析表明所得特征恰好表示光滑非线性模型的一阶预测项，且泰勒余项有界。将TALF集成到基于变换的属性编解码器中，采用显式系数预测与条件残差熵建模，在统一的系数域率失真目标下优化，同时保留显式的量化步长控制。

Result: 在三个基准数据集和多种变换基上的大量实验表明，TALF相比传统方法与学习基线均能提升率失真性能。

Conclusion: 显式地将属性变换应用于学习到的空间表示，可有效对齐特征与编码目标，为一阶预测提供理论支撑，并在点云属性压缩中带来一致的率失真增益，同时保持量化控制的可解释性。

Abstract: Transform-based methods provide an effective framework for point cloud attribute compression by representing attributes as transform coefficients. Introducing learned spatial context into this framework requires mapping spatial representations to the transform domain, but this known basis change is often left for the network to learn implicitly. We propose Transform-Aligned Learned Features (TALF) by applying the attribute transform to learned spatial representations, explicitly aligning them with the coding targets. Our analysis shows that the resulting features exactly represent the first-order prediction term of a smooth nonlinear model, with a bounded Taylor remainder. We integrate TALF into a transform-based attribute codec with explicit coefficient prediction and conditional residual entropy modeling under a unified coefficient-domain rate--distortion objective, while retaining explicit quantization-step control. Extensive experiments across three benchmark datasets and multiple transform bases demonstrate that TALF improves rate--distortion performance over conventional and learned baselines.

</details>


### [367] [ORAV: Benchmarking Audio-Video Generation from Multimodal Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34843)
*Jiacheng Hua,Xiaokun Feng,Jiaqi Hua,Chang Liu,Biao Wang,Miao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ORAV Bench 音视频生成基准，含380个任务、2-10个异构参考、9种语义角色与30种角色组合，并开发参考感知成对评估协议（与人判断一致率86.08%），揭示5个前沿系统在参考组合上的差异化表现与共同失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使用异构多模态参考进行音视频生成是新出现的挑战，既需要对生成的组合式控制，也需要对多模态上下文的落地理解，但缺乏相应评测基准与可靠评估方法。

Method: 构建 ORAV Bench，包含380个任务实例、2-10个参考、9种语义角色、30种角色组合；指令指定参考间关系，媒体提供需实现的身份、动态与音频特征。提出参考感知成对评估协议：准备视觉与听觉证据，比较各参考的预期贡献，并在两种呈现顺序下核验总体结论。

Result: 协议在留出实例上与人类判断达到86.08%的有效一致率；5个前沿系统的整体排名掩盖了其在不同参考组合上的差异化优势；常见失败模式是复现了非预期的源内容（尽管与参考高度相似）而非所要求的结果；可复现的逐点诊断（质量、参考亲和度、语音）揭示了模型行为的不同维度。

Conclusion: ORAV 为追踪可控、可组合、参考忠实的音视频生成进展提供了基准。

Abstract: Audio-video generation using heterogeneous multimodal references has emerged as a new challenge, requiring both compositional control over generation and grounded understanding of multimodal context. In this paper, we introduce ORAV Bench for Omni Reference Audio-Video Generation, comprising 380 task instances with 2-10 references, 9 semantic roles, and 30 role compositions. Instructions specify the relationships among references; the media supply the identities, dynamics, and audio characteristics to be realized. To evaluate these open-ended outputs, we develop a reference-aware pairwise protocol that prepares visual and auditory evidence, compares the intended contribution of each reference, and checks the overall verdict in both presentation orders. On held-out instances, it achieves 86.08% effective agreement with human judgments. Across 5 frontier systems, overall rankings conceal distinct strengths across reference compositions. A recurring failure is to reproduce unintended source content in place of the requested result, despite closely resembling a reference. Reproducible pointwise diagnostics of quality, reference affinity, and speech reveal distinct dimensions of model behavior. ORAV thus offers a benchmark for tracking progress toward controllable, compositional, and reference-faithful audio-video generation.

</details>


### [368] [EviSplat: Preserving Multi-View Evidence in 3D Gaussian Splatting for Open-Vocabulary Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34853)
*Sungho Moon,Kota Shimomura,Junwoo Park,Wonhyeok Choi,Seunghun Lee,Takayoshi Yamashita,Sunghoon Im*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EviSplat 保留多视角的个体观测特征直至查询时刻，并针对文本查询动态聚合证据，实现开放词汇三维场景理解的最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 的开放词汇三维方法在查询到来前就将多视角观测（如单视图掩码裁剪）整合为语言特征或紧凑物体描述符。但同一物体在不同视角下的观测信息量不同，部分观测对特定查询更关键，另一些则不完整或具误导性；这种查询前的提前整合可能抑制后续查询所需的线索。

Method: EviSplat 将个体观测特征保留在类无关的三维实例（对应物体、物体部件或背景区域）中作为证据。同时为每个 Gaussian 学习一个分布，描述其观测支持哪些视觉外观。给定文本查询时，先用每个实例最相关的观测为其打分，再结合实例级相关性与局部支持证据为每个 Gaussian 计算得分，并按该 Gaussian 被观测的频率与明确程度加权。

Result: 在多种数据集与评测协议上均取得最先进性能，验证了将多视角证据保留至查询时刻并按查询进行聚合的收益。

Conclusion: 将多视角证据保留到查询时刻、并依据查询动态聚合，比查询前的提前整合更有效，不同查询可以从同一份保留证据中提取不同的视觉线索。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding enables object localization and segmentation from free-form text queries without a fixed category vocabulary. Many recent methods build on 3D Gaussian Splatting and consolidate multi-view observations, such as masked crops from individual views, into language features or compact object descriptors before the query is known. However, observations of the same object vary across viewpoints and are not equally informative: some reveal cues relevant to a particular query, whereas others provide incomplete or misleading evidence. Pre-query consolidation can therefore suppress cues on which a later query depends. We introduce EviSplat, which preserves individual observation features as evidence for later text queries. EviSplat retains individual observation features within class-agnostic 3D instances that represent objects, object parts, or background regions. It also learns, for each Gaussian, a distribution describing which visual appearances its observations support. Given a text query, EviSplat scores each instance using its most relevant observations. It then computes a score for each Gaussian by combining instance-level relevance with locally supported evidence, weighted by how often and how unambiguously that Gaussian was observed. Different queries can thus draw on different visual cues from the same preserved evidence. Experiments across diverse datasets and evaluation protocols demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, supporting the benefit of preserving multi-view evidence until query time and aggregating it according to the query.

</details>


### [369] [When Text Matters: Design Principles for Visual Token Pruning in Vision-Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34861)
*Minchan Kang,Kyeonghye Park,Seoyoung Cho,Daeshik Kim,Yucheol Cho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练视觉token剪枝方法DeFT，将早期视觉引导剪枝与延迟文本引导重选分离，在80%/90%剪枝率下平均性能恢复较最优基线提升11.10/16.84个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉-语言模型计算开销大，视觉token剪枝是降低成本的实用手段，但难以保留关键视觉信息导致性能下降：基于图像的token选择会忽略任务相关细节，文本引导的token选择又难以捕捉复杂推理所需的文本-视觉关系。作者发现过早引入文本引导会限制其识别与答案相关视觉区域的能力。

Method: 免训练方法：先利用视觉编码器注意力进行剪枝，保留额外候选token至解码器中点，此时文本到视觉注意力信息量更丰富，再用其确定最终视觉token集合，即把早期视觉引导剪枝与延迟文本引导重选分离。

Result: 在八个基准、三个模型上，80%与90%剪枝率下，性能恢复平均超过最优基线11.10与16.84个百分点，LLM-prefill延迟与多数基线相当或更低。

Conclusion: 文本引导应延迟至解码器中间层使用，视觉引导负责早期剪枝、文本引导负责后期重选，可在高剪枝率下显著恢复性能且不增加推理延迟，代码已开源。

Abstract: Visual token pruning has been widely studied as a practical approach to reducing the computational cost of large vision-language models. However, it struggles to preserve essential visual information, which can lead to substantial performance degradation. In particular, image-based token selection can overlook task-relevant details, while text-guided token selection may fail to capture the text--visual relationships needed for complex reasoning. We find that applying textual guidance too early can limit its ability to identify answer-relevant visual regions, whereas text-to-visual attention becomes more informative at intermediate decoder depths. This finding motivates our training-free method, which separates early vision-guided pruning from deferred text-guided reselection. We first prune visual tokens using vision-encoder attention, retain additional candidates until the decoder midpoint, and then use text-to-visual attention to determine the final visual-token set. Across eight benchmarks and three models, our method outperforms the best-performing baselines by an average of 11.10 and 16.84 percentage points in performance recovery at 80% and 90% pruning, respectively, with comparable or lower LLM-prefill latency than most baselines. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/kmc3661/DeFT

</details>


### [370] [Revisit to Segment: Working Memory Distillation for Reasoning Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34863)
*Cilin Yan,Yilun Qiu,Wanyang Zhang,Rui Zu,Xiaolong Jiang,Yao Hu,Jiayin Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SWiM，通过工作记忆蒸馏增强MLLM推理分割能力，达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM在图像分割中生成的推理痕迹和定位建议可作为工作记忆，重访同一图像和查询时有助提升推理分割，但模型本身在推理时未必能利用此优势。

Method: SWiM框架：根据分割质量选择rollout构建工作记忆，以记忆条件下的模型为教师，在学生生成的轨迹上提供token级分布监督，学生仅接收原始图像和查询；联合优化on-policy自蒸馏与基于结果的强化学习。

Result: 在推理分割基准上大量实验表明SWiM达到state-of-the-art性能。

Conclusion: 验证了工作记忆蒸馏的有效性，使模型在推理时有或无工作记忆均可受益。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have approached image segmentation by reasoning about visual content and predicting target locations. Their generated responses contain reasoning traces and localization proposals that can serve as working memory when revisiting the same image and query. Our exploration reveals that MLLMs benefit from using this self-generated working memory as context, leading to enhanced reasoning segmentation. Motivated by this finding, we seek to strengthen the backbone model's reasoning segmentation capabilities by distilling the guidance gained from revisiting prior attempts, enabling it to benefit with or without working memory at inference time. To this end, we propose Reasoning Segmenter with Working Memory (SWiM), a working-memory distillation framework for reasoning segmentation. Specifically, SWiM selects rollouts based on segmentation quality to construct working memory and uses the memory-conditioned model as a teacher. The teacher provides token-level distributional supervision along student-generated trajectories, while the student receives only the original image and query. Joint optimization of on-policy self-distillation and outcome-based reinforcement learning combines working-memory guidance with direct feedback on segmentation quality. Extensive experiments on reasoning segmentation benchmarks demonstrate that SWiM achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating the effectiveness of working-memory distillation.

</details>


### [371] [P4Q: Co-designing Token Pruning and Quantization for Vision-Language Model Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34867)
*Haizhao Jing,Zhenhao Shang,Haokui Zhang,Rong Xiao,Peng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: P4Q是一个联合优化视觉token剪枝与低比特量化的协同设计框架，在LLaVA-NeXT上实现2.8倍端到端推理加速并保持更高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型性能强但计算和内存开销大，难以高效部署。现有视觉token剪枝与训练后量化分别从序列长度和数值精度两个互补维度降低开销，但通常被独立优化或简单串行应用，二者优化目标不同导致交互关系被忽视，限制了可达成的压缩效果。

Method: P4Q包含两个耦合组件：一是量化感知的视觉token选择策略，在LLM前对投影器输出的特征副本施加伪量化，并基于伪量化特征的统计量选择视觉token，使选择器的特征决策条件化于模拟低比特扰动；二是剪枝感知的量化校准策略，使用与剪枝相同的选择策略，在保留token分布上校准量化模型，使校准过程与部署时的剪枝执行路径对齐。

Result: 在LLaVA-NeXT上，P4Q在八个不同测试集上实现平均2.8倍端到端推理加速，同时比先前的压缩与量化方法保持更高准确率，取得优于独立优化流程的效率-精度权衡。

Conclusion: 通过将视觉token剪枝与低比特量化协同设计，P4Q证明了二者耦合可带来更优的效率-精度权衡，为高效VLM推理提供了实用的协同优化方案。

Abstract: Vision language models have achieved strong performance across a wide range of multimodal applications, yet their substantial computational and memory costs hinder efficient deployment. Visual token pruning and post-training quantization reduce inference overhead along two complementary dimensions, namely sequence length and numerical precision. Existing workflows typically optimize these techniques independently or apply them sequentially. Their distinct optimization objectives leave critical interactions unaddressed and constrain the achievable compression performance. We revisit these designs and present P4Q, a practical co-design framework that jointly optimizes visual token pruning and low-bit quantization for efficient VLM inference. First, P4Q introduces a quantization-aware visual token selection strategy before the LLM. It applies fake quantization to copies of the features produced by the projector and selects visual tokens using statistics computed from these fake-quantized features, thereby conditioning the selector's feature-based decisions on simulated low-bit perturbations. Second, P4Q introduces a pruning-aware quantization calibration strategy. It uses the same selection strategy as pruning to calibrate the quantized model on the retained-token distribution, thereby aligning the calibration process with the pruned execution path used during deployment. By coupling these two components, P4Q achieves substantial inference speedups while maintaining comparable task performance, resulting in a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off than independently optimized pipelines. For instance, on LLaVA-NeXT, P4Q achieves an average end-to-end inference speedup of 2.8x across eight distinct test sets, while retaining higher accuracy than prior compression and quantization methods.

</details>


### [372] [SPOC-Net: Single-Primitive Online Composition Network for GNSS Jamming Set Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34875)
*Zhihan Zeng,Kaihe Wang,José A. López-Salcedo,Gonzalo Seco-Granados,Zhongpei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 SPOC-Net，将 GNSS 干扰识别分解为基本干扰组件集合的识别问题，通过多分辨率时频特征与组件查询实现可扩展识别，在新组合上取得 80.89% 的精确集合准确率，领先最强对比方法 18.77 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠的定位、导航与授时是智能交通、自主系统和天地一体化网络的基础。但现有 GNSS 干扰识别器把每种混合信号当作独立类别，难以扩展到新的干扰组合，泛化能力受限。

Method: 提出 SPOC-Net，将识别问题分解为识别一组基本干扰组件。通过多分辨率时频特征和学习到的组件查询为每种组件类型提供证据；高分辨率分支估计活跃类型数量，结构化解码器结合该估计与组件证据选出有效集合。训练仅使用实测单组件记录作为物理样本，按需合成不同相对功率和干噪比的带标签混合信号；另用十个已列组合的实测混合信号进行模型选择与解码器校准，六个未列组合留作最终测试。

Result: 在 14,220 个独立生成、传导合成并录制的射频混合信号上评估，取得 80.69% 精确集合准确率和 92.84% 微平均 F1 分数；在未参与模型开发的组合上取得 80.89% 精确集合准确率，在所述协议下超过最强对比方法 18.77 个百分点。

Conclusion: SPOC-Net 通过组件化分解与结构化解码，实现了对未见干扰组合的有效泛化，显著优于现有将混合信号视为独立类别的识别方法。

Abstract: Reliable positioning, navigation, and timing support intelligent transportation, autonomous systems, and space-air-ground integrated networks. However, global navigation satellite system (GNSS) jamming recognizers that treat each mixture as a separate class are difficult to extend to new combinations. Therefore, this paper proposes SPOC-Net, which decomposes the recognition problem into identifying a set of basic jamming components. Multi-resolution time-frequency features and learned component queries provide evidence for each component type. A high-resolution branch estimates the number of active types, and a structured decoder combines this estimate with component evidence to select a valid set. For training, measured single-component records are the only physical samples used in gradient optimization. Their associated clean in-phase and quadrature (IQ) sequences are combined on demand during training to produce labeled mixtures with different relative powers and jamming-to-noise ratios. Separate measured mixtures from ten training-listed compositions support model selection and decoder calibration; six other compositions are reserved for final testing. Evaluation on 14,220 independently generated, conductively combined, and recorded radio frequency mixtures yields 80.69% exact-set accuracy and a 92.84% micro-averaged F1 score. On combinations excluded from model development, SPOC-Net achieves 80.89% exact-set accuracy, exceeding the strongest comparison method by 18.77 percentage points under the reported protocols.

</details>


### [373] [SubRot: Signed Gradient Subspace Calibration for VLM Rotation Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34884)
*Zhenhao Shang,Haizhao Jing,Haokui Zhang,Guoting Wei,Rong Xiao,Jianqing Gao,Peng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 SubRot，一种用于视觉-语言模型旋转量化的带符号梯度子空间校准方法，通过在通道空间上对激活梯度的经验 Fisher 矩阵做特征分解，识别敏感通道子空间，并结合一阶符号引导与二阶约束，提升低比特量化下的多模态性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLM 训练后量化方法依赖模态级或 token 级梯度统计，容易受视觉-文本 token 比例及视觉信息位置等跨样本变化影响，统计稳定性差；同时使用绝对值与平均的粗粒度聚合会丢弃梯度符号和通道差异，难以区分模态特定的敏感结构。通道空间提供了跨样本共享的坐标系，更适合捕捉稳定的任务敏感结构。

Method: SubRot 对激活梯度的经验 Fisher 矩阵进行特征分解，识别具有跨样本稳定性、敏感度清晰分离、以及沿特定方向对自回归损失有一致带符号效应的敏感通道子空间。基于局部泰勒展开，沿符号稳定方向使用带符号一阶引导，在其余敏感方向施加二阶约束，同时保留 MSE 以维持整体重建质量，从而将量化误差导向降低损失的方向并控制其幅度。

Result: 在 5 个 VLM 和 5 个基准上，SubRot 在 W4A6 和 W4A4 下相对于 FlatQuant 均取得一致的均分提升，在 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 上达到 1.4 个百分点。W4A4 下所有评估模型的平均精度相对 FP16 退化均控制在 1.4 个百分点以内，而 LLaVA-v1.5-13B 的平均分甚至超过其 FP16 达 0.4 个百分点。

Conclusion: SubRot 通过签名梯度子空间校准有效提升了 VLM 旋转量化的低比特性能，在保持多模态能力方面优于现有方法。

Abstract: Post-training quantization reduces the deployment cost of vision-language models (VLMs), but preserving multimodal capabilities at low bit widths remains challenging. Existing methods rely on modality- or token-level gradient statistics, which are susceptible to cross-sample variations in visual-to-textual token ratios and the positions of visual information, limiting statistical stability. Moreover, overly coarse aggregation through absolute values and averaging discards gradient signs and channel-wise differences, limiting the separation of modality-specific sensitivities. In contrast, the channel space provides a shared coordinate system across samples, making it a more natural basis for capturing stable task-sensitive structures. We therefore propose SubRot, a signed gradient subspace calibration method for VLM rotation quantization. Through eigendecomposition of the empirical Fisher matrix of activation gradients, SubRot identifies a sensitive channel subspace with three properties: cross-sample stability, clear sensitivity separation, and consistent signed effects on the autoregressive loss along certain directions. Guided by a local Taylor expansion, SubRot combines signed first-order guidance along sign-stable directions with second-order constraints along the remaining sensitive directions, while retaining MSE for overall reconstruction quality. This objective steers quantization errors toward loss-decreasing directions while controlling their magnitude. Experiments on five VLMs across five benchmarks show consistent average-score improvements over FlatQuant under W4A6 and W4A4, reaching 1.4 percentage points on LLaVA-NeXT-7B. Under W4A4, average accuracy degradation from FP16 remains within 1.4 percentage points across all evaluated models, while LLaVA-v1.5-13B exceeds its FP16 average score by 0.4 percentage points.

</details>


### [374] [ECHO: Event-Augmented Context with Hindsight and Outlook for Wrist-Only Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34893)
*Xinyue Wang,Yicheng Jiang,Zesen Gan,Junhao He,Jiaxu Wang,Junhao Li,Jingtao Zhang,Tianlun He,Jianan Wang,Isabel Guan,Qiming Shao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ECHO是一种仅用手腕事件相机的潜在世界动作模型，通过事后与前瞻模块为策略提供时空上下文，在极端曝光下显著优于RGB及RGB+事件基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于RGB相机的操作策略在极端曝光下观测质量严重下降。事件相机虽具备高动态范围，但其观测高度依赖相机布置：固定相机漏掉静态场景内容，而手腕相机运动会使已访问区域移出视野，存在时空局限。

Method: 提出ECHO（事件增强上下文与事后/前瞻），一种仅用手腕的潜在世界动作模型，将手腕事件编码为紧凑运动表示。利用预训练事件编码器解释帧间视觉特征变化；事后模块以过去事件流保留夹爪轨迹作为可寻址的视野外上下文；前瞻模块引入可学习事件前瞻查询，监督其预测未来动作的事件窗口，使策略能预判场景变化。

Result: 在仅用手腕的RLBench任务上，正常光照下比RGB和RGB+事件基线分别高20.6和12.0个百分点，严重曝光下降时分别高14.6和11.3个百分点，并超过使用第三人称相机的RGB参考。真实世界手腕事件相机实验验证了在正常与极暗光照下均优于基线的表现。

Conclusion: ECHO通过事件增强的时空上下文建模，有效克服手腕事件相机的空间-时间局限，在极端曝光条件下实现了更强的操作策略鲁棒性。

Abstract: Learning-based manipulation policies relying on RGB cameras often suffer from degraded observations under extreme exposure. Event cameras mitigate this degradation by asynchronously detecting pixel-level intensity changes to offer a high dynamic range. However, their observations heavily depend on camera placement, as fixed cameras miss static scene content while wrist-mounted camera motion causes previously visited regions to leave the field of view. To address these spatial-temporal limitations, we present ECHO (Event-augmented Context with Hindsight and Outlook), a wrist-only latent world action model that encodes wrist events into compact motion representations to provide temporal and spatial context for policy reasoning. Specifically, ECHO utilizes a pretrained event encoder to explain visual-feature changes between frames. Its hindsight module preserves the gripper trajectory with past event stream as addressable off-camera context. Concurrently, the outlook module introduces learnable event foresight queries supervised to anticipate the event window for future actions, enabling the policy to predict upcoming scene changes. Evaluated on wrist-only RLBench tasks, ECHO outperforms RGB and RGB+event baselines by 20.6 and 12.0 percentage points under normal lighting, and by 14.6 and 11.3 points under severe exposure drops, respectively, while also surpassing RGB references using a third-person camera. Real-world experiments with a wrist-mounted event camera validate that ECHO outperforms RGB-only and RGB+event baselines across multiple tasks under both nominal and severely dark lighting. Project page is at https://echo-wam.github.io/.

</details>


### [375] [LVMT: Video Mask Transformer for Long-term Video Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34895)
*Narges Norouzi,Niccol`o Cavagnero,Idil Esen Zulfikar,Bastian Leibe,Gijs Dubbelman,Daan de Geus*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LVMT模型，通过GRU时序传播模块与截断查询传播（TQP）训练策略，解决长视频中长时遮挡的目标跟踪难题，在六个基准上刷新SOTA并保持10倍速度优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线视频分割方法在长且复杂的视频、长时遮挡场景下难以跟踪目标。作者假设其局限源于两点：(i) 时序传播机制无法自适应选择跨时间传播的目标信息；(ii) 因内存需求与梯度消失问题，无法在长视频上训练。

Method: 针对第一点，提出轻量级GRU时序传播模块，可学习选择保留在内存中并跨时间传播的信息。针对第二点，提出截断查询传播（TQP）训练策略：模型分块处理视频帧，块间传播被跟踪目标的信息，但反向传播仅在单个块内进行，从而在无显存溢出、无推理开销、无梯度消失的情况下实现更长的时序监督。由此得到Long-term Video Mask Transformer (LVMT)。

Result: 在六个基准上的大量实验表明，LVMT在多种视频分割任务上均刷新了state of the art，同时保持了其基座高效模型的推理速度，比此前的SOTA快10倍。

Conclusion: LVMT通过可学习的GRU传播与TQP训练策略，有效提升了长视频分割与长时遮挡下的跟踪能力，兼顾精度与效率。

Abstract: Existing online video segmentation methods struggle to track objects in long, complex videos with long-term occlusions. We hypothesize that this limitation is caused by (i) the inability of their temporal propagation mechanism to adaptively select the object information that is propagated across time, and (ii) their inability to be trained on long videos due to memory requirements and vanishing gradients. To address the first limitation, we propose to use a lightweight GRU-based temporal propagation module that can learn to select which information it keeps in memory and propagates across time. Second, to allow training on long videos, we introduce Truncated Query Propagation (TQP), a training strategy in which the model processes a video in chunks of frames, where information about tracked objects is propagated between chunks but backpropagation is only conducted in individual chunks, enabling longer temporal supervision without out-of-memory issues, inference overhead, or vanishing gradients. The resulting model is called the Long-term Video Mask Transformer (LVMT). Extensive experiments on six benchmarks show that LVMT sets a new state of the art across a range of video segmentation tasks, while retaining the speed of the highly efficient model it is based on, making it 10X faster than the prior state of the art. Code: https://www.tue-mps.org/lvmt

</details>


### [376] [Role-Guided MOE for Encoder-Level Pathology Representation Learning in WSI Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34897)
*Xinyu Ma,Xing Yang,Hongtao Jin,Guoquan Zhang,Shijie Zhang,Yu Zhang,Xitong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种病理角色引导的MoE-FFN框架，通过两阶段训练实现高效的编码器级表征学习，用于全切片图像分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理基础模型作为冻结特征提取器时，其固定编码器难以充分适应目标特定的组织模式和判别线索；而微调虽能提升适应性，却面临病理表征能力与适应效率之间的权衡，尤其在数据稀缺场景下。

Method: 设计两阶段训练范式：源域专家初始化阶段，从冻结的Virchow2教师模型向轻量DINOv2-small学生模型蒸馏病理先验，并以角色原型作为弱病理锚点促进专家功能分化，在高层Transformer层引入MoE-FFN块提供变换多样性；目标域适应阶段，通过非对称原型引导优化细化专家，增强任务相关正证据并分离易混淆的难负样本。

Result: 在公开数据集BRACS和私有PAROTID WSI数据集上，基于五种代表性骨干网络的实验均显示出一致优于最强基线的性能。

Conclusion: 该框架所产出的编码器可提取离线patch表征并直接与标准MIL聚合器集成，实现了高效的病理表征适应。

Abstract: Whole slide image classification is a fundamental task in computational pathology, where patch representation quality directly affects downstream aggregation and slide-level discriminability. Pathology foundation models are widely adopted as frozen feature extractors for WSI classification; however, their fixed encoders may produce representations insufficiently adapted to target-specific tissue patterns and discriminative cues. Fine-tuning can improve target adaptation, but introduces a trade-off between pathology-specific representation capacity and adaptation efficiency, particularly in data-scarce settings. To address this, we propose a pathology role-guided mixture-of-experts feed-forward network (MoE-FFN) framework for efficient encoder-level representation learning. We design a two-stage training paradigm to establish and adapt pathology-aware expert specialization. In source-domain expert initialization, pathology-specific priors are distilled from a frozen Virchow2 teacher into a lightweight DINOv2-small student, while role prototypes serve as weak pathological anchors to encourage distinct expert functions. MoE-FFN blocks are introduced into selected high-level transformer layers to provide transformation diversity for heterogeneous pathological patterns. In target-domain adaptation, the initialized experts are refined through asymmetric prototype-guided optimization, enhancing task-relevant positive evidence and separating confusable hard negatives. The resulting encoder extracts offline patch representations that can be directly integrated with standard MIL aggregators. Experiments on the public BRACS dataset and a private PAROTID WSI dataset across five representative backbones demonstrate consistent improvements over the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [377] [FILIGREE3D: Scaling Sparse Latent Flow Matching for Ultra-High-Resolution Image-to-3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34900)
*Hongjie Li,Xinran Yang,Xiuchao Wu,Jiangjing Lyu,Chengfei Lv*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Filigree3D，一种稀疏潜在流匹配框架，可从单张图像生成高达 2048³（可扩展至 4096³）体素分辨率的 3D 几何，在实用显存下约一分钟完成高细节生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将图像到 3D 生成扩展到超高分辨率时，计算成本会急剧增长，而现有方法往往难以在不牺牲精细几何细节的前提下控制开销。因此需要一种既能抑制计算增长、又能保留细尺度细节与长程结构的方案。

Method: 核心方法包括四点：1）Structure-Aware Sparse Scaling，结合空间包围与交替式局部-全局注意力，约束 token 增长同时保留细节与结构上下文；2）基于高分辨率几何增益筛选训练样本；3）将多尺度图像特征注入稀疏 3D DiT，耦合结构语义与细粒度视觉线索；4）可见性感知的体素正则化，提升对稀疏扰动的鲁棒性并补全未观测几何。

Result: 在默认配置下，GPU 峰值显存控制在当代硬件可接受范围内，约一分钟即可生成复杂 3D 几何。大量实验表明，相比现有基线，该方法在整体几何保真度与细节保持方面均有显著提升。

Conclusion: Filigree3D 验证了在空前高分辨率下进行实用且保细节的 3D 生成是可行的，并具备向 4096³ 进一步扩展的能力。

Abstract: Scaling image-to-3D generation to ultra-high resolutions requires controlling rapidly growing computational costs without sacrificing fine geometric detail. We present \textbf{Filigree3D}, a sparse latent flow-matching framework that generates 3D geometry from a single image at voxel resolutions up to $2048^3$, with straightforward extensibility to $4096^3$. To make training tractable, we introduce Structure-Aware Sparse Scaling, which combines spatial bounding with alternating local-global attention to constrain token growth while preserving both fine-scale details and long-range structural context. To enhance detail reconstruction, we curate training samples based on their high-resolution geometric gains and inject multi-scale image features into a sparse 3D DiT, effectively coupling structural semantics with fine-grained visual cues. Furthermore, a visibility-aware voxel regularization strategy improves robustness against sparse perturbations and facilitates the completion of unobserved geometry. Under our default configuration, Filigree3D maintains peak GPU memory consumption within practical limits for contemporary hardware, enabling the generation of highly intricate 3D geometry in approximately one minute. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method yields substantial improvements in overall geometric fidelity and fine-detail preservation compared to existing baselines, validating practical, detail-preserving 3D generation at unprecedented resolutions.

</details>


### [378] [ReSight-SMC: Two-Stage Power Sampling via Island SMC with Visual Scouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34905)
*Yaowen Zhang,Xiangyu Qiu,Junyi Hu,Zhi Lu,Wenwen Tian,Aoqin Wang,Junhai Luo,Zhenming Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将Power-SMC迁移到LVLM解码，提出免验证器的两阶段功率采样方法ReSight-SMC，在四个主干和五个基准上优于Power-SMC，并可与RL训练模型竞争。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 功率采样在LLM推理中已展现接近强化学习的效果，但在大视觉语言模型（LVLM）中尚缺乏探索。直接将Power-SMC迁移到LVLM虽能提供较强的免训练基线，却存在两个未解决问题：粒子层面，全局重采样会破坏轨迹谱系，且粒子未利用不同视觉线索来多样化轨迹，限制了有限粒子预算下的探索；答案层面，序列级锐化使支持同一答案的不同推理轨迹相互竞争。

Method: 提出ReSight-SMC，一种免验证器的两阶段功率采样器。第一阶段采用祖先隔离的SMC岛屿以保留独立轨迹族，并路由有限数量的前缀条件视觉侦察粒子到与前缀相关的图像区域，同时抑制冗余重叠；每个侦察粒子临时提升对图像token的注意力并强化其路由区域。精确重要性校正保证基础LVLM序列功率目标不变。第二阶段按规范答案聚合终端重要性质量，对答案边缘分布做幂次锐化，采样一个答案及其支持轨迹。

Result: 在四个LVLM主干和五个基准上，ReSight-SMC在推理与感知两类基准组上的总体性能均强于Power-SMC；在无后训练情况下，总体表现与使用强化学习训练的同主干模型相比仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: ReSight-SMC通过粒子级祖先隔离与视觉侦察、答案级边缘锐化，缓解了LVLM有限粒子多模态推理中的探索不足与轨迹竞争问题，是一种有效的免训练LVLM推理增强方法。

Abstract: Power sampling has emerged as a training-free approach to LLM reasoning, eliciting capabilities comparable to reinforcement learning by sharpening the model distribution over complete responses. Despite this success, power sampling remains underexplored in large vision-language models (LVLMs). We transfer Power-SMC to LVLM decoding by defining a sequence-power target conditioned on both the image and the prompt. This direct transfer provides a strong training-free baseline, but leaves two aspects of finite-particle multimodal inference unaddressed. At the particle level, global resampling can collapse genealogies, while particle-based power sampling does not diversify trajectories through distinct visual cues in multimodal decoding, limiting exploration under a finite particle budget. At the answer level, sequence-level sharpening makes distinct reasoning trajectories compete even when they support the same answer. We introduce ReSight-SMC, a verifier-free two-stage power sampler for LVLM inference. Its first stage uses ancestry-isolated SMC islands to preserve independent trajectory families and routes a bounded set of prefix-conditioned visual scouts to prefix-relevant image regions while discouraging redundant overlap. Each scout temporarily increases attention to the image tokens and emphasizes its routed region. Exact importance correction preserves the base LVLM sequence-power target. The second stage aggregates terminal importance mass by canonical answer, powers the answer marginal, and samples an answer together with a supporting trajectory. Across four LVLM backbones and five benchmarks, ReSight-SMC achieves stronger aggregate performance than Power-SMC over both the reasoning and perception benchmark groups. Without post-training, it remains competitive in aggregate with backbone-matched models trained using reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [379] [TaoTex: Boosting Texture Detail Fidelity for Native 3D Material Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34934)
*Xiuchao Wu,Shuichang Lai,Jiangjing Lyu,Chengfei Lyu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TaoTex是一种基于扩散的原生3D材质生成模型，通过数据构建代理、多级特征融合、潜空间到像素空间的损失转换及多视图扩展，显著提升3D纹理细节重建能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D生成模型能生成准确几何，但在重建细节纹理方面仍存在困难，且公开数据集缺乏高频纹理3D资产。

Method: 1) 开发数据构建代理生成高频纹理3D资产以弥补数据缺口；2) 设计多级特征融合(MLFF)模块自适应整合条件输入的局部与全局特征；3) 采用潜空间到像素空间的损失转换以缓解VAE重建误差；4) 通过引入可学习视角嵌入将模型扩展至多视图输入。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在单视图和多视图设置下，在保留纹理细节方面均显著优于现有方法，能恢复文字、图案等挑战性细节。

Conclusion: TaoTex通过数据增强、特征融合、损失转换和多视图扩展等策略，有效实现了高保真3D材质生成，在纹理细节保留上达到领先水平。

Abstract: Recent 3D generation models can produce accurate geometries while still struggling to reconstruct detailed textures. We propose a diffusion-based native 3D material generation model TaoTex, which faithfully recovers intricate textures through tailored strategies and improvements. First, we develop a data construction agent to create high-frequency textured 3D assets to bridge the data gap in public datasets. Training with these data significantly enhances the ability of TaoTex to recover challenging details such as text and patterns. Second, we design a multi-level feature fusion (MLFF) module to adaptively integrate local and global features of the conditional input, providing more complete texture cues for the diffusion model and thereby enhancing reconstruction fidelity. To alleviate VAE reconstruction errors, we adopt a latent-to-pixel space loss transition, further improving the pixel-level details and generation quality. Finally, we scale TaoTex to multi-view inputs by incorporating learnable viewpoint embeddings, achieving accurate and consistent material reconstruction across views. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing approaches in preserving texture details in both single- and multi-view settings.

</details>


### [380] [Resolution as a First-Class Decision: Task-Conditioned Routing for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34942)
*Zhiqiang Xia,Yang Li,Xinyuan Zhang,Yuchen Liu,Haoyu Lu,Jiaming Xu,Runyu Shi,Ying Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出任务条件化分辨率路由（TCRR），用轻量跨模态路由器按查询预测最小充分压缩级别，减少视觉token与计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM推理效率受高分辨率输入带来的海量视觉token序列制约，计算成本呈二次增长；现有方法多聚焦下游token压缩，忽视上游问题：输入分辨率被当作静态、任务无关的超参数。

Method: 将视觉压缩建模为任务条件化决策；采用轻量跨模态路由器，通过特征级调制与交叉注意力，以文本语义为条件约束骨干视觉表示，为每个查询预测最小充分压缩级别；构建覆盖12类任务、50万样本的数据集，并用教师-预言机流程标注近似帕累托最优压缩尺度。

Result: 在多种架构上取得更优效率前沿：在Qwen3-VL-8B上视觉FLOPs降低40.9%、延迟降低53.7%，同时保持有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 动态路由视觉压缩可在不修改MLLM骨干的前提下实现最优资源分配，缩放行为分析进一步验证其有效性。

Abstract: The inference efficiency of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is severely constrained by massive visual token sequences induced by high-resolution inputs, with computational cost scaling quadratically. Existing approaches primarily focus on downstream token compression, while overlooking a fundamental upstream inefficiency: input resolution is treated as a static, task-agnostic hyperparameter. We propose Task-Conditioned Resolution Routing (TCRR), which formulates visual compression as a task-conditioned decision and employs a lightweight cross-modal router that conditions backbone visual representations on textual semantics via feature-wise modulation and cross-attention to predict the minimal sufficient compression level per query. To support this, we curate a dataset of 500k samples across 12 task categories, labeled via a teacher-oracle pipeline to approximate Pareto-optimal compression scales. Extensive experiments across diverse architectures show that TCRR achieves a superior efficiency frontier, specifically reducing visual FLOPs by 40.9% and latency by 53.7% on Qwen3-VL-8B while preserving competitive performance. Further analysis of scaling behavior confirms that dynamically routing visual compression enables optimal resource allocation without modifying the MLLM backbone.

</details>


### [381] [Just MLPs: Efficient Visual State Reconstruction for Multimodal Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34972)
*Jingdi lei,Junxian Li,Di Zhang,Zhanqiu Zhang,Yiwen Guo,Soujanya Poria*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 δ-Vision，通过轻量低秩适配器构建逐层视觉记忆，替代视觉 token 的重复 Transformer 演化，在保留全部视觉 token 的同时降低 MLLM 计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM 中长视觉 token 序列占大量计算开销，现有剪枝方法会永久丢弃后续层可能有用的视觉信息，因此作者希望在不丢弃视觉 token 的前提下降低重复演化表示的成本。

Method: 对视觉到文本信息流做低秩干预，发现阻断视觉到文本注意力后仅恢复少数方向即可找回大部分精度，说明视觉影响集中于低维子空间；并发现逐层视觉状态具有强可预测性，轻量 MLP 即可高余弦相似度、低重构误差地近似。据此提出 δ-Vision，用轻量低秩适配器构建逐层视觉记忆，替代视觉 token 的重复 Transformer 演化。

Result: 在图像和视频基准上，δ-Vision 在相当或更低计算量下取得高于视觉 token 剪枝基线的精度，并在不丢弃视觉 token 的情况下具备有竞争力的推理效率。

Conclusion: 保留全部视觉 token 并通过低秩适配器构建逐层视觉记忆是可行且有效的，可在效率与精度间取得更优平衡，优于剪枝式方案。

Abstract: Long visual token sequences often account for a substantial fraction of the computational overhead in multimodal large language models~(MLLMs). Existing approaches reduce this cost by pruning redundant visual tokens, but permanently discard visual evidence that may become useful in subsequent layers. We instead ask whether all visual tokens can be preserved while reducing the cost of repeatedly evolving the representations through the Transformer. To answer this question, we perform low-rank interventions on visual-to-text information flow. We find that, after visual-to-text attention is blocked, restoring only a few directions recovers most of the lost accuracy, suggesting the relevant visual influence is concentrated in a low-dimensional subspace. We further observe strong predictability in layer-specific visual states: lightweight MLPs approximate them with high cosine similarity and low reconstruction error. Motivated by these findings, we propose $δ$-Vision, which replaces repeated Transformer evolution of visual tokens with lightweight low-rank adapters that construct layer-wise visual memories while preserving all visual tokens for text retrieval. Across image and video benchmarks, $δ$-Vision achieves higher accuracy than visual token pruning baselines at comparable or lower computation, while delivering competitive inference efficiency without discarding visual tokens.

</details>


### [382] [SPIDER: Multi-Layer Semantic Token Pruning and Adaptive Sub-Layer Skipping in Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34977)
*Tianxiang Chen,Zhentao Tan,Zi Ye,Yue Wu,Xiaobing Tu,Jinkui Ren,Xiantao Zhang,Tao Gong,Qi Chu,Nenghai Yu,Xipeng Qiu,Jieping Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出免训练的SPIDER框架，结合多层语义视觉token剪枝与自适应子层跳过机制，缓解MLLM数据与计算双重冗余，在保持性能的同时大幅降低FLOPs。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型存在数据冗余与计算冗余两类效率问题，现有方法多仅关注视觉编码器输出端的token剪枝或在LLM解码器中使用块级重要性，忽视了层间表示漂移与层内分布差异，因此需要更细粒度地探索双层冗余。

Method: SPIDER为免训练框架，包含两部分：一是多层语义视觉token剪枝，利用视觉编码器中间层token（中层更关注物体级细节）进行有效剪枝；二是自适应子层跳过机制，基于Attention与FFN在不同LLM解码器层中的差异化贡献进行跳过。

Result: 在多种MLLM架构与压缩比下保持一致强性能。例如在LLaVA-NeXT-7B上，SPIDER减少79% FLOPs，同时保持基线性能的96%。

Conclusion: 通过统一处理数据与计算双重冗余，SPIDER验证了中间层视觉token与解码器子层差异化贡献的重要性，为实现高效多模态大模型提供了免训练、可泛化的方案。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models face significant efficiency challenges that stem from two distinct yet coupled sources: data redundancy and computational redundancy. While most methods focus on data redundancy by pruning visual tokens from the output of the visual encoder or computing redundancy in LLM decoders using blockwise importance, the finer-grained inter-layer representation shifts and the distribution differences within the layers themselves have not been fully explored. In this work, we comprehensively investigate this dual-level inefficiency. We posit that intermediate layer tokens from vision encoders should be considered for effective visual token pruning, as semantic focus shifts across layers, with middle-layer tokens capturing more detailed object-centric information that deeper layers may abstract away. Furthermore, we reveal the differential contributions of Attention and FFNs across distinct LLM decoder layers. Building upon these discoveries, we propose \textbf{SPIDER}, a training-free framework that integrates multi-layer \underline{\textbf{S}}emantic visual token \underline{\textbf{P}}run\underline{\textbf{I}}ng with an a\underline{\textbf{D}}aptive sub-lay\underline{\textbf{ER}} skipping mechanism. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that SPIDER consistently maintains strong performance across various MLLM architectures and reduction ratios. For instance, on LLaVA-NeXT-7B, SPIDER reduces FLOPs by $79\%$ while maintaining 96$\%$ of the baseline performance.

</details>


### [383] [One Sensor, Whole Body - 3D Body Pose from a Single Consumer Earbud IMU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34978)
*Zhilin Guo,Boqiao Zhang,Oszkár Urbán,Josef Bengtson,Hakan Aktas,Wenzhao Li,Siyu Hong,Kyle Fogarty,Chenliang Zhou,Ali Senguel,Cengiz Oztireli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 单个消费级耳机头部IMU即可较好地恢复下肢姿态与足部触地状态，增加鞋垫IMU并不会显著提升、甚至会因安装方向质量差而降低精度；传感器可靠性而非数量是瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 消费级耳机已能提供头部惯性运动数据，且头部是身体上佩戴最广泛的传感器位置之一。作者想探究：仅凭单个头部IMU能恢复多少3D全身姿态，以及增加更多消费级传感器是否真的有用。

Method: 构建多模态采集流程，同步记录四视角RGB-D视频、AirPods头部IMU与两个Striv鞋垫IMU，并用SAM 3D Body生成伪真值，得到35个take的单受试者基准（涵盖步态、转向、垂直、日常及临床启发动作）。在此基准上适配两族循环模型（IMUPoser与MobilePoser），并做因果变体、配对逐take显著性检验、安装偏差探针与仅足部消融。同时将输出扩展到20关节全身骨架，并采用分阶段微调。

Result: 单个头部IMU恢复下肢姿态达79.0 mm rigid-MPJPE，每脚触地达0.809 macro-F1，因果变体在流式延迟下保留大部分精度。配对检验中，加入消费级足部IMU从未显著改善姿态，且在四组模型-划分组合中的两组显著恶化；机制在于鞋垫安装方向质量而非足部位置。扩展到全身时，远端手臂粗大动作可部分恢复，近端上身姿态无法恢复，分阶段微调可挽回朴素多任务训练所牺牲的腿部精度。

Conclusion: 对于消费级可穿戴设备的姿态学习而言，传感器可靠性而非数量是关键约束；在受测设备中，耳机是性能的甜蜜点。

Abstract: Consumer earbuds already stream inertial motion data from the head, one of the most widely worn sensor locations on the body. We ask how much of the 3D body pose a single such head IMU can recover, and whether adding more consumer sensors actually helps. We build a multimodal capture pipeline that records four-view RGB-D video together with an AirPods head IMU and two Striv insole IMUs, synchronize the streams post-hoc, and generate pseudo-ground-truth with SAM 3D Body, yielding a 35-take single-subject benchmark spanning gait, turning, vertical, everyday, and clinically inspired motions. Adapting two recurrent model families (IMUPoser and MobilePoser), we show that one head IMU recovers lower-body pose at 79.0 mm rigid-MPJPE and per-foot ground contact at 0.809 macro-F1, and that a causal variant retains most of this accuracy at streaming latency. In paired per-take significance tests across both families, adding the consumer foot IMUs never significantly improves pose and significantly degrades it in two of four model-split combinations; a mounting-bias probe and feet-only ablation identify insole orientation quality, not foot placement, as the mechanism. Extending the output to a 20-joint full-body skeleton maps the boundary: gross distal-arm motion is partially recoverable from the head alone, proximal upper-body pose is not, and staged fine-tuning recovers the leg accuracy that naive joint training sacrifices to multi-task dilution. For learned pose from consumer wearables, sensor reliability, not sensor count, is the binding constraint here. For the devices tested, the earbud is its sweet spot. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhilinGuo/one-sensor-whole-body.

</details>


### [384] [What Makes World Action Models Generalize? An Empirical Study of Test-Time Future Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34981)
*Renping Zhou,Zanlin Ni,Zihao Fan,Guohao Fu,Zeyu Liu,Hao Shi,Jie Zhang,Chi Bene Chen,Yang Yue,Xueyang Fu,Gao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Simple-WAM，将未来建模简化为对全噪声视频token的单次前向传播，在保持Latent WAM效率的同时获得显式WAM的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界动作模型训练时预测未来，但推理时是否需生成未来存在争议：显式WAM逐帧去噪代价高，隐式WAM丢弃未来以加速。研究发现隐式WAM虽在分布内任务上与显式相当，却丧失了WAM最初追求的泛化优势，需在环境扰动、数据效率、任务泛化三方面验证这一差距。

Method: 使用匹配的骨干网络、训练数据与预算做受控对比，沿环境扰动、数据效率、任务泛化三个轴评估泛化性；进一步分析定位差距来源。基于"收益来自准备未来而非生成未来"的发现，提出Simple-WAM：将未来建模简化为对完全加噪视频token的单次前向传播，并调整训练时噪声调度以适配该推理行为。

Result: 受控对比显示，当动作专家不再以未来表征为条件时，三个泛化轴均出现一致退化。分析表明差距几乎全部来自第一步去噪。Simple-WAM在仿真与真实世界任务中兼顾两者优势：泛化性能超越显式WAM，效率与隐式WAM相当。

Conclusion: WAM的泛化收益源于准备未来而非生成未来，Simple-WAM以单次前向传播实现高效且强泛化的世界动作模型，达成显式与隐式WAM的最佳折中。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) predict the future alongside actions during \emph{training}. Due to the heavy computation cost of video denoising, whether the future must still be generated during \emph{inference} is disputed: Explicit WAMs denoise it into clean frames along with every action chunk, whereas Latent WAMs discard it entirely for acceleration. We find that latent WAMs, despite matching explicit ones on in-distribution tasks, fail to retain the generalization benefits that originally motivated WAMs. To demonstrate this, we evaluate generalization along three axes: \emph{environmental perturbation}, \emph{data efficiency}, and \emph{task generalization}. Controlled comparisons with a matched backbone, training data, and budget reveal consistent degradation across all three axes when the action expert no longer conditions on future representations. Further analysis shows that the gap arises almost entirely from the first denoising step: the benefit comes from \emph{preparing} the future, not \emph{generating} it. We therefore propose \textbf{Simple-WAM}, which simplifies future modeling into a single forward pass of fully noised video tokens and adapts the training-time noise schedule to this inference behavior. Across simulation and real-world tasks, Simple-WAM achieves the best of both worlds, leading explicit WAMs in generalization performance with efficiency comparable to Latent WAMs. Project Page: \href{https://zrporz.github.io/Simple-WAM-Web/}{\textcolor{panton}{\texttt{https://zrporz.github.io/Simple-WAM-Web}}}

</details>


### [385] [ActionUNet: Improving Robustness of VLA Models with Efficient Multi-scale Fine-tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34982)
*Di Zhu,Ziheng Yan,Fang Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ActionUNet 是一个高效的多尺度微调框架，通过在时间对齐的动作特征空间中构建轻量级时序 U-Net 并采用条件 SIREN 连续动作解码器，以极低计算成本增强预训练 VLA 模型，桥接语义与细粒度时序执行之间的尺度差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽能将多模态语义映射到物理动作，但这种映射难以将粗粒度语义与细粒度时序执行对齐，导致在杂乱环境中的泛化能力有限、鲁棒性不足。作者希望以最小计算成本解决语义与动作时序之间的尺度鸿沟问题。

Method: ActionUNet 首先在时间对齐的动作特征空间内构建轻量级时序 U-Net，融合分层结构先验，桥接语义与时序执行的尺度差距；针对多尺度建模可能破坏微观时序连续性、引发机械振荡的问题，进一步采用条件 SIREN 作为连续动作解码器，并引入显式二阶平滑约束，保证时序连续性并减少高频运动抖动。

Result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO-Plus 基准及真实世界困难评测中，ActionUNet 将 π0.5 的成功率分别绝对提升 9.8%、6.1% 和 11.4%，同时也能泛化到基于回归的 OpenVLA-OFT 主干，验证了其作为微调策略的有效性与高效性。

Conclusion: ActionUNet 通过多尺度时序融合与连续动作建模，有效缓解了多尺度融合带来的时序不连续，减少了机械执行失败，同时保留了基础 VLA 模型的泛化能力与操作鲁棒性，是一种高效且通用的 VLA 微调方案。代码已开源。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown great promise for robotic manipulation by mapping multi-modal semantics to physical actions. However, this mapping inherently struggles to align these coarse-grained semantics with fine-grained temporal execution. It leaves VLA models with limited generalization and insufficient robustness in cluttered environments. To overcome this issue, we propose ActionUNet, an efficient multi-scale fine-tuning framework that enhances pre-trained VLA models with minimal computational cost. ActionUNet first constructs a lightweight temporal U-Net within the temporal-aligned action feature space to fuse hierarchical structural priors, effectively bridging the scale gap between semantics and temporal executions. Recognizing that multi-scale modeling can disrupt microscopic temporal continuity and cause mechanical oscillations, ActionUNet then employs a conditional SIREN as a continuous action decoder. Equipped with explicit second-order smoothness constraints, this decoder guarantees temporal continuity and reduces high-frequency motion jitter. By smoothing temporal discontinuities from multi-scale fusion, this continuous formulation reduces mechanical execution failures while preserving the base VLA model's generalization and manipulation robustness. Extensive experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks, together with real-world hard evaluations, demonstrate that ActionUNet significantly improves π0.5 success rates by absolute 9.8%, 6.1%, and 11.4%, respectively, while also generalizing to the regression-based OpenVLA-OFT backbone, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency as a fine-tuning strategy. Code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/Di-Zhu123/ActionUNet.

</details>


### [386] [Still There, No Longer Seen: Exposing Compression-Induced Risk in Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35002)
*Qiankun Li,Yuechen Zhang,Bowen Chen,Shilinlu Yan,Zhenhong Zhou,Kun Wang,Li Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"压缩特定失效（CSF）"概念，将视觉token压缩带来的对抗风险刻画为配对失效归因问题，并提出无需下游问题、标签及语言模型访问的压缩诱导风险攻击CIRA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉token压缩可降低大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）推理成本，但现有聚合鲁棒性指标无法区分对抗失效是由压缩引起还是源自底层模型本身，因而缺乏对压缩风险的准确归因。

Method: 定义CSF为在全token推理下正确、压缩后失效的对抗样本；在受控诊断队列中用反事实分析发现保留集分配会因果性改变压缩正确性，并揭示恢复率与位移证据表示漂移呈负相关；据此提出CIRA，在视觉编码器白盒设定下，通过编码器侧目标优化图像扰动，操纵不同候选压缩预算下的token优先级并保留位移证据，不使用下游问题、标签，也无需访问语言模型、部署压缩器或精确预算。

Result: 在12种数据集-压缩器组合、4种预算下，CIRA平均CSFR达20.35%，同时全token攻击成功率仅6.92%；在其它LVLM系列上表现类似。跨视图选择-稳定化防御可大幅抑制CIRA，但自适应CIRA能部分恢复其效果。

Conclusion: 压缩特定失效在受限访问条件下依然存在，支持对全token与压缩推理进行配对评估，从而将风险准确归因于视觉token压缩。

Abstract: Visual token compression reduces the inference cost of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). However, aggregate robustness measures do not reveal whether a particular adversarial failure is induced by compression or inherited from the underlying model. We define a compression-specific failure (CSF) as an adversarial input that remains correct under full-token inference but fails after compression, casting compression-induced risk as a paired failure attribution problem. Within a controlled diagnostic cohort, counterfactuals show that retained-set allocation causally changes compressed correctness and reveal a negative association between recovery and representation drift in displaced evidence. Motivated by these findings, we propose CIRA, a Compression-Induced Risk Attack for Large Vision-Language Models. Under a vision-encoder white-box setting, CIRA optimizes image perturbations through encoder-side objectives that manipulate token priorities across candidate compression budgets while preserving displaced evidence. CIRA uses no downstream questions or labels and requires no access to the language model, deployed compressor, or exact compression budget. Across 12 dataset-compressor settings evaluated at four budgets, CIRA achieves a mean CSFR of 20.35% while limiting full-token attack success to 6.92%, with similar behavior on additional LVLM families. A cross-view selection-stabilization defense substantially suppresses CIRA, although Adaptive CIRA partially restores its effectiveness. These results show that compression-specific failures persist under restricted access and support paired evaluation of full-token and compressed inference for attributing risk to visual-token compression.

</details>


### [387] [Verifying the Linear Representation Hypothesis: How Interpretable Are Vision SAEs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35020)
*Teodor Chiaburu,Franz Motzkus,Frank Haußer,Felix Bießmann*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过将Autointerpretability Score适配到视觉任务并进行用户研究，发现现有视觉SAE可解释性度量（包括稀疏性、字典一致性等无参考指标）彼此不相关，也不与AIS对齐，说明单靠无参考代理指标无法验证视觉SAE的可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉稀疏自编码器（SAE）在机制可解释性中被广泛使用，其核心动机是线性表示假设（LRH），即多义特征可投影到近似正交的稀疏、人类可理解表示上。然而当前评估框架多依赖代理指标（如SAE特征稀疏性、推断字典的一致性），并隐含假设这些指标能反映与人类感知的一致性。作者希望检验这一假设是否成立。

Method: 作者将原本在自然语言处理中已被证明与人类判断一致的Autointerpretability Score（AIS）适配到视觉任务，并通过专门的用户研究验证该适配方法的有效性。随后，他们同时使用标准指标和适配后的AIS评估SAE概念质量，比较不同度量之间的相关性。

Result: 实验发现，已有的SAE可解释性指标之间互不相关，且与AIS也不相关。这表明无论是基于LRH的指标还是其他无参考指标，都没有单一指标足以验证视觉SAE的可解释性。

Conclusion: 测量SAE概念的可解释性比现有代理指标所暗示的更为困难。研究结果支持近期关于需要更可验证、以真实标签为锚的设计与评估解释方法的呼吁。

Abstract: Vision Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have become a popular tool in Mechanistic Interpretability due to their presumed ability to disentangle complex features learned by a model into monosemantic concepts. Despite their growing popularity, evaluating their interpretability remains an active topic of research. The bedrock motivating the adoption of SAEs is the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which claims that polysemantic features can be projected onto a (near) orthogonal basis of sparse, human-understandable representations. Yet, most current frameworks evaluate proxies such as the sparsity of SAE features or the coherence of the inferred dictionary, implicitly assuming that these reflect alignment with human perception. In this paper, we provide empirical evidence that measuring the interpretability of SAE concepts is more difficult than these proxies suggest. To this end, we adapt the Autointerpretability Score (AIS) - previously shown to align with human judgments in Natural Language Processing - to vision tasks and validate our approach in a dedicated user study. We evaluate SAE concept quality using both standard metrics and our adapted AIS. We find that established interpretability metrics for SAEs correlate neither with one another nor with AIS, indicating that no single reference-free metric, whether grounded in the LRH or not, is sufficient for verifying the interpretability of vision SAEs. We argue these findings support recent calls for more verifiable, ground-truth-anchored design and evaluation of explanation methods.

</details>


### [388] [Detection of Adversarial Attacks on Super-Resolvers Using Spectral Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35022)
*Emma J. Reid,Haley Duba-Sullivan,Tony G. Allen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于频谱的检测方法，利用径向平均功率谱密度作为特征训练XGBoost检测器，识别超分辨率模型权重中的对抗攻击，并在多种训练与跨架构场景下优于幅度和相位谱检测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型被集成进超分辨率等图像预处理流程，为攻击者提供了针对下游任务的新攻击面。为保障关键成像流程的可信性，需要能够检测预处理模型内部的对抗行为，而这一问题此前鲜有探索。

Method: 以径向平均功率谱密度（radially-averaged power spectral density）作为判别特征，训练极端梯度提升（XGBoost）检测器，用于检测超分辨率网络权重中的模型级对抗威胁；并与基于幅度和相位的傅里叶频谱检测器进行对比，覆盖多种训练和跨架构场景。

Result: 所提检测器在大多数场景下优于对比检测器，并表明高频特征对于跨超分辨率架构检测AdvSR攻击最具信息量。

Conclusion: 基于径向平均功率谱密度的XGBoost方法可有效检测超分辨率模型权重中的对抗攻击，高频频谱特征在跨架构检测中尤为关键，为图像预处理管线的可信性提供了检测手段。

Abstract: The integration of deep learning models into image preprocessing pipelines such as super-resolution introduces a largely unexplored attack vector for adversaries targeting downstream tasks. To ensure trustworthiness of critical imaging pipelines, we must be able to detect adversarial behavior within preprocessing models. In this paper, we propose a spectral-based detection method for identifying adversarial attacks embedded in super-resolution model weights. More specifically, we use the radially-averaged power spectral density as a discriminative feature to train an extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) detector, demonstrating detectability of model-level threats in super-resolution networks. We further benchmark our detector against magnitude- and phase-based Fourier spectrum detectors, evaluating each method across a range of training and cross-architecture scenarios. Our proposed detector out-performs the comparison detectors in most of these scenarios and indicates that high-frequency features are most informative for detecting AdvSR attacks across SR architectures.

</details>


### [389] [Proxy2World: Learning to Generate Worlds From Lightweight Proxies without Seeing Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35023)
*Hongli Xu,Weilong Yan,Anbang Wang,Chunyu Zou,Siyu Hong,Jingwei Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Proxy2World 是一种可控世界模型，能从普通姿态 RGBD 视频中学习深度条件 RGB 生成与联合 RGBD 生成，实现代理结构遵循与高视觉质量兼顾的场景生成，并提出了 ProxyBench 评测基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轻量级场景代理允许创作者控制场景布局与运动，同时在外观、光照和视觉特效上保留想象空间。然而合适的代理并非唯一确定，导致难以大规模自动构建成对的"代理-视频"数据。因此需要一种无需成对代理-视频数据即可学习代理到真实世界映射的方法。

Method: 提出 Proxy2World 可控世界模型，仅使用普通姿态 RGBD 视频训练，无需成对代理-视频数据。模型通过跨模态流匹配（cross-modal flow matching）联合学习深度条件 RGB 生成与联合 RGBD 生成两项任务。在推理阶段，利用两项任务的学习结果实现代理-相机混合去噪（proxy-camera hybrid denoising），从而在遵循代理结构的同时生成自然、细节丰富的视觉效果。此外提出 ProxyBench 基准用于评估该能力。

Result: 在 ProxyBench 上，Proxy2World 在结构遵循度与视觉质量之间取得了比相机控制方法和几何条件方法更好的平衡，并得到定量指标、VLM 评估、人工评估以及多样化定性结果的支持。

Conclusion: Proxy2World 证明了可以从普通 RGBD 视频中联合学习深度条件生成与联合 RGBD 生成，通过混合去噪策略实现可控世界建模，在结构遵循与视觉真实感之间取得良好折中，为无需成对数据的代理驱动场景生成提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Lightweight scene proxies let creators control scene layout and motion while leaving room for imagination in appearance, lighting, and visual effects. However, a suitable proxy is not uniquely defined, making paired proxy-video data difficult to construct automatically at scale. We present Proxy2World, a controllable world model that learns these complementary capabilities from ordinary posed RGBD videos, without training on authored proxy-video pairs. The model jointly learns depth-conditioned RGB generation and joint RGBD generation through cross-modal flow matching. Learning both tasks enables proxy-camera hybrid denoising at inference to follow the proxy structure while producing natural, detailed visuals. We further introduce ProxyBench to evaluate this capability across a diverse set of scenes, camera trajectories, and subject motions. Experiments on ProxyBench show that Proxy2World achieves a better balance between structural adherence and visual quality than camera-controlled and geometry-conditioned methods, supported by quantitative metrics, VLM assessments, human evaluations and diverse qualitative results.

</details>


### [390] [Mixed-Prior Decision Risk for Open-Set Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35043)
*L. A. Erlygin,P. D. Proskura,A. A. Zaytsev*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MPRisk，一种基于混合先验后验决策风险的选择性识别评分，直接对错误事件评分以替代KL散度汇总，在九个图像、音频和文本基准上取得更优的过滤质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有贝叶斯开放集识别模型（如HolUE）用KL散度分量经监督非线性校准器映射为不确定性分数，但该KL汇总对决策风险并非单调，线性融合KL分量在多个基准上甚至产生负的过滤质量，因此需要一个与决策风险一致的评分方法。

Method: 提出MPRisk（混合先验后验决策风险分数），保留相同的贝叶斯后验，但直接对所选决策相关的错误事件（误接受、误识别、误拒绝风险）评分，并加入针对拒绝的非特异性惩罚；通过将未知身份建模为连续分量实现该评分。仅需在验证集上调节四个非负权重即可完成排序，无需非线性监督模型。

Result: 在九个图像、音频和文本基准上，MPRisk在图像与音频基准的每个操作点以及大多数文本操作点上取得最佳或并列最佳的预测拒绝比（PRR）；在五个基准上经bootstrap确认优于HolUE（提升最高达+0.19 PRR），且运行时间相当或更低。

Conclusion: 直接对决策风险相关的错误事件建模比KL散度汇总更适合作为开放集识别的选择性识别不确定性分数，方法简单、无需非线性监督校准且计算成本不增加。

Abstract: In open-set recognition (OSR), a probe must either be identified as one of the known gallery classes or rejected as unknown, so three error types coexist: false acceptance, false rejection, and misidentification. An uncertainty score for selective recognition should rank probes by the risk of the decision the system has made. Bayesian gallery-aware models such as Holistic Uncertainty Estimation (HolUE) summarize the posterior over known and unknown classes by Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence components and map them to an uncertainty score with a supervised nonlinear calibrator. We show that the KL summary is not generally monotone in decision risk: linear fusion of the KL components tuned on validation data yields negative filtering quality on several benchmarks. We propose MPRisk, a mixed-prior posterior decision-risk score that keeps the same Bayesian posterior but directly scores the error events associated with the selected decision: false-acceptance, misidentification, and false-rejection risks, plus a non-specificity penalty for rejections, enabled by modeling unknown identities as a continuous component. Four nonnegative weights tuned on a validation set suffice for ranking; no nonlinear supervised model is required. Across nine image, audio, and text benchmarks, MPRisk achieves the best or tied-best Prediction Rejection Ratio at every operating point on the image and audio benchmarks and on most text operating points, with bootstrap-confirmed gains over HolUE on five benchmarks (up to $+0.19$ PRR) at comparable or lower runtime.

</details>


### [391] [LEGAU: Learning Semantic Gaussian Priors for Scalable Category-level Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35046)
*Hongli Xu,Zhaowei Lu,Junwen Huang,Jiaqi Hu,Peter KT Yu,Benjamin Busam,Federico Tombari,Slobodan ilic*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LEGAU是一个统一框架，联合预测NOCS对应关系、物体位姿与尺寸，以及规范语义高斯场，将高斯场作为类别条件结构先验参与多模态特征融合，为局部位姿推理提供全局引导，在合成与真实基准上取得强性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单张RGB-D观测下的类别级6D位姿估计本质上是欠约束问题，需要将部分可见几何与规范物体结构结合才能确定稳定位姿。已有方法通常将重建作为独立的辅助任务，未能充分为位姿推理提供结构先验与全局引导。

Method: LEGAU以类别文本嵌入为条件，通过基于Transformer的融合模块处理RGB-D观测，整合视觉、几何与类别级线索，联合解码NOCS图、位姿与尺寸信息以及基于高斯的物体表示。其核心是把规范语义高斯场作为类别条件结构先验，参与多模态特征融合，并为局部位姿推理提供全局指导，而非将其视为分离的辅助任务。

Result: 在合成与真实世界基准上的大量实验表明，这种位姿-形状耦合的建模在单模型多类别设置下表现强劲，SOPE上提升最高达22%，并具有竞争力的真实数据迁移能力。

Conclusion: 在统一表示中联合学习规范对应关系、物体形状与位姿对齐具有明显收益，验证了将重建结构先验融入位姿推理的有效性。

Abstract: Category-level 6D pose estimation from a single RGB-D observation is inherently under-constrained, since partial visible geometry must be interpreted together with a canonical object structure before a stable pose can be determined. We present LEGAU, a unified framework that jointly predicts NOCS correspondence, object pose and size, and a canonical Semantic Gaussian Field. Rather than treating reconstruction as a detached auxiliary task, LEGAU uses the Gaussian field as a category-conditioned structural prior that participates in multimodal feature fusion and provides global guidance for local pose reasoning. Conditioned on a categorical text embedding, LEGAU processes RGB-D observations through a transformer-based fusion module that integrates visual, geometric, and category-level cues, decoding the NOCS map, pose and size information and the Gaussian-based object representation. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that this coupled pose-shape formulation achieves strong performance in a single-model multi-category setting, with up to 22\% on SOPE and competitive transfer to real-world data. These results highlight the benefit of jointly learning canonical correspondence, object shape, and pose alignment within a unified representation.

</details>


### [392] [OPIS: An Input-Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Object Memory in Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35052)
*Hao Wang,Tao Yu,Liuzhou Zhang,HeXin Wang,Haopeng Jin,Yuxuan Zhou,Xinming Wang,Hongzhu Yi,Xinye Li,Yuanlei Wang,Ping Nie,Yan Huang,Yuxuan Zhang,Pengfei Zhou,Yanyan Zou,Wei Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出OPIS基准，以初始观测中的固定物体实例为锚点，评估视频世界模型的多物体记忆能力，覆盖500个案例、12,672个实例标注，并揭示现有模型在保持物体身份方面存在明显不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型评测常依赖生成历史、视频参考或选定重访视角，这些因素会混淆对模型真实记忆能力的评估。

Method: 构建OPIS数据集，包含真实世界、具身机器人和游戏世界三类共500个案例，对12,672个刚性、铰接和可变形实例进行密集物体级标注；采用物体中心评估器，结合关联与显式可见性推理，分层测量Object Presence、Identity、Structure，并依据物体运动学设置静态或动态评测轨道。

Result: 在八个图像到视频或相机条件世界模型上，OPIS得分为48.65至56.01；当参考清单从不到20个物体增至40个以上时，Presence、Identity、Structure得分整体下降，平均Identity得分从40.22降至23.11。

Conclusion: 保持输入中的特定物体实例，比生成看似合理的视觉元素要困难得多。

Abstract: Video world models must preserve the visual state of the world over time, but existing evaluation protocols often rely on generated histories, video reference, or selected revisit viewpoints that can confound the assessment of a model's true memory capability. To address this, we introduce OPIS, an input-grounded benchmark that strictly anchors the assessment to a fixed set of object instances from the initial observation for evaluating multi-object memory in video world models. The OPIS dataset comprises 500 cases across real-world, embodied-robotic, and game-world domains, providing dense object-level annotations for 12,672 rigid, articulated, and deformable instances. Our object-centric evaluator combines association and explicit visibility reasoning to hierarchically measure Object (O) Presence (P), Identity (I), and Structure (S), utilizing static or dynamic evaluation tracks based on object kinematics. Across eight image-to-video or camera-conditioned world models, our proposed OPIS scores range from 48.65 to 56.01. As the reference inventory grows from less than 20 to more than 40 objects, the Presence, Identity, and Structure scores show an overall decline, with the average Identity score falling from 40.22 to 23.11. The results demonstrate that preserving the particular object instances in the input is considerably harder than generating plausible visual elements.

</details>


### [393] [Towards Generalizable 3D Anomaly Detection via Relational Inconsistency Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35059)
*KunHo Heo,SuYeon Kim,Hayoung Lee,Chanse Oh,MyeongAh Cho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出关系不一致建模框架GRIM，将3D点云缺陷定义为邻域几何一致性的违背，通过伪异常学习类别无关的缺陷线索，在Anomaly-ShapeNet和Real3D-AD上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D异常检测方法以正常性为中心，只学习正常样本分布并将偏差视为异常，未显式建模缺陷本身，导致决策边界模糊，在统一和跨域设置下误检漏检增多。

Method: 将缺陷刻画为邻域结构间几何一致性的违背；用受控关系违背构造伪异常以学习类别无关缺陷线索；包含两个模块：Edge-aware Graph Refinement (EGR) 编码局部区域几何关系，Cluster-Deviation Modeling (CDM) 识别与结构同类群关系不兼容的区域。

Result: 在Anomaly-ShapeNet和Real3D-AD上的大量实验表明，在域内和跨域设置下均持续优于此前最先进方法。

Conclusion: 验证了学习显式、基于关系的缺陷判据对3D异常检测的有效性。

Abstract: 3D anomaly detection (3DAD) aims to identify defective regions in point cloud data, serving as a critical component in industrial inspection systems. Existing methods are normality-centered -- learning the distribution of normal samples and treating deviations as anomalies -- without explicitly modeling what constitutes a defect. This leads to ambiguous decision boundaries with increased false positives and negatives, particularly in unified and cross-domain settings where diverse normal distributions further blur the boundaries. We propose a relational inconsistency modeling framework that characterizes defects as violations of geometric consistency among neighboring structures. Our approach learns category-agnostic defect cues through pseudo-anomalies designed as controlled relational violations, instantiated by two key modules: Edge-aware Graph Refinement (EGR) for encoding geometric relationships among local regions, and Cluster-Deviation Modeling (CDM) for identifying regions that are relationally incompatible within their structural peer group. Extensive experiments on Anomaly-ShapeNet and Real3D-AD demonstrate consistent improvements over prior state-of-the-art methods in both in-domain and cross-domain settings, validating the effectiveness of learning an explicit, relation-based defect criterion for 3D anomaly detection. Project page: https://visualsciencelab-khu.github.io/GRIM_project/.

</details>


### [394] [RefineDrive: Reliable Failure-Guided Learning for Vision-Language-Action Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35078)
*Zhe Sun,Ziyi Luo,Yehao Lu,Lei Zhou,Xi Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 RefineDrive，一种利用自生成失败进行后训练的自驾 VLA 框架，通过可靠诊断、最小修正目标检索、修正 SFT 与安全分层奖励的 GRPO，提升轨迹规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶 VLA 模型高度依赖成功专家演示，忽视了模型自身的失败案例。而利用失败学习面临三大障碍：诊断不可靠、修正目标与失败轨迹不匹配、奖励过于粗糙。

Method: 包含四个组件：(1) 可靠诊断，从仿真器状态中提取碰撞与可行驶区域违规的结构化可验证反馈；(2) 最小修正目标检索，在聚类的人类轨迹库中寻找满足当前场景硬安全约束、且尽量保留失败预测运动模式的近邻修正；(3) 修正 SFT，以驾驶上下文和失败轨迹为条件，将"先诊断后修正"作为仅训练用的辅助任务；(4) 使用安全分层奖励的 GRPO，严格优先硬安全轨迹，对不安全与硬安全轨迹均保留连续安全反馈，仅在满足硬安全后奖励行驶进展。推理时策略直接预测轨迹，无需显式诊断或修复。

Result: 在 NAVSIM v1 上，RefineDrive 将 4B 基础 SFT 策略的 PDMS 从 87.7 提升至 91.7；使用同一检查点且不额外训练，在 NAVSIM v2 扩展指标下的原始 NAVTEST 场景上取得 89.4 EPDMS。受控消融验证了结构化诊断监督、检索式修正与安全分层优化对直接规划的收益。

Conclusion: RefineDrive 表明，系统性地利用模型自生成失败并配合目标化监督与安全感知强化学习，可有效提升自动驾驶 VLA 的直接轨迹规划能力，且推理阶段无需额外诊断或修复模块。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving rely heavily on successful expert demonstrations, leaving model-specific failures underexploited. Learning from these failures is hindered by unreliable diagnoses, poorly matched correction targets, and coarse rewards. We propose RefineDrive, a failure-guided post-training framework that learns from self-generated failures through targeted supervision and safety-aware reinforcement learning. Reliable Diagnosis derives structured, verifiable feedback on collisions and drivable-area violations directly from simulator states. Minimum-Correction Target Retrieval searches a clustered human trajectory bank for nearby corrections that satisfy hard-safety constraints in the current scene, prioritizing preservation of the failed prediction's motion pattern. Conditioned on the driving context and failed trajectory, Correction SFT learns to generate the diagnosis followed by the retrieved correction as a training-only auxiliary task. We then apply GRPO with a Safety-Layered Reward that strictly prioritizes hard-safe trajectories, retains continuous safety feedback for both unsafe and hard-safe trajectories, and rewards driving progress only after hard safety is satisfied. At inference, the policy directly predicts trajectories from the driving context without an explicit diagnosis or repair stage. On NAVSIM v1, RefineDrive improves the 4B base SFT policy from 87.7 to 91.7 PDMS. Using the same checkpoint without additional training, RefineDrive achieves 89.4 EPDMS on the original NAVTEST scenes evaluated with NAVSIM v2 extended metrics. Controlled ablations support the benefits of structured diagnosis supervision, retrieved corrections, and safety-layered optimization for direct planning.

</details>


### [395] [Advancing Video-Text Pretraining with Multi-View Captions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35090)
*Fida M. Thoker,Renaud Vandeghen,Karen Sanchez,Marc Van Droogenbroeck,Bernard Ghanem*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于多模态大语言模型的监督生成框架，通过多视角字幕（MVC）和粒度感知文本表示提升视频-文本预训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网络规模数据集的视频-文本监督质量不足：通常每个视频仅有一条稀疏字幕，无法捕捉丰富的时空语义；而直接使用字幕生成模型又会引入噪声描述。语言监督的质量问题尚未被充分探索。

Method: 从1000万视频出发，基于多模态大语言模型构建监督生成框架，生成多视角字幕：包括互补的摘要字幕与详细字幕、基于推理的精炼，以及语义正样本字幕生成；并引入粒度感知文本表示，为摘要与详细视角分别设置独立的CLS token。

Result: 在标准、细粒度及详细文本到视频检索基准上进行评估，所提方法在零样本和微调设置下均持续提升性能，且使用的预训练语料规模小于现有方法。

Conclusion: 丰富且互补的文本监督对视频-文本预训练至关重要，多视角字幕与粒度感知表示能有效提升监督的多样性、保真度与语义覆盖度。

Abstract: Video-text pretraining has achieved remarkable progress through the scaling of models and datasets, yet the quality of language supervision remains underexplored. Existing web-scale datasets often provide only a single sparse caption per video that fails to capture rich spatiotemporal semantics, while directly using captioning models can generate noisy descriptions. We propose a large-scale multimodal large language model-based supervision generation framework that improves supervision diversity, fidelity, and semantic coverage. Starting from 10 million videos, our approach generates multi-view captions (MVC) through complementary summary and detailed captions, reasoning-based refinement, and semantic positive caption generation. To effectively exploit supervision at different granularities, we further introduce a granularity-aware text representation with separate CLS tokens for summary and detailed views. We pretrain video-text models using the resulting supervision corpus and evaluate them across standard, fine-grained and detailed text-to-video retrieval benchmarks. Our approach consistently improves both zero-shot and fine-tuned performance while using smaller pretraining corpora than existing methods, demonstrating the importance of rich and complementary textual supervision for video-text pretraining. Project page: https://rvandeghen.github.io/mvc/

</details>


### [396] [DF-CBM: Region-Aware Concept Bottleneck Models for Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35096)
*Georgios Tsoumplekas,Vazgken Vanian,Alexandros Doumanoglou,Panos K. Papadopoulos,Yannis Spyridis,Dimitrios Zarpalas,Vasileios Argyriou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 DF-CBM，一种区域感知的概念瓶颈模型，用于可解释的深度伪造检测，通过从文本伪影标注构建紧凑的伪造相关概念词表，并将概念与面部及边界区域关联，实现空间落地的概念证据与反事实解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测方法虽效果不断提升，但大多无法说明预测所依据的证据。在取证场景中，用户不仅需要真假判断，还需知道哪些伪造线索支撑该决策以及线索出现的位置。现有可解释方法各有所短：基于定位的方法缺乏语义描述，基于语言的方法又与视觉证据关联薄弱，因此需要一种兼顾语义与空间定位的解释性检测方法。

Method: 提出 DF-CBM（区域感知概念瓶颈模型）。首先从文本伪影标注中构建紧凑的伪造相关概念词表，并将每个概念与合理的面部及边界区域相链接；随后利用由解析面部掩码引导的概念特定掩码注意力机制，从视觉特征中预测这些概念；最终的真实/伪造决策基于预测出的概念瓶颈做出。

Result: 实验表明，DF-CBM 在概念预测与深度伪造分类上均优于基于概念的基线方法，同时与最先进的黑盒检测器保持竞争力。定性结果与干预分析进一步显示，DF-CBM 能够提供空间落地的概念证据，并支持关于单个伪造概念如何影响最终预测的反事实解释。

Conclusion: DF-CBM 通过概念瓶颈与区域感知注意力，实现了兼具语义描述与空间定位的可解释深度伪造检测，为取证场景提供了可验证的概念证据与反事实解释能力，代码已开源。

Abstract: Deepfake detection methods have become increasingly effective yet most provide limited insight into the evidence behind their predictions. However, in forensic settings users also need to know which manipulation cues support the decision and where they appear. Existing explainability methods only partially address this need since localization-based approaches lack semantic descriptions while language-based explanation methods are only weakly grounded in visual evidence. In this work, we propose DF-CBM, a region-aware concept bottleneck model for explainable deepfake detection. DF-CBM builds a compact vocabulary of manipulation-related concepts from textual artifact annotations and links each concept to plausible facial and boundary regions. It then predicts these concepts from visual features using a concept-specific masked attention mechanism guided by parsed facial masks and the final real/fake decision is made from the predicted concept bottleneck. Our experiments show that DF-CBM outperforms concept-based baselines in concept prediction and deepfake classification while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art black-box detectors. Finally, qualitative results and intervention analyses demonstrate that DF-CBM provides spatially grounded concept evidence and enables counterfactual explanations of how individual manipulation concepts influence the final prediction. Our code is available at: https://github.com/GeorgeTsoumplekas/DF-CBM.

</details>


### [397] [Style-Driven Data Synthesis and Degradation-Aware Enhancement for Ultrasound Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35120)
*Yu-Kai Wang,Chun-Xin Tan,Manh-Hung Nguyen,Ching-Chun Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出两阶段框架，解决手持低质量超声到医院高质量超声增强中缺乏像素对齐配对数据的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低成本手持超声设备图像存在复合退化，易误导临床判断，因此将手持低质量（LQ）图像映射为医院高质量（HQ）图像具有研究价值。但传统方法需要像素对齐的LQ-HQ配对，而实际不同时间扫描的图像几乎不可能像素对齐，这一要求不切实际。

Method: 提出两阶段框架。第一阶段在未对齐的真实LQ-HQ对上训练循环一致性风格迁移模型，学习HQ到LQ的映射，将真实HQ图像转换为像素对齐的LQ图像，从而生成对齐数据集。第二阶段基于该数据集，利用双退化引导低秩适配（DDG LoRA）方法微调LQ到HQ模型，该模型基于PiSA-SR框架并插入退化条件校正矩阵。

Result: 在USenhance2023数据集上，FID指标相比最强基线提升16.7%，其他指标表明增强输出与真实HQ分布良好对齐。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 两阶段框架无需像素对齐的真实配对即可实现手持超声图像增强，生成的增强结果在分布上与医院高质量图像高度一致，验证了方法的有效性。

Abstract: Low-cost handheld ultrasound devices can be widely deployed compared to professional hospital ultrasound machines. However, their images suffer from compound degradation that can mislead clinical judgment. Motivated by this observation, mapping handheld low-quality (LQ) to hospital high-quality (HQ) images has been considered a valuable research question. Conventionally, the mapping requires pixel-aligned LQ-HQ pairs. This requirement is unsatisfactory in practical scenarios because real scans at different times are never pixel-aligned. This paper addresses the challenge with a two-stage framework. The first stage generates pixel-aligned LQ-HQ datasets, and the second stage trains an enhancement model that improves LQ images. The first stage trains a cycle-consistent style-transfer model on unaligned real LQ-HQ pairs to learn a HQ-to-LQ model. Then, the model transforms real HQ images into pixel-aligned LQ images. Based on the dataset generated by the first stage, the second stage uses the Dual Degradation-Guided (DDG) Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) method to fine-tune an LQ-to-HQ model based on aligned pairs. In this stage, the model is based on the well known PiSA-SR framework but inserts a degradation-conditioned correction matrix. Experimental results on the USenhance2023 dataset show that the FID metric is improved by 16.7% over the strongest baseline while other metrics indicate that our enhanced outputs are well aligned with the real HQ distribution. The source code of our method is available at https://github.com/Jason0411202/DDG_LoRA.

</details>


### [398] [VideoPhysEdit: Physical Counterfactual Video Editing via Rigid-Body Physical Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35134)
*Conghan Yue,Yuanjie Chen,Yue Han,Ya Gao,Yunyan Xiao,WeiYao Zhang,Zhineng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出物理反事实视频编辑（PCVE）任务，并给出免训练流水线 VideoPhysEdit 及配套基准 PCVE-RigidBench 与评价指标 Physical Edit Score。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频编辑方法多关注阴影、遮挡等视觉后果，而对编辑引发的后续运动与交互等物理后果关注不足，且缺乏成对的事实/反事实数据与专门评价指标。

Method: VideoPhysEdit 面向刚体场景，通过物理场景重建方法恢复出在仿真中能重现观测运动与交互的场景，从而使编辑可作为物理干预施加，并利用产生的轨迹引导反事实视频生成；同时构建合成基准 PCVE-RigidBench 并提出 Physical Edit Score。

Result: VideoPhysEdit 的物理编辑准确率显著高于开源方法与商业模型，同时保持有竞争力的视觉保真度；其 Physical Edit Score 为 0.376，是对比方法中唯一为正的分数。真实视频上的定性对比也表明其适用于真实场景，能更好刻画编辑引发的后续运动与交互。

Conclusion: 该工作将视频编辑从视觉后果扩展到物理后果，验证了显式物理推理在反事实视频生成中的有效性，并为该方向提供了基准与评价工具。

Abstract: Video editing has advanced substantially in recent years, with methods increasingly accounting for the visual consequences of edits, such as changes to shadows and occlusions. However, the physical consequences of edits, including changes to subsequent motion and interactions, remain less explored. We formulate this problem as physical counterfactual video editing (PCVE), which aims to generate a counterfactual video depicting the resulting motion and interactions given a source video, a physical edit, and its execution frame. PCVE is challenging because it requires understanding scene physics and inferring the downstream motion and interactions induced by a physical intervention, while paired factual and counterfactual data and dedicated evaluation metrics are lacking. We introduce VideoPhysEdit, a new training-free pipeline for PCVE in rigid-body scenes. It makes physical reasoning explicit through a novel physical scene reconstruction method that recovers a scene reproducing the observed motion and interactions under simulation, enabling the pipeline to apply physical edits as interventions and use the resulting trajectories to guide counterfactual video generation. We further construct PCVE-RigidBench, a synthetic benchmark with paired source and counterfactual target videos and physical ground truth, and introduce the Physical Edit Score. VideoPhysEdit achieves substantially higher physical edit accuracy than open-source methods and commercial models while maintaining competitive visual fidelity. Its Physical Edit Score is 0.376, the only positive score among the compared methods. Qualitative comparisons on real videos further show that VideoPhysEdit applies to real-world scenes and better depicts the downstream motion and interactions induced by the edits than the compared methods. Code: https://github.com/Hammour-steak/VideoPhysEdit

</details>


### [399] [Timeline-Bench: Evaluating Agents on Realistic Video-Editing Tasks, from Raw Footage to Final Cut](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35143)
*Gunin Gupta,Nirmit Arora,Pavan Kalyan Tankala*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Timeline-Bench 基准，含 56 个真实视频剪辑任务，要求智能体将原始素材做成成片。最强智能体仅解决 15/56（26.8%），多数失败仅因质量测试未过。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 智能体越来越多承担长周期专业工作，但现有评测很少要求交付完整的创造性成品。为弥补这一缺口，作者构建了以"完成一支可交付视频"为目标的评测。

Method: 构建 Timeline-Bench：56 个真实视频剪辑任务（选对话镜头、把访谈素材剪成故事、用产品镜头/配音/图形做广告等）。每个任务提供任务简报、源素材、容器和测试集；输出须通过全部测试才算解决。测试涵盖交付格式、内容与简报明确要求，并含一项基于 43 位剪辑师 2,582 次盲评校准的质量测试。评测 16 个智能体，均为前沿模型配 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等编码智能体框架。
