Conclusion: 该框架无需训练即可直接应用于现成 MLLM，通过图像特定的局部证据获取与全局上下文整合，有效提升深度伪造检测准确率并减少解释幻觉，优于现有训练-free 方法。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can explain deepfake verdicts in natural language, but such explanations are not necessarily visually grounded in the visual evidence underlying the prediction. A model may describe plausible artifacts inferred from language priors rather than from image evidence. Existing grounding methods improve visual reliance through decoding or attention interventions, but they generally strengthen grounding over the entire image, making them ill-suited for forensic artifacts that are subtle, spatially localized, and image-dependent. We propose Look Before You Judge, a training-free framework that formulates explainable deepfake detection as a sequential evidence acquisition process. Instead of directly predicting image authenticity from holistic visual reasoning, our framework first identifies image-specific candidate evidence regions by contrasting the MLLM's decoder-to-visual attention between an original image and its Gaussian-blurred counterpart. The identified regions are then inspected individually, and the resulting local evidence is integrated with the global image context before reaching a final verdict. The framework operates without manipulation masks, external forensic models, or parameter updates, making it directly applicable to off-the-shelf MLLMs. Across five open-source MLLMs on TriDF and MMTD-Set, our framework improves detection accuracy by up to 12.8%, reduces CHAIR by up to 33.4% and hallucination rate by up to 21.3%, and outperforms representative training-free decoding and attention methods.

</details>


### [434] [Learning to Reason with Persistent Object States for Video Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35539)
*Yongxue Xu,Boxue Yang,Ziqian Liu,Shaoqiu Zhang,Rui Qian,Haopeng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出POSReasoner，一个可训练、即插即用的框架，通过显式判断何时更新对象状态来缓解视频分割中的身份漂移问题，在长时VOS和VIS基准上取得一致性提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频分割模型依赖跨帧传递实例信息来维持对象身份。但在长时间遮挡、重新出现或相似实例交互时，不可靠的更新可能覆盖有效历史，导致持续的身份漂移。现有方法缺乏对"何时应当更新状态"的显式判断机制。

Method: 提出POSReasoner框架：1）每个持久状态记录身份、置信度和缺席历史；2）构建稀疏的状态-观测图，支持Propose-Verify推理，利用对象历史、预测存在性和身份间竞争来复核临时关联；3）经核验的决策决定对每个状态进行保留、更新、重新激活或抑制；4）学习门控控制写回记忆的证据，仅经核验的转移才更新后续帧使用的持久状态；5）使用标准视频标注，冻结基础模型，可集成多种VOS和VIS架构。

Result: 在长时VOS和VIS基准上相比强基线取得一致性提升，在遮挡和对象重新出现情形下增益最大。

Conclusion: 通过显式推理何时更新对象状态、仅让经核验的转移写入持久记忆，POSReasoner有效缓解了身份漂移，且保持即插即用与基础模型冻结的通用性。

Abstract: Video segmentation models maintain object identities by carrying instance information across frames. Under prolonged occlusion, reappearance, or interactions between similar instances, however, an unreliable update can overwrite a valid history and cause persistent identity drift. We introduce POSReasoner, a trainable, plug-and-play framework that explicitly decides when an observation should change an object's state. Each persistent state records identity, confidence, and absence history. A sparse state-observation graph supports Propose-Verify reasoning: provisional associations are revisited using object history, predicted presence, and competition among identities. The verified decisions determine whether to retain, update, reactivate, or suppress each state, while a learned gate controls the evidence written back to memory. Only verified transitions update the persistent state used in subsequent frames. POSReasoner uses standard video annotations and keeps the base model frozen, enabling integration with diverse VOS and VIS architectures. Experiments across long-term VOS and VIS benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong baselines, with the largest gains under occlusion and object reappearance.

</details>


### [435] [WorldPlay2: Extending Real-Time Interactive World Models in Control and Horizon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35560)
*Haiyu Zhang,Wenqiang Sun,Tengfei Wang,Junta Wu,Jun Zhang,Yunhong Wang,Yu Qiao,Chunchao Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 WorldPlay2，一种交互式世界模型，通过分解式混合控制接口与"压缩记忆+稳定蒸馏"协同设计，兼顾多样化实时控制与长时程一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式世界模型需实时响应多样控制并保持长时程一致性，但异构控制建模困难，上下文爆炸与蒸馏不稳定使长时程一致性与实时响应难以兼得。

Method: 1) 分解式混合控制接口：将帧对齐动作控制与结构化语义控制结合，显式解耦场景外观、角色身份和动态语义事件；2) 将历史上下文压缩为紧凑记忆token，由自回归学生与双向教师共享，实现片段级、记忆条件化的分数评估，降低蒸馏开销；3) 提出 Stable Forcing，用少步策略初始化自回归学生，并利用全 rollout 回放保持长时程质量，实现稳定蒸馏。

Result: 大量实验表明模型具有强泛化能力，且性能优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 分解式控制接口、压缩记忆与稳定蒸馏的协同设计可有效实现兼具长时程一致性与实时响应性的交互式世界模型。

Abstract: Interactive world models require responding in real time to versatile controls and maintaining long-horizon consistency. However, modeling heterogeneous controls remains difficult, while explosive contexts and unstable distillation impede achieving both long-horizon consistency and real-time responsiveness. In this paper, we present WorldPlay2, an interactive world model that couples a factorized hybrid control interface with a co-design of compressed memory and stable distillation. 1) Our factorized hybrid control interface integrates frame-aligned action control with structured semantic control that explicitly disentangles scene appearance, character identity, and dynamic semantic events, thereby facilitating effective control learning. 2) To achieve efficient long-horizon modeling, we compress historical contexts into compact memory tokens shared by the autoregressive student and the bidirectional teacher. This design enables clip-wise, memory-conditioned score evaluation instead of jointly processing an entire long rollout, substantially reducing distillation overhead. 3) We further propose Stable Forcing, which initializes the autoregressive student via a few-step strategy and leverages full-rollout replay to preserve the quality of long-horizon rollouts, ensuring robust and stable distillation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the strong generalizability of our model and its superior performance compared to existing methods.

</details>


### [436] [Revisiting Risky Tackle Detection with Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35562)
*Syed Ahsan Masud Zaidi,Lior Shamir,Scott Dietrich*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文是ICPR 2026一项美式橄榄球危险擒抱检测研究的Track 2可复现性配套论文，公开了工件并将已发表指标追溯到具体脚本与聚合文件，复现出的头部结果与原文四舍五入后一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原文对733段标注视频微调ViViT并报告了危险类召回0.67、F1 0.59，但缺少可追溯的复现证据；本文旨在公开工件、核实这些数字的来源，并检验各增强因素的贡献。

Method: 构建Track 2可复现配套工件，将已发表指标追溯到具体脚本、折输出与聚合文件；复现头部配置run_15（高斯噪声＋静态亮度下降，无旋转、无翻转）；开展消融实验比较亮度、旋转、翻转与噪声的主效应范围，并与无增强设置及C3D基线对比。

Result: 复现头部run_15的折均值危险召回为0.667、危险F1为0.588，与已发表值四舍五入后吻合；消融显示亮度为主因，其危险召回主效应范围0.055，大于旋转、翻转和噪声；无增强时ViViT危险召回0.545，未超过C3D基线的0.583。

Conclusion: 原始结果得到成功复现，亮度增强是性能提升的主导因素。由于原始片段含可识别的学生运动员，不能重新分发，工件改为提供公开样本用于流程检查，并提供受控途径进行全数据审查。

Abstract: This paper is a Track 2 reproducibility companion to an ICPR 2026 study on risky tackle detection in American football prac- tice videos. The original work fine-tuned a Video Vision Transformer (ViViT) on 733 clips labeled with the SATT-3 rubric. It used focal loss, Taguchi L18 augmentation, and 5-fold cross-validation. It reported risky- class recall of 0.67 and risky-class F1 of 0.59. This companion documents the released artifact and traces those numbers to specific scripts, fold out- puts, and aggregation files. The reproduced headline is run_15. It com- bines Gaussian noise with static brightness decrease and uses no rotation and no flip. Its fold-mean risky recall is 0.667 and its fold-mean risky F1 is 0.588. These values match the published headline after rounding. The ablation shows that brightness is the dominant factor. Its risky-recall main-effect range is 0.055, which is larger than the ranges for rotation, flip, and noise. Without augmentation, ViViT reaches risky recall of 0.545 and does not exceed the C3D baseline of 0.583. The raw clips show iden- tifiable student athletes, so they cannot be redistributed. The artifact provides a public sample for pipeline checks and a controlled route for full-data review.

</details>


### [437] [Less Is More: Genetic Frame Selection for Efficient Novel View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35573)
*Diego E. Farchione,Ramzi Idoughi,Alberto Jaspe-Villanueva,Peter Wonka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需渲染的视图选择器，从已采集序列中选出对目标视角重建最有信息量的固定数量视图，通过蒸馏遗传算法搜索，性能超过几何与重建感知基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈新视角合成虽可单次前向重建场景，但输入视图更多不一定更好：冗余或选择不当的帧会增加计算成本，甚至降低重建质量。因此需要从已采集序列中挑选出对指定目标视角最有信息量的固定规模视图子集。

Method: 提出无需渲染的视图选择器，基于三个互补准则对候选帧打分：目标视角覆盖度（用观测帧代替目标进行评估）、与已选视图的冗余度、图像清晰度。轻量评分网络在推理时无需渲染、重建或逐场景优化即可选出信息量最大的帧。训练时蒸馏一个昂贵的离线搜索流程，其中遗传算法通过直接优化训练场景的重建性能来识别高质量子集，选择器仅凭几何与图像级特征学习复现这些选择。

Result: 在六个数据集和多种输入预算下，方法持续优于几何和重建感知的视图选择基线，且选择成本显著低于基于重建的替代方案。精心选择的子集甚至能超过使用完整输入序列的前馈重建。学习到的选择器可泛化到多种重建范式（前馈、3D高斯泼溅、NeRF）、物体定向重建，以及目标视角来自另一次采集的跨采集场景。

Conclusion: 结果表明，显式推理目标相关性与视图间冗余是高效场景重建的关键因素。

Abstract: Feed-forward novel view synthesis reconstructs a scene from many input images in a single forward pass, yet more views do not necessarily improve performance: redundant or poorly chosen frames increase computational cost and may degrade reconstruction quality. We address the problem of selecting, from an already captured sequence, a fixed-size subset of input views that is most informative for reconstructing specified target viewpoints. We propose a render-free view selector that scores candidate frames based on three complementary criteria: target-view coverage, measured against observed frames that stand in for the targets, redundancy with previously selected views, and image sharpness. A lightweight scoring network then selects the most informative frames without rendering, reconstruction, or per-scene optimization at inference time. To train the selector, we distill an expensive offline search procedure in which a genetic algorithm identifies high-quality subsets by directly optimizing reconstruction performance on training scenes. The selector learns to reproduce these choices from geometric and image-level features alone. Across six datasets and multiple input budgets, our method consistently outperforms both geometric and reconstruction-aware view-selection baselines while incurring significantly lower selection costs than reconstruction-based alternatives. Moreover, carefully selected subsets can outperform feed-forward reconstruction from the full input sequence. The learned selector generalizes across diverse reconstruction paradigms (feed-forward, 3D Gaussian Splatting, and NeRF), to object-targeted reconstruction and to a cross-capture setting in which the target views come from a separate acquisition pass. More broadly, our results indicate that explicitly reasoning about target relevance and inter-view redundancy is a fundamental factor in efficient scene reconstruction.

</details>


### [438] [What Paired Evaluations Reveal under Visual Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35583)
*Yongda Wei,Chen Zhang,Yifei Wang,Xinyu Wang,Bosen Shao,Hanxi Li,Liping Di*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了配对评估（同一图像在干净与扰动条件下的预测对应关系）在鲁棒性评估中的价值，涵盖结果解释与物理测试样本优先级排序两方面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鲁棒性评估需覆盖多样视觉扰动，但基准仅涵盖部分真实条件且物理测试昂贵。配对评估通过关联同一图像的干净与扰动预测，能捕捉正确性、置信度与接受度的变化，超越简单的聚合准确率。

Method: 在解释配对评估结果方面，固定两组预测记录并在每个类别内改变其对应关系，证明类别内"正确-正确"计数能为接受的损失与保留正确输入的平均真实类概率下降提供与任何可行五状态细分相同的紧界。在样本优先级方面，保留每张图像的合成响应，并按扰动下的平均真实类概率对干净正确图像排序。

Result: 在44个分类器上，测试风险最高20%的样本，在轻度屏幕与打印翻拍下分别发现67%和45%的失败，而干净置信度方法为58%和36%，等规模自然变换平均为60%和37%。使用概率平均和A3Rank评分适配时，被测扰动集比自然变换集有更高的平均失败召回率；分数间差异取决于来源与预算。

Conclusion: 对应关系的价值取决于评估目标：类别计数足以支撑指定的可靠性界，而图像特定的合成响应能改善被测池中物理测试的分配。

Abstract: Robustness evaluation must examine diverse visual perturbations, while benchmarks cover only some real-world conditions and physical testing is costly. Paired evaluations link clean and perturbed predictions for the same image, capturing changes in correctness, confidence, and acceptance beyond aggregate accuracy. We investigate how this image correspondence supports two needs in robustness evaluation: interpreting paired evaluation results and prioritizing samples for physical testing. To interpret paired evaluation results, we fix both sets of prediction records and vary their correspondence within each class. We prove that classwise correct-correct counts give the same sharp bounds on lost acceptance and mean true-class probability decrease among retained-correct inputs as any feasible five-state refinement. Distinguishing persistent from changed wrong answers can further constrain accepted-error transitions, while shared correspondence can establish policy orderings left unresolved by separate cost intervals. To prioritize samples for physical testing, we retain each image's synthetic responses and rank clean-correct images by their mean true-class probability under corruption. Across 44 classifiers, testing the highest-risk 20% finds 67% and 45% of failures under mild screen and print recaptures, versus 58% and 36% for clean confidence and 60% and 37% for an equal-size natural-transformation average. With both probability averaging and an A3Rank scoring adaptation, the tested corruption set yields higher mean failure recall than the natural-transform set; differences between scores depend on the source and budget. Together, these findings show that the value of correspondence depends on the evaluation objective: classwise counts suffice for specified reliability bounds, while image-specific synthetic responses improve the allocation of physical tests within the evaluated pool.

</details>


### [439] [ReSS: Residual-Restoring Sparse Attention for 3D Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35593)
*Yongsung Kim,Jaehoon Lee,Minjun Park,Wooseok Song,Hun Hwangbo,Sungroh Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ReSS 稀疏注意力方法，用"残差漂移"而非注意力概率来选择保留的块，从而在更高稀疏度下更好保持 3D 视觉变换器的密集性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VGGT 等 3D 视觉变换器在多视图输入上做全局注意力，计算量随视图数增长而急剧上升。现有 SparseVGGT、HeSS 在块级别稀疏化注意力，并以高注意力概率为保留准则。但作者发现注意力概率并不能很好预测移除某块后模型行为的实际变化，这种错配正是稀疏度上升时性能崩溃的原因。

Method: 将块选择问题从"最大化保留的注意力质量"重构为"最小化稀疏化给残差流带来的漂移"。引入漂移分数（drift score）量化每个块对残差的偏移量；由于一个丢弃集合的漂移取决于贡献向量的方向而非仅幅度，进一步提出迭代残差恢复过程，对整体丢弃集合进行细化。

Result: 在三个骨干网络和五个数据集上，ReSS 在相同稀疏度下比此前方法更好地保持密集性能。两项补充结果支持"漂移是决定稀疏化代价的关键量"：最大化漂移比随机选择更快地降低性能；以实际漂移（而非稀疏度）为横轴作图时，各方法近似落在同一条曲线上。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 残差漂移而非注意力概率才是控制稀疏化代价的核心指标，基于漂移的 ReSS 能有效缓解高稀疏度下的性能崩溃。

Abstract: 3D vision transformers such as VGGT predict camera poses and scene geometry from multi-view images in a single forward pass, but their global attention over all concatenated view tokens dominates computation as the number of views grows. To reduce this cost, SparseVGGT and HeSS sparsify attention at the block level, and both retain blocks with high attention probability. However, we observe that attention probability poorly predicts how much the model's behavior actually changes when a block is removed, and we show that this mismatch is why performance collapses as sparsity increases. In this paper, we propose ReSS (ReSidual-ReStoring Sparse Attention), which recasts block selection from a problem of maximizing the retained attention mass to one of minimizing the drift that sparsification leaves in the residual stream. We introduce a drift score that quantifies how much each block shifts the residual, and, since the drift of a drop set depends on the directions of the contribution vectors rather than on their magnitudes alone, an iterative residual restoration procedure that refines the drop set as a whole. Across three backbones and five datasets, ReSS preserves dense performance better than prior methods at matched sparsity. Two further results support drift as the quantity that governs the cost of sparsification: maximizing drift degrades performance faster than random selection, and plotted against realized drift instead of sparsity, all methods fall approximately onto a single curve. Code is available at https://github.com/libary753/ReSS.

</details>


### [440] [Simultaneous Translation between Sign Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35608)
*Zetian Wu,Bowen Xie,Stefan Lee,Liang Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 首次提出同步手语到手语（S2S）翻译系统，支持两种wait-k机制，并引入计算感知延迟指标ca-Stream-AL，在六组S2S方向上实现38%延迟降低而质量损失有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手语到手语翻译系统为离线运行，需完整源视频片段才能输出目标手语，无法满足广播直播、双向视频通话等实时场景对"边打边译"的同步输出需求。

Method: 提出首个同步S2S翻译系统，包含两种wait-k机制：直接对整句模型施加测试时wait-k推理，以及通过随机多路径监督训练的wait-k模型；同时提出计算感知延迟指标ca-Stream-AL。

Result: 在较小的人工验证测试集与较大的合成S2S语料上，六组S2S方向平均结果显示：相比整句基线，ca-Stream-AL降低38%，DTW-PA-MPJPE仅增加9%，BLEU-4仅下降2.1；并通过词序案例研究探讨了同步翻译下的词序错配处理。

Conclusion: 同步S2S翻译可在实时场景中显著降低延迟，同时对翻译质量影响较小；ca-Stream-AL为流式输出提供了计算感知的延迟评估手段，词序错配是同步翻译需关注的问题。

Abstract: Deaf and hard-of-hearing (DHH) signers cannot converse in real time across different sign languages today: existing sign-to-sign translation systems run offline, requiring the full source clip before any target sign is emitted. Live use cases - e.g. broadcast interpretation and two-way video calls - instead demand simultaneous output, while the source signer is still signing. We present, to our knowledge, the first simultaneous sign-to-sign (S2S) translation system, with two wait-k regimes: test-time wait-k inference applied directly to a full-sentence model, and a trained wait-k model via stochastic multi-path supervision. We further introduce ca-Stream-AL, a computation-aware latency metric for streaming output. Averaged across six S2S directions on both a smaller human-verified test set and a larger synthetic S2S corpus, our streaming system achieves a 38% ca-Stream-AL reduction while staying within a 9% DTW-PA-MPJPE increase and a 2.1 BLEU-4 drop compared to the full-sentence baseline. A word-order case study probes how the streaming model handles word order mismatch between different sign languages - a consequence of simultaneous translation.

</details>


### [441] [On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multi-Turn Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35611)
*Liangbing Zhao,Le Zhuo,Mohamed Elhoseiny*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对迭代式图像编辑中存在的训练-测试条件分布不匹配问题，提出在线策略自蒸馏框架MT-OPSD，并构建长程编辑基准LME-Bench，显著提升多轮编辑鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于指令的图像编辑模型在单轮任务中表现优异，但实际编辑常为迭代式的，每一轮指令作用于上一轮输出。作者发现现有模型在递归编辑下性能迅速退化，并将该失败归因于条件分布的训练-测试不匹配：模型在干净的源图像上训练，却在推理时反复以自身不完美的输出作为条件。因此需要一种无需多轮标注即可缓解该问题的方法及评测长程鲁棒性的基准。

Method: 提出MT-OPSD（在线策略自蒸馏框架），在模型自身生成的条件下进行训练，并由干净条件教师提供编辑监督，无需多轮标注数据。同时构建LME-Bench基准，包含100个十轮编辑会话，用于评估长程编辑的鲁棒性。

Result: 在三种编辑骨干模型上的实验表明，MT-OPSD显著提升了长程编辑的成功率，减少了多轮编辑崩溃现象，同时基本保持了单轮编辑的质量。

Conclusion: 通过在线策略自蒸馏使模型适应自身生成的条件状态，可有效缓解递归编辑中的训练-测试不匹配，为长程迭代式图像编辑提供了可行的解决方案，并配合LME-Bench为相关研究提供评测基准。

Abstract: Instruction-based image editing has achieved strong performance in single-turn settings, yet practical editing is often iterative, with each instruction applied to the output of the previous turn. We find that existing editing models degrade rapidly under recursive editing and attribute this failure to a train-test mismatch in the conditioning distribution: models are trained on clean source images but must repeatedly condition on their own imperfect outputs at inference time. To address this, we propose MT-OPSD, an on-policy self-distillation framework that trains the model on self-generated conditioning states with editing supervision from a clean-conditioned teacher, without requiring multi-turn annotations. We further introduce LME-Bench, a benchmark of 100 ten-turn editing sessions for evaluating long-horizon robustness. Experiments across three editing backbones show that MT-OPSD substantially improves long-horizon editing success and reduces multi-turn collapse while largely preserving single-turn editing quality.

</details>


### [442] [Remote Sensing Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting via Depth Image-Based Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35612)
*Jiaming Kang,Zhengxia Zou,Zhenwei Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 DIBR-GS 框架，利用 DIBR 生成伪视图做跨视图一致性监督，在仅 3 个输入视图的稀疏观测下显著提升遥感新视图合成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏观测下的遥感新视图合成缺乏几何约束与跨视图监督，现有 NeRF 与 3DGS 方法容易过拟合，并面临深度歧义、跨视图信息缺失以及欠观测区域约束不足等问题。

Method: 1) 将单目深度先验与稀疏 SfM 重建对齐，构建可靠几何初始化；2) 将跨视图外观先验引入神经高斯表示以增强稀疏观测下的外观建模；3) 提出渐进式基于 DIBR 的伪视图监督策略，提供额外几何与外观约束，重建弱观测区域；4) 设计高度约束锚点生长策略，抑制不合理的高斯扩展。

Result: 仅用 3 个输入视图训练时性能优于现有方法：相比此前最佳方法 PSNR 提升 6.83 dB，SSIM 相对提升 14%，LPIPS 相对提升 60%，并保持有竞争力的计算效率。

Conclusion: DIBR-GS 通过 DIBR 伪视图监督与几何、外观先验结合，有效缓解稀疏观测下的过拟合与约束不足问题，在遥感新视图合成任务上取得领先效果，代码已开源。

Abstract: Remote sensing novel view synthesis under sparse observations remains challenging due to insufficient geometric constraints and limited cross-view supervision. Existing Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods are prone to overfitting and face challenges of depth ambiguities, missing cross-view information, and insufficient constraints in under-observed regions. To address these challenges, we propose DIBR-GS, a neural Gaussian Splatting framework that exploits Depth Image-Based Rendering (DIBR) to generate pseudo views for cross-view consistency supervision. Specifically, reliable geometric initialization is constructed by aligning monocular depth priors with sparse SfM reconstruction, and cross-view appearance priors are incorporated into neural Gaussian representations to enhance appearance modeling under sparse observations. Furthermore, we introduce a progressive DIBR-based pseudo-view supervision strategy to provide additional geometric and appearance constraints, enabling more complete reconstruction of weakly observed regions. In addition, a height-constrained anchor growth strategy is designed to suppress unreasonable Gaussian expansion. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance over existing approaches when training with only 3 input views. Compared with the previous best-performing method, it improves PSNR by 6.83 dB, with relative gains of 14\% in SSIM and 60\% in LPIPS, while maintaining competitive computational efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/kanehub/DIBR-GS

</details>


### [443] [EvolvingAvatar: Interactive 3D Head Generation That Adapts as Conversations Unfold](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35616)
*Junjie Chen,Fei Wang,Kun Li,Yiqi Nie,Xun Yang,Yanbin Hao,Linfeng Zhang,Meng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EvolvingAvatar，一个通过测试时训练适应用户面部视频和双人音频的因果式3D头部生成器，并发布InterHead-Bench基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D头部生成器虽将输入观测作为上下文，但参数保持固定，未能把对话模式用作学习信号。交互式生成需要能响应演变对话的说话与倾听协同运动。

Method: 采用测试时训练，在交互过程中适应用户面部视频和双人音频。其双人上下文预测目标从视听上下文提供自监督学习信号，无需测试时目标运动标签。持久快速权重在每段对话中累积更新以指导运动生成，瞬态下颌适应响应当前视听上下文，预测的语音活动控制持久适应如何引导运动。

Result: 构建了InterHead-Bench统一基准，包含单视角与双视角对话视频，共455.95小时。实验显示对话运动统计优于强基线；在最难的分布外划分上，随着对话推进生成质量提升，与录制的用户-化身表情统计不匹配度从第一个区间起最多降低11.1%。

Conclusion: 测试时自适应与双人上下文自监督结合可有效提升交互式3D头部生成的对话运动质量，并随对话推进持续改进。

Abstract: Interactive 3D head generation requires coordinated speaking and listening motion that responds to an evolving conversation. Existing generators use incoming observations as context but keep their parameters fixed, leaving conversational patterns unused as a learning signal. We introduce EvolvingAvatar, a causal generator that uses test-time training to adapt to user face video and dyadic audio during interaction. Its dyadic context prediction objective provides a self-supervised learning signal from audiovisual context without target motion labels at test time. Persistent fast weights accumulate these updates within each conversation to guide motion generation, while transient jaw adaptation responds to current audiovisual context. Predicted speech activity controls how persistent adaptation guides motion. We also introduce InterHead-Bench, a unified 455.95-hour benchmark built from single-view and dual-view conversation videos. Experiments show improved conversational motion statistics over strong baselines. On the hardest out-of-distribution split, generation improves as conversations unfold, reducing mismatch with recorded user-avatar expression statistics by up to 11.1% from the first interval.

</details>


### [444] [RT-Super: Learning Tumor Segmentation from Longitudinal Images and Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35637)
*Pedro R. A. S. Bassi,Wenxuan Li,Hanxue Gu,Jieneng Chen,Xinze Zhou,Zheren Zhu,Sezgin Er,Ibrahim E. Hamamci,Bjoern H. Menze,Gulhan E. Akan,Kang Wang,Yang Yang,Alan L. Yuille,Zongwei Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RT-Super架构，利用放射报告和纵向、多期图像替代肿瘤分割掩码进行训练，可在无掩码情况下分割食管、子宫、脾脏肿瘤并超越公开AI模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肿瘤分割掩码获取昂贵、耗时，且许多肿瘤类型在公开数据中缺乏掩码，而医院拥有大量易得的放射报告、纵向图像和多期图像数据可用于指导分割。

Method: RT-Super包含教师网络和学生网络：教师网络分析患者的纵向图像与报告生成高质量肿瘤掩码；学生网络仅看单张图像、无报告，用教师生成的掩码训练。采用新型CNN-Transformer架构，并设计一致性损失，利用纵向图像间肿瘤位置的一致性。

Result: 在食管、子宫和脾脏肿瘤上训练，这些肿瘤几乎或完全没有公开掩码。即使没有训练掩码，RT-Super也能分割这些肿瘤并超越公开AI模型。

Conclusion: 从纵向图像、多期图像和报告中学习可以克服掩码稀缺问题，推动多癌种检测与分割。代码已开源。

Abstract: Multi-tumor segmentation is important for early cancer detection and allows radiologists to visualize, verify, and understand AI predictions. However, tumor segmentation masks are expensive, time-consuming, and unavailable for many tumor types in public data. Instead, hospitals have vast, readily available data that can guide segmentation: radiology reports, longitudinal images, and multi-phase images. We use this readily available data to substitute for tumor masks in training AI for tumor segmentation. To this end, we propose a new architecture, RT-Super. It has a teacher network, which analyzes the patient's longitudinal images and reports to create high-quality tumor masks. These masks train a student network, which sees a single image and no report. At inference, when longitudinal images and reports are unavailable, we use the student. RT-Super uses a new CNN-Transformer architecture and novel Consistency Losses that exploit tumor location consistency across longitudinal images. We train RT-Super to segment esophagus, uterus and spleen tumors, which have few or no public masks. Even without training masks, RT-Super can segment these tumors and surpass public AI models. Overall, we demonstrate that learning from longitudinal images, multi-phase images, and reports can overcome mask scarcity and advance multi-cancer detection and segmentation. Code: https://github.com/MrGiovanni/RT-Super

</details>


### [445] [Many Eyes, One World: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Mixed Cameras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35658)
*Qiaoge Li,Yifan Zhan,Haijun Yang,Haiyang Liu,Yiyi Cai,Chenchi Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MEOW是一个前馈系统，仅凭图像即可从单个N视图混合相机元组中联合重建度量点图和相机位姿，覆盖透视、鱼眼和360°全景图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实场景采集具有异构性，透视、鱼眼和360°全景图像常共存于同一重建任务中，但现有前馈3D重建模型多假设透视图像和统一输入表示；能处理多种相机的模型要么需要每视图相机类型信息，要么每次只重建一对图像，尚无单次前向方法能从图像重建含全景的混合相机元组。

Method: 将异构相机重建视为数据适应问题而非架构重设计。MEOW保留透视预训练主干网络，通过程序化数据引擎完全从数据中学习异构相机：该引擎在连续相机模型流形上渲染每个场景，提供精确光线与深度，并为每个相机采样的训练元组验证共视性。训练仅使用合成元组，无需标定、畸变参数、相机类型标签或位姿。

Result: 在异构2D3DS元组上达到79.9 mAA@30，而Wid3R在已知每视图相机类型时为53.8；在激光扫描混合相机基准上，每个四视图混合元组均以79.4 AUC@30完成配准。合成训练实现了对真实采集的零样本迁移。

Conclusion: MEOW证明了将异构相机重建作为数据适应问题的有效性，实现了单次前向、无需相机先验的混合相机重建，并取得显著优于现有方法的性能。数据引擎、基准和完整评估流程将公开。

Abstract: Real-world capture is heterogeneous: perspective, fisheye, and $360^\circ$ panoramic images can coexist within a single reconstruction task, yet most feed-forward 3D reconstruction models assume perspective imagery and a uniform input representation. Recent models handling several camera types are either informed of the camera type for each view or reconstruct one image pair at a time. No single-pass method reconstructs mixed-camera tuples containing full panoramas from images alone. We present MEOW, a feed-forward system that jointly reconstructs metric pointmaps and camera poses from one N-view tuple mixing perspective, fisheye and full-panorama images, in a single forward pass from images alone: no calibration, distortion parameters, camera-type labels or poses are supplied for any view. Our guiding design philosophy is to treat heterogeneous-camera reconstruction as a data-adaptation problem rather than an architectural redesign. MEOW retains a perspective-pretrained backbone and learns heterogeneous cameras entirely from a procedural data engine, which renders each scene across a continuous manifold of camera models with exact rays and depth, and certifies covisibility for every camera-sampled training tuple. Trained on synthetic tuples only, MEOW transfers zero-shot to real captures: on heterogeneous 2D3DS tuples it achieves 79.9 mAA@30 against 53.8 for Wid3R given the camera type of every view; on our laser-scanned mixed-camera benchmark it registers every four-view mixed tuple with 79.4 AUC@30. The data engine, benchmark, and complete evaluation pipeline will be released.

</details>


### [446] [FlowTool: Controlling Tool Parameter in Image Retouching via Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35673)
*Thanh-Long V. Le,Steven Walton,Seunghyun Yoon,Branislav Kveton,Trung Bui,Eunho Yang,Viet Lai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FlowTool，将基于工具的图像编辑建模为条件校正流(flow matching)问题，用条件生成替代自回归推理，在多个基准上取得更强性能且推理效率大幅提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于工具的图像编辑通常采用自回归多模态大语言模型，顺序生成推理、工具选择与参数值，效率低且推理链冗长。作者希望探索是否可以在不进行自回归推理的情况下，直接对高质量工具参数的分布进行条件建模。

Method: FlowTool结合视觉语言模型骨干（多模态理解）与Diffusion Transformer参数生成器，使用条件校正流将高斯噪声变换为编辑方案；训练采用两阶段监督式流匹配课程，随后进行基于奖励的后训练。

Result: 在MMArt-Bench、FlowTool-Eval、ArtEdit-Bench和MIT-Adobe5K上，FlowTool的参考型(reference-based)性能显著优于专用MLLM编辑智能体和商用MLLM，在无参考评测中也具竞争力；延迟至少降低50倍，内存占用约为对比基线的1/2。

Conclusion: 基于工具的图像编辑可有效建模为对结构化连续编辑参数的条件生成问题，无需自回归推理。

Abstract: Tool-based image editing (image retouching) is commonly formulated with autoregressive multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that sequentially generate reasoning, tool selections, and parameter values. In this work, we present a novel approach to tool-based image editing by framing the task as a flow matching problem. We introduce FlowTool, a framework that directly models the distribution of high-quality tool parameters conditioned on the input image and user instruction using conditional rectified flow. FlowTool combines a vision-language model backbone for multimodal understanding with a Diffusion Transformer parameter generator that transforms Gaussian noise into an editing plan. We train FlowTool with a two-stage supervised flow-matching curriculum, followed by reward-based post-training. Across MMArt-Bench, FlowTool-Eval, ArtEdit-Bench, and MIT-Adobe5K, FlowTool achieves significantly stronger reference-based performance than specialized MLLM editing agents and proprietary MLLMs, while remaining competitive with proprietary models under reference-free evaluation. Moreover, FlowTool significantly improves inference efficiency, reducing latency by at least $50\times$ while requiring nearly $2\times$ less memory than the compared baselines. These results demonstrate that tool-based image editing can be effectively modeled as conditional generation over structured continuous editing parameters, without autoregressive reasoning.

</details>


### [447] [DynaTokens: Teaching Dynamics to Camera-Controlled Video Models at Test Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35704)
*Ma Ziqi,Chen Hongqiao,Gkioxari Georgia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DynaTokens提出一组轻量级可学习场景专属token，通过交叉注意力为已有的相机控制世界模型注入场景动态，在冻结基础模型的前提下实现相机与动态的联合控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成包含相机运动与场景动态两种运动来源，理想模型应同时支持二者。但现有相机控制模型在动态场景中表现不佳：物体静止、运动错误或质量下降。作者观察到两种运动存在结构不对称性——相机运动全局影响视图，而物体动态是空间局部的，这一不对称启发了新方法。

Method: 提出DynaTokens，一组轻量可学习的场景专属token。保持基础模型冻结，仅从少量示例轨迹中通过交叉注意力训练这些token，随后可在新的查询相机路径下同时生成场景动态。与LoRA、块微调及专门可训练层基线进行对比。

Result: 在VBench2和WorldScore评估中，DynaTokens在动态-相机权衡上优于LoRA、块微调和专门可训练层基线。token注意力分析、消融实验和运动时序研究进一步表明，将可训练接口与学习目标的结构相匹配对有效适配很关键。

Conclusion: 通过匹配可训练接口与学习目标结构（利用相机运动全局性与动态局部性的不对称），以少量场景专属token即可为冻结的相机控制世界模型有效注入动态，实现相机与动态的联合可控生成。

Abstract: Video generation must account for two sources of motion, one induced by the observer's camera path and the other caused by scene dynamics. An ideal camera-controlled video model should account for both motions: let users move the camera while evolving the scene dynamics. While current models handle camera-induced motion well in static settings, they struggle for dynamic scenes: objects are static, move incorrectly, or degrade in generation quality. We introduce DynaTokens, a lightweight set of learnable scene-specific tokens that teach dynamics to an existing camera-controlled world model. Our method is motivated by a simple asymmetry between the two sources of motion: whereas camera motion affects the generated view globally, object dynamics are spatially localized. Through cross-attention, DynaTokens trains the learnable tokens from a few example trajectories for a scene while keeping the base model frozen, and enables dynamics under new query camera paths. DynaTokens achieves a better simultaneous dynamics-camera tradeoff on VBench2 and WorldScore evaluations than LoRA, block finetuning, and specialized trainable-layer baselines. Analyses of token attention, ablations, and motion temporality suggest that matching the trainable interface to the structure of the learning target is important for effective adaptation. Project website: https://glab-caltech.github.io/dynatokens/

</details>


### [448] [Mind the RefGAP: Correcting Reference Attention in Diffusion-Based Visual Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35708)
*Yanan Wang,Shengcai Liao,Guangyi Liu,Xiaodan Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RefGAP，一种无需训练的校正方法，通过在前向传播中在线测量参考注意力质量来动态调整logit偏移，增强参考引导扩散编辑器对用户参考的使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参考引导的扩散编辑器难以忠实复现用户提供的参考，作者发现潜在瓶颈在于许多方法对参考的注意力分配有限（如LoomVideo中编辑区域查询对参考的注意力质量不足1%）。

Method: RefGAP在每个层根据前向传播中测得的参考注意力质量在线确定logit偏移幅度：对参考logit施加正偏移以增强编辑区域查询对参考的使用，对保留区域查询施加负偏移以限制编辑外的参考相关变化；仅用两个全局系数控制校正，在四个开发用扩散编辑器的验证数据上选定后固定不变。

Result: 在七个基于扩散的图像/视频编辑器上，RefGAP提升了换头与换脸中的身份保真度，并实现了与分别调优的常量编辑侧偏置相当的保真度-保留权衡，且无需针对每种方法进行强度扫描；在虚拟试穿和背景替换上的额外实验评估了其超越身份编辑的迁移性。

Conclusion: RefGAP通过简单的全局系数控制在多层在线调整参考注意力，无需逐方法调参即可提升参考保真度，并展现出向其他编辑任务的迁移潜力。

Abstract: Reference-guided diffusion editors struggle to faithfully reproduce user-provided references. We identify a potential bottleneck in diffusion editors: many methods provide limited reference-attention allocation. For example, in LoomVideo, edit-region queries assign less than 1% of their attention mass to the reference. We introduce RefGAP, a training-free correction that determines logit-offset magnitudes online at each layer from the reference-attention mass measured during the forward pass. Positive offsets to reference logits strengthen reference usage by edit-region queries, while negative offsets for keep-region queries limit reference-induced changes outside the edit. Two global coefficients control the correction; they are selected once on validation data from four development diffusion editors and held fixed. Across seven diffusion-based image/video editors, RefGAP improves identity fidelity in head swapping and face swapping. RefGAP achieves a fidelity-preservation trade-off comparable to separately tuned constant edit-side biases, without per-approach strength sweeps. Additional experiments on virtual try-on and background replacement evaluate transfer beyond identity editing.

</details>


### [449] [Lagrangian--Hamiltonian Flows for Video Prediction and Image Generation: A Symplectic Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35710)
*Jiawei Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LHFM是一个基于辛几何与几何量子化的图像动力学学习框架，将图像表示为精确拉格朗日图，用哈密顿流建模演化，在视频预测中实现低算力高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望借鉴经典力学、辛几何和几何量子化中的结构，为图像动力学学习提供一个统一的几何框架，并将其应用于确定性视频预测和流匹配任务。

Method: LHFM将每张图像表示为一个精确拉格朗日图，通过图像依赖的哈密顿流建模其演化，得到图像速度的传输—源（transport–source）参数化。基于此提出循环模型LHFM-V（积分预测的传输场和源场以推进帧）以及适配流匹配的图像变体LHFM-I。

Result: LHFM-V在同类精度的循环模型中取得了最低的FLOP数；LHFM-I在匹配实验中FID低于流匹配基线。

Conclusion: 该几何框架能同时支持循环式视频预测与流匹配生成，显示出效率与生成质量方面的优势。

Abstract: We introduce LHFM, a geometric framework for learning image dynamics. Drawing on structures central to classical mechanics, symplectic geometry, and geometric quantization, LHFM represents each image as an exact Lagrangian graph and models its evolution through image-dependent Hamiltonian flows, which yield a transport--source parameterization of image velocities. Our primary application is deterministic video prediction: LHFM-V is a recurrent model that advances frames by integrating predicted transport and source fields, and achieves the lowest reported FLOP count among the compared recurrent models with similar prediction accuracy. The image variant, LHFM-I, shows that the same construction is compatible with flow matching: in a matched experiment, it attains a lower FID than the flow-matching baseline.

</details>


### [450] [Hard Vision, Easy Vision: What GPT-6 Astra Reveals Across Computer Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35718)
*Hanoona Rasheed,Mohammed Irfan Kurpath,Bin Ren,Hisham Cholakkal,Fahad Shahbaz Khan,Salman Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了GPT-6 Astra与五款前沿通用AI系统在计算机视觉九大领域、34项能力、55个基准上的表现，发现语义理解与推理类任务已接近专用模型和人类水平，而度量几何精度、忠实重建、时序一致稠密预测和细粒度视觉知识仍是难点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿通用系统正从视觉理解扩展至传统上由专用计算机视觉模型处理的能力，计算机视觉社区需要明确这种扩展的边界在哪里、哪些任务仍然困难。

Method: 对GPT-6 Astra及五款前沿通用AI系统进行大规模评测，覆盖计算机视觉九大领域、34项能力和55个基准，并在有合适参考的情况下与专用模型和人类表现进行对比；同时考察额外推理与专用工具对性能缺口的弥补效果。

Result: Astra展现出广泛的视觉能力，在视觉与空间推理及多种结构化预测上较其他前沿系统有明显提升。总体上，语义解释、推理和以物体为中心的预测已接近或达到参考水平；而需要度量几何精度、忠实重建、时序一致稠密预测或专门细粒度视觉知识的任务仍存在较大差距。额外推理与专用工具可弥补部分缺口，但收益因能力而异。

Conclusion: 计算机视觉格局正在变化：日益复杂的视觉任务可通过通用接口完成，但精确且对保真度敏感的感觉仍是重要前沿方向。

Abstract: Frontier general-purpose systems are rapidly expanding beyond visual understanding into capabilities traditionally handled by dedicated computer-vision models. As these capabilities expand, a central question for the computer-vision community is how far this reach extends, and what remains hard. We evaluate GPT-6 Astra alongside five frontier general-purpose AI systems across 34 capabilities and 55 benchmarks spanning nine areas of computer vision. We compare their performance with dedicated models and humans where suitable references are available. Astra demonstrates broad visual capability, with substantial gains over other frontier systems in visual and spatial reasoning and several forms of structured prediction. Across the state-of-the-art systems, a consistent pattern emerges. Capabilities involving semantic interpretation, reasoning, and object-centric prediction increasingly approach or reach available reference levels. In contrast, larger gaps remain when tasks require metric geometric accuracy, faithful reconstruction, temporally consistent dense prediction, or specialized fine-grained visual knowledge. Additional reasoning and specialist tools close selected gaps, but their benefits vary across capabilities. These results map a changing landscape of computer vision in which increasingly sophisticated visual tasks are accessible through a general-purpose interface, while precise and fidelity-sensitive perception remains an important frontier.

</details>


### [451] [Superquadric Primitive Decomposition of 3D point clouds via Geometric-Aware Inlier Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35725)
*Alessandro Rinaldi,Edoardo Tedesco,Andrea Ferraris,Filippo Leveni,Daniele Baieri,Filippo Maggioli,Simone Melzi,Luca Magri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出几何感知的超二次曲面图元分解框架，用图割优化进行内点精炼，融合法向一致性等几何先验，提升精度、鲁棒性与收敛效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D点云分解为可解释几何图元是长期难题；超二次曲面虽紧凑且表达力强，但其估计是非线性优化问题，对噪声、外点和重叠结构敏感。RANSAC类鲁棒方法主要依赖空间邻近性与残差准则，在相邻或复杂图元排布下易产生错误内点分配。

Method: 提出几何感知的图元分解框架，将局部表面属性显式引入拟合过程。核心是内点精炼步骤，建模为能量最小化问题并用图割优化求解；该公式融合法向一致性等几何先验，实现超越纯残差准则的内点选择，可自然适用于单模型估计与多模型分解。

Result: 在合成与真实数据集上的实验表明，相比最先进的RANSAC类方法，本方法在几何精度、对噪声与外点的鲁棒性以及收敛效率方面均有稳定提升。

Conclusion: 通过利用点级残差之外的几何信息，方法减少了错误内点的传播并稳定了参数估计，为超二次曲面图元分解提供了更可靠的方案。

Abstract: The decomposition of 3D point clouds into interpretable geometric primitives remains a longstanding challenge in Computer Vision and Computer Graphics. Among the available representations, superquadrics offer a compact and expressive model capable of capturing a wide range of shapes. However, their estimation is inherently challenging, as it requires solving a non-linear optimization problem and is particularly sensitive to noise, outliers, and overlapping structures. While robust estimation methods such as RANSAC and its variants achieve strong performance, they rely primarily on spatial proximity and residual-based criteria, often leading to incorrect inlier assignments across adjacent or complex arrangements of primitives. In this work, we introduce a geometric-aware framework for primitive decomposition that explicitly incorporates local surface properties into the fitting process. Specifically, we propose an inlier refinement step formulated as an energy minimization problem and solved via graph-cut optimization. Our formulation integrates geometric priors, such as normal consistency, enabling more reliable inlier selection beyond purely residual-based criteria. The approach naturally applies to both single-model estimation and multi-model decomposition. By leveraging geometric information beyond point-wise residuals, our method reduces erroneous inlier propagation and stabilizes parameter estimation. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets show consistent improvements in geometric accuracy, robustness to noise and outliers, and convergence efficiency compared to state-of-the-art RANSAC-based methods.

</details>


### [452] [Impact of Patient Orientation in Single- and Multi-View Camera Environments for AI-based Rehabilitation Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35726)
*Miriama Jánošová,Andreas Lang,Petra Budikova,Jan Sedmidubsky*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出REHAB26-ViewAngles数据集与可分性度量，系统评估不同相机角度下RGB姿态估计策略对康复动作质量评估的影响，发现优化2D视角与双视角融合能显著提升判别能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 康复动作质量的自动评估依赖准确的姿态估计，但相机摆放位置对检测临床相关动作错误的影响尚缺乏深入研究，现存RGB姿态估计方法多为单一视角且未考虑角度因素。

Method: 构建包含正确与错误康复动作、覆盖多相机角度的REHAB26-ViewAngles数据集；提出新的可分性度量量化算法区分有效与错误动作重复的能力；对比分析单相机2D/3D估计以及四种多相机策略：两个正交2D视角组合、3D三角测量、加权3D融合和基于AI的双同步相机姿态估计Transformer模型。

Result: 优化摆放的2D相机相比常用的0°正面视角可分性提升16.9%，且常优于单相机3D估计；结合两个视角可进一步提升准确率最多13.1%。

Conclusion: 研究结果为家庭与临床场景中康复监测的相机部署提供了实用指导，强调了视角选择与多视角融合在动作质量评估中的重要性。

Abstract: Automated quality assessment of rehabilitation exercises relies heavily on accurate human pose estimation from video data. Although numerous RGB-based pose estimation methods have been proposed, the impact of camera placement on detecting clinically relevant movement errors remains insufficiently explored. To address this gap, we introduce REHAB26-ViewAngles, a dataset comprising correct and incorrect rehabilitation exercise executions captured from a wide range of camera angles. Furthermore, we propose a novel separability metric to quantify an algorithm's ability to distinguish between valid and faulty exercise repetitions. Using these tools, we analyze how various RGB-based pose-estimation strategies are suitable for exercise quality assessment under varying camera placements. In particular, we analyze single-camera 2D and 3D pose estimation and four multi-camera strategies: a combination of two orthogonal 2D views, 3D triangulation, weighted 3D fusion, and an AI-based pose-estimation transformer model specifically trained from two synchronized cameras. Our findings reveal that an optimally placed 2D camera can improve the separability by 16.9\,\% over the commonly used $0^\circ$ frontal view and frequently outperforms single-camera 3D estimation, while combining two views can further improve accuracy by up to 13.1\,\%. These results offer practical guidance for deploying rehabilitation monitoring in both home and clinical settings.

</details>


### [453] [FlowAct-R2: Beyond Talking Avatar via Streaming Multimodal References and Proactive Agent Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35728)
*Ziyao Huang,Zhengkun Rong,Shiyang Qin,Shuang Liang,Wentao Hu,Yuxuan Luo,Yuan Zhang,Mingyuan Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlowAct-R2是一个交互式人形视频生成框架，结合连续多模态控制与主动智能体规划，支持实时720p生成和小时级流式传输。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实现交互式人形视频生成需要同时解决两个问题：连续的多模态控制（如动作、音频、动态参考）以及智能体在直播场景中的主动规划与实时响应能力。现有方法难以在保持外观一致性的同时支持长时间流式生成，也难以自主调度行为并应对观众互动与中断。

Method: 方法由两个耦合组件构成。第一，流式多模态参考扩散Transformer：将预训练的Seedance 2.0 Mini参考到视频骨干网络改造成可接受滚动动作提示、流式音频以及动态更新的图像、音频、视频参考。采用视频驱动的旋转位置嵌入将参考块与生成时间线对齐，并通过参考加图像条件以及部分加噪的历史运动帧来保持外观并避免累积漂移。第二，主动交互智能体：将上线前规划与在线调度和响应分离，提前准备人设、长时程议程和可复用多模态技能，然后在直播过程中自主调度行为、响应观众输入并处理中断。

Result: FlowAct-R2支持实时720p生成和小时级流式传输，适用于娱乐直播、直播带货、视频聊天和直播vlog等场景。

Conclusion: FlowAct-R2通过结合流式多模态参考扩散Transformer与主动交互智能体，在保持外观一致性和防止漂移的同时，实现了具备实时、长时程流式能力的交互式人形视频生成，适用于多种直播与互动场景。

Abstract: We present FlowAct-R2, a framework for interactive humanoid video generation that combines continuous multimodal control with proactive agent planning. Our method consists of two coupled components. First, a Streaming Multimodal Reference Diffusion Transformer adapts the pretrained Seedance 2.0 Mini reference-to-video backbone to accept rolling action prompts, streaming audio, and dynamically updated image, audio, and video references. Video-driven rotary positional embeddings align reference chunks with the generation timeline, while reference-plus-image conditioning and partially noised historical motion frames preserve appearance and avoid accumulated drift. Second, a Proactive Interaction Agent separates pre-online planning from online scheduling and response: it prepares a persona, a long-horizon agenda, and reusable multimodal skills in advance, then autonomously schedules behaviors, responds to audience input, and handles interruptions during a live session. FlowAct-R2 supports real-time 720p generation and hour-scale streaming across entertainment streaming, live shopping, video chatting, and live vlogging.

</details>


### [454] [GeoVerse: World-Consistent Novel View Synthesis in Geometric Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35734)
*Kerui Ren,Tao Lu,Linning Xu,Changjian Jiang,Mu Huang,Chunhua Shen,Mulin Yu,Bo Dai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 GeoVerse 框架，在预训练3D基础模型的几何潜空间中完成生成，同时注入视频生成模型的表观先验，并借助全局空间记忆保证跨视角一致性，实现稀疏图像下世界一致的新视角合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏图像新视角合成需同时兼顾已观测区域的忠实重建与未观测区域的合理补全，并保持跨视角的世界一致性。几何类方法能保留观测结构但难以补全未见区域；视频生成模型具备丰富的表观先验，却在逐视角生成中不断累积不一致性。

Method: GeoVerse 从预训练的 Wan2.2 VACE 视频生成模型中提取多层级特征，通过 ControlNet 风格的适配器注入到几何潜空间扩散模型中，以视频学习到的表观先验增强结构补全；同时引入全局空间记忆，持续聚合已观测与已合成内容，并将对齐目标的引导重投影，从而把后续预测锚定在共享的场景表示上。

Result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明视觉质量与几何一致性均有提升：相比 GLD，在 DL3DV 上 PSNR 高出 2.23 dB，在 Mip-NeRF360 上 ATE 降低 32.4%。

Conclusion: GeoVerse 通过在几何潜空间中进行生成并融合视频表观先验与全局空间记忆，有效结合了结构保真与内容补全，实现了世界一致的稀疏视角新视角合成。

Abstract: Novel view synthesis from sparse images must reconcile faithful reconstruction of observed regions with plausible completion of unseen content, while maintaining world consistency across viewpoints. Existing geometry-based methods preserve observed scene structure but often struggle to complete unseen regions, whereas video generative models offer rich appearance priors but accumulate inconsistencies during sequential view generation. We propose GeoVerse, a framework that synthesizes world-consistent novel views by performing generation within the geometric latent space of a pretrained 3D foundation model and injecting appearance priors from a video generative model. Specifically, GeoVerse extracts multilevel features from Wan2.2 VACE and injects them into the geometric latent diffusion model via a ControlNet-style adapter, incorporating video-learned appearance priors to enhance structural completion. To enforce cross-view coherence, a global spatial memory continuously aggregates observed and synthesized content, reprojecting target-aligned guidance to anchor subsequent predictions to a shared scene representation. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate improved visual quality and geometric consistency, with a 2.23 dB higher PSNR on DL3DV and 32.4% lower ATE on Mip-NeRF360 compared to GLD.

</details>


### [455] [InfiniHand: Streaming World-Space Hand Motion Estimation from Egocentric Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35743)
*Kerui Ren,Kaiwen Song,Weiguang Zhao,Yuxi Wang,Yufei Liu,Bo Dai,Haoyu Guo,Chunhua Shen,Mulin Yu,Tao Lu,Junting Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: InfiniHand 是一个端到端流式前馈框架，可直接从无标定的第一人称视频中联合估计 MANO 手部参数、相机轨迹与手部世界坐标位置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界坐标系手部运动估计方法依赖级联的独立手部姿态估计器与 SLAM 系统，导致误差累积、流程复杂且计算开销大。

Method: 提出 InfiniHand，将持久时空记忆与以手为中心的视觉特征结合，在统一架构中显式耦合相机运动与局部手部几何；采用两阶段渐进训练（先学习稳健的相机空间手部先验，再扩展到流式世界空间重建）；并聚合约 5000 小时多数据集第一人称数据作为预训练语料。

Result: 在域内基准上优于 SOTA，相比 ViDiHand 在 ARCTIC PA-p 上降低 21.4%，显著缓解世界空间漂移；可稳健泛化到野外视频，运行速度 11.19 FPS，吞吐量超过 HaWoR 两倍以上。

Conclusion: InfiniHand 以端到端流式方式实现了高效、精确且泛化良好的世界空间手部运动估计，克服了级联式管线的误差累积与高开销问题。

Abstract: World-space hand motion estimation from egocentric video requires recovering 3D articulated hand geometry while tracking camera egomotion. Existing approaches heavily rely on cascading independent hand pose estimators and SLAM systems, resulting in error accumulation, complex pipelines, and severe computational overhead. To address these limitations, we present InfiniHand, an end-to-end streaming feed-forward framework that jointly estimates MANO parameters, camera trajectories, and hand locations directly from uncalibrated egocentric video. InfiniHand integrates persistent spatiotemporal memory with hand-centered visual features, explicitly coupling camera motion with local hand geometry within a unified architecture. We train InfiniHand in two progressive stages by first learning robust camera-space hand priors and then extending to streaming world-space reconstruction. To support this process, we aggregate a pretraining corpus of approximately 5,000 hours of egocentric data across multiple public datasets. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that InfiniHand outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on in-domain benchmarks, achieving a 21.4% reduction in ARCTIC PA-p compared to ViDiHand while substantially mitigating world-space drift. Furthermore, InfiniHand generalizes robustly to in-the-wild videos and operates at 11.19 FPS, delivering more than twice the throughput of HaWoR.

</details>


### [456] [Copy the Same, Distill the Difference: Initializing Linear Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35745)
*Huaiyuan Qin,Muli Yang,Gabriel James Goenawan,Shiqi Huang,Min Kass Chong,Wahyu Wiratama,Peng Hu,Chen Gong,Wu Liu,Xi Peng,Chun Jian Ho,Hongyuan Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文探究线性ViT能否复用Softmax ViT预训练权重，发现MLP权重可直接复制、注意力需蒸馏，二者结合可缩小甚至超越Softmax ViT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性ViT虽效率更高，但需从头预训练且性能通常不及Softmax版本，如何高效有效地初始化线性ViT尚不清楚。作者希望探究能否让线性ViT受益于主流Softmax ViT的预训练权重。

Method: 作者分别考察注意力权重与MLP权重的跨算子迁移性：尝试直接复制注意力权重进行Softmax到线性的迁移，并采用适当的损失设计对注意力的token路由行为进行蒸馏；同时分析MLP权重的直接复制效果。

Result: 注意力权重是算子特有的，直接复制几乎无益甚至不如随机初始化；通过蒸馏可恢复其token路由行为，使线性ViT缩小差距甚至持平。MLP权重是算子无关的，直接复制即能带来预训练权重的大部分收益。结合MLP复制与注意力蒸馏后，线性ViT进一步弥补差距甚至超越Softmax版本。该结论在多种线性ViT变体、不同模型规模和数据集上均成立。

Conclusion: 研究深化了对跨注意力算子复用预训练权重的理解：保持不变的直接复制，存在差异的进行蒸馏，从而在Softmax到线性的边界上恢复预训练收益。

Abstract: Linear Vision Transformers (ViTs) are designed to replace the attention in Softmax ViTs with the linear-complexity attention operator for more efficient token routing, but they require from-scratch pre-training and typically underperform the original Softmax version. How to initialize linear ViTs both efficiently and effectively still remains unclear. In this work, we explicitly ask: given that most foundation ViTs are built on the mainstream Softmax attention, can linear ViTs benefit from their pre-trained weights? Recent works on Attention Transfer show that attention is the effective transferable component between Softmax ViTs, suggesting attention alone suffices for such reuse. However, we find the opposite for Softmax-to-linear transfer. The attention weights are operator-specific: copying them barely helps, and is sometimes even worse than random initialization. Instead, the attention's token routing behavior can be recovered through distillation with a proper loss design, letting linear ViTs reduce the gap and even match Softmax ones. In contrast, the MLP weights, which carry the learned representation, are operator-agnostic: they can be transferred by simple direct copying, which already carries most of the benefit of the pre-trained weights. Thus, copying MLPs can serve as an effective foundation for Softmax-to-linear transfer: paired with the distilled attention, linear ViTs eventually close the remaining gap and even surpass Softmax ones. These findings hold consistently across various linear ViT variants, different model sizes, and diverse datasets. We hope this study deepens the understanding of reusing pre-trained weights across attention operators: copy what stays the same and distill what differs, to recover the benefit across the Softmax-to-linear boundary.

</details>


### [457] [Reliability-Gated Fusion of Consumer Head and Foot IMUs for Lower-Body 3D Pose](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35764)
*Zhilin Guo,Boqiao Zhang,Oszkár Urbán,Josef Bengtson,Hakan Aktas,Wenzhao Li,Siyu Hong,Kyle Fogarty,Chenliang Zhou,Ali Senguel,Cengiz Oztireli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出通道级可靠性门控的稀疏惯性位姿估计方法，在含耳机头IMU与智能鞋垫足IMU的新基准上，通过学习每流每通道的信任度显著提升精度与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 消费级传感器不可靠：固件融合的姿态有偏、佩戴方式随会话变化、数据流漂移或丢包。作者希望解决稀疏惯性动作捕捉中的可靠性问题，而非简单增加传感器数量。

Method: 构建35段单受试者基准（耳机头IMU+两只智能鞋垫足IMU，SAM-3D-Body伪真值）。通过通道消融发现足部加速度信息量最大，而固件融合的足部姿态是拖累项。方法为每个流的每个通道块设置一个时间门控，并在合成损坏的预训练数据上用辅助可靠性目标训练。

Result: 通道门控模型在干净数据上最准（69.4 mm，对比静态83.7、无门控86.6），在所有模拟故障下均最优；门控在无测试监督下自动抑制原生有偏的足部姿态通道，并以0.92-0.999 AUROC标记丢包。对比：先验丢弃通道在足部故障下持平，但未预料流失败时崩溃（头部丢包92.9 vs 79.3 mm）；微调HMD-Poser干净数据更准（64.4 mm），但最坏情况退化更大（+16.1 vs +3.5 mm）。

Conclusion: 学习可靠性门控（而非依赖传感器数量）是实现可部署稀疏惯性捕捉的关键手段。

Abstract: Sparse inertial pose estimation promises camera-free motion capture from consumer devices, but consumer sensors are unreliable: firmware-fused orientations are biased, mounting varies between sessions, and streams drift or drop out. On a new 35-take single-subject benchmark pairing an earbud head inertial measurement unit (IMU) with two smart-insole foot IMUs (SAM-3D-Body pseudo-ground-truth labels), we show the reliability problem is channel-level: a channel ablation isolates foot acceleration as the most informative input (66.6 mm vs. 79.0 mm head-only) and the firmware-fused foot orientation as the liability that destroys the gain. We therefore let the model learn how much to trust each channel of each stream: one temporal gate per stream per channel block, trained with an auxiliary reliability objective on synthetically corrupted pretraining data. The channel-gated model is the most accurate of our learned fusion arms on clean data (69.4 mm vs. 83.7 static, 86.6 ungated) and under every simulated fault (bias in training; drift, dropout eval-only); its gates suppress the natively biased foot-orientation channels on clean real data without test-time supervision and flag dropout bursts at 0.92-0.999 AUROC. Two contrasts: dropping a channel known a priori to fail is flat across foot faults but collapses when an unanticipated stream fails (head dropout: 92.9 vs. 79.3 mm); and a fine-tuned HMD-Poser is more accurate on clean data (64.4 mm) and nominally under drift, with no significant paired difference under bias or dropout, but a larger worst-case degradation from clean (+16.1 vs. +3.5 mm, single seed). Learning to gate reliability instead of sensor count is the lever for deployable sparse inertial capture. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhilinGuo/reliability-gated-imu-fusion.

</details>


### [458] [Learning Native Reflection in Unified Models with Interleaved Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35767)
*Yijia Fan,Ziqi Huang,Zhongang Cai,Yan Li,Zimo Wen,Wanqi Yin,Haiwen Diao,Ziwei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 UMM-Reflection，用强化学习在统一多模态模型内部完成"反思—修订"闭环，使反思文本与图像生成联合优化，在无需外部验证器的情况下显著提升图像生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一多模态模型本可"看"与"画"，理论上能自我修复生成结果：诊断问题、修订、观察再诊断。但修订是否有效只有渲染后才能知道，因此反思文本与图像生成必须对整个闭环联合学习。现有方法存在不足：SFT 冷启动无法找到高成功率的修复路径；朴素 RL 只优化渲染器或单个头，收益有限。

Method: 提出 UMM-Reflection，在单一统一模型内用 RL 完成反思轨迹。兄弟轨迹共享同一初始图像，组相对优势用于比较不同反思策略；单条轨迹级优势同时更新反思 token 与基于流的修订，避免逐轮信用分配的组合爆炸。信用跨轮次流动并覆盖同一模型的两个角色，推理时无需验证器。

Result: 在 BAGEL 上，UMM-Reflection 相比 SFT 将 GenEval 提升 12.05 分；增益可迁移到未参与训练的 WISE（+10.97）、OneIG-Bench（+3.48）和 T2I-CompBench++（+4.63）。

Conclusion: 将反思与渲染联合、并在闭环中进行 RL 训练，能有效提升统一多模态模型的自我修复与生成能力，且具备良好的泛化性，无需外部验证器。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models can both look at and render images, so in principle they can repair their own generations: diagnose what an image gets wrong, revise it, observe the result, and diagnose again. Whether a revision helps is known only after it is rendered, so the reflection text and the image generation must be learned jointly, over the whole loop. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on reflection trajectories gives a cold start but does not find the high-success repair paths, and naive RL that optimizes only the renderer or only one head leaves most of the gain untapped. We introduce UMM-Reflection, which applies reinforcement learning (RL) to complete reflection trajectories inside one unified model: sibling trajectories share one initial image, so the group-relative advantage compares reflection strategies, and one trajectory-level advantage updates both the reflection tokens and the flow-based revisions, avoiding the combinatorial blow-up of per-round credit assignment. Unlike single-round editing or pipelines with an external critic, credit flows across rounds and to both roles of the same model, and no verifier is needed at inference. On BAGEL, UMM-Reflection improves GenEval by 12.05 points over SFT, and the gains transfer to WISE (+10.97), OneIG-Bench (+3.48), and T2I-CompBench++ (+4.63), none of which is used in training.

</details>


### [459] [PDMD: Projected Distribution Matching Distillation for Video Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35768)
*Zimo Wang,Junkun Yuan,Angtian Wang,Haotian Yang,Canyu Zhang,Siyuan Yuan,Xingchang Huang,Bo Liu,Yizhi Wang,Yiding Yang,Chongyang Ma,Gordon Guocheng Qian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PDMD，通过对DMD更新与残差的投影过滤critic误差，稳定少步视频扩散蒸馏训练，仅需一行代码改动即在视频与音视频生成上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代视频扩散模型需大量去噪评估（NFE高），DMD虽将NFE降至个位数，但采样质量在训练中退化，出现过度饱和与伪影。作者追溯该不稳定源于critic误差，其进入学生更新并随时间累积。

Method: 提出Projected Distribution Matching Distillation (PDMD)，将DMD更新中平行于学生-critic端点残差的分量投影剔除，从而过滤critic误差。在固定噪声查询下证明该残差是critic端点误差的无偏估计；在高维假设下，该投影去除恒定比例的critic误差，仅丢弃可忽略的理想DMD信号。实现上仅需一行代码改动，无额外损失、网络、数据、模型前向或多阶段训练。

Result: 投影稳定了训练并提升样本质量。Wan2.1上4 NFE的VBench总分83.73，超过对齐DMD 1.03分；MiniMax-H3音视频联合生成上VideoGen-Eval视觉总分83.17，比最强蒸馏基线高0.41分；在对比的4-NFE模型中六项音频指标均最佳；定性比较与用户研究在视觉质量、运动和音频质量上均偏好PDMD。

Conclusion: PDMD是一种轻量且有效的DMD误差过滤方法，能稳定少步视频扩散蒸馏训练并提升生成质量，代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Modern video diffusion models require tens of denoising evaluations over long spatiotemporal token sequences. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) reduces the number of function evaluations (NFE) to just a few. However, DMD samples can degrade during training, exhibiting progressive oversaturation and artifacts. We trace this instability to critic errors, which enter successive student updates and accumulate over time. We introduce Projected Distribution Matching Distillation (PDMD) to filter critic errors. PDMD projects out the component of the DMD update parallel to the student-critic endpoint residual. At a fixed noisy query, we prove that this residual is an unbiased estimate of the critic's endpoint error. Under high-dimensional assumptions, this projection removes a constant fraction of critic error while discarding only a vanishing fraction of ideal DMD signal. Empirically, the projection stabilizes training and improves sample quality where DMD degrades and develops unnatural textures. PDMD requires only a one-line code change to DMD, with no extra loss, network, data, model pass, or multi-stage training. With Wan2.1, PDMD achieves a VBench total score of 83.73 at 4 NFE, surpassing matched DMD by 1.03 points. On MiniMax-H3 joint video-audio generation, PDMD achieves a VideoGen-Eval visual total score of 83.17, 0.41 points above the strongest distilled baseline. PDMD also achieves the best performance on all six audio metrics among the compared 4-NFE models. Qualitative comparisons and user studies favor PDMD over the distilled baselines in visual quality, motion, and audio quality. Code and models are available at https://pdmd2026.github.io/.

</details>


### [460] [FurE: Efficient Instance-Specific 3D Fur Reconstruction without Animal-Fur Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35770)
*Srinjay Sarkar,Prakhar Kaushik,Soumava Paul,Alan Yuille*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FurE方法，通过优化根条件隐场并结合PCA解码器，从多视图图像高效重建可编辑的逐股动物毛发。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动物毛发重建面临细节精细、自遮挡与模糊、缺乏动物毛发数据集等困难，且毛发覆盖体表大部分、物种间与物种内差异大，现有方法难以兼顾效率与保真度。

Method: 采用根条件（root-conditioned）隐场优化，经基于PCA的解码器生成毛发股几何；利用表面约束的高斯Frosting表示中局部毛厚线索结合部件先验重建去毛动物身体；并借助从人类头发数据学到的PCA解码器缓解动物数据稀缺并加速优化。

Result: 在毛发股训练上相比当前SOTA的密集逐股优化实现10倍加速，同时保持毛发股保真度，并在合成与真实序列上均具备泛化能力，定量与定性验证支持该结论。

Conclusion: FurE在显著缩短训练时间的同时实现了高效、可编辑的动物毛发重建，证明了跨域（人类头发）先验在动物毛发任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Realistic and editable animal fur reconstruction from multi-view images is challenging due to fine-scale detail, self-occlusion and obfuscation, and, unlike human hair, the lack of animal-fur datasets. Fur usually covers most of an animal's body, with large inter-species and intra-species variability. We present FurE, an efficient strand-based animal fur reconstruction method that recovers a per-strand, editable groom by optimizing a root-conditioned latent field, decoded into strand geometry via a PCA-based decoder. We reconstruct a defurred animal body using local fur-thickness cues from a surface-constrained Gaussian Frosting representation together with part-based priors. We further show that a PCA-based decoder learned from human-hair strand data can alleviate animal-data scarcity while enabling substantially faster optimization. FurE achieves a 10x speedup in strand training over current SOTA dense per-strand optimization while retaining strand fidelity and generalizing across synthetic and real-world sequences, with quantitative and qualitative validation despite the reduction in training time.

</details>
